"}}},{"verse_id":207766,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa: a(n)mirat bachan anahadh sabadh a(n)mirat dhirasaT nivaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohra: Meditating on unstruck melodious Divine Word, the sight and utterances of Guru Amar Das Ji, started showering elixir of life. "}}},{"verse_id":207767,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥","translit_en":"mil a(n)mirat a(n)mirat bhe satigur amar pragaas ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting Guru Angad Dev Ji, elixir-like cool, tranquil and granter of emancipation, Satgur Amar Das too became the same."}}},{"verse_id":207768,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਛੰਦ: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਮਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"chha(n)dh: satigur amar pragaas taas charanaamirat paavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Channt: Satgur Amar Das Ji who is light refulgent, whosoever partakes nectar-like wash of his feet, "}}},{"verse_id":207769,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaam naam nihakaam param padh sahaj samaavai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becomes free from all desires is absorbed in high state of spirituality and equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":207770,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)dh suga(n)dh saadh sa(n)gat nij aasan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the fragrance of Naam Simran of Guru Amar Das Ji, the Guru's obedient seeker finds stability in the company of holy men and Lord's devotees"}}},{"verse_id":207771,"page_no":null,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਨ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat dhirasaT nivaas a(n)mirat mukh bachan pragaasan ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the elixir-like vision of Guru Amar Das lies the nectar of life and his words provide elixir-like luminance of Naam of the Lord. (4)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41030,"next":41032}}
files.shabads/82/41032.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41032,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207772","verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":207772,"last_verse_id":207779,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207772,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ॥","translit_en":"soraThaa: brahamaasan bisraam gur bhe gurmukh sa(n)dh mil ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sorath: Satguru who resides in Waheguru (Brahm), meeting such Guru-conscious person (Guru Amar Das), and becoming one with him he too acquired all traits of Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":207773,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh ramataa raam raam naam gurmukh bhe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Through the blessings of Naam Simran of the principal Guru Satguru (Amar Das Ji), Guru Ram Das Ji too became prime Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":207774,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਹਰਾ: ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਿਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥","translit_en":"dheharaa: gur bhe gurmukh sa(n)idh mil brahamaasan bisraam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohra: In the association of prime Guru (Guru Amar Das Ji) he too became Guru and found refuge in the holy feet of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":207775,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥","translit_en":"raam naam gurmukh bhe gurmukh ramataa raam ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru-conscious person whose name is Ram Das, by perpetual meditation on Lord's name, became Guru-oriented and virtuous (Satguru)"}}},{"verse_id":207776,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਛੰਦ: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"chha(n)dh: gurmukh ramataa raam naam gurmukh pragaTaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Channt: Through God-conscious Guru Amar Das Ji and by the blessing of meditation on His name, the virtuous Ram Das emerged as Guru Ram Das (slave of the Lord). "}}},{"verse_id":207777,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਹਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat gur giaan dhiaan gur guroo kahaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of knowledge of Guru Shabad and consciously uniting with Him, Guru Ram Das became known as principal Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":207778,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰ ॥","translit_en":"dheep jot mil dheep jot jagamag a(n)tar ur ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The flame of a beacon lights up another lamp. "}}},{"verse_id":207779,"page_no":null,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਮਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"gurmukh ramataa raam sa(n)dh gurmukh mil bhe gur ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus Guru Ram Das became principal Guru through the blessings of Simran of Lord's name and his association with Guru Amar Das Ji. (5)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41031,"next":41033}}
files.shabads/82/41033.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41033,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207780","verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":207780,"last_verse_id":207787,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207780,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਫਲ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"soraThaa: aadh a(n)t bisamaadh fal dhraum gur sikh sa(n)dh gat ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sorath: Just as the puzzle of seed and tree as to who came first is strange and perplexing, similarly strange is understanding the meeting of Guru and Sikh. "}}},{"verse_id":207781,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"aadh param paramaadh a(n)t ana(n)t na jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This mystery of the beginning and end is beyond comprehension. Lord is beyond, away and infinite. "}}},{"verse_id":207782,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਫਲ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa: fal dhraum gur sikh sa(n)dh gat aadh a(n)t bisamaadh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohra: Guru Ram Das caused the meeting of Guru and Sikh in the same wondrous way of fruit and tree. "}}},{"verse_id":207783,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)t ana(n)t na jaaneeaai aadh param paramaadh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That perspective is infinite and no one can understand it. It is beyond, away and still away out of the reach of mortals. "}}},{"verse_id":207784,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਨਾਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"chha(n)dh: aadh param paramaadh naadh mil naadh sabadh dhun ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Channt: Just as the sound of musical instruments melds with the words (of song/hymns), similarly Guru Ram Das and Guru Arjan became indistinguishable."}}},{"verse_id":207785,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲਹਿ ਸਲਿਲ ਸਮਾਇ ਨਾਦ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੁਨਿ ॥","translit_en":"salileh salil samai naadh saritaa saagar sun ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the river water becomes inseparable from the water of the ocean, Guru Arjan became one with Guru Amar Das by engrossing himself in his precepts and following them obediently. "}}},{"verse_id":207786,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਹੋਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਰਜਨ ॥","translit_en":"narapat sut nirap hot jot gurmukh gun garajan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as son of a king becomes king, similarly Guru Arjan born as son to Guru Ram Das became an enlightened soul by singing the eulogies of Lord-a boon blessed to him by Satguru. "}}},{"verse_id":207787,"page_no":null,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜਨ ॥੬॥","translit_en":"raam naam parasaadh bhe gur te gur arajan ||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the grace of Guru Ram Das, Arjan Dev succeeded him as Guru Arjan Dev. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41032,"next":41034}}
files.shabads/82/41034.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41034,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207788","verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":207788,"last_verse_id":207795,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207788,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੁਇ ॥","translit_en":"soraThaa: pooran braham bibek aapaa aap pragaas hui ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sorath: Being supreme conscious and knowledgeable; it seems God Himself has descended as light divine in the form of Guru Hargobind. "}}},{"verse_id":207789,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"naam dhoi prabh ek gur gobi(n)dh bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One may hold them (Guru Hargobind) and Gobind different due to their names, but in reality, God Himself has appeared in the form of Hargobind. "}}},{"verse_id":207790,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa: aapaa aap pragaas hoi pooran braham bibek ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohra: Guru Hargobind the enlightened is manifest of Lord. He is granter of spiritual knowledge. "}}},{"verse_id":207791,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ॥","translit_en":"gur gobi(n)dh bakhaaneeaai naam dhoi prabh ek ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru and Gobind are just two separate names, but in reality it is Lord Himself who is manifest. "}}},{"verse_id":207792,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਛੰਦ: ਨਾਮ ਦੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਠਹਰਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"chha(n)dh: naam dhoi prabh ek Tek gurmukh Thaharaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Channt: Guru and Gobind though are two different names, in reality He himself is refulgent"}}},{"verse_id":207793,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ਦੁਤੀਅ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਡਾਈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh bhe gur naam dhuteea gobi(n)dh baddaiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sikhs ever in attendance of Guru has this strong belief that, first He was called Guru Arjan and then he gave this honour of Guruship to Hargobind."}}},{"verse_id":207794,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਨ ॥","translit_en":"har gur har gobi(n)dh rachan rach thaap uthaapan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God Lord is Guru Arjan Himself and then He Himself became Hargobind."}}},{"verse_id":207795,"page_no":null,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਆਪਾ ਆਪਨ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"pooran braham bibek pragaT hui aapaa aapan ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Omnipotent Lord who created the cosmos, established it and has singular authority of destroying it; it seems He Himself has taken the form of Hargobind to reveal all knowledge about Himself. (7)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41033,"next":41035}}
files.shabads/82/41035.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41035,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207796","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":207796,"last_verse_id":207796,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207796,"page_no":null,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਰਠਾ: ਬਿਸਮਾਦਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਅਸਚਰਜਹਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਗਤਿ ॥ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਭਏ ॥","translit_en":"soraThaa: bisamaadheh bisamaadh asacharajeh asacharaj gat || aadh purakh paramaadh adhabhut paramadhabhut bhe ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sorath: God-manifest Satguru's play is ecstatic and blissful, astonishing beyond astonishment, unimaginably wondrous, and amazing beyond perception. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41034,"next":41036}}
files.shabads/82/41036.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41036,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207797","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":207797,"last_verse_id":207797,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207797,"page_no":null,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਅਸਚਰਜਹਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਭਏ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ॥","translit_en":"dhoharaa: asacharajeh asacharaj gat bisamaadheh bisamaadh || adhabhut paramadhabhut bhe aadh purakh paramaadh ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dohra: (Describing the essence of the Guru), we have reached the high stage of magnificence and ecstaticisim. I have reached this stage of transcendence by seeing the magnificence of the Lord, who is the beginning of the cosmos and beyond."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41035,"next":41037}}
files.shabads/82/41037.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41037,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207799","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207798,"last_verse_id":207801,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207798,"page_no":null,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਅਗੋਚਰ ॥","translit_en":"chha(n)dh: aadh purakh paramaadh savaiaadh ras ga(n)dh agochar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Channt: Primordial Lord (God) has no beginning. He is beyond and still farther. He is free of such mundane worldly pleasures like taste, desires and fragrances. "}}},{"verse_id":207799,"page_no":null,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਮਨੋਚਰ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas asaparas surat mat sabadh manochar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is beyond vision, touch, reach of mind, intelligence and words. "}}},{"verse_id":207800,"page_no":null,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖੇ ਨਹੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥","translit_en":"log bedh gat giaan lakhe nahee alakh abhevaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The imperceptible and unattached Lord cannot be known by study of Vedas and through other earthly knowledge. "}}},{"verse_id":207801,"page_no":null,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"net net kar namo namo nam satigur dhevaa ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Satguru who is embodiment of Lord and inhabits His divine radiance is infinite. Thus, he is worthy of salutation and obeisance in all the three times-past, present and future. (8)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41036,"next":41038}}
files.shabads/82/41038.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41038,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207802","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207802,"last_verse_id":207805,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207802,"page_no":null,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਧ ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਧ ਰਹੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਰਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dhekhat hee sudh kee na sudh rahee budh kee na budh rahee mat mai na mat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A glimpse of (Satguru) left me bereft of all my consciousness, senses, intelligence, cleverness and all other considered wisdom of the world. "}}},{"verse_id":207803,"page_no":null,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿਔ ਧਯਾਨ ਮੈਂ ਨ ਧਯਾਨ ਰਹਯੋ ਗਯਾਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਰਹਯੋ ਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"surat mai na suratiaau dhayaan mai(n) na dhayaan rahayo gayaan mai na gayaan rahayo gat mai na gat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I lost my awareness, attachment of mind with insignificant matters, desires to acquire base or futile ego inflating knowledge and other worldly predicaments. "}}},{"verse_id":207804,"page_no":null,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਧੀਰਜ ਕੋ ਧੀਰਜ ਗਰਬ ਕੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਯੋ ਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਤਿ ਰਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheeraj ko dheeraj garab ko garab gayo rat mai na rat rahee pat rat pat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My patience was lost and so was my vanity. There was no life in me and I was bereft of my existence even. "}}},{"verse_id":207805,"page_no":null,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਅਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੫॥","translit_en":"adhabhut paramadhabhut bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj at at hai ||25||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glimpse of Satguru is capable of amazing one with wondrous feelings. These are astonishing and marvellous and there is no end to this amazement. (9)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41037,"next":41039}}
files.shabads/82/41039.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41039,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207806","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207806,"last_verse_id":207809,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207806,"page_no":null,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਦਸਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਕੇ ਸਮਾਨ ਕੌਨ ਭੌਨ ਕਹੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਤੇ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"dhasam sathaan ke samaan kauan bhauan kaho gurmukh paavai su te anat na paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What other place of mystic abode can I say than the tenth concealed opening of a human being? Only the Guru conscious person can reach it by the grace of True Guru by meditating on His name. "}}},{"verse_id":207807,"page_no":null,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਟੰਤਰ ਦੀਜੈ ਕੌਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਦਯਾ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹੀ ਤਾਹੀ ਬਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"aunamanee jot paTa(n)tar dheejai kauan jot dhayaa kai dhikhaavai jaahee taahee ban aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What light can be equated with the radiance one receives at the time of spiritual enlightenment? "}}},{"verse_id":207808,"page_no":null,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਸਮਸਰ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਕੌਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"anahadh naadh samasar naadh baadh kauan sree guroo sunaavai jaeh soiee liv laaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What melodious musical sound can be equal to the melodious unstruck musical sound of divine word? "}}},{"verse_id":207809,"page_no":null,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"nijhar apaar dhaar tul na a(n)mirat ras apiau peeaavai jaeh taahee mai samaaviee ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is no other elixir capable of making one immortal than the one that flows perpetually in the concealed opening (Dasam Duar) of a human being. And one who is blessed by the True Guru (Satguru) to receive this elixir of immortality obtains it by His grace. (10)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41038,"next":41040}}
files.shabads/82/41040.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41040,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207810","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207810,"last_verse_id":207813,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207810,"page_no":null,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਇਤ ਤੇ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਤ ਜਾਇ ਠਹਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees it te ula(n)gh ut jai Thaharaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting with Guru, a Sikh receives the Lord's word to meditate upon and by his untiring and resolute efforts become one with Him. He frees himself from the worldly matters and lives in harmony in the realm of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":207811,"page_no":null,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੂੰਦ ਪੇਖੈ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਓੁਨਮਨੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"charam dhirasaT moo(n)dh pekhai dhib dhirasaT kai jagamag jot ounamanee sudh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He shuts his eyes from mundane worldly attractions and lives in the spiritual wisdom that helps him feel His presence in everything. "}}},{"verse_id":207812,"page_no":null,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਕੋਚਤ ਹੀ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੋਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਪਰੈ ਅਨਹਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"surat sa(n)kochat hee bajar kapaaT khol naadh baadh parai anahat liv laaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Weaning his thoughts away from the worldly attractions, his doors of ignorance are opened; he is distracted from all sources of worldly pleasures and he gets engrossed in listening to celestial songs and music. "}}},{"verse_id":207813,"page_no":null,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਬਚਨ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਆਵਈ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"bachan bisarajit an ras rahit hui nijhar apaar dhaar apiau peeaaviee ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Renouncing the worldly matters and shedding all attachment with worldly pleasures, he drinks deep the elixir that flows continuously in his (Dasam Duar) the celestial door of the body. (11)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41039,"next":41041}}
files.shabads/82/41041.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41041,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207814","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207814,"last_verse_id":207817,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207814,"page_no":null,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau an ras bas tau lau nahee prem ras jau lau aan dhiaan aap aap nahee dhekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So long a human being remains absorbed in worldly attractions and pleasures, he cannot know love. So long his attention is focused on something else, he cannot realize self. "}}},{"verse_id":207815,"page_no":null,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਅਧਯਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬਿਸੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau aan giaan tau lau na adhayaatam giaan jau lau naadh baadh na anaahadh bisekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(Renouncing Lord) as long as one is busy acquiring knowledge of mundane worldly things, he remains bereft of spiritual wisdom. As long as one remains involved in worldly pleasures one cannot hear the unstruck celestial music of divine word."}}},{"verse_id":207816,"page_no":null,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਨ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਅਲਖ ਨ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau aha(n) budh sudh hoi na a(n)taragat jau lau na lakhaavai tau lau alakh na lekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As long as one remains proud and arrogant, one cannot realise self. Till such time True Guru does not initiate a person with the boon of Lord's name and propitiate the Lord, one cannot realise the 'formless God'. "}}},{"verse_id":207817,"page_no":null,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਭੇਖੀਐ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam sat gur giaan dhiaan ek hee anek mek ek ek bhekheeaai ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The knowledge of Almighty lies in the consecrating words of the True Guru that leads one to reality of His name and form. By uniting his mind with His name, the Lord who prevails in various forms gets revealed. (12)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41040,"next":41042}}
files.shabads/82/41042.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41042,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207818","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207818,"last_verse_id":207821,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207818,"page_no":null,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸੀਂਚਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਹਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naanaa misaTaan paan bahu bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh see(n)chat sarab ras rasanaa kahaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Tongue that enjoys many forms of sweet and savoury foods, drinks and is relisher of all the tastes is called gustation. Eyes see good and bad, beautiful and ugly and is therefore known as vision power. "}}},{"verse_id":207819,"page_no":null,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਅਮਿਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat liv giaan dhiaan simaran amit baddaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ears for their ability to hear all sorts of sounds, melodies etc. are called hearing power. With the use of all these faculties, one obtains knowledge of various things, focuses one's mind in meaningful thoughts and earns worldly respect. "}}},{"verse_id":207820,"page_no":null,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਅਉ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal surat asaparas aau raag naadh budh bal bachan bibek Tek paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The skin brings awareness of things through touch. Enjoyment of music and songs, intellect, strength, speech and dependence on discrimination is the boon of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":207821,"page_no":null,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਬੋਲਤ ਮਧੁਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥","translit_en":"gurmat satinaam simarat safal hui bolat madhur dhun sun sukhadhaiee hai ||13||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But all these senses of knowledge are useful if a person obtains the boon of Guru's wisdom, dwells his mind in the name of the Immortal Lord and sings the sweet paeans of me Lord's name. Such tune and melody of His name is bestower of bliss and happiness. (13)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41041,"next":41043}}
files.shabads/82/41043.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41043,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207822","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207822,"last_verse_id":207825,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207822,"page_no":null,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਹੁਇ ਪਤੰਗ ਸੰਗਮ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras bas hui pata(n)g sa(n)gam na jaanai bireh bichhoh meen hui na mar jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In order to become one with my dear beloved, I, a deceitful lover, not possessed by his love, did not learn from a mot how to die in separation from him, nor did I learn from fish how to die in the separation of beloved. "}}},{"verse_id":207823,"page_no":null,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਚਰਨ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਠਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan jot mai na hui jotee saroop charan bimukh hoi praan Thahiraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And here I am who is not making any effort to merge in my Lord by keeping his refulgence in my heart; and yet with all this recalcitrance, I am alive. "}}},{"verse_id":207824,"page_no":null,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਬਿਰਹ ਜਾਨੀ ਮੀਨ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੇਖਤ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mil bichharat gat prem na bireh jaanee meen aau pata(n)g moh dhekhat lajaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I have not understood the intensity of love and consequence of death as is in the case of a moth and flame or fish and water, and therefore both moth and fish feel ashamed of my; fraudulent love. "}}},{"verse_id":207825,"page_no":null,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ  ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਨਰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"maanas janam dhirag dha(n)n hai tiragadh jon  kapaT saneh dheh narak na maane hai ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being a deceitful friend, my human life is damnable, whereas the reptilian species are worth appreciation for their love of their beloveds like the moth and fish. Because of my fraudulent love I will not even get a place in hell. (14)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41042,"next":41044}}
files.shabads/82/41044.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41044,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207826","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207826,"last_verse_id":207829,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207826,"page_no":null,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਅਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਿਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal savaiaadh bisamaadh at akath kathaa binodh kahit na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The spiritual happiness of a devout Sikh of Guru who meditates on Lord's name, the bliss and his spiritual happiness is wonderful beyond explanation. "}}},{"verse_id":207827,"page_no":null,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਗੰਧ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਸੀਤਲ ਕੋਮਲ ਪਰਸਤ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmakh sukh fal ga(n)dh paramadhabhut seetal komal parasat ban aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The peace and joy of a Guru-conscious person diffuses wonderful fragrance. Its tranquility and softness can only be realised when it is relished. There is no limit of the divine peace and wisdom of such a Guru-oriented person. It can understood best when a Sikh becomes one with his Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207828,"page_no":null,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal mahimaa agaadh bodh gur sikh sa(n)dh mile alakh lakhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is a devout Sikh of Guru, the glory of his spiritual, knowledge gets reflected in every limb of his body umpteen times. Every hair of his body becomes alive with divine effulgence. "}}},{"verse_id":207829,"page_no":null,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਤੋ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal a(n)g a(n)g koT sobhaa maiaa kai dhikhaavai so to anat na dhaaviee ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By his grace, whosoever is shown this state of spiritual bliss, does not wander about anywhere. (15)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41043,"next":41045}}
files.shabads/82/41045.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41045,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207830","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207830,"last_verse_id":207833,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207830,"page_no":null,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aulaT pavan man meen kee chapal gat satigur parache param padh paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing Naam Simran (meditation on Lord's name) one can turn the wind-like wayward mind into sharp and swift movement of fish. Developing association with the word of True Guru, one attains noble state. "}}},{"verse_id":207831,"page_no":null,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰ ਸਰ ਸੋਖਿ ਪੋਖਿ ਸੋਮ ਸਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਦੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰ ਅਪਿਅ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soor sar sokh pokh som sar pooran kai ba(n)dhan dhai mirat sar apia peeaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nectar of life (blissful peace) is obtained only by meditation. By burning away the indestructible ego and by killing the imperishable mind, leaving all doubts and suspicions, those who stabilise their body, their life-force finds a direction. "}}},{"verse_id":207832,"page_no":null,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜਰਹਿ ਜਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਮਰਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਕੰਧ ਹੰਸ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ajareh jaar maar amareh bhraat chhaadd asathir ka(n)dh ha(n)s anat na dhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By burning away the indestructible ego and by killing the imperishable mind, leaving all doubts and suspicions, those who stabilise their body, their life-force finds a direction."}}},{"verse_id":207833,"page_no":null,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦੈ ਆਦਿ ਨਾਦੈ ਨਾਦਿ ਸਲਿਲੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"aadhai aadh naadhai naadh salilai salil mil brahamai braham mil sahaj samaae hai ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the space merges with space, air with air and water mixes up with its source, so does the life-force integrates with the radiance of the Lord and supreme bliss is experienced. (16)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41044,"next":41046}}
files.shabads/82/41046.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41046,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207834","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207834,"last_verse_id":207837,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207834,"page_no":null,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"chira(n)kaal maanas janam niramol paae safal janam gur charan saran kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After wandering many births, this human life is obtained. But the birth becomes successful only when one takes the refuge the holy feet of a True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":207835,"page_no":null,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਅਮੋਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਅਮੋਲ ਦੇਖੇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਅਮੋਲ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਧਰਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan amol gur dharas amol dhekhe sravan amol gur bachan dharan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eyes are invaluable only when they see a glimpse of the Lord ugh the form of Sat guru. Ears are fruitful if they listen the precepts and command of Satguru attentively. "}}},{"verse_id":207836,"page_no":null,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਸਕਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"naasakaa amol charanaarabi(n)dh baasanaa kai rasanaa amol gur ma(n)tr simaran kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nostril’s are worthy only when they smell the fragrance of dust of Satguru's lotus-feet. The tongue becomes invaluable when it recites the word of the Lord given as consecration by Satguru Ji. "}}},{"verse_id":207837,"page_no":null,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹਸਤ ਅਮੋਲ ਗੁਰੁਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੈ ਸਫਲ ਚਰਨ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕਰਨ ਕੈ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"hasat amol gurudhev sev kai safal charan amol paradhachhanaa karan kai ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hands are invaluable only when they involve in the comforting service of Satguru and feet become precious when they ever stroll about in the vicinity of Satguru. (17)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41045,"next":41047}}
files.shabads/82/41047.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41047,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207838","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207838,"last_verse_id":207841,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207838,"page_no":null,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿੱਬ ਦੇਹ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dhiaan dhib dhirasaT pragaas bhiee karunaa kaTaachh dhi'b dheh paravaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Focusing mind on the form of True Guru, one is enlightened with celestial vision of knowledge. By the grace of True Guru, the human form acquires Godly refulgence making its coming to this world a success. "}}},{"verse_id":207839,"page_no":null,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬੱਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv ba'jar kapaaT khule prem ras rasan kai a(n)mirat nidhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Concentrating the mind on the divine word, the rock strong doors of ignorance become ajar. The acquisition of knowledge then blesses one with the treasure of Lord's name. "}}},{"verse_id":207840,"page_no":null,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ  ਹਸਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਮ ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਗਯਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh baasanaa subaas  hasat poojaa pranaam safal su gayaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The touching and feeling of the dust of True Guru's feet enlivens the fragrance of Lord's name in the mind. Involving the hands in His prayer and service, one is blessed with true and real spiritual knowledge. "}}},{"verse_id":207841,"page_no":null,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਇ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੪॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g bisam sraba(n)g mai samai bhe man manasaa thakat braham dhiaan hai ||34||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus every hair of a person becomes glorious and he merges with the light divine. All his vices and desires end and his mind dwells in the love of Lord's feet. (18)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41046,"next":41048}}
files.shabads/82/41048.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41048,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207842","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207842,"last_verse_id":207845,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207842,"page_no":null,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal at asacharaj mai herat hiraane aan dhiaan bisaraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The contentment that a devout Sikh gets from meditating on His name is so mystical that he (Gursikh) forgets all other worldly pleasures. "}}},{"verse_id":207843,"page_no":null,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੁਇ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਨ ਹਿਤਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal ga(n)dh ras bisam hui an ras baasanaa bilaas na hitaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the fragrance of spiritual peace Guru-conscious person lives in a state of bliss and forgets all other worldly enjoyments."}}},{"verse_id":207844,"page_no":null,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਅਸਥਲ ਨ ਲੁਭਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal adhabhut asathaan mirat ma(n)ddal asathal na lubhaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who live in the conscious presence of True Guru live a state of perpetual bliss. The perishable pleasures of the destructible world entice and attract them no more"}}},{"verse_id":207845,"page_no":null,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal sa(n)gat milaap dhekh aan giaan dhiaan sabh niras kar jaane hai ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of spiritually elevated souls and seeing their state of ecstasy of uniting with the Lord, they consider all wisdom and attractions of the world as worthless. (19)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41047,"next":41049}}
files.shabads/82/41049.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41049,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207846","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207846,"last_verse_id":207849,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207846,"page_no":null,"line_no":22,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal dhiaa kai dhikhaavai jaeh taeh aan roop ra(n)g dhekhe naahee bhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is blessed by Satguru with spiritual wisdom, he does not like to see any other form or attraction. Nothing else can give tranquility and peace to such a blessed person."}}},{"verse_id":207847,"page_no":null,"line_no":22,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਚਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal miaa kai chakhaavai jaeh taeh an ras nahee(n) rasanaa hitaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is blessed with spiritual pleasure by the True Guru, he does not relish any other pleasures. "}}},{"verse_id":207848,"page_no":null,"line_no":22,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal agahu gahaavai jaeh sarab nidhaan parasan kau na dhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devout Sikh who is blessed with the spiritual pleasure that no one can reach to, he need not run after other worldly relishments. "}}},{"verse_id":207849,"page_no":null,"line_no":22,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਵਾਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhaavai jaeh akath kathaa binodh vaahee ban aaviee ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only he who is blessed with self-realization (spiritual knowledge) can feel its pleasure and this cannot be explained. The devotee himself can only appreciate the pleasure of that state. (20)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41048,"next":41050}}
files.shabads/82/41050.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41050,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207850","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207850,"last_verse_id":207853,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207850,"page_no":null,"line_no":23,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਨ ਸਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sidh naath jogee jog dhiaan mai na aan sake bedh paaTh kar brahamaadhik na jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Supreme, absolute, true Lord whom Sidhs, Yogis and Naths could not bring in their perception, who could not be known by Brahma and other deities despite contemplation of Vedas; "}}},{"verse_id":207851,"page_no":null,"line_no":23,"gurmukhi":"ਅਯਿਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ayiaatam giaan kai na siv sanakaadh paae jag bhog mai na i(n)dhraadhik pahichaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who could not be realised by Shiva and four sons of Brahma, nor by Indra and other such deities who resorted myriad yags and penances; "}}},{"verse_id":207852,"page_no":null,"line_no":23,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਸੇਖਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਸੰਖਯਾ ਜਾਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਰਜ ਨਾਰਦਾਦਿਕ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naam simaran kai sekhaadhik na sa(n)khayaa jaanee brahamacharaj naaradhaadhik hiraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whom Shesh Naag with his thousand tongues could not comprehend and speak out all names of the Lord; bewildered by His magnificence, even the celibate sage Narad gave up the search out of frustration,"}}},{"verse_id":207853,"page_no":null,"line_no":23,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੧॥","translit_en":"naanaa avataar kai apaar ko na paar paio pooran braham gur sikh man maane hai ||21||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"About the infinitude of which Lord, Vishnu in spite of manifesting in so many incarnations, could know nothing. Satguru manifests Him in the heart of his obedient devotee. (21)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41049,"next":41051}}
files.shabads/82/41051.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41051,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207854","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207854,"last_verse_id":207857,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207854,"page_no":null,"line_no":24,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes ridhai nimrataa nivaas jaas dhiaan gur moorat kai pooran braham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikh in whose heart resides the percept of Guru, and by focusing his mind in the holy feet of the Lord through Simran, the omnipresent Lord dwells in him; "}}},{"verse_id":207855,"page_no":null,"line_no":24,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat unamaan giaan sahaj subhai sarabaatam kai sam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who lodges the holy word of the True Guru, contemplates on spiritual knowledge and in the process realises that One Supreme Lord exists in all, thus treats all as equals; "}}},{"verse_id":207856,"page_no":null,"line_no":24,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਓੁਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haumai tiaag tiaagee bisamaadh kai bairaagee bhe man ounaman liv ga(n)mitaa aga(n)m hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who sheds his ego and becomes an ascetic by virtue of Simran, yet live a detached worldly life; reaches the inaccessible Lord, "}}},{"verse_id":207857,"page_no":null,"line_no":24,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਖਮ ਅਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥੨੨॥","translit_en":"sookham asathool mool ek hee anek mek jeevan mukat namo namo namo nam hai ||22||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who recognises one Lord manifested in all things subtle and absolute; that Guru-conscious person is emancipated even when living a worldly life. (22)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41050,"next":41052}}
files.shabads/82/41052.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41052,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207858","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207858,"last_verse_id":207861,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207858,"page_no":null,"line_no":25,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਨ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਪਤੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan jot na jotee saroop hui pata(n)g sabadh surat mirag jugat na jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a moth, I do not sacrifice myself over the radiant glimpse True Guru, nor do I know the method of lodging the music of True Guru's words as is the wont of a deer; "}}},{"verse_id":207859,"page_no":null,"line_no":25,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨ ਮਧੁਪ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਮੀਨ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh na madhup gat bireh biog hui na meen mar jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a bumble bee mad for the nectar of lotus flower loses his life when the flower closes, but I have not sacrificed myself unto the lotus like feet of my Satguru, nor have Known the pangs of separation from my Satguru like a fish when out of water; "}}},{"verse_id":207860,"page_no":null,"line_no":25,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਗੁਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek ek Tek na Tarat hai tiragadh jon chaatur chatur gun hoi na hiraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The living being of lower species do not backtrack their steps dying for their love that is based on just one virtue. But I with all my wisdom do not carry any trait like these beings, I do not sacrifice myself unto my True Guru creatures do;"}}},{"verse_id":207861,"page_no":null,"line_no":25,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਹਨ ਕਠੋਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਨਰਕ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੩॥","translit_en":"paahan kaThor satigur sukh saagar mai sun mam naam jam narak lajaane hai ||23||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Satguru is ocean of peace and tranquillity but I am like a stone (who is least influenced by any precept of the True Guru) despite living near Him. Hearing the name of a sinner like the messenger of hell would feel ashamed of me. (23)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41051,"next":41053}}
files.shabads/82/41053.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41053,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207862","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207862,"last_verse_id":207865,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207862,"page_no":null,"line_no":26,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਚਲ ਅਚਲ ਭਏ ਮਹਾਂ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar cha(n)chal achal bhe mahaa(n) mal mootr dhaaree niramal keene hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those frolicsome persons who toil on the name of the Lord with devotion and love become peaceful and tranquil. Those who are filled with dross become neat and clean. "}}},{"verse_id":207863,"page_no":null,"line_no":26,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਭਏ ਕਾਲ ਸੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਦੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar jon kai ajon bhe kaal sai akaal kai amar padh dheene hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who practiced the consecration of True Guru saved themselves from the repeated births in the life of various species and achieved immortality. "}}},{"verse_id":207864,"page_no":null,"line_no":26,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar haumai khoi hoi ren tirakuTee tirabenee paar aapaa aap cheene hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who toil on the Naam Simran of the Lord with full devotion and love, become humble by renouncing ego and crossing all hurdles merge into Him. "}}},{"verse_id":207865,"page_no":null,"line_no":26,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਅਬਰਨ ਭਏ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਕੈ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੪॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar baran abaran bhe bhai bhram nivaar ddaar nirabhai kai leene hai ||24||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are free from caste, creed, race and colour-based social inequalities and becoming fearless merge with the Fearless Lord. (24)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41052,"next":41054}}
files.shabads/82/41054.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41054,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207866","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207866,"last_verse_id":207869,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207866,"page_no":null,"line_no":27,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar adham asaadh saadh gurmat sat kar ja(n)t sa(n)t naam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By adopting and accepting the Guru's word as true and immortal, a lowly and base person can become pious. By concentrating on the precepts of Guru, even a lowly and trivial person can rise to become a holy man. "}}},{"verse_id":207867,"page_no":null,"line_no":27,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar abibekee haivai bibekee gurmat sat kar kaam nihakaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The thoughtless and ignorant person becomes rational and considerate once he accepts the truth of Guru's wisdom. He also becomes free from all desires and wants. "}}},{"verse_id":207868,"page_no":null,"line_no":27,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਗਿਯਾਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਯਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar agiyaanee braham gayaanee gurmat sat kar sahaj bisraam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is wandering in the darkness of ignorance becomes a Brahm Gyani once he accepts the truth of Guru's wisdom and teachings. By practicing the teachings of Guru with full devotion and confidence, one reaches a state of equipoise. "}}},{"verse_id":207869,"page_no":null,"line_no":27,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥੨੫॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar jeevan mukat bhe gurmat sat kar nihachal dhaam hai ||25||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By accepting Guru's teachings as true and practicing them with concentration, devotion and faith, one attains salvation when still alive and secures a place in the higher realms of the Lord. (25)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41053,"next":41055}}
files.shabads/82/41055.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41055,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207870","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207870,"last_verse_id":207873,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207870,"page_no":null,"line_no":28,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਰ ਨਿਰਬੈਰਿ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਮੈ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar bair nirabair bhe pooran braham gur saradhaa mai jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who abide by Guru's teachings with faith and sincerity are without rancour. They carry no enmity for anyone because they have realised His presence in everybody."}}},{"verse_id":207871,"page_no":null,"line_no":28,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਦ ਨਿਰਭੇਦ ਭਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧਿ ਖੇਦ ਬਿਨਸਾਨੇ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar bhedh nirabhedh bhe dhubidhaa bidh nikhedh khedh binasaane hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who practice the teachings of the Guru are free from discriminatory temperament. All are alike for them. The sense of dualism and attitude of condemnation of others disappear from their mind."}}},{"verse_id":207872,"page_no":null,"line_no":28,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਇਸ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਗਯਾਨ ਅੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਗੰਧ ਠਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar bais param ha(n)s gayaan a(n)s ba(n)s niraga(n)dh ga(n)dh Thaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those crow-like dross-filled persons who adopt Guru's wisdom as truth are able to shed all the dross and become clean and pious. A miniscule of spiritual knowledge help them spread the fragrance of the Lord like Sandalwood."}}},{"verse_id":207873,"page_no":null,"line_no":28,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇ ਆਸਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਉਰ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ॥੨੬॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar karam bharam khoi aasaa mai niraas haivai bisavaiaas ur aane hai||26||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who abide by the teachings of the Guru destroy all their doubts of rites and rituals. They become unattached with worldly desires and imbibe the intellect of the Guru in their hearts. (26)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41054,"next":41056}}
files.shabads/82/41056.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41056,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207874","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207874,"last_verse_id":207877,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207874,"page_no":null,"line_no":29,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿੰਬਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਂਸ ਮੈ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar si(n)bal safal bhe gurmat sat kar baa(n)s mai suga(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who sincerely and faithfully follow the teachings of the True Guru turn into a fruit-bearing tree from a silk cotton tree (Simbal). That is to say that they become worthy from what good for nothing they were earlier. It is like egoistic bamboo tree becoming humble and worthy."}}},{"verse_id":207875,"page_no":null,"line_no":29,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਮਨੂਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਰਖਤ ਅੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar ka(n)chan manoor bhe gurmat sat kar parakhat a(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who toil their lives on the teachings of Guru become glittering like gold (those who are highly noble and pious) from burnt out iron sludge (useless persons). The ignorants acquire assayer intellect and become knowledgeable."}}},{"verse_id":207876,"page_no":null,"line_no":29,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੂਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਕਾਲ ਮੈਂ ਅਕਾਲ ਭਏ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar kaal kooT a(n)mirat haivai kaal mai(n) akaal bhe asathir ka(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who imbibe Guru's teachings as true are filled with spiritual happiness shedding all the attachment with maya. They do not fear death any more and their body rests in the memory of the Lord forever."}}},{"verse_id":207877,"page_no":null,"line_no":29,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੈਂ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬੰਧ ਨਿਰਬੰਧ ਹੈ ॥੨੭॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat kar jeevan mukat bhe maayaa mai(n) udhaas baas ba(n)dh niraba(n)dh hai ||27||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"such people are emancipated from the love and attachment of worldly pleasures despite staying and living their life-span in this world. (27)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41055,"next":41057}}
files.shabads/82/41057.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41057,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207878","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207878,"last_verse_id":207881,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207878,"page_no":null,"line_no":30,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gursikh sa(n)dh mile sas ghar soor poor nij ghar aae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of Guru and Sikh leads the Sikh to focus his mind on the divine word. The irha, pingla and Sukhmana enter the tenth door of the Sikh making him realise himself and granting him spiritual peace."}}},{"verse_id":207879,"page_no":null,"line_no":30,"gurmukhi":"ਓੁਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"oulaT pavan man meen tirabenee prasa(n)g tirakuTee ula(n)gh sukh saagar samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Practicing Naam Simran, the frolicsome mind becomes peaceful and crossing all hurdles gets engrossed in the realm of peace and tranquillity-the Dasam Duar. They are not to bear the torments of yogic practices."}}},{"verse_id":207880,"page_no":null,"line_no":30,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਪਦ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਮਿਅ ਚੁਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tiragun ateet chaturath padh ga(n)mitaa kai nijhar apaar dhaar amia chuaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A practitioner of Naam detaches himself from the three pronged influence of mammon i.e. the worldly attractions and reach the stage of absolute."}}},{"verse_id":207881,"page_no":null,"line_no":30,"gurmukhi":"ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਈ ਕਦਲੀ ਕਮਲ ਸੋ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"chakiee chakor mor chaatirak ana(n)dh miee kadhalee kamal so bimal jal chhaae hai ||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Chakvi (Sun bird) seeing sun, Chakor (moon bird) seeing moon, rain bird and peacock seeing clouds get into wondrous stage of bliss, similarly a ·Gunnukh (Guru conscious person) who practices Naam Simran keeps progressing like a lotus flower in the water. (28)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41056,"next":41058}}
files.shabads/82/41058.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41058,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207882","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207882,"last_verse_id":207885,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207882,"page_no":null,"line_no":31,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਿਟੇ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gursikh sa(n)dh mile pa(n)ch parapa(n)ch miTe pa(n)ch paradhaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the meeting of Guru and Sikh, and engrossment of the latter in the divine word, he is able to counter the deceit of five vices-kam, krodh, lobh, moh and ahankar. The five virtues of Truth, Contentment, Compassion, Devotion and Patience become paramount in his life."}}},{"verse_id":207883,"page_no":null,"line_no":31,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਗੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਭੇਦ ਕਾਲ ਅਉ ਕਰਮ ਖੇਦ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaage bhai bharam bhedh kaal aau karam khedh log bedh ula(n)gh udhot gur giaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All his doubts, fear and discriminatory feelings are destroyed. He is not hunted by the worldly discomforts those accrue from worldly activities."}}},{"verse_id":207884,"page_no":null,"line_no":31,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਅਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮ ਦਸਮ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣਝੁਣ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa aau braham sam dhasam dhuaar paar anahadh runajhun baajat neesaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With his conscious awareness firmly lodged in the mystical tenth opening, the worldly attractions and Lord appears alike to him. He sees the image of the Lord in every creature of the world. And in such a state, he remains engrossed in the celestial music that he hears."}}},{"verse_id":207885,"page_no":null,"line_no":31,"gurmukhi":"ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੯॥","translit_en":"aunaman magan gagan jagamag jot nijhar apaar dhaar param nidhaane hai ||29||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In such a high spiritual state, he enjoys heavenly bliss and the divine light shines in him. He is ever relishing the divine elixir of Naam. (29)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41057,"next":41059}}
files.shabads/82/41059.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41059,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207886","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207886,"last_verse_id":207889,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207886,"page_no":null,"line_no":32,"gurmukhi":"ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੀ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਪਾਯੋ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਘਰ ਬਨ ਬਨਵਾਸ ਨ ਉਦਾਸ ਫਲ ਪਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gireh meh girahasatee haivai paayo na sahaj ghar ban banavaas na udhaas fal paayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without Guru's teaching and all by himself a householder engrossed in all household duties cannot reach the state of oneness with Lord nor renouncing the world and living in jungles can he attain Him"}}},{"verse_id":207887,"page_no":null,"line_no":32,"gurmukhi":"ਪੜ੍ਹ ਪੜ੍ਹ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਸਿਧਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paRh paRh pa(n)ddit na akath kathaa bichaaree sidhaasan kai na nij aasan dhiraRaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By becoming a scholar, reading scriptures no one can become knowledgeable of the magnificence of the Lord and describe Him. Nor by doing Yogic practices can one merge in Him."}}},{"verse_id":207888,"page_no":null,"line_no":32,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਧਯਾਨ ਧਾਰਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਥਨ ਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਾਥ ਜਗਯ ਭੋਗ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੈ ਨ ਅਜਹੂ ਗਹਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jog dhayaan dhaaran kai naathan na dhekhe naath jagay bhog poojaa kai na ajahoo gahaayo hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Yogis, Naths could not realise Him by their strenuous yogic practices, nor can He be attained by doing yags etc."}}},{"verse_id":207889,"page_no":null,"line_no":32,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੈ ਨ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਟਾਰੀ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਗੁਰੂਦੇਵ ਸਮਝਾਯੋ ਹੈ ॥੩੦॥","translit_en":"dhevee dhev sev kai na aha(n)mev Tev Taaree alakh abhev guroodhev samajhaayo hai ||30||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Serving gods and goddesses one cannot get rid of one's ego. All this worship and offerings before these gods and goddesses only inflate the ego. The Lord who is beyond reach and description can only be reached with the teachings, knowledge and wisdom of the Guru and by His Grace. (30)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41058,"next":41060}}
files.shabads/82/41060.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41060,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207890","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207890,"last_verse_id":207893,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207890,"page_no":null,"line_no":33,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਗੁਨ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tiragun ateet chaturath gun ga(n)mitaa kai pa(n)ch tat ula(n)gh param tat vaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"detaching himself from the worldly attractions and the three its of maya, a Guru-conscious person acquires fourth state and discarding all adorations of the body lives in the memory the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":207891,"page_no":null,"line_no":33,"gurmukhi":"ਖਟ ਰਸ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਿ ਸਰ ਸਪਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khaT ras tiaag prem ras kau praapat bhe poor sar sapat anahadh abhiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is not enamoured by the tastes of worldly things, and enjoys the bliss of love of the Lord; and celestial music by keeping Him in his mind all the time"}}},{"verse_id":207892,"page_no":null,"line_no":33,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਭੇਦਿ ਨਾਥਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਥ ਭਏ ਦਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"asaT sidhaa(n)t bhedh naathan kai naath bhe dhasam sathal sukh saagar bilaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"he renunciates yog and ways of Naths and surpasses them ;all-spiritually, and reaching the ultimate, enjoys all happiness and peace. "}}},{"verse_id":207893,"page_no":null,"line_no":33,"gurmukhi":"ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੧॥","translit_en":"aunaman magan gagan hui nijhar jharai sahaj samaadh gur parachai udhaasee hai ||31||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"because of his high spiritual state and residing his conscious awareness in the Dasam Duar, he gets detached from worldly things and remains in a state of bliss. (31)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41059,"next":41061}}
files.shabads/82/41061.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41061,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207894","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207894,"last_verse_id":207897,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207894,"page_no":null,"line_no":34,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਂਾਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhubidhaa nivaar abaran hui baran bikhai pa(n)aach parapa(n)ch na dharas adharas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By perpetual meditation on Lord's name, a Guru-conscious person distances himself from duality and caste discrimination. He frees himself from the grip of five vices (lust, anger, greed, ego and attachment) nor does he entangle himself in the rationales or reasoning of philosophies."}}},{"verse_id":207895,"page_no":null,"line_no":34,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਭਏ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤ ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"param paaras gur paras paaras bhe kanik anik dhaat aapaa aparas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an iron piece when touched with a philosopher-stone becomes gold, similarly a devotee meeting Guru becomes a pious and a clean man."}}},{"verse_id":207896,"page_no":null,"line_no":34,"gurmukhi":"ਨਵ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਮੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨਿ ਰੁਚਤ ਨ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nav dhuaar paar brahamaasan si(n)ghaasan mai nijhar jharan ruchat na an ras hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Overcoming the pleasures of the nine doors of the body, he rests his faculties in the tenth door, where the divine elixir flows perpetually that turn him away from all other pleasures."}}},{"verse_id":207897,"page_no":null,"line_no":34,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਅਨਹਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਅਭਰ ਭਰਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੨॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees anahadh gadh gadh abhar bharas hai ||32||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Be assured that the meeting of Guru and a disciple, makes a disciple realise Lord and virtually becomes like Him. His  heart then remains immersed in the celestial music. (32)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41060,"next":41062}}
files.shabads/82/41062.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41062,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207898","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207898,"last_verse_id":207901,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207898,"page_no":null,"line_no":35,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਭਜ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal bhaj kamal pragaas bhe dharas dharas sam dharas dhikhaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By taking refuge of Sat guru's lotus feet, a devotee's mind )0 blooms like lotus flower. It is beyond contemplation and indescribable too. (33)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41061,"next":41063}}
files.shabads/82/41063.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41063,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207902","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207902,"last_verse_id":207905,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207902,"page_no":null,"line_no":36,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੀ ਖੋਇ ਕੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"dhuramat meT gurmat hiradhai pragaasee khoi kai agiaan jaane brahamagiaane hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a disciple meets his Guru and he works hard and toil himself on his precepts, he gets rid of base intellect and divine intelligence is revealed to him. He sheds his ignorance and acquires His knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":207903,"page_no":null,"line_no":36,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਪਰਵਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan aan dhiaan bisimaran kai sabadh surat mon brat paravaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the glimpse of the True Guru and focusing his mind, he weans away his attention from worldly pleasures and concentrates the divine word in his consciousness and closes his mind from all other attractions."}}},{"verse_id":207904,"page_no":null,"line_no":36,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੋੁਇ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਤ ਹੁਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੁਰ ਤਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"peram ras rasik huoi an ras rahat hui jotee meh jot saroop soha(n) sur taane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In His love, leaving all worldly pleasures, getting absorbed in His Naam, he keeps on remembering Him all the time."}}},{"verse_id":207905,"page_no":null,"line_no":36,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀਯੇ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੩੪॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees pooran bibek Tek ek heeye aane hai ||34||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Believe it for Sure that by meeting with Guru, a Guru conscious person becomes one with Lord and all his life depends on Naam Simran-an exclusive support of the Lord. (34)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41062,"next":41064}}
files.shabads/82/41064.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41064,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207906","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207906,"last_verse_id":207909,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207906,"page_no":null,"line_no":37,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜਾਸ ਮਾਨਸ ਔਤਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"rom rom koT brahamaa(n)dd ko nivaas jaas maanas aauataar dhaar dharas dhikhaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Supreme Lord, whose each hair support millions of cosmos has incarnated as Satguru in human form."}}},{"verse_id":207907,"page_no":null,"line_no":37,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਮੁਖ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ke oa(n)kaar ke akaar hai naanaa prakaar sree mukh shabadh gursikhan sunaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Omniprotector Lord who has many forms, appearing as Guru has given sermon to his disciples in person."}}},{"verse_id":207908,"page_no":null,"line_no":37,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਜਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖਨ ਲਡਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"jag bhog nieevedh jagat bhagat jaeh asan basan gurusikhan laddaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The God for whose propitiation yags are performed, food and offerings are made, the same Lord takes the form of Guru now coddling his Sikhs by distributing food and to his disciples."}}},{"verse_id":207909,"page_no":null,"line_no":37,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਗਮ ਸੇਖਾਦਿਕ ਕਥਿਤ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੫॥","translit_en":"nigam sekhaadhik kathit net net kar pooram braham gursikhan lakhaae hai(n) ||35||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The supreme Creator, whom Shesh Nag and others have calling by innumerable names, now manifests as Guru showing Himself to His devotees (The Sikhs). (35)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41063,"next":41065}}
files.shabads/82/41065.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41065,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":0,"shabad_name":"207910","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207910,"last_verse_id":207913,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207910,"page_no":0,"line_no":38,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"niragun saragun kai alakh abigat gat pooran braham gur roop pragaTaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Supreme Lord whose countenance is beyond perception, who is indestructible, despite being formless took human form and revealed Himself as Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207911,"page_no":null,"line_no":38,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਗੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਕਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"saragun sree gur dharas kai dhiaan roop akal akaal gurusikhan dhikhaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God in His immanent form as Satguru who is beyond all castes, creed and race make the Sikhs realise the true form of God."}}},{"verse_id":207912,"page_no":null,"line_no":38,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਗੁਰੁਸਿੱਖਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"niragun sree gur sabadh anahadh dhun sabadh bedhee gurusi'khan sunaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The heart piercing melodious tune which Satguru sings to his Sikhs is in fact manifestation of True Lord."}}},{"verse_id":207913,"page_no":null,"line_no":38,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਹਂੈ ॥੩੬॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh nihakaam dhaam gurusikh madhukar gat lapaTaae ha(n)ai ||36||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fragrance of the dust (of the lotus feet of such Satguru) with which the Sikhs remain attached is capable of destroying all worldly desires. (36)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41064,"next":41066}}
