ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur bel haivai cha(n)belee gat mool saakhaa patr kar bibidh bithaar hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Satguru, manifestation of Almighty God, is like jasmine creeper of which He Himself is the root and all His devotees and pious persons are its leaves and branches."}}},{"verse_id":207915,"page_no":null,"line_no":39,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਤਾ ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਕਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurusikh puhap subaas nij roop taa mai(n) pragaT haivai karat sa(n)saar ko udhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pleased at the services of His devotees (like Bhai Lehna Ji, Baba Amar Das Ji, etc.) Satguru turns those devotees by His grace and makes them into fragrance-spreading flowers and by manifesting in them is liberating the world."}}},{"verse_id":207916,"page_no":null,"line_no":39,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਰ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੇਰ ਮਹਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"til mil baasanaa subaas ko nivaas kar aapaa khoi hoi hai fuler mahikaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sesame seed loses its existence and becomes scent when unites with the fragrance of the flowers, the devotees too lose themselves to the Lord through meditation and spread divine fragrance in the world."}}},{"verse_id":207917,"page_no":null,"line_no":39,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਮਂੈ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag ma(n)ai patit puneet reet sa(n)saaree havai nira(n)kaaree paraupakaar hai ||37||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sikhism has a tradition of changing sinners into holy persons. And in this path, this is a very righteous task and service towards others. Those engrossed in material world are converted into God-loving and godly persons. They are detached from maya (mammon) and united with the Almighty. (37)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41065,"next":41067}}
files.shabads/82/41067.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41067,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207918","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207918,"last_verse_id":207921,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207918,"page_no":null,"line_no":40,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਮੂਲ ਖੰਦ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur birakh bithaar dhaar mool kha(n)dh saakhaa patr anik prakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Satguru, a total form of complete Lord is like a fragrant tree, whose spread has many branches, leaves, flowers in the form of Sikhs."}}},{"verse_id":207919,"page_no":null,"line_no":40,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਫਲ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਅਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taa mai nij roop gursikh fal ko pragaas baasanaa subaas aau savaiaadh upakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the strenuous toil of devoted Sikhs like Bhai Lehna Ji and Baba Amar Das Ji, the True Guru illuminated His own light in them. Engulfed in the desire of worship and fragrance of the Lord, these pious souls are keen to spread and distribute the elixir-like Naam."}}},{"verse_id":207920,"page_no":null,"line_no":40,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਚਾਖੇ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੋ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras rasik hui chaakhe charanaamirat sa(n)saar ko udhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such Gursikhs enjoying the fragrance of the dust of Lord's lotus-feet emancipate others from the world.  "}}},{"verse_id":207921,"page_no":null,"line_no":40,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੮॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag mahaatam akath kathaa net net net namo namo namasakaar hai ||38||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of the path of Sikhism cannot be described. All that we can say is that He is infinite, infinite and beyond and is worthy of our salutes myriad times. (38)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41066,"next":41068}}
files.shabads/82/41068.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41068,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207922","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207922,"last_verse_id":207925,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207922,"page_no":null,"line_no":41,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਗੋ ਬੰਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਰਨ ਦੁਹੇ ਦੂਧ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"baran baran bahu baran go ba(n)s jaise ek hee baran dhuhe dhoodh jag jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the cows are of many breeds and colours, yet the whole world knows that they all yield milk of the same colour."}}},{"verse_id":207923,"page_no":null,"line_no":41,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਕੈ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਏਕੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"anik prakaar fal fool kai banaasapatee ekai roop agan sarab mai samaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There are many species of fruit and flower trees but all carry the same latent fire in them."}}},{"verse_id":207924,"page_no":null,"line_no":41,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਪਾਨ ਚੂਨਾ ਅਉ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਾਥਾ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"chatur baran paan choonaa aau supaaree kaathaa aapaa khoi milat anoop roop Thaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Four different colours-beetle leaf, Supari (beetle nut), Kattha (extract of the bark of accacia) and lime shed their own colour and merge in each other in a Paan and make beautiful red colour."}}},{"verse_id":207925,"page_no":null,"line_no":41,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੯॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar gurmukh eka(n)kaar sabadh surat unaman unamaaneeaai ||39||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the Guru-conscious person (Gurmukh) renounces various worldly pleasures and adopts one colour of the formless God. And because of the blessings of his Guru who has taught him to unite with the divine word and his mind, he achieves higher spiritual state. (39)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41067,"next":41069}}
files.shabads/82/41069.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41069,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207926","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207926,"last_verse_id":207929,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207926,"page_no":null,"line_no":42,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਂਚਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਏਕੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"see(n)chat salil bahu baran banaasapatee cha(n)dhan subaas ekai cha(n)dhan bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By irrigation, several kinds of plants and vegetation can be grown but when they come in touch with sandalwood they are all called sandalwood (because they have the same fragrance)."}}},{"verse_id":207927,"page_no":null,"line_no":42,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਬਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਤਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਏਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"parabat bikhai utapat hui asaT dhaat paaras paras ekai ka(n)chan kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eight metals are obtained from mountain but when each one of them are touched by philosopher-stone become gold."}}},{"verse_id":207928,"page_no":null,"line_no":42,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਾਰਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"nis a(n)dhakaar taaraa ma(n)ddal chamatakaar dhin dhinakar jot ekai paravaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the darkness of the night, many stars shine but during the day, the light of one Sun alone is considered authentic."}}},{"verse_id":207929,"page_no":null,"line_no":42,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੦॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar gurmukh eka(n)kaar sabadh surat unaman unamaaneeaai ||40||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a Sikh who lives life according to the advice of his Guru becomes divine in all respects, even when he is living life as a worldly person. Due to the lodging of the divine word in his mind, he is known to be living in heavenly state. (40)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41068,"next":41070}}
files.shabads/82/41070.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41070,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207930","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207930,"last_verse_id":207933,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207930,"page_no":null,"line_no":43,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਮੈ ਘੂਘਟ ਪਟ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨ ਪੀਅ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kulaa badhoo gur jan mai ghooghaT paT sihajaa sa(n)jog samai a(n)tar na peea sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a daughter-in-law covers herself with veil in front of the elders of the house, but keeps no distance from her husband at the time of sharing his bed;"}}},{"verse_id":207931,"page_no":null,"line_no":43,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਣਿ ਅਛਤ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਹੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਅਹਿ ਬੰਕ ਤਨ ਸੂਧੋ ਬਿਲ ਪੈਸਤ ਹੁਇ ਜੀਅ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise man achhat kuTa(n)b hee sahit eh ba(n)k tan soodho bil paisat hui jeea sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a snake remains crooked when with female snake and his family, but becomes straight when it enters in the burrow;"}}},{"verse_id":207932,"page_no":null,"line_no":43,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਛਤ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੈ  ਪਾਛੇ ਕੈ ਦੈ ਸਰਬਸ ਮੋਹੁ ਸੁਤ ਤੀਅ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"maat pitaa achhat na bolai sut banitaa sai  paachhe kai dhai sarabas moh sut teea sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son avoids talking to his wife in front of his parents, but when alone showers all his love upon her,"}}},{"verse_id":207933,"page_no":null,"line_no":43,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀਅ ਸੈ ॥੪੧॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar gurmukh eka(n)kaar sabadh surat unaman man heea sai ||41||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a devoted Sikh appears worldly among others but having attached his mind with Guru's word, he rises spiritually and realises the Lord. Quintessence: One may maintain oneself as a worldly person outwardly but inwardly one keeps oneself attached with Naam and attains divine bliss. (41)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41069,"next":41071}}
files.shabads/82/41071.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41071,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207934","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207934,"last_verse_id":207937,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207934,"page_no":null,"line_no":44,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਭੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੋਗ ਜਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੈ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jog bikhai bhog ar bhog bikhai jog jat gurmukh pa(n)th jog bhog sai ateet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where yogic practitioners have innate desire for worldly relishments and the worldly people desire to become yogi, but those treading the path of Guru maintain a very different and unique desire in their hearts than the yogis."}}},{"verse_id":207935,"page_no":null,"line_no":44,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬੇਧੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਅਜੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan bikhai dhiaan ar dhiaan bikhai bedhe giaan gurmat gat giaan dhiaan kai ajeet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those following the path of Gyan (knowledge) keep their mind focused on contemplation while those in contemplation are wandering for Gyan. But the state of a person treading the path of his Guru is above those persons who are pursuing Gyan or Dhyan (contemplation)."}}},{"verse_id":207936,"page_no":null,"line_no":44,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਅਲਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem kai bhagat ar bhagat kai prem nem alakh bhagat prem gurmukh reet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Followers of path of love yearn for devotion and those on path of devotion desire love, but the innate desire of Guru-conscious person is to remain engrossed in loving worship of God."}}},{"verse_id":207937,"page_no":null,"line_no":44,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਪਾਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੨॥","translit_en":"niragun saragun bikhai bisam bisavaiaas ridhai bisam bisavaiaas paar pooran prateet hai ||42||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many seekers hold a faith on the worship of Transcendental Lord while others hold a strange view of worship of God. Perhaps their belief and understanding is half baked. But the disciples of Guru hold their faith on the Lord much above these strange devotions and beliefs. It is absolute. (42)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41070,"next":41072}}
files.shabads/82/41072.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41072,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207938","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207938,"last_verse_id":207941,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207938,"page_no":null,"line_no":45,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਬਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh dhib dheh dhib dhirasaT hui dhib jot ko dhiaan dhib dhirasaTaa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With just a miniscule of clement look of Satguru, the body and looks of a disciple of the Guru become divine. He then starts seeing the presence of the Lord all around him."}}},{"verse_id":207939,"page_no":null,"line_no":45,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਗੰਮਿ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਕੋ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh bibek Tek pragaT hui gurmat anahadh ga(n)m unamanee ko mataa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By meditating on Gur Shabad (Guru's Word) and taking its refuge, Guru's precepts are revealed to him. When he reaches the state of listening to unstruck melody of the divine word, he enjoys the bliss of higher state of equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":207940,"page_no":null,"line_no":45,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਨੀ ਕੈ ਉਪਜਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਨਿਜ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan karanee kai upajat prem ras gurmukh sukh prem nem nij kraa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Concentrating on the knowledge of the True Guru, listening to his counsel, practicing contemplation and living life according to His command, a feeling of love grows and blossoms. And in living this life of love, a Guru-conscious person realises the radiance of his self by the divine enlightenment."}}},{"verse_id":207941,"page_no":null,"line_no":45,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਧੁਪ ਗਤਿ  ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਪਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਂਤਿ ਕੈ ॥੪੩॥","translit_en":"charan kamal dhal sa(n)paT madhup gat  sahaj samaadh madh paan praan shaa(n)t kai ||43||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the bumble bee attains the divine bliss by drinking the elixir and getting shut in the box-like petals of a lotus flower, similarly in order to provide spiritual peace to his life, a true seeker enjoins the lotus-like feet of Guru and drinks deep by contemplating on Naam. (43)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41071,"next":41073}}
files.shabads/82/41073.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41073,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207942","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207942,"last_verse_id":207945,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207942,"page_no":null,"line_no":46,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਆ ਗਹਿ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਕਉ ਉਲਟਿ ਗਹਾਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਹਾਥ ਸੈ ਛਡਾਏ ਛਾਡੈ ਪਰ ਬਸਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sooaa geh nalinee kau ulaT gahaavai aap haath sai chhaddaae chhaaddai par bas aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A parrot catcher fixes a rotating pipe/tube on which a parrot comes and sits. The pipe rotates and the parrot hangs upside down. He does not let go the pipe. The parrot catcher then comes and frees his claws. Thus he becomes a slave."}}},{"verse_id":207943,"page_no":null,"line_no":46,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਬਾਰੰਬਾਰ ਟੇਰਿ ਟੇਰਿ ਕਹੇ ਪਠੋ ਪਠੋ ਆਪਨੋ ਹੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੀਖਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੜਾਵਈ","translit_en":"taise baara(n)baar Ter Ter kahe paTho paTho aapano hee naau seekh aap hee paRaaviee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the parrot is trained and taught to say words, he repeatedly speak those words. He learns to speak his own name and he teaches it to others as well."}}},{"verse_id":207944,"page_no":null,"line_no":46,"gurmukhi":"ਰਘੁਬੰਸੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਲ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਸੁ ਭਾਖਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"raghuba(n)see raam naam gaal jaamanee su bhaakhaa sa(n)gat subhaav gat budh pragaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A parrot learns to pronounce the name of Ram from the devotees of Ram. From the wicked and unrighteous, he learns bad names. In the company of Greeks, he learns their language. He develops his intellect according to the company he keeps."}}},{"verse_id":207945,"page_no":null,"line_no":46,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੪॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran saadh sa(n)g mile aapaa aap cheen gurmukh sukh paaviee ||44||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly in the company of holy men, and taking the refuge of the lotus-like feet of the Satguru, the Sikh in attendance of his Guru realises his self and enjoys the true bliss and peace. (44)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41072,"next":41074}}
files.shabads/82/41074.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41074,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207946","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207946,"last_verse_id":207949,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207946,"page_no":null,"line_no":47,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT meh dharas dharas meh dhirasaT dhirag dhirasaT dharas adharas gur dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the vision of Guru-conscious persons rests the image of the True Guru, and in the eyes of the True Guru, rests the glimpse of the disciple. Because of this attention of Satguru, these disciples keep away from the worldly attractions."}}},{"verse_id":207947,"page_no":null,"line_no":47,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਗਮਿਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh meh surat surat meh sabadh dhun sabadh surat agamit gur giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They remain engrossed in the words of the Guru and the tune of these words remain lodged in their consciousness. But the knowledge of word and consciousness is beyond reach."}}},{"verse_id":207948,"page_no":null,"line_no":47,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਨੀ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan karanee kai pragaTat prem ras gurmat gat prem nem nirabaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By following the teachings of the True Guru and moulding one's character in accordance with the contemplation of Lord's qualities, a sense of love develops. The well defined routine of Guru's philosophy, leads one to free oneself from the worldly shackles."}}},{"verse_id":207949,"page_no":null,"line_no":47,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਬੀਸ ਕੋ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਮੋ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੫॥","translit_en":"pi(n)dd praan praanapat bees ko baratamaan gurmukh sukh ik iees mo nidhaan hai ||45||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living life in the world, a Guru-conscious person always believes that his life belongs to the Master of Life-God. Remaining engrossed in One Lord is the wealth of happiness of the Guru-conscious persons. (45)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41073,"next":41075}}
files.shabads/82/41075.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41075,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207950","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207950,"last_verse_id":207953,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207950,"page_no":null,"line_no":48,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਭਏ ਸਹਜ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach kram hui ikatr chhatrapat bhe sahaj si(n)ghaasan kai nihachal raaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person feels like a mighty king when he is able to concentrate his mind on words and acts as per the teachings of Gum. When he is able to rest in a state of equipoise, he feels like an emperor of infallible kingdom."}}},{"verse_id":207951,"page_no":null,"line_no":48,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਯ ਅਉ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਮੇਲਿ  ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satay aau sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam arath mel  pa(n)ch paravaan ke'ee gurmat saaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By imbibing the five virtues of Truth, Contentment, Compassion, Righteousness and Purpose in accordance with the teachings of the Gum, he becomes acceptable and an honourable person."}}},{"verse_id":207952,"page_no":null,"line_no":48,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਉ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਭਾ ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal padhaarath aau sarab nidhaan sabhaa siv nagaree subaas koT chhab chhaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All materials and worldly treasures are his. The divine abode of Dasam Duar is his fort where the continuous presence of melodious Naam makes him a unique and glorious person."}}},{"verse_id":207953,"page_no":null,"line_no":48,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖੈ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸਫਲ ਸਬ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੪੬॥","translit_en":"raajaneet reet preet parajaa kai sukhai sukh pooran manorath safal sab kaaj hai ||46||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving and affectionate treatment of such a king-like disciple of the True Guru with other human beings is his statesmanship that spreads happiness, peace and success all around him. (46)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41074,"next":41076}}
files.shabads/82/41076.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41076,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207954","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207954,"last_verse_id":207957,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207954,"page_no":null,"line_no":49,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran man bach kram hui ikatr ga(n)mitaa tirakaal tirabhavan sudh paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a Guru-conscious person achieves harmony with his mind, words and actions, and by the blessings of the refuge of True Guru, he acquires knowledge of times and the three worlds."}}},{"verse_id":207955,"page_no":null,"line_no":49,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਜਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadh agam agaadh kathaa a(n)tar dhisa(n)tar nira(n)taree jataiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing on Naam, a Guru-conscious person lives in a state of equipoise. Any description of that state is beyond our comprehension. It is indescribable. By dint of that state, he becomes aware of all that is happening in every nook and corner of the world."}}},{"verse_id":207956,"page_no":null,"line_no":49,"gurmukhi":"ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd pi(n)dd praan praanapat gat gur sikh sa(n)dh mile soha(n) liv laiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the union of Guru and Sikh, the seeker feels the presence of the Lord of Cosmos in his body and his life-giving support; and when he achieves oneness with God, he remains engrossed in the memory of Lord."}}},{"verse_id":207957,"page_no":null,"line_no":49,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਪਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਉ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੭॥","translit_en":"dharapan dharas aau ja(n)tr dhan ja(n)tree bidh ot pot soot ekai dhubidhaa miTaiee hai ||47||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the mirror and image in it, music and the musical instrument, waft and woof of a cloth are all part of each other and inseparable, so does the Guru-conscious person becomes one with God and is freed of all doubts of duality. (47)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41075,"next":41077}}
files.shabads/82/41077.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41077,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207958","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207958,"last_verse_id":207961,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207958,"page_no":null,"line_no":50,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ  ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਈ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"charan saran man bach kram hui ikatr  tan tirabhavan gat alakh lakhaiee hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of the refuge of True Guru and moulding his mind, words and actions as per His teachings, a Guru-conscious person learns the happenings of the three worlds innately. He recognises the true Lord residing within."}}},{"verse_id":207959,"page_no":null,"line_no":50,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਮਨ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਮ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach karam karam man bachan kai bachan karam man unamanee chhaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the harmony of actions, mind and words, the thoughts of the mind, the utterance of the words and actions performed are influenced."}}},{"verse_id":207960,"page_no":null,"line_no":50,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਹੂਆ ਕਮਾਦ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੈ ਚੁਆਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaanee dhiaanee karanee jiau gur mahooaa kamaadh nijhar apaar dhaar bhaaThee kai chuaaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As wine is brewed from jaggery, sugarcane and Madhuca Indica flowers, so does a Guru-conscious person obtain the unique flow of elixir of Naam when knowledge and concentration of mind are performed by him."}}},{"verse_id":207961,"page_no":null,"line_no":50,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੮॥","translit_en":"peram ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran hui gurmukh sa(n)dh mile sahaj samaiee hai ||48||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious person satiates himself by drinking deep the loving elixir of Lord's name and by his union with the divine word of the True Guru, he resides in a state of equipoise. (48)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41076,"next":41078}}
files.shabads/82/41078.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41078,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207962","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207962,"last_verse_id":207965,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207962,"page_no":null,"line_no":51,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਲੀ ਫਲ ਫੁਲ ਮੂਲ ਸਾਖਾ ਰਚਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"bibidh birakh balee fal ful mool saakhaa rachan charitr chitr anik prakaar hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The vegetation is seen in many forms like trees, creepers, fruit, flowers, roots and branches. This beautiful creation of the Lord unfolds itself in many forms of wonderful artistic skills."}}},{"verse_id":207963,"page_no":null,"line_no":51,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫਲ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫੂਲ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"baran baran fal bahu bidh savaiaadh ras baran baran fool baasanaa bithaar hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These trees and creepers bear fruits of different tastes and flavour, flowers of myriad shape and colour. All of them spread various types of fragrance."}}},{"verse_id":207964,"page_no":null,"line_no":51,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਮੂਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਪਤੑ ਸੁਗਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"baran baran mool baran baran saakhaa baran baran pat(h) sugan achaar hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The trunks of the trees and creepers, their branches and leaves are of many kind and each leaves a different effect."}}},{"verse_id":207965,"page_no":null,"line_no":51,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੯॥","translit_en":"bibidh banaasapat a(n)tar agan jaise sakal sa(n)saar bikhai ekai eka(n)kaar hai ||49||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the latent fire in all these types of vegetation is the same, so do the God-loving persons find One Lord dwelling in the hearts of all the living beings in this world. (49)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41077,"next":41079}}
files.shabads/82/41079.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41079,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207966","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207966,"last_verse_id":207969,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207966,"page_no":null,"line_no":52,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਾਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile dhirasaT dharas liv gurmukh braham giaan saadh liv laiee hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the devoted Guru-conscious person becomes one with the True form of the True Lord, his vision enjoins the holy sight of Guru. He who practices meditation on Lord's name remains attached with the words of wisdom of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207967,"page_no":null,"line_no":52,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile sabadh surat liv gurmukh braham giaan dhiaan sudh paiee hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the union of True Guru and his disciple (Gursikh) the disciple obeys the command of his Guru very sincerely and faithfully. By meditating on the Lord, he learns to reflect on the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207968,"page_no":null,"line_no":52,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕਰਨੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile savaiaamee sev sevak hui gurmukh nihakaam karanee kamaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus union of a disciple with Guru imbibes the trait of service of the Master. He serves all without reward or desire as he has learnt that he is serving Him who resides in all."}}},{"verse_id":207969,"page_no":null,"line_no":52,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕਰਨੀ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਨੇਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੫੦॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile karanee su giaan dhiaan gurmukh peram nem sahaj samaiee hai ||50||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a person emerges as a person with ideal actions by virtue of the meditation and reflection on Lord. In the process, he attains equipoise and remains engrossed in it. (50)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41078,"next":41080}}
files.shabads/82/41080.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41080,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207970","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207970,"last_verse_id":207973,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207970,"page_no":null,"line_no":53,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ  ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)dh mile braham dhiaan liv  eka(n)kaar kai akaar anik prakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a Guru-conscious person lives in harmony with his Guru, his mind is absorbed in the remembrance of God. He then realises that all forms are actually His forms."}}},{"verse_id":207971,"page_no":null,"line_no":53,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)dh mile braham giaan liv nira(n)kaar oa(n)kaar bibidh bithaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And when he establishes his relationship with Him, he realises through the medium of meditation on His name that Formless Lord has manifested Himself in various forms and shapes."}}},{"verse_id":207972,"page_no":null,"line_no":53,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile savaiaamee sev sevak hui braham bibek prem bhagat achaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of a devoted Sikh with True Guru renders him with an attitude of service and benevolence and he yearns to be available at His service. He then develops character of loving devotion and divine reflection."}}},{"verse_id":207973,"page_no":null,"line_no":53,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੫੧॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)dh mile paramadhabhut gat net net net namo namo namasakaar hai ||51||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The state of union of a God-conscious person and his True Guru is glorious and full of astonishment. No other state can equal it. He is worthy of salutation infinite time, again and again. (51)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41079,"next":41081}}
files.shabads/82/41081.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41081,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207974","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207974,"last_verse_id":207977,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207974,"page_no":null,"line_no":54,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh man bach karam ikatr bhe a(n)g a(n)g bisam sraba(n)g mai samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing the teachings of Guru with mind, words and action, the devoted Sikh in attendance keeps every limb of his body in the memory of blissful Omnipresent Lord all the time."}}},{"verse_id":207975,"page_no":null,"line_no":54,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਮਦੋਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ ਕਹਿਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"peram ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan ke madhon rasanaa thakat bhiee kahit na aae hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He remains in a state of trance by drinking the loving elixir of Naam: He relishes not any other pleasure of life anymore. "}}},{"verse_id":207976,"page_no":null,"line_no":54,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗਮਗ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਲੋਚਨ ਚਕਿਤ ਭਏ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"jagamag peram jot at asacharaj mai lochan chakit bhe herat hiraae hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wonderful elixir that has caused him to live such a celestial state of trance is indescribable. "}}},{"verse_id":207977,"page_no":null,"line_no":54,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਲੈ ਬਿਲੈ ਬਿਲਾਏ ਹੈ॥੫੨॥","translit_en":"raag naadh baadh bisamaadh peram dhun sun sravan surat bilai bilai bilaae hai||52||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The radiance of love for Naam Simran exists in him a strange form that surprises all the beholders. (52)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41080,"next":41082}}
files.shabads/82/41082.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41082,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207978","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207978,"last_verse_id":207981,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207978,"page_no":null,"line_no":55,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪੇ੍ਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh man bach karam ikatr bhe pooran param padh peram pragaTaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of the harmonious state of mind, words and actions, a Guru's disciple who is blessed with the loving elixir of Naam Simran, reaches a highly conscious state."}}},{"verse_id":207979,"page_no":null,"line_no":55,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan mai dhirasaT dharas ras ga(n)dh sa(n)dh sravan sabadh surat ga(n)dh ras paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of the fragrance of Naam relishment, he is blessed with True Guru-like glimpse. His ears perpetually hear His celestial music."}}},{"verse_id":207980,"page_no":null,"line_no":55,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਮੈ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੇਲ ਨਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਰਸ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa mai ras ga(n)dh sabadh surat mel naas baas ras srut sabadh lakhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This harmonious integration of word and consciousness renders his tongue to be sweet and comfort-giving. The exhaling of his breath too is fragrant and reflects his high state of harmonious relationship between his mental faculties and Naam."}}},{"verse_id":207981,"page_no":null,"line_no":55,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਰਸਨਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਸਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਿੰਡ ਪਾ੍ਰਨ ਮੈ ਜਤਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੫੩॥","translit_en":"rom rom rasanaa sravan dhirag naasaa koT kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd pi(n)dd paaran mai jataae hai ||53||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus by perpetual meditation on Him, with the relishing fragrance of Lord's name residing on his tongue, eyes, ears and nostrils, a Guru-conscious person realises the presence of Lord who abides in millions cosmoses within himself. (53)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41081,"next":41083}}
files.shabads/82/41083.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41083,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207982","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207982,"last_verse_id":207985,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207982,"page_no":null,"line_no":56,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਨ ਹੀ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਪਨ ਰਚਿਓ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham aap aapan hee aap saaj aapan rachio hai naau aap hee bichaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Omniscient and Omnipotent God Himself has created His own form and has named Himself as (Guru) Nanak."}}},{"verse_id":207983,"page_no":null,"line_no":56,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਕਹਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਿਖ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਕਾਰ ਓਅੁੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh gur dhuteeaa gobi(n)dh naam kai kahaio gurmuikh rachanaa akaar oau(n)kaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The second name that He called Himself is Gobind. The transcendental Lord took the immanent form to appear as the first Guru."}}},{"verse_id":207984,"page_no":null,"line_no":56,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਦ  ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਲਾਧਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh naadh bedh gurmukh paavai bhedh  gurmukh leelaadhaaree anik aautaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lord Himself is the precept of Vedas and He Himself knows all the secrets that lie therein. Lord Himself has created this wonderful act and is manifesting in many forms and bodies"}}},{"verse_id":207985,"page_no":null,"line_no":56,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਬਰ ਉਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੫੪॥","translit_en":"guroo gobi(n)dh aau gobi(n)dh gur ek mek ot pot sootr gat a(n)bar uchaar kai ||54||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like waft and woof of a cloth, both Guru and Gobind (God) are not different to each other. files.shabads/82/41085.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41085,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207990","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207990,"last_verse_id":207993,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207990,"page_no":null,"line_no":58,"gurmukhi":"ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਮੂਲ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"fal mool mool fal mool fal fal mool aadh paramaadh ar a(n)t kai ana(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"From fruit one begets a seed and seed develops into a tree to give fruit, and this process continues. Its end is beyond the end."}}},{"verse_id":207991,"page_no":null,"line_no":58,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਪਿਤ ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pit sut sut pit sut pit pit sut utapat gat at gooR mool ma(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Father begets a son and the son then becomes a father and begets son. Thus continues the system of father-son-father. This convention of creation has very deep quintessence."}}},{"verse_id":207992,"page_no":null,"line_no":58,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਿਕ ਬਸੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਬੈਠ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਿਧੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pathik baseraa ko niberaa jiau nikas baiTh it ut vaar paar saritaa sidha(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the end of journey of a traveller depends upon his embarking a boat and then de-embarking from it, crossing the river defines its near and far ends, and these ends keep changing depending upon which direction a traveller is crossing the river from."}}},{"verse_id":207993,"page_no":null,"line_no":58,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਰ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ॥੫੬॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur gobi(n)dh gobi(n)dh gur abigat gat simarat sikh sa(n)t hai ||56||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly all powerful, all knowing Guru is God Himself. He is both Guru and God. This incomprehensible state can best be understood by a Guru-conscious person. (56)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41084,"next":41086}}
files.shabads/82/41086.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41086,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207994","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207994,"last_verse_id":207997,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207994,"page_no":null,"line_no":59,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਗਹੇ ਜਮਪੁਰ ਪੰਥ ਮੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗ ਪੰਜ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th gahe jamapur pa(n)th meTe gursikh sa(n)g pa(n)j dhoot sa(n)g tiaage hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Treading the path of Guru's percepts, a Sikh is freed from the fear of death. By keeping company of the holy Sangat (congregation) even vices like lust, anger, avarice, attachment and pride are shed."}}},{"verse_id":207995,"page_no":null,"line_no":59,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇ ਦਰਸ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਟਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur karam bharam khoi dharas akaal kaal ka(n)Tak bhai bhaage hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By taking the refuge of Satguru, one destroys all effects of the past deeds. And beholding the God-like form of Satguru, the fear of death disappears."}}},{"verse_id":207996,"page_no":null,"line_no":59,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਵੇਸ ਬੱਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੂਰਛਤ ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes ves ba'jar kapaaT khule sabadh surat moorachhat man jaage hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Abiding by the sermons of the Satguru, all desires and apprehensions vanish. By engrossing the mind in the holy words of the Guru, the mammon-gripped unconscious mind becomes alert."}}},{"verse_id":207997,"page_no":null,"line_no":59,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਿਤ ਕਟਾਛਯ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਯਾਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੫੭॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chit kaTaachhay kirapaa sarab nidhaan paae jeevan mukat gur gayaan liv laage hai(n) ||57||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even a subtle element of grace of the Satguru is no less than all the worldly treasures. By engrossing the mind in the word and Naam blessed by the Satguru, one achieves salvation while still alive and living life. (57)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41085,"next":41087}}
files.shabads/82/41087.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41087,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"207998","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":207998,"last_verse_id":208001,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":207998,"page_no":null,"line_no":60,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਸੁਖ ਚਾਹਤ ਸਕਲ ਪੰਥ ਸਕਲ ਦਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th sukh chaahat sakal pa(n)th sakal dharas gur dharas adheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All religions yearn for the comfort and peace of the path of Guru-conscious people. All cults and religions are subservient and in attendance to the path of Guru"}}},{"verse_id":207999,"page_no":null,"line_no":60,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰ ਸੁਰਸਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਸਬਦ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sur surasar gur charan saran chaahai bedh brahamaadhik sabadh livaleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All gods and their holy rivers yearn for the refuge of Satguru Ji. Brahma the creator of Vedas also longs to attach his mind in the words of Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208000,"page_no":null,"line_no":60,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਬ ਗਿਅਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਮੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sarab gian gur giaan avagaahan mai sarab nidhaan gur kirapaa jal meen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the religions are seekers of the Naam Simran. By the blessings of the Guru, one gets all the treasures of the world just as a fish receives life-supporting water."}}},{"verse_id":208001,"page_no":null,"line_no":60,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਭੋਗੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੮॥","translit_en":"jogee jog jugat mai bhogee bhog bhugat mai gurmukh nij padh kul akuleen hai ||58||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the Yogis are perpetually immersed in practicing yogic exercises and a worldly man is ever engrossed in enjoying the relishments, similarly the devoted Sikhs remain engrossed in the higher spiritual state through Naam Simran and keep themselves unsullied of caste and creed divide. (58)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41086,"next":41088}}
files.shabads/82/41088.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41088,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208002","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208002,"last_verse_id":208005,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208002,"page_no":null,"line_no":61,"gurmukhi":"ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aulaT pavan man meen kee chapal gat sukhamanaa sa(n)gam kai braham sathaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The unsettled wind and fickle-fish of the mind is contained within the mind of the God-conscious being."}}},{"verse_id":208003,"page_no":null,"line_no":61,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਸਲਿਲ ਗਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saagar salil geh gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd unaman magan lagan gur giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They merge with the Eternal Light of the Lord, just as the river merges with the water of the ocean. They remain in ecstacy and are focused, devoted on lighting their spirit with the Light the Guru has shone."}}},{"verse_id":208004,"page_no":null,"line_no":61,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਤਿ ਮੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਗਰਜਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jot mai jotee saroop dhaaminee chamatakaar garajat anahadh sabadh neesaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By melding into the super radiance of the Lord, they enjoy the blissful electric radiance of the union. They hear the sound of unstruck music loud and clear."}}},{"verse_id":208005,"page_no":null,"line_no":61,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਸਰਬ ਨੀਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੯॥","translit_en":"nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa a(n)mirat jal sevak sakal fal sarab needhaan hai ||59||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They perpetually enjoy the continuous flow of the divine elixir in the Dasam Duar and the seekers obtain all the fruits and treasures. (59)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41087,"next":41089}}
files.shabads/82/41089.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41089,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208006","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208006,"last_verse_id":208009,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208006,"page_no":null,"line_no":62,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar bedhan mai bedh beechaar log bedh bees ik iees gur giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious seeker lives like a worldly being in the society and conducts himself as a knowledgeable person among the scholars. And yet for him, all these are worldly deeds and keeps him unsullied from them. He remains engrossed in the memory of the Lord as taught to him by the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208007,"page_no":null,"line_no":62,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਤੀਤ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jog mai na jog bhog mai na khaan paan jog bhogaateet unaman unamaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The yogic practices do not provide a seeker with the true union of the Lord. The worldly pleasures are also devoid of true comfort and peace. Thus a Guru-conscious person keeps himself free from such distractions and enjoys the true bliss by engrossing his mind in the higher spiritual state."}}},{"verse_id":208008,"page_no":null,"line_no":62,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas dhiaan sabadh surat giaan giaan dhiaan lakh prem param nidhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious person's vision is always focused on the glimpse of his Guru. His mind is always engrossed in repeated remembrance of Lord's name. In acquiring such divine awareness, he is able to receive the divine treasure of love of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208009,"page_no":null,"line_no":62,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਧਨਾਧਯਾਤਮ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਰਬੋਤਿਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੦॥","translit_en":"man bach kram sram saadhanaadhayaatam kram gurmukh sukh sarabotim nidhaan hai ||60||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever good he does with mind, words and actions, is all spiritual. He enjoys all the happiness in the supreme treasure of Naam Simran. (60)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41088,"next":41090}}
files.shabads/82/41090.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41090,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208010","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208010,"last_verse_id":208013,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208010,"page_no":null,"line_no":63,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv dhaavat baraj raakhai nihachal mat man unaman bheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By engrossing the mind in the divine word, a Guru-conscious seeker is able to arrest his wandering mind. That stabilises his memory in the meditation of Naam raising him to a higher spiritual state."}}},{"verse_id":208011,"page_no":null,"line_no":63,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰ ਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saagar lahar gat aatam tara(n)g ra(n)g paramadhabhut paramaarath prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sea and the waves are one and the same. Similarly by becoming one with the Lord, the spiritual waves experienced are astonishing and gloriously unique. Guru-conscious people are only capable of understanding and experiencing the spiritual state."}}},{"verse_id":208012,"page_no":null,"line_no":63,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕ ਰਤਨ ਧਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes niramolak ratan dhan param nidhaan gur giaan livaleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru-conscious person obtains the invaluable jewel like treasure of Naam by the precepts of Guru. And once he obtains it, he remains engrossed in the practicing of Naam Simran."}}},{"verse_id":208013,"page_no":null,"line_no":63,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਹੰਸੋ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੧॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile soha(n) ha(n)so ek mek aapaa aap cheen hai ||61||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the harmonious union of Guru and Sikh (disciple) the Sikh attaches his mind in the divine word that enables his self to become one with the Supreme soul. Thus he is able to recognise what he truly is. (61)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41089,"next":41091}}
files.shabads/82/41091.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41091,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208014","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208014,"last_verse_id":208017,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208014,"page_no":null,"line_no":64,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਬਿਮਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat avagaahan bimal mat sabadh surat gur giaan ko pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikh who remains in service of his Guru, whose mind is engrossed in his teachings, who practices remembering Lord; his intellect becomes sharp and high. That enlightens his mind and soul with the light of Guru's knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":208015,"page_no":null,"line_no":64,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਦਿਬਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat sam dhirasaT kai dhib jot sabadh surat liv anabhai abhiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With Guru's word residing in the memory, seeing and treating all alike, he experiences the divine refulgence in his soul. By attachment of his mind in the divine word, he becomes a practitioner of Fearless Lord's Naam Simran."}}},{"verse_id":208016,"page_no":null,"line_no":64,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat paramaarath param padh sabadh surat sukh sahaj nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By this union a Guru-conscious person achieves emancipation, the supreme spiritual state. He then rests in a state of perpetual comfort and peace and lives in a state of blissful equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208017,"page_no":null,"line_no":64,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੬੨॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv prem ras rasik hui sabadh surat liv braham bisavaiaas hai ||62||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And by imbibing the divine word in his memory, Guru conscious person lives in the love of the Lord. He relishes the divine elixir forever. An astonishing devotion for the Lord develops in his mind then. (62)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41090,"next":41092}}
files.shabads/82/41092.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41092,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208018","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208018,"last_verse_id":208021,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208018,"page_no":null,"line_no":65,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਕਾਸ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile ghaT ghaT kaas jal a(n)tar dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a devoted Sikh meets True Guru, his vision gets absorbed in the sight/glimpse of the Guru. And then his soul recognises everyone as if He resides in all; like the sky/space resides equally in all the water pitchers."}}},{"verse_id":208019,"page_no":null,"line_no":65,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile ja(n)tr dhun ja(n)tree unaman unamaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of a True Guru and a Sikh blesses the Sikh with the capability of remaining engrossed in the words/precepts of the Guru. As a musician gets totally engrossed in the tune that he is playing, so is the case of a Sikh's absorption in his Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208020,"page_no":null,"line_no":65,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh man bach karam ikatr bhe tan tirabhavan gat ga(n)mitaa giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the concentration of mind and Guru's words in a Guru devotee, he realises all the happenings of the three worlds within his body."}}},{"verse_id":208021,"page_no":null,"line_no":65,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਆਤਮ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੩॥","translit_en":"ek aau anek mek braham bibek Tek srot saritaa samu(n)dhr aatam samaan hai ||63||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the help of divine knowledge, the soul of a Guru devotee becomes harmonious with One Lord who is present in every bit of His creation. This union is like the merging of a river water in the ocean. (63)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41091,"next":41093}}
files.shabads/82/41093.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41093,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208022","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208022,"last_verse_id":208025,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208022,"page_no":null,"line_no":66,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh man bach kram ikatr bhe paramadhabhut gat alakh lakhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The obedient slaves of Guru, being dyed in the hue of Naam Simran (with their mind, speech and actions being harmonious) sees the astonishing and transcendental Lord God conspicuous."}}},{"verse_id":208023,"page_no":null,"line_no":66,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar dhiaan dhib jot ko udhot bhio tirabhavan roop ghaT a(n)tar dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And when he looks inward (concentrates his faculties within), he sees the divine light refulgent within. He sees the happenings of the three worlds in his consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208024,"page_no":null,"line_no":66,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਤਨ ਜਤਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"param nidhaan gur giaan ko pragaas bhio ga(n)mitaa tirakaal gat jatan jataae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the supreme treasure of Guru's Gyan (Divine knowledge) becomes effulgent in the mind of a Guru conscious person, he becomes aware of all the three worlds. And even then, he does not go astray from his objective of absorption of self into the vastness of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208025,"page_no":null,"line_no":66,"gurmukhi":"ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮਧ ਪਾਨ ਮਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੬੪॥","translit_en":"aatam tara(n)g prem ras madh paan mat akath kathaa binodh herat hiraae hai ||64||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a devotee remains in a state of trance drinking deep the divine elixir of ecstasy. This wonderful state is beyond description. One feels amazed at this state. (64)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41092,"next":41094}}
files.shabads/82/41094.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41094,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208026","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208026,"last_verse_id":208029,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208026,"page_no":null,"line_no":67,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਕਤ ਹੀ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਾਤੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਭਏ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bin ras rasanaa bakat hee bahut baatai prem ras bas bhe mon brat leen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without tasting the elixir of Naam, an insipid tongue speaks much trash. On the contrary, by indulging in repeated utterance of His name, a devotee becomes sweet of tongue and pleasant of disposition."}}},{"verse_id":208027,"page_no":null,"line_no":67,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੈ ਮਦੋਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan kai madhon a(n)tar dhiaan dhirag dhuteeaa na cheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By drinking the elixir-like Naam, a devotee remains in a state of exhilaration. He starts seeing inward and depends not on anyone else."}}},{"verse_id":208028,"page_no":null,"line_no":67,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem nem sahaj samaadh anahadh liv dhuteeaa sabadh sravana(n)tar na keen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The devoted traveller on the path of Naam stays in a state of equipoise and remains absorbed in the celestial melody of divine words music. He hears no other sound in his ears."}}},{"verse_id":208029,"page_no":null,"line_no":67,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਅਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੫॥","translit_en":"bisam bidheh jag jeevan mukat bhe tirabhavan aau tirakaal ga(n)mitaa prabeen hai ||65||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And in this blissful state, he is free of body and still alive. He is free from all worldly things and is emancipated while still living. He becomes capable of knowing the happenings of the three worlds and of the three periods. (65)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41093,"next":41095}}
files.shabads/82/41095.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41095,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208030","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208030,"last_verse_id":208033,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208030,"page_no":null,"line_no":68,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧਤਾ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਹੋਤ ਕੋੇਟਿ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਮਿਲ ਬਿਸਮ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੈ॥","translit_en":"sakal suga(n)dhataa milat aragajaa hot koeT aragajaa mil bisam subaas kai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When sandalwood, musk, camphor and saffron are mixed; a fragrant paste is formed, But millions of such pastes are worthless before the fragrance of the lotus like feet of Satguru Ji."}}},{"verse_id":208031,"page_no":null,"line_no":68,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਕਮਲਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal anoop roop kamalaa bikhai samaat herat hiraat koT kamalaa pragaas kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the beauties of the world are absorbed in Lakshmi (the consort of Vishnu) but the beautiful radiance of Lord's feet is many times more blissful and pleasant than millions of Lakshmis,"}}},{"verse_id":208032,"page_no":null,"line_no":68,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਿਲ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭਏ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੁਇ ਚਕਿਤ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sarab nidhaan mil param nidhaan bhe koTik nidhaan hui chakit bilaas kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wealth of the world put together becomes supreme and invaluable assets. But all the peace and comforts obtainable from many times more wealth is not even a counterpart of the comforts obtained from the spiritual bliss of the Lord,"}}},{"verse_id":208033,"page_no":null,"line_no":68,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਯਾਸ ਕੈ ॥੬੬॥","translit_en":"charan kamal gur mahimaa agaadh bodh gursikh madhukar anabhai abhayaas kai ||66||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of the lotus feet of a True Guru is beyond the perception of a man. The devoted Sikhs enjoy and relish the elixir of the lotus feet of Fearless God through engrossing themselves in Naam Simran. (66)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41094,"next":41096}}
files.shabads/82/41096.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41096,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208034","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208034,"last_verse_id":208037,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208034,"page_no":null,"line_no":69,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖਾ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਾਟ ਸਾਟ ਰਤਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ratan paarakh mil ratan pareekhaa hot gurmukh haaT saaT ratan biauhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The genuineness of a gem can only be assayed by some connoisseur of the trade. Similarly an alert and attentive Sikh of the Guru trades in the purchase of jewel like Naam at the shop of a True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208035,"page_no":null,"line_no":69,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਕੈ ਗਾਹਕ ਚਾਹਕ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maanak heeraa amol man mukataahal kai gaahak chaahak laabh labhat apaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who is genuinely interested in the trading of the diamonds, pearls, rubies and precious stones, he alone makes maximum profit out of it. Similarly true devotees and disciples of the Guru trade in the commodity of True Naam and make their life profitable."}}},{"verse_id":208036,"page_no":null,"line_no":69,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਬਿਸਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat avagaahan bisaahan kai param nidhaan prem nem gur dhuaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By engrossing the mind in the divine word and trading in the commodity of Naam and Shabad (divine word), True Guru blesses his disciple with the treasure of love."}}},{"verse_id":208037,"page_no":null,"line_no":69,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਭਵ ਤਰਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੬੭॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mil sa(n)gam samaagam kai maiaa mai udhaas bhav tarat sa(n)saar hai ||67||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a true servant meets with True Guru; when he joins the loving and devoted congregation of the Guru, such a disciple who is ever in attendance of the Guru remains aloof and unsullied of maya (mammon). He sails across the worldly ocean with impunity. (67)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41095,"next":41097}}
files.shabads/82/41097.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41097,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208038","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208038,"last_verse_id":208041,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208038,"page_no":null,"line_no":70,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhat haivai nij ghar sahaj samaadh liv laagee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Gursikh (disciple of the Gum) immersed in the pleasure of the elixir of Naam of the Lord remains stable of mind and fully conscious of his self. His mind is ever absorbed in the memory of God."}}},{"verse_id":208039,"page_no":null,"line_no":70,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੇ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhat haivai gurmat ridhe jagamag jot jaagee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who remains engrossed in the elixir-like Naam of the Lord is blessed by the wisdom of Gum. The higher wisdom and his toil of remembering the Lord perpetually reveals the supernatural form of God radiance in his mind."}}},{"verse_id":208040,"page_no":null,"line_no":70,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhat haivai a(n)mirat nidhaan paan dhuramat bhaagee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is absorbed in the lotus-like holy feet of the True Guru, keeps drinking the elixir Naam from the inexhaustible source of the Lord. Thus he destroys his sullied wisdom."}}},{"verse_id":208041,"page_no":null,"line_no":70,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੈ ॥੬੮॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhat haivai maayaa mai udhaas baas biralo bairaagee hai ||68||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who remains absorbed in the lotus-like holy feet of the True Guru remains unsoiled by the effect of maya (mammon). Only a rare person achieves renunciation from material attractions of the world. (68)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41096,"next":41098}}
files.shabads/82/41098.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41098,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208042","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208042,"last_verse_id":208045,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208042,"page_no":null,"line_no":71,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਠਤ ਸੇ ਜੋਊ ਬਚੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਬੂਡ ਗਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛਤਾਯੋ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise naau booThat se jouoo bachai soiee bhalo boodd ge paachhe pachhataayo reh jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed are those who are saved from a capsizing boat. If drowned, there would be nothing but repentance."}}},{"verse_id":208043,"page_no":null,"line_no":71,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗ ਜੋਹੀ ਬਚੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਜਰ ਬੁਝੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਬਸੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghar laagai aag johee bachai soiee bhalo jar bujhai paachhai kachh bas na basaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All those who escape from a burning house are blessed people. Nothing can be done if one is burnt into ashes."}}},{"verse_id":208044,"page_no":null,"line_no":71,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੋਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਗੇ ਜੋਈ ਰਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਸੋਇ ਗਏ ਰੀਤੋ ਘਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਉਠ ਪਾ੍ਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chor laage jaage joiee rahai soiee bhalo soi ge reeto ghar dhekhai uTh paarat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As one wakes up when the thief is committing theft, whatever is left behind by him is bonus and blessing. Otherwise one would find the house empty in the morning."}}},{"verse_id":208045,"page_no":null,"line_no":71,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਤਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫॥੬੫॥","translit_en":"taise a(n)t kaal gur charan saran aavai pavai mokh padhavee natar bilalaat hai ||35||65||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly if a wayward person comes to the refuge of Guru even at the near end of his life, he can achieve a state of emancipation. Otherwise he would fall in the hands of angels of death and keep wailing. (69)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41097,"next":41099}}

॥","translit_en":"a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai satee hoi dha(n)n dha(n)n kahat hai sakal sa(n)saar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Controlling her mind and with utmost determination, when a
