wife."}}},{"verse_id":208047,"page_no":null,"line_no":72,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੂਝੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਹੋਤ ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai jodhaa joojhai it ut jat kat hot jai jaikaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a brave warrior lays down his life fighting for his noble cause determinedly till the end, he is applauded here, there and everywhere as a martyr."}}},{"verse_id":208048,"page_no":null,"line_no":72,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਫਾਸੀ ਕੈ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਢਾਏ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai chor marai faasee kai sooree chaddaae jag meh dhikaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Contrary to this, as a thief determinedly makes up his mind to commit theft, if caught, he is jailed, hanged or punished, he is degraded and rebuked the world over"}}},{"verse_id":208049,"page_no":null,"line_no":72,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਨਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੭੦॥","translit_en":"taise dhuramat gurmat kai asaadh saadh sa(n)gat subhaav gat maanas aautaar jee ||70||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly one becomes bad and wicked with base wisdom whereas accepting and abiding by Guru's wisdom makes a person noble and virtuous. A human being makes his life a success or failure according to the company he keeps or his devotion to the holy congregation. (70)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41098,"next":41100}}
files.shabads/82/41100.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41100,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208050","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208050,"last_verse_id":208053,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208050,"page_no":null,"line_no":73,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਕੈ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਰ ਅੰਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਅਥਾਹ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh kai anaadh ar a(n)t kai ana(n)t at paar kai apaar na athaeh thaeh paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the imperishable God is beyond beginning though He is the beginning of all; as He is beyond end since He is the end of all; as He is beyond the farthest conceivable extent as He is unfathomable, so is the praise of the True Guru just like that of Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208051,"page_no":null,"line_no":73,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸੰਖ ਕੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਪੁਨਿ ਲੇਖ ਕੈ ਅਲੇਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੌਲ ਕੈ ਤੁਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mit kai amit ar sa(n)kh kai asa(n)kh pun lekh kai alekh nahee taual kai tulaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the imperishable God is beyond measurement, beyond counting, beyond perception, beyond· weighing; so is the praise of a True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208052,"page_no":null,"line_no":73,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰਜੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨ ਮੋਲ ਕੈ ਮੁਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aradh uradh paraja(n)t kai apaaraja(n)t agam agochar na mol kai mulaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the Almighty is limitless, inaccessible, beyond the perception of senses and evaluation, so is the praise of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208053,"page_no":null,"line_no":73,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੭੧॥","translit_en":"paramadhabhut asacharaj bisam at abigat gat satigur kee baddaiee hai ||71||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As God Almighty is absolutely marvellous, astonishing and very strange, so is the praise of True Guru. (71)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41099,"next":41101}}
files.shabads/82/41101.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41101,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208054","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208054,"last_verse_id":208057,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208054,"page_no":null,"line_no":74,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਕੋਟ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur teerath purab koT dhevee dhev sev gur charan saran hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Refuge of a True Guru is equivalent to pilgrimage of millions of holy places. Service of millions of gods and goddesses is also equivalent to living in the service of True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208055,"page_no":null,"line_no":74,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਮਰਨ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur kaamanaa sakal fal ridh sidh nidh avataar amaran hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All desires fructify in the holy refuge of True Guru. All the miraculous powers remain in attendance forever."}}},{"verse_id":208056,"page_no":null,"line_no":74,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur naam nihakaam dhaam bhagat jugat kar taaran taran hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meditation on Lord's name carried out in the refuge of the True Guru but with no reward at the back of the mind, is the place of all the comforts and peace in the world. A devoted Sikh absorbs himself in Naam Simran and sails across the worldly ocean beside helping others in their emancipation."}}},{"verse_id":208057,"page_no":null,"line_no":74,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੮॥੮੮॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur mahimaa agaadh bodh haran bharan gat kaaran karan hai ||38||88||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of the refuge of a True Guru is beyond perception. Like eternal Lord, it destroys all base deeds and vices and fills a person with virtues. (72)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41100,"next":41102}}
files.shabads/82/41102.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41102,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208058","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208058,"last_verse_id":208061,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208058,"page_no":null,"line_no":75,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh ek mek rom mahimaa ana(n)t agam apaar gur mahimaa nidhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of inexhaustible toil of Naam Simran in the service of a True Guru, the praise of a hair of a Gursikh is infinite. Then the inaccessible Satguru with countless virtues is a treasure house of praises."}}},{"verse_id":208059,"page_no":null,"line_no":75,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਬੋਲ ਕੋ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਮੋਲ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਮਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh ek mek bol ko na tol mol sree gur sabadh agamit giaan dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who obey the commands of their True Guru; those who are one with their Guru; their words are beyond evaluation. Then the divine words of a True Guru, his Gyan (knowledge) and reflection on his precepts is beyond comprehension."}}},{"verse_id":208060,"page_no":null,"line_no":75,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਾਰੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਰਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh ek mek dhirasaT dhirasaT taarai sree gur kaTaachh kirapaa ko na paramaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When one who is in harmony with True Guru, who meditates on His name, his one glimpse is good enough to sail the recipient across the ocean. Then the intensity of power of a True Guru is incomprehensible."}}},{"verse_id":208061,"page_no":null,"line_no":75,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਪਲ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੭੩॥","translit_en":"gursikh ek mek pal sa(n)g ra(n)g ras abigat gat satigur nirabaan hai ||73||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The company of a person for a second, who is deep into the meditation of Lord's name bless one with happiness, ecstasy and elixir of life. Like indestructible Lord, Satguru  is an epitome of eternal bliss. (73)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41101,"next":41103}}
files.shabads/82/41103.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41103,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208062","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208062,"last_verse_id":208065,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208062,"page_no":null,"line_no":76,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baran baran bahu baran ghaTaa ghama(n)dd basudhaa biraajamaan barakhaa ana(n)dh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gathering of thick and different hue of clouds in the sky causes rain that beautifies the Earth spreading happiness all around. "}}},{"verse_id":208063,"page_no":null,"line_no":76,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਕੰਦ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baran baran hui prafulit banaasapatee baran baran fal fool mool ka(n)dh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That also causes colourful flowers to bloom. The vegetation wears a fresh and new look. "}}},{"verse_id":208064,"page_no":null,"line_no":76,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਖਗ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਭਾਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baran baran khag bibidh bhaakhaa pragaas kusam suga(n)dh paun gaun seet ma(n)dh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With fragrance of the colourful flowers carried by cool breeze and fruits of different shape, size and taste, birds of various species come and sing songs merrily. "}}},{"verse_id":208065,"page_no":null,"line_no":76,"gurmukhi":"ਰਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕੈ ॥੭੪॥","translit_en":"ravan gavan jal thal tiran sobhaa nidh safal hui charan kamal makara(n)dh kai ||74||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Enjoying all these attractions of the rainy season become more fruitful and enjoyable by putting hard work on the meditation of Lord's name as is advised by Satguru. (74)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41102,"next":41104}}
files.shabads/82/41104.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41104,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208066","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208066,"last_verse_id":208069,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208066,"page_no":null,"line_no":77,"gurmukhi":"ਚੀਟੀ ਕੈ ਉਦਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਹਸਤੀ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਅਤੁਲ ਪਹਾਰ ਭਾਰ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਨ ਉਠਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"cheeTee kai udhar bikhai hasatee samai kaise atul pahaar bhaar bhira(n)gee na uThaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As an elephant cannot be contained in the stomach of an ant, as a small flying insect cannot lift the weight of a mountain,"}}},{"verse_id":208067,"page_no":null,"line_no":77,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਛਰ ਕੇ ਡੰਗ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਹੈ ਬਾਸਕ ਨਾਗ ਮਕਰੀ ਨ ਚੀਤੈ ਜੀਤੈ ਸਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"maachhar ke dda(n)g na marat hai baasak naag makaree na cheetai jeetai sar na pujaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a mosquito sting cannot kill the king of snakes, a spider can neither win a tiger nor match with it, "}}},{"verse_id":208068,"page_no":null,"line_no":77,"gurmukhi":"ਤਮਚਰ ਉਡਤ ਨ ਪੰਹੁਚੈ ਆਕਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਮੂਸਾ ਤਉ ਨ ਪੈਰਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"tamachar uddat na pa(n)huchai aakaas baas moosaa tau na pairat samu(n)dhr paar paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As an owl cannot fly and reach the sky, nor can a rat swim across the ocean and reach the far side, "}}},{"verse_id":208069,"page_no":null,"line_no":77,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਜਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੭੫॥","translit_en":"taise pria prem nem agam agaadh bodh gurmukh saagar jiau boo(n)dh hui samaaviee ||75||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So are the ethics of love of our beloved Lord difficult and beyond for us to understand. It is a very serious subject. As a drop of water merges with the water of the ocean, so does a devoted Sikh of the Guru becomes one with his beloved Lord. (75)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41103,"next":41105}}
files.shabads/82/41105.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41105,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208070","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208070,"last_verse_id":208073,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208070,"page_no":null,"line_no":78,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat avagaahan kai saadh sa(n)g aatam tara(n)g ga(n)g saagar lahar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":" When a Sikh joins in the holy congregation and become engrossed in the divine word, the ecstasy of the spiritual waves felt by him is like the waves of the ocean. "}}},{"verse_id":208071,"page_no":null,"line_no":78,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਆਹਿ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਹਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"agam athaeh aaeh apar apaar at ratan pragaas nidh pooran gahar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ocean-like Lord is beyond our reach and its depth is unfathomable. One who stays engrossed in Naam Simran and adulations of the Lord is able to realise the jewel-like treasure of the Almighty. "}}},{"verse_id":208072,"page_no":null,"line_no":78,"gurmukhi":"ਹੰਸ ਮਰਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਹਕ ਚਾਹਕ ਸੰਤ ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਪਹਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ha(n)s marajeevaa gun gaahak chaahak sa(n)t nis dhin ghaTikaa mahoorat pahar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The true disciple and seeker of the Lord remains a trader for the jewel-like traits of the Lord's name and he is never affected by the time of the day or night, watch, auspiciousness of the time and other rites and rituals. "}}},{"verse_id":208073,"page_no":null,"line_no":78,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਖਾ ਜਿਉ ਗਵਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਹੋਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਉ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰ ਹੈ ॥੭੬॥","translit_en":"savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh barakhaa jiau gavan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd hot mukataahal aau nar narahar hai ||76||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the Swati raindrop becomes a precious pearl when it falls on a clam in the deep sea, similarly when a Sikh experiences the divine unstruck music in the tenth opening (Dasam Duar) as a result of Naam Simran, he becomes God from the form of a human being. (76)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41104,"next":41106}}
files.shabads/82/41106.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41106,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208074","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208074,"last_verse_id":208077,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208074,"page_no":null,"line_no":79,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਭਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਅਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv jot ko udhot bhio tirabhavan aau tirakaal a(n)tar dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the absorption of his mind in the divine word, a devoted servant of the Guru experiences the radiance of the Lord within, and in such a state, he becomes aware of the happenings three worlds and in the three periods. "}}},{"verse_id":208075,"page_no":null,"line_no":79,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gurmat ko pragaas akath kathaa binodh alakh lakhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the lodging of the divine word in the consciousness Guru-conscious person, he experiences the refulgence of the divine wisdom within. And in this state, he establishes a relationship with the God and enjoys lasting bliss. He then understands the unknowable Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208076,"page_no":null,"line_no":79,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਅਪਿਅ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv nijhar apaar dhaar prem ras rasik hui apia peeaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By his engrossment in the word, he experiences a perpetual flow of elixir of Naam from the Dasam Duar and he continuously enjoys its relishment."}}},{"verse_id":208077,"page_no":null,"line_no":79,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮਏ ਹੈ ॥੭੭॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv soha(n) so ajapaa jaap sahaj samaadh sukh saagar same hai ||77||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This engrossment of his consciousness attaches him with the comforting and peace-giving Lord and he remains absorbed meditating on His name. (77) "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41105,"next":41107}}
files.shabads/82/41107.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41107,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208078","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208078,"last_verse_id":208081,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208078,"page_no":null,"line_no":80,"gurmukhi":"ਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਹੁਤੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਬੈਦ ਪੈ ਲੈ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh kai biaadh kai upaadh kai tiradhokh hute gursikh saadh gur baidh pai lai aae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The disciple servant of the Guru brings all those who suffer from physical, psychic or ailments of mind, to the doctor like True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208079,"page_no":null,"line_no":80,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਪੇਖ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਮੇਟੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਮ ਭੈ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mit kaTaachh pekh janam maran meTe jon jam bhai nivaare abhai padh paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru obliterates their cycle of re-incarnation by casting one clement look of grace upon them. He makes them free of all psychosis of death and thus they attain a state of fearlessness."}}},{"verse_id":208080,"page_no":null,"line_no":80,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਜ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੈ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੀਖਿਆ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਅਉਖਦਿ ਖਵਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh raj lepan kai dheekhiaa seekhiaa sa(n)jam kai aaukhadh khavaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By providing support to all those who come to his refuge, by consecrating them with practice of meditation and imparting them with divine knowledge, he provides them with the medication of Naam and restraint. "}}},{"verse_id":208081,"page_no":null,"line_no":80,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੭੮॥","translit_en":"karam bharam khoi dhaavat baraj raakhe nihachal mat sukh sahaj samaae hai ||78||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And thus the ailing persons sheds away the network of rites and rituals controlling the wandering mind for enjoyment of false pleasures. They then stay in stable disposition and acquire state of equipoise. (78)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41106,"next":41108}}
files.shabads/82/41108.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41108,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208082","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208082,"last_verse_id":208085,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208082,"page_no":null,"line_no":81,"gurmukhi":"ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਰਗ੍ਰਾਮੀ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਮੀਪ ਬੂਡਿ ਮਰਤ ਅਭਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bohith praves bhe nirabhai hui paaragraamee bohith sameep boodd marat abhaage hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Once someone boards a ship, he is confident of sailing across the sea. But many unfortunates die even when the ship is near about. "}}},{"verse_id":208083,"page_no":null,"line_no":81,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੋ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਹੋਹਿ ਦੂਰੰਤਰ ਤਰੁ ਗੰਧ ਮਾਰੁਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep dhuraga(n)dh so suga(n)dh hoh dhoora(n)tar tar ga(n)dh maarut na laage hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fragrance less trees acquire fragrance when they grow near Sandalwood trees. But those trees which are located far away do not receive fragrant breeze of Sandalwood as it cannot reach them."}}},{"verse_id":208084,"page_no":null,"line_no":81,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਾਰਿ ਗਰ ਹਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਕੁਲ ਦੀਪਕ ਨ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog naar gar haar hot purakh bidhes kul dheepak na jaage hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To enjoy the pleasure of nocturnal bed, a faithful wife clings to her husband. But one whose husband is away don't even feel like lighting a lamp in her home."}}},{"verse_id":208085,"page_no":null,"line_no":81,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਲ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੇ ਹੈ ॥੭੯॥","translit_en":"sree gur kirapaa nidhaan simaran giaan dhiaan gurmukh sukh fal pal anuraage hai ||79||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a Gursikh who holds the Guru close receives comfort by following the teachings of the Guru and meditating upon the Name that the Guru has blessed him with. One who does not feel the presence of Vaheguru cannot attain peace. (79)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41107,"next":41109}}
files.shabads/82/41109.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41109,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208086","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208086,"last_verse_id":208089,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208086,"page_no":null,"line_no":82,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal ko mahaatam agaadh bodh at asacharaj mai namo namo nam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The praise of the lotus feet of Satguru Ii is comprehension. It is indeed wonderful. Salutations time and again."}}},{"verse_id":208087,"page_no":null,"line_no":82,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਮਲ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਔ ਸੀਤਲ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਭਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨ ਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"komal komalataa aau seetal seetalataa kai baasanaa subhaas taas dhuteeaa na sam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They are tender than the tenderness of the whole world. They are indeed comfortably cool. No other fragrance matches them. "}}},{"verse_id":208088,"page_no":null,"line_no":82,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰਸ ਗੰਮਯਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh nij aasan si(n)ghaasan savaiaadh bisamaadh ras ga(n)mayataa agam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The disciple, who lives ever in attendance of the holy feet of the True Satguru Ii and has worked hard on meditation of Lord's name, has relished the supernatural elixir of Naam Simran. "}}},{"verse_id":208089,"page_no":null,"line_no":82,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥੮੦॥","translit_en":"roop kai anoop roop man manasaa thakat akath kathaa binodh bisamai bisam hai ||80||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The beauty of Satguru's lotus feet is exemplary. The desire and faculty of mind tires describing it. Their praise indescribable. This wonder of wonders is astonishing. (80)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41108,"next":41110}}
files.shabads/82/41110.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41110,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208090","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208090,"last_verse_id":208093,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208090,"page_no":null,"line_no":83,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਬਦ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur dharasan sabadh agaadh bodh abigat gat net net namo nam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Understanding the deep philosophy and his precept is highly unfathomable matter that is beyond comprehension. Like the imperishable Lord, it is beyond and infinite and worthy of salutation time and again."}}},{"verse_id":208091,"page_no":null,"line_no":83,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਠਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dhiaan ar sabadh giaan liv gupat pragaT ThaT pooran braham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By concentrating mind in his philosophy and attaching the mind in Naam Simran, one realises the omnipresent Lord in the entire expanse created by Him."}}},{"verse_id":208092,"page_no":null,"line_no":83,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੁਸਮਾਵਲੀ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਏਕ ਔ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niragun saragun kusamaavalee suga(n)dh sa(n)dh ek aau anek roop ga(n)mitaa agam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One Transcendental Lord is appearing in countless immanent forms. Like the fragrance of a flower bed, He, the inaccessible can be realised and felt."}}},{"verse_id":208093,"page_no":null,"line_no":83,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥੮੧॥","translit_en":"paramadhabhut asacharajai asacharaj mai akath kathaa alakh bisamai bisam hai ||81||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The precept and philosophy of the True Guru is utmost admirable. It is most astonishing and beyond description. He is beyond understanding and stranger than the strangest. (81)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41109,"next":41111}}
files.shabads/82/41111.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41111,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208094","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208094,"last_verse_id":208097,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208094,"page_no":null,"line_no":84,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur dharas dhiaan giaan a(n)jam kai mitr satrataa nivaaree pooran braham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By concentrating mind on the vision and by toiling on Naam Simran with rapt attention, one destroys all enmity and friendship and experiences presence of One Lord God."}}},{"verse_id":208095,"page_no":null,"line_no":84,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes paraves aadh kau aadhes usatat ni(n)dhaa meT ga(n)mitaa agam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By imbibing the words of the Guru in one's heart and by the counsel of the True Guru can one indulge in His praise humbly. All desires of praise and slander are destroyed and one reaches the inaccessible Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208096,"page_no":null,"line_no":84,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gahe dhaavat baraj raakhe aasaa manasaa thakat safal janam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By taking the refuge of a True Guru, a mind chasing vices and other evil pleasures come to rest. All desires and expectations end. Thus a human birth becomes a success. "}}},{"verse_id":208097,"page_no":null,"line_no":84,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਹੈ ॥੮੨॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g prem nem jeevan mukat gat kaam nihakaam nihakaram karam hai ||82||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Through joining the congregation of the Guru (Sadh Sangat), one reaches the state of emancipation while alive (Jeevan Mukt). One feels unaffected by worldly desires and instead focusses on Simran and Seva without desire for any reward. (82)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41110,"next":41112}}
files.shabads/82/41112.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41112,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208098","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208098,"last_verse_id":208101,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208098,"page_no":null,"line_no":85,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur dhev sev alakh abhev gat saavadhaan saadh sa(n)g simaran maatr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Keeping company of holy persons wakefully, serving the effulgent True Guru and practicing continuous Naam Simran the indescribable and incomprehensible Lord is perceived."}}},{"verse_id":208099,"page_no":null,"line_no":85,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰੀਤ ਪਾਰਸ ਕਰੈ ਮਨੂਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਮੈਂ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਦੈ ਕੁਪਾਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"patit puneet reet paaras karai manoor baas mai(n) subaas dhai kupaatreh supaatr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the true tradition of converting sinners into pious individuals, by the sermon of Naam Simran, a True Guru changes the iron slag-like base persons into gold/philosopher-stone. And by instilling the fragrance of Naam Simran in the bamboo-like arrogant individuals, he makes them superior persons. "}}},{"verse_id":208100,"page_no":null,"line_no":85,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸੈ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"patit puneet kar paavan pavitr keene paaras manoor baas baasai dhrum jaatr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who is made noble by Guru, strives to make others noble. Focusing on Naam, an iron-like person is made into gold or a philosopher's stone. A bamboo-like arrogant person becomes humble and acquires a fragrance that spreads to others."}}},{"verse_id":208101,"page_no":null,"line_no":85,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਜੀਅ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਠ ਛੇਦ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਕੈ ॥੮੩॥","translit_en":"saritaa samu(n)dhr saadh sa(n)g tirakhaava(n)t jeea kirapaa jal dheejai moh ka(n)Th chhedh chaatrakai ||83||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The company of holy and True Guru is like rivers and lakes from where his disciples drink the elixir of Naam and quench their thirst. I, an unfortunate person am still thirsty because I am full of ill traits and vices. Please be clement on me and grant me the boon of Naam Simran. (83)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41111,"next":41113}}
files.shabads/82/41113.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41113,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208102","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208102,"last_verse_id":208105,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208102,"page_no":null,"line_no":86,"gurmukhi":"ਬੀਸ ਕੇ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਹੇਮ ਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bees ke baratamaan bhe na subaas baa(n)s hem na bhe manoor log bedh giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Practically, bamboo cannot acquire fragnance and iron cannot become gold. However, through the Guru, a bamboo-like arrogant person can acquire the fragnance of virtues and a vice ridden person (dirty like iron) can become pious and shine like gold."}}},{"verse_id":208103,"page_no":null,"line_no":86,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਕੋ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਸੈ ਦੁ੍ਰਮ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th ik iees ko baratamaan cha(n)dhan subaas baa(n)s baasai dhuram aan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The path of Sikhism is a path of One God. The sandalwood like True Guru blesses a bamboo-like arrogant person with humility and Naam making him full of virtuous qualities. His dedication to Naam Simran instills fragrance into other similar persons."}}},{"verse_id":208104,"page_no":null,"line_no":86,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਚਨ ਮਨੂਰ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਭੇਟਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)chan manoor hoi paaras paras bheT paaras manoor karai aaur Thaur maan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Vice laden iron waste-like person becomes philosopher-stone by touching Paaras (philosopher stone) like True Guru. The True Guru converts the wasted person into gold like virtuous. He earns respect everywhere."}}},{"verse_id":208105,"page_no":null,"line_no":86,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ  ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥੮੪॥","translit_en":"gursikh saadh sa(n)g patit puneet reet  gursikh sa(n)dh mile gursikh jaan hai ||84||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The congregation of holy and true disciples of a True Guru is capable of making the sinners into pious persons. One who joins the congregation of true Sikhs of Satguru is also known as Guru's disciple. (84)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41112,"next":41114}}
files.shabads/82/41114.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41114,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208106","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208106,"last_verse_id":208109,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208106,"page_no":null,"line_no":87,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur bhiee nihachal mat man unaman liv sahaj samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the refuge of Satguru the intellect becomes stable. The mind attaches itself with state divine and rests in equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208107,"page_no":null,"line_no":87,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil paramadhabhut prem nem upajaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the mind engrossing into the teachings of Satguru and divine word residing for ever in the memory, astonishing loving devotion is generated."}}},{"verse_id":208108,"page_no":null,"line_no":87,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੁਇ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਧਾਤ ਕੰਚਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g hui ta(n)bol ras paaras paras dhaat ka(n)chan dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of devoted Sikhs, one gets dyed in the color of the Lord; they give their fragrance like a betel leaf and as metal can become gold when touched with the Philosophers-stone; so becomes the state of devoted Sikhs."}}},{"verse_id":208109,"page_no":null,"line_no":87,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥੮੫॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh sa(n)dh baasanaa subaas taas akath kathaa binodh kahat na aae hai ||85||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The touch of the Holy Feet, a glimpse of the True Guru, passes on fragrance like the sandalwood, which makes other trees equally fragrant. This state of ecstasy is beyond words. (85)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41113,"next":41115}}
files.shabads/82/41115.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41115,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208110","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208110,"last_verse_id":208113,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208110,"page_no":null,"line_no":88,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran hui akath kathaa binodh kahat na aae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union between Guru and Sikh is full of pleasure and happiness. It cannot be described. By the strenuous practice of meditation on the Guru blessed Naam and by relishing the elixir of love, a Sikh feels totally satiated."}}},{"verse_id":208111,"page_no":null,"line_no":88,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan siaan simaran bisimaran kai bisam bidheh bisamaadh bisamaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Forgetting the worldly boasts of knowledge, involvements, wisdoms and other achievements, practicing the Simran strenuously, a Sikh loses the awareness of his existence and he merges in the astonishing of astonishing state."}}},{"verse_id":208112,"page_no":null,"line_no":88,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਅਰੁ ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਭਏ ਥਾਹ ਕੈ ਅਥਾਹ ਨ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh paramaadh ar a(n)t kai ana(n)t bhe thaeh kai athaeh na apaar paar paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By reaching the high divine state and becoming one with the Lord who is beyond the beginning, and even the eons, a Sikh goes beyond the beginning and end. He becomes unfathomable and because of his oneness with Him, his extent cannot be comprehended."}}},{"verse_id":208113,"page_no":null,"line_no":88,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਦੀਪਕ ਸੈ ਦੀਪਕ ਜਗਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੮੬॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees soha(n) soiee dheepak sai dheepak jagai hai ||86||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This union of Guru and Sikh surely makes a Sikh like God Himself. This union makes him dwell in His name. He perpetually utters-Thou! Thou! Lord! Lord! and he enlightens the beacon of Naam. (86)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41114,"next":41116}}
files.shabads/82/41116.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41116,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208114","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208114,"last_verse_id":208117,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208114,"page_no":null,"line_no":89,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਚਲ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਚਲ ਆਵਈ॥","translit_en":"satigur charan saran chal jai sikh charan saran taa(n) kee jagat chal aaviee||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh who devotedly goes to the refuge of a True Guru, has the whole world falling at his feet."}}},{"verse_id":208115,"page_no":null,"line_no":89,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗਯਾ ਸਤਯ ਸਤਯ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਿਖਯ ਆਗਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur aagayaa satay satay kar maanai sikhay aagayaa taeh sagal sa(n)saar hitaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who abides by the command of his Guru, accepting it to be true; his command is loved by the whole world."}}},{"verse_id":208116,"page_no":null,"line_no":89,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਖ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sevaa bhai praan poojaa karai sikh sarab nidhaan agrabhaag liv laaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who serves his Guru with loving devotion at the cost of his life considering such service as worship, all the treasures are mute attendant before him."}}},{"verse_id":208117,"page_no":null,"line_no":89,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਖਯਾ ਦੀਖਯਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਜਾਹਿ॥ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੀਖ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੮੭॥","translit_en":"satigur seekhayaa dheekhayaa hiradhai praves jaah|| taa kee seekh sunat param padh paaviee ||87||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who has the teachings and consecration of his Guru in his heart, listening to his teachings/sermons one can reach supreme spiritual state. (87)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41115,"next":41117}}
files.shabads/82/41117.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41117,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208118","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208118,"last_verse_id":208121,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208118,"page_no":null,"line_no":90,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮਂੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਭਏ ਬਾਰਨੀ ਬਿਗੰਧ ਗੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g ma(n)ai ra(n)geele bhe baaranee biga(n)dh ga(n)g sa(n)g mile ga(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As evil smelling wine when poured into river Ganges become like the water of Ganges, so can vice ridden, maya (mammon) immersed, worldly pleasure seeking individuals get dyed in the hue of Naam Simran when they join the true, Naam immersed holy company of devoted Sikhs."}}},{"verse_id":208119,"page_no":null,"line_no":90,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"surasaree sa(n)gam haivai prabal pravaeh liv saagar athaeh satigur sa(n)g sa(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the rapid flow of brooks and rivers like Ganges merges into the vast ocean losing all their destructive traits, so can one get absorbed into the ocean like Satguru by keeping the company of true, loving and devoted Sikhs."}}},{"verse_id":208120,"page_no":null,"line_no":90,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh nihachal chit dharasan sobhaa nidh lahar tara(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind stabilises in the fragrant dust of Satguru’s feet. The glimpse of infinite praise, myriad colourful waves of Naam appear in his consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208121,"page_no":null,"line_no":90,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨੂ ਗਯਾਨ ਅੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੈ ॥੮੮॥","translit_en":"anahadh sabadh kai sarab nidhaan dhaanoo gayaan a(n)s ha(n)s gat sumat sraba(n)g hai ||88||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of Naam Simran and appearance of unstruck music in the consciousness, a Sikh feels he has been blessed with all the treasures of the world. He acquires knowledge of the True Guru that reflects in every hair of his body. (88)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41116,"next":41118}}
files.shabads/82/41118.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41118,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208122","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208122,"last_verse_id":208125,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208122,"page_no":null,"line_no":91,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਏ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag hui dhubidhaa bharam khoe charan saran gahe nij ghar aae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Entering the path of Sikhism destroys suspicions and separatism and by the support of Satguru, one realises self."}}},{"verse_id":208123,"page_no":null,"line_no":91,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕੈ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dharas dhib dhirasaT pragaas bhiee a(n)mirat kaTaachh kai amar padh paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the glimpse of Satguru, one is blessed with a vision that enables one see the Lord all around oneself. By the clement look of Satguru, one achieves eternal position."}}},{"verse_id":208124,"page_no":null,"line_no":91,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨ ਛਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat anahadh nijhar jharan simaran ma(n)tr liv unaman chhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the union of word and consciousness and by virtue of the sweet tune of Naam, a perpetual flow of divine elixir starts flowing. By continuous repetition of Guru-given incantation, higher spiritual state is achieved."}}},{"verse_id":208125,"page_no":null,"line_no":91,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੮੯॥","translit_en":"man bach kram hui ikatr gurmukh sukh prem nem bisam bisavaiaas upajaae hai ||89||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person attains real spiritual comfort and peace by bringing in harmony between mind, words and deeds. That unique tradition of Lord's love breeds a wonderful confidence and faith in his mind. (89)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41117,"next":41119}}
files.shabads/82/41119.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41119,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208126","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208126,"last_verse_id":208129,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208126,"page_no":null,"line_no":92,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ ਸਮਤ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh aapaa khoi jeevan mukat gat bisam bidheh geh samat subhaau hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikh follower of Guru loses his self and achieves salvation in his life when still alive. Leading a house holder’s life, he feels no concern for distress or peace/comfort that comes his way."}}},{"verse_id":208127,"page_no":null,"line_no":92,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਸਮ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਅਰੁ ਪੰੁਨ ਪਾਪ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"janam maran sam narak surag ar pa(n)un paap sa(n)pat bipat chi(n)taa chaau hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And then birth and death, sin and piety, heaven and hell, pleasures and tribulations, worry and happiness all means equal to him."}}},{"verse_id":208128,"page_no":null,"line_no":92,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਹ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਧੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਗਾਨੰਦ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਤਾਉ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ban greh jog bhog log bedh giaan dhiaan dhukh sukh sogaana(n)dh mitr satr taau hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For such a Guru-conscious person, jungle and home, enjoyment and renunciation, folk traditions and traditions of the scriptures, knowledge and contemplation, peace and distress, sorrow and pleasure, friendship and enmity are all the same."}}},{"verse_id":208129,"page_no":null,"line_no":92,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਅਨੁਰਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੯੦॥","translit_en":"losaT kanik bikh a(n)mirat agan jal sahaj samaadh unaman anuraau hai ||90||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A lump of earth or gold, poison and nectar, water and fire are all the same for a Guru-conscious person. Because, his love is to remain absorbed in the stable state of perpetual knowledge of the Guru. (90)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41118,"next":41120}}
files.shabads/82/41120.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41120,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208130","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208130,"last_verse_id":208133,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208130,"page_no":null,"line_no":93,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੁਇ ਜਨਮ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਚਰਨ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗ ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"safal janam gurmukh hui janam jeetio charan safal gur maarag ravan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A human life is usefully spent when one leads it as an obedient Sikh of the True Guru and wins all its benefits. The feet are successful if they tread the path defined by the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208131,"page_no":null,"line_no":93,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਾ ਵਲੋਕਨ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕ ਸਫਲ ਰਜ ਪਦ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan safal gur dharasaa valokan kai masatak safal raj padh gavan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The eyes are successful if they accept the omnipresence of the Lord and see Him everywhere. The forehead is successful if it touches the dust of the path tread by Satguru."}}},{"verse_id":208132,"page_no":null,"line_no":93,"gurmukhi":"ਹਸਤ ਸਫਲ ਨਮ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"hasat safal nam satagur baanee likhe surat safal gur sabadh sravan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The hands are successful if they are raised in the salutation of Satguru and to write his utterances/compositions. The ears become successful by listening to the glory, adulations of the Lord and words of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208133,"page_no":null,"line_no":93,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਕੈ ॥੯੧॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gat safal gursikh saadh sa(n)gam kai prem nem ga(n)mitaa tirakaal tirabhavan kai ||91||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The congregation of holy and true souls attended by a Sikh is useful as it helps in uniting with the Lord. Thus abiding by the tradition of Naam Simran, he becomes aware of all the three worlds and the three periods. (91)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41119,"next":41121}}
files.shabads/82/41121.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41121,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208134","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208134,"last_verse_id":208137,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208134,"page_no":null,"line_no":94,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui sahaj samaadh sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By becoming a true servant of Satguru Ji, remaining fond of the fragrance of the dust of the holy feet of the True Guru, and in perpetual contemplation, a Sikh permeates himself in the spiritual peace."}}},{"verse_id":208135,"page_no":null,"line_no":94,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈਜਲ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਲਹਰ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਸਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਠਹਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaijal bhiaanak lahar na biaap sakai dhubidhaa nivaar ek Tek Thaharaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious person is never affected by the frightening worldly waves of desires and hopes. He is deemed to have destroyed all duality and taken the refuge of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208136,"page_no":null,"line_no":94,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਰਜਿ ਬਿਸਰਜਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT sabadh surat baraj bisarajit prem nem bisam bisavaiaas ur aane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He keeps his eyes away from the evils and ears closed to the slander and praise. Ever engrossed in Naam Simran, he imbibes the celestial faith of the Lord in his mind."}}},{"verse_id":208137,"page_no":null,"line_no":94,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੯੨॥","translit_en":"jeevan mukat jag jeevan jeevan mool aapaa khoi hoi apara(n)par paraane hai ||92||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Liberated Guru-conscious Sikh sheds all his ego and becomes a devotee of the infinite Lord, the creator of the World and source of all life on it. (92)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41120,"next":41122}}
files.shabads/82/41122.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41122,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208138","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208138,"last_verse_id":208141,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208138,"page_no":null,"line_no":95,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਏਕ ਭਏ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"saritaa sarovar salil mil ek bhe ek sai anek hot kaise niravaaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the water of river and lake meet, they become indistinguishable. Then how can they be disintegrated into their earlier form when they have become one?"}}},{"verse_id":208139,"page_no":null,"line_no":95,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਨ ਚੂਨਾ ਕਾਥਾ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਖਾਏ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਭਏ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"paan choonaa kaathaa supaaree khaae sura(n)g bhe bahur na chatur baran bisathaaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chewing beetle leaf, catechu, lime and beetle nut produces deep red colour. But then none of these ingredients can be separated from that red colour."}}},{"verse_id":208140,"page_no":null,"line_no":95,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਮੈ ਅਨਿਕ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਗੋਤਾਚਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"paaras paras hot kanik anik dhaat kanik mai anik na hot gotaachaaro jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many metals turn into gold by a touch of the philosopher-stone. Thereafter they cannot revert back to their original form."}}},{"verse_id":208141,"page_no":null,"line_no":95,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਕੈ ਸੁਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ਜੀ ॥੯੩॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan subaas kai subaasanaa banaasapatee bhagat jagat pat bisam bichaaro jee ||93||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sandalwood tree imparts fragrance to all the other trees around it. That fragrance cannot then be taken away from them. Similarly the union of the Lord and his devotees is a very strange and astonishing tale. They become one and there is no duality left. (93)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41121,"next":41123}}
