{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41123,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208142","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208142,"last_verse_id":208145,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208142,"page_no":null,"line_no":96,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur baran mil sura(n)g ta(n)bol ras gursikh saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g mai ra(n)geele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the union of beetle leaf, beetle nut, lime and catechu produce deep red colour, so do the Sikhs living in the presence of Satguru get dyed in hue of his love and Naam in the company of True and noble Sikhs."}}},{"verse_id":208143,"page_no":null,"line_no":96,"gurmukhi":"ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਜਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khaa(n)dd ghirat choon jal mile bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh prem ras a(n)mirat mai rasik raseele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the mixing of sugar, clarified butter, flour and water results in various types of dainty dishes, similarly Guru-conscious persons become the relishers of elixir like Naam in the company of the holy and noble people who themselves are engrossed in the meditation of Lord's name."}}},{"verse_id":208144,"page_no":null,"line_no":96,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਬਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh aragajaa hoi sabadh surat liv baasanaa baseele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As all fragrances when put together result in a perfume of high quality, similarly the servant Sikhs of the Guru become pleasant smelling by virtue of Naam Simran and instilling the words of Guru in their conscious mind."}}},{"verse_id":208145,"page_no":null,"line_no":96,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥੯੪॥","translit_en":"paaras paras jaise kanik anik dhaat dhib dheh man unaman unameele hai ||94||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As many metals turn into gold by the touch of paaras (Philosopher-Stone), so do the devoted Sikhs become refulgent and blossoms in the company of True Guru. (94)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41122,"next":41124}}
files.shabads/82/41124.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41124,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208146","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208146,"last_verse_id":208149,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208146,"page_no":null,"line_no":97,"gurmukhi":"ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਡੀਆ ਉਡਤ ਰਹੈ ਪਵਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਗੁਡੀ ਉਡ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pavan gavan jaise guddeeaa uddat rahai pavan rahit guddee udd na sakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a kite keeps aloft in the sky only if there is breeze blowing, and in the absence of breeze it drops down on the ground;"}}},{"verse_id":208147,"page_no":null,"line_no":97,"gurmukhi":"ਡੋਰੀ ਕੀ ਮਰੋਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਟੂਆ ਫਿਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਉ ਹਾਉ ਮਿਟੈ ਗਿਰ ਪਰੈ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਥਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ddoree kee maror jaise laTooaa firat rahai taau haau miTai gir parai haivai thakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a top keeps revolving on its axis/spindle as long as the torque provided to it by the thread lasts, where after it drops dead;"}}},{"verse_id":208148,"page_no":null,"line_no":97,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਚਨ ਅਸੁਧ ਜਿਉਂ ਕੁਠਾਰੀ ਠਹਰਾਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)chan asudh jiau(n) kuThaaree Thaharaat naahee sudh bhe nihachal chhab kai chhakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a base gold cannot remain stable in a crucible and on becoming pure, rests and acquire glitter;"}}},{"verse_id":208149,"page_no":null,"line_no":97,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਮੋਨਿ ਨ ਬਕਤ ਹੈ ॥੯੫॥","translit_en":"dhuramat dhubidhaa bhramat hai chatur ku(n)T gurmat ek Tek mon na bakat hai ||95||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a person roams about in all the four directions due to duality and base intelligence. But once he takes the refuge of Guru's wisdom, he acquires peace and becomes engrossed within. (95)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41123,"next":41125}}
files.shabads/82/41125.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41125,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208150","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208150,"last_verse_id":208153,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208150,"page_no":null,"line_no":98,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran havai paramadhabhut gat aatam tara(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious Sikh feels fully satiated drinking the loving elixir of the nectar-like Naam. He experiences strange and astonishing waves of spiritual ecstasy within."}}},{"verse_id":208151,"page_no":null,"line_no":98,"gurmukhi":"ਇਤ ਤੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਸਰਜਤ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"eit te dhirasaT surat sabadh bisarajat ut te bisam asacharaj prasa(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Relishing the loving elixir, a Guru-conscious person turns his senses away from the worldly engrossments and attaches them with the faculties that help him enjoy the divine pleasures. As a result he experiences strange and astonishing sensations within."}}},{"verse_id":208152,"page_no":null,"line_no":98,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਚਾਖੈ ਸੋ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਗ ਰਸ ਰੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhekhai so dhikhaavai kaise sune so sunaavai kaise chaakhai so bataavai kaise raag ras ra(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All that he experiences, he cannot make others experience. How can he make others hear the unstruck music that he himself hears? The taste of Naam nectar that he enjoys himself, how can he describe it to others? All these he alone can enjoy."}}},{"verse_id":208153,"page_no":null,"line_no":98,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਥਕਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੈ ॥੯੬॥","translit_en":"akath kathaa binodh a(n)g a(n)g thakat havai herat hiraanee boo(n)dh saagar sraba(n)g hai ||96||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That person feels astonished and reaches a state of spiritual delight where every part of his body becomes stable in happiness. Staying in the holy feet of Satguru, the person merges with God like a drop falling in the sea loses its identity. (96)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41124,"next":41126}}
files.shabads/82/41126.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41126,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208154","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208154,"last_verse_id":208157,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208154,"page_no":null,"line_no":99,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g ga(n)g mil sree gur saagar mile giaan dhiaan param nidhaan livaleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh ever in attendance of Satguru merges in the ocean-like True Guru through the Ganges-like holy congregation. He remains engrossed in the fountain-head of Cyan (knowledge) and contemplation."}}},{"verse_id":208155,"page_no":null,"line_no":99,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਚਕੋਰ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh madhukar gat cha(n)dhramaa chakor gur dhiaan ras bheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A True Sikh remains absorbed and immersed in the holy dust of the True Guru like a bumble bee and longs for a glimpse of his Guru just as a moon bird experiences pangs of separation of his beloved moon."}}},{"verse_id":208156,"page_no":null,"line_no":99,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat mukataahal ahaar ha(n)s prem paramaarath bimal jal meen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a swan whose diet is pearls, a true Sikh relishes the pearl-like Naam as his life support. Like a fish, he swims in the cool, clean and comforting waters of spirituality."}}},{"verse_id":208157,"page_no":null,"line_no":99,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਅਮਰਾਪਦ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ  ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰੁ ਕਾਮਧੈਨਾਧੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੯੭॥","translit_en":"a(n)mit kaTaachh amaraapadh kirapaa kirapaal  kamalaa kalapatar kaamadhainaadheen hai ||97||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the element and nectar-like glimpse of grace of the True Guru, a true Sikh attains immortality. And then all mythical donors like Kamdhen cow or Kalap brichh and even Lakshmi (Goddess of wealth) serve him diligently. (97)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41125,"next":41127}}
files.shabads/82/41127.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41127,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208158","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208158,"last_verse_id":208161,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208158,"page_no":null,"line_no":100,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਥਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੋ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ek brahamaa(n)dd ke bithaar kee apaar kathaa koT brahamaa(n)dd ko naik kaise jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When description of one universe is beyond the ability of a human being then how can the master of millions of universes be known?"}}},{"verse_id":208159,"page_no":null,"line_no":100,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਉ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ghaT ghaT a(n)tar aau sarab nira(n)tar hai sookham sathool mool kaise pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God, the cause of all visible and invisible world who is prevailing equally in all and sundry; how can he be reckoned?"}}},{"verse_id":208160,"page_no":null,"line_no":100,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"niragun adhirasaT sirasaT mai naanaa prakaar alakh lakhio na jai kaise ur aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God who is not visible in His Transcendental form, and is visible in myriad forms in His immanent form; who cannot be perceived, how can he then be lodged in the mind?"}}},{"verse_id":208161,"page_no":null,"line_no":100,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੯੮॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan pooran braham sarabaatam kai maaneeaai ||98||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Imperishable of character, of ever stable name, the complete Lord God, becomes known to a devoted Sikh through the Gyan dispensed by True. Guru. He attaches his conscious mind in the word and its tune and realises His presence in every living being. (98)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41126,"next":41128}}
files.shabads/82/41128.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41128,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208162","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208162,"last_verse_id":208165,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208162,"page_no":null,"line_no":101,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਪਰਿਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran sarab miee pooran kirapaa kai paripooran kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-blessed Sikh realises the universal presence of God through the total benefaction and kindness of the complete Guru who is manifestation of Supreme God."}}},{"verse_id":208163,"page_no":null,"line_no":101,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan liv ek aau anek mek sabadh bibek Tek ekai ur aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By absorbing the mind in the form of True Guru and contemplation of Guru's teachings, the Sikh lodges that God in his heart who is one and is present in all."}}},{"verse_id":208164,"page_no":null,"line_no":101,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੇਖਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸੋ੍ਰਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil pekhataa bakataa sorataa ekai pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By keeping the vision of the eyes in the glimpse of Satguru and tuning the ears to the sound of Guru's utterances, an obedient and devoted Sikh reckons Him as the speaker, listener and watcher."}}},{"verse_id":208165,"page_no":null,"line_no":101,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਠਟ ਨਟ ਵਟ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੯੯॥","translit_en":"sookham sathool mool gupat pragaT ThaT naT vaT simaran ma(n)tr man maaneeaai ||99||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God who is the cause of the visible and invisible expanse, who is playing the game of the world both as a performer and the apparatus, the mind of a devoted Sikh of Guru gets engrossed in words and teachings of the Guru. (99)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41127,"next":41129}}
files.shabads/82/41129.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41129,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208166","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208166,"last_verse_id":208169,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208166,"page_no":null,"line_no":102,"gurmukhi":"ਨਹੀ ਦਦਸਾਰ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਿਤਾਮਾ ਪਰ ਪਿਤਾਮਾ ਸਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੁਤ ਬਾਂਧਵ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਾ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nahee dhadhasaar pitaa pitaamaa par pitaamaa sajan kuTa(n)b sut baa(n)dhav na bhraataa hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the paternal hierarchy, there is not one relation; whether grandfather, great grandfather or any other son of the family, ward or brother;"}}},{"verse_id":208167,"page_no":null,"line_no":102,"gurmukhi":"ਨਹੀ ਨਨਸਾਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਪਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਾਮੂ ਮਾਮੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਔ ਮੌਸਾ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਬਿਖਯਾਤਾ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nahee nanasaar maataa par maataa biradh par maataa maamoo maamee maasee aau mauasaa bibidh bikhayaataa hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly there isn't any relation, whether it is mother, grandmother or great grandmother, maternal uncle, aunt or any other recognised relationships;"}}},{"verse_id":208168,"page_no":null,"line_no":102,"gurmukhi":"ਨਹੀ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਸੁਰਾ ਸਾਰੋ ਅਉ ਸਾਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਰਤੀਸੁਰ ਮੈ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nahee sasuraar saas sasuraa saaro aau saaree nahee birateesur mai jaachik na dhaataa hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And also there is no relationship in the in-laws family whether mother-in-law, brother-in-law or sister-in-law; nor is their any relationship of family priest, donor or beggar."}}},{"verse_id":208169,"page_no":null,"line_no":102,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਧਾਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਮੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਜੈਸਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤ ਕੋ ਨਾਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧੦੦॥","translit_en":"asan basan dhan dhaam kaahoo mai na dhekhio jaisaa gursikh saadh sa(n)gat ko naataa hai ||100||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nor has any relationship been seen amongst the friends and close associates who share their eats and drinks as is the relationship of Sikh Sangat (congregation) and a Sikh. (100)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41128,"next":41130}}
files.shabads/82/41130.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41130,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208170","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208170,"last_verse_id":208173,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208170,"page_no":null,"line_no":103,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੁਤਨ ਪੈ ਨ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maat pitaa pratipaalat anek sut anik sutan pai na taise hoi na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As parents bring up and care for many of their children yet £hose children do not reciprocate the same way;"}}},{"verse_id":208171,"page_no":null,"line_no":103,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਤਨ ਕਉੋ ਤੈਸੇ ਨ ਸੁਤਨ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maat pitaa chit chaahat hai sutan kauo taise na sutan chit chaeh upajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As parents love their wards from the core of their hearts, the same intensity of love cannot be generated in the hearts of the children."}}},{"verse_id":208172,"page_no":null,"line_no":103,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸੋਗਾਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਨ ਤੈਸੇ ਸੁਤ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maat pitaa sut sukh dhukh sogaana(n)dh sukh dhukh mai na taise sut Thahiraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As parents feel delighted on the happy occasions of their children and are distressed when they face tribulations, but the children do not feel the reciprocal intensity for their parents;"}}},{"verse_id":208173,"page_no":null,"line_no":103,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਸਿਖਨ ਲੁਡਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੧॥","translit_en":"jaise man bach kram sikhan luddaavai gur taise gur sevaa gursikh na hitaaviee ||101||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As Satguru Ji pamper and cuddle the Sikhs with mind, words and deeds, similarly a Sikh cannot express in reciprocation these boons of Satguru Ji with equal intensity. (101)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41129,"next":41131}}
files.shabads/82/41131.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41131,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208174","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208174,"last_verse_id":208177,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208174,"page_no":null,"line_no":104,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਛਪ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਤ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kachhap dhar dhiaan saavadhaan karai taise maat pitaa preet sut na lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a she tortoise bears its young ones in sand and takes care of them till they are sufficiently capable of looking after themselves, such love and concern for parents cannot be the characteristic of a child."}}},{"verse_id":208175,"page_no":null,"line_no":104,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੂੰਜ ਪਰਪਕ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸੁਤ ਪੈ ਨ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise simaran kar koo(n)j parapak karai taiso simaran sut pai na ban aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crane teaches its young ones to fly and make them adept by flying many miles, a child cannot do for his parents."}}},{"verse_id":208176,"page_no":null,"line_no":104,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਬਛਰਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਗਧ ਪੀਆਇ ਪੋਖੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਬਛਰਾ ਨ ਗਊ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise guoo bachharaa kau dhugadh peeaai pokhai taise bachharaa na guoo preet hit laaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cow feeds her young one with her milk and brings him up, the young one cannot reciprocate with same feelings the love and affection for the cow."}}},{"verse_id":208177,"page_no":null,"line_no":104,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੨॥","translit_en":"taise giaan dhiaan simaran gursikh prat taise kaise sikh gur sevaa Thahiraaviee ||102||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a True Guru blesses a Sikh and expresses his love by making him well versed in divine knowledge, contemplation and meditation on Lord's name, how can a devoted Sikh rise to the same level of dedication and devotion in the service of Guru? (102)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41130,"next":41132}}
files.shabads/82/41132.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41132,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208178","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208178,"last_verse_id":208181,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208178,"page_no":null,"line_no":105,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਵਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maat pitaa keree sevaa saravan keenee sikh biralo iee gur sevaa Thahiraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A rare disciple would stay and serve his Guru just as noble Sarvan served his blind parents so dedicatedly."}}},{"verse_id":208179,"page_no":null,"line_no":105,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਲਛਮਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise lachhaman raghupat bhai bhagat mai koT madhe kaahoo gur bhaiee ban aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Some rare devotee would serve his Guru with so much love and devotion with which Lachhman served his brother Ram."}}},{"verse_id":208180,"page_no":null,"line_no":105,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal baran baran saraba(n)g ra(n)g biralo bibekee saadh sa(n)gat samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water mixes with any colour to acquire the same hue; thus a rare Sikh contemplating and practising meditation merges into the holy gathering of Guru's devotees."}}},{"verse_id":208181,"page_no":null,"line_no":105,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੩॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees pooran kirapaa kai kaahoo alakh lakhaaviee ||103||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On meeting the Guru and receiving the blessings of initiation from him, a Sikh surely reaches and realises God to become one with Him. Thus a True Guru showers his beneficence on a rare Sikh and lifts him to the divine level of supreme consciousness. (103)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41131,"next":41133}}
files.shabads/82/41133.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41133,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208182","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208182,"last_verse_id":208185,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208182,"page_no":null,"line_no":106,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮ ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"lochan dhiaan sam losaT kanik taa kai sravan usatat ni(n)dhaa samasar jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For a devoted Sikh of the Guru, a lump of earth and gold are equal in value. Thus, praise and slander for him are the same."}}},{"verse_id":208183,"page_no":null,"line_no":106,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"naasakaa suga(n)dh biraga(n)dh sam tul taa kai ridhai mitr satr samasar unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For that devoted Sikh, both fragrance and foul smell means nothing. So he treats both friend and foe alike."}}},{"verse_id":208184,"page_no":null,"line_no":106,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਿਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਸਪਰਸ ਜਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"rasan suaadh bikh a(n)mrit samaan taa kai kar saparas jal agan samaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For him the taste of poison is not different from that of nectar. He feels the touch of water and fire alike."}}},{"verse_id":208185,"page_no":null,"line_no":106,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀਐ ॥੧੦੪॥","translit_en":"dhukh sukh samasar biaapai na harakh sog jeevan mukat gat satigur giaaneeaai ||104||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He treats comforts and distresses alike. These two emotions do not influence him. By the benign and magnificence of a True Guru, who has blessed him with Naam, he achieves emancipation while living a house-holder's life. (104)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41132,"next":41134}}
files.shabads/82/41134.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41134,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208186","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208186,"last_verse_id":208189,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208186,"page_no":null,"line_no":107,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gahe nij ghar mai nivaas aasaa manasaa thakat anat na dhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the refuge of a True Guru, a devoted Sikh resides in higher spiritual plane. All his expectations and desires vanish and his mind does not waver any more."}}},{"verse_id":208187,"page_no":null,"line_no":107,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੈ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan maatr aan dhiaan sai rahat hoi simaran aan simaran bisaraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the glimpse of True Guru, a devoted Sikh seeks not audience with anyone else. He rids himself of all other remembrances."}}},{"verse_id":208188,"page_no":null,"line_no":107,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੋਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਕਹਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat mon brat kau praapat hoi prem ras akath kathaa na keh aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By engrossing his mind in the divine word (of Guru), he becomes bereft of all other thoughts. (He gives up all other futile talks). Thus his love for his Lord is beyond description."}}},{"verse_id":208189,"page_no":null,"line_no":107,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੫॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa param nidhaan dhaan paramadhabhut gat at bisamaaviee ||105||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By a momentary glimpse of the True Guru, one attains invaluable treasure of His name. The state of such a person is amazing and a cause of surprise for the beholder. (105)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41133,"next":41135}}
files.shabads/82/41135.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41135,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208190","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208190,"last_verse_id":208193,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208190,"page_no":null,"line_no":108,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਰਤੈ ਬਰਤਮਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat aapaa khoi gur dhaas hoi baratai baratamaan gur upadhes kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shedding away the mine and - thine differentiation by the union of mind and divine word, one becomes a humble slave of the Guru. He makes his present a success by perpetual contemplation on His name."}}},{"verse_id":208191,"page_no":null,"line_no":108,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"honahaar hoiee joiee joiee soiee soiee bhalo pooran braham giaan dhiaan paraves kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With his mind focused on the name of the Lord; living life according to Guru's teachings, he accepts all happenings as divine Will and blessings."}}},{"verse_id":208192,"page_no":null,"line_no":108,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਤ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"naam nihakaam dhaam sahaj subhai chai prem ras rasik hui a(n)mrat aves kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devotee living life of a householder, engrossed, in meditation of Lord's name and seized in His love ever enjoys the elixir of His name."}}},{"verse_id":208193,"page_no":null,"line_no":108,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਅਦੇਸ ਕੈ ॥੧੦੬॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan pooran sarab miee aadh kau adhes kai ||106||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a slave of the Guru who by focusing his mind in the Lord regards the indestructible and ever stable Lord permeated in every speck, salutes and pays his obeisance to the force who is the cause of all beginnings. (106)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41134,"next":41136}}
files.shabads/82/41136.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41136,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208194","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208194,"last_verse_id":208197,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208194,"page_no":null,"line_no":109,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat aapaa khoi gur dhaas hoi baal budh sudh na karat moh dhroh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One becomes true disciple only by getting the divine word of Guru absorbed in the mind and becoming a humble slave of the Guru. For virtually a possessor of the child-like wisdom, he is free of deceit and infatuations."}}},{"verse_id":208195,"page_no":null,"line_no":109,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਮ ਤੁਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੋਚਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਉ ਲੋਹ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"sravan usatat ni(n)dhaa sam tul surat liv lochan dhiaan liv ka(n)chan aau loh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since his consciousness is engrossed in the name of the Lord; he is least affected by praise or rejection."}}},{"verse_id":208196,"page_no":null,"line_no":109,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਬੋਹ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"naasakaa suga(n)dh biraga(n)dh samasar taa kai jihabaa samaan bikh a(n)mrit na boh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fragrance and foul smell, poison or elixir are the same for him, because his (devotee's) conscious is absorbed in Him."}}},{"verse_id":208197,"page_no":null,"line_no":109,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰ ਚਰ ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਅਪਥ ਪਥ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਸਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਨ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੀ ॥੧੦੭॥","translit_en":"kar char karam akaram apath path kirat birat sam ukat na dhroh kee ||107||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He remains stable and uniform even if he uses his hands in good or indifferent deeds; or treads path not worthy of appreciation. Such a devotee never harbours any feeling of deceit, falsehood or ill deeds. (107)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41135,"next":41137}}
files.shabads/82/41137.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41137,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208198","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208198,"last_verse_id":208201,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208198,"page_no":null,"line_no":110,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat aapaa khoi gur dhaas hoi sarab mai pooran braham kar maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By contemplating and absorbing oneself in the name obtained by the blessings of a True Guru, and shedding the feelings of mine and his, one becomes a servant of the Guru. Such a servant acknowledges the presence of one Lord everywhere."}}},{"verse_id":208199,"page_no":null,"line_no":110,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਾਲਾ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗੋਰਸ ਗੋਬੰਸ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੋ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kaasaT agan maalaa sootr goras goba(n)s ek aau anek ko bibek pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the same fire exists in all the woods, different beads are arranged in the same thread; as all shades and species of cows yield milk of the same colour; similarly the slave of True Guru achieves the wisdom and knowledge of the presence of one Lord in all the living beings."}}},{"verse_id":208200,"page_no":null,"line_no":110,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੁਖ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਮੇਕ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"lochan sravan mukh naasakaa anek sotr dhekhai sunai bolai man mek ur aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As all that is seen by the eyes, heard by the ears and said by the tongue reaches the mind, similarly the slave of the Guru sees one Lord residing in all beings and lodges Him in his mind."}}},{"verse_id":208201,"page_no":null,"line_no":110,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਓੋਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੦੮॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile soha(n) soiee oot pot jotee jot milat jotee saroop jaaneeaai ||108||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of a Sikh with his Guru makes him utter Lord's name repeatedly and enjoins in Him like warp and weft. When his light merges with light eternal, he too acquires the form of light divine. (108)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41136,"next":41138}}
files.shabads/82/41138.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41138,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208202","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208202,"last_verse_id":208205,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208202,"page_no":null,"line_no":111,"gurmukhi":"ਗਾਂਡਾ ਮੈ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਛਿਲਕਾ ਨ ਲੀਓ ਜਾਇ ਦਾਰਮ ਅਉ ਦਾਖ ਬਿਖੈ ਬੀਜੁ ਗਹਿ ਡਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gaa(n)ddaa mai miThaas taas chhilakaa na leeo jai dhaaram aau dhaakh bikhai beej geh ddaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the sweet juice of the sugarcane is taken and the cane is discarded; as the seeds in pomegranate and grapes are discarded;"}}},{"verse_id":208203,"page_no":null,"line_no":111,"gurmukhi":"ਆਂਬ ਖਿਰਨੀ ਛੁਹਾਰਾ ਮਾਝ ਗੁਠਲੀ ਕਠੋਰ ਖਰਬੂਜਾ ਅਉ ਕਲੀਦਾ ਸਜਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"aa(n)b khiranee chhuhaaraa maajh guThalee kaThor kharaboojaa aau kaleedhaa sajal bikaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mango, dates have their endocarps hard; melon and watermelons though sweet release water and become unworthy of consumption very soon;"}}},{"verse_id":208204,"page_no":null,"line_no":111,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਮੈ ਮਲੀਨ ਸਮੈ ਪਾਇ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਭਏ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"madh maakhee mai maleen samai pai safal hui ras bas bhe nahee tirasanaa nivaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The honey when cleaned of the bees and the wax become hard to give up eating it;"}}},{"verse_id":208205,"page_no":null,"line_no":111,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ॥੧੦੯॥","translit_en":"sree gur sabadh ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan gursikh saadh sa(n)g janam savaareeaai ||109||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a Sikh of the Guru, relishes the elixir-like Naam in the company of holy men and makes his life a success. (109)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41137,"next":41139}}
files.shabads/82/41139.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41139,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208206","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208206,"last_verse_id":208209,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208206,"page_no":null,"line_no":112,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਮੈ ਧਰਨਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਮੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਪ ਅਨਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"salil mai dharan dharan mai salil jaise koop anaroop kai bimal jal chhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As there is land in water and water inside Earth, like a well that is dug up to obtain neat and cold water;"}}},{"verse_id":208207,"page_no":null,"line_no":112,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਹੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੈ ਬਨਾਈ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਜਲੁ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taahee jal maaTee kai banaiee ghaTikaa anek ekai jal ghaT ghaT ghaTikaa samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The same water and earth are used for making pots and pitchers and all of them contain the same type of water."}}},{"verse_id":208208,"page_no":null,"line_no":112,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਹੀ ਜਾਹੀ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਪੇਖੀਅਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaahee jaahee ghaTikaa mai dhirasaT kai dhekheeat pekheeat aapaa aap aan na dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whichever pot or pitcher one looks into, one would see the same image in it, and nothing else is seen,"}}},{"verse_id":208209,"page_no":null,"line_no":112,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਠਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੦॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur eka(n)kaar kai akaar braham bibek ek Tek Thahiraae hai ||110||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the complete God pervades in the form of a-Guru and appear in the hearts of Sikhs (as was the case of image in various water-filled pots and pitchers). (110)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41138,"next":41140}}
files.shabads/82/41140.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41140,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208210","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208210,"last_verse_id":208213,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208210,"page_no":null,"line_no":113,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕ ਪੈਂਡਾ ਜਾਇ ਚਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੈਂਡਾ ਆਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur ek pai(n)ddaa jai chal satigur koT pai(n)ddaa aage hoi let hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A disciple who walks one step towards Guru to take his refuge and goes to him with devotion and humility, Guru advances to receive him (devotee) by taking million steps."}}},{"verse_id":208211,"page_no":null,"line_no":113,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਬਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਬਾਰੰਬਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek baar satigur ma(n)tr simaran maatr simaran taa(n)h baara(n)baar gur het hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who unites with the Lord by remembering the incantation of the Guru even once, the True Guru remembers him millions of time."}}},{"verse_id":208212,"page_no":null,"line_no":113,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਕੌੁਡੀ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaavanee bhagat bhai kaauddee agrabhaag raakhai taeh gur sarab nidhaan dhaan dhet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who makes an offering of even a shell before the True Guru with loving worship and faith, the True Guru blesses him with the countless treasures of invaluable wealth that is Naam."}}},{"verse_id":208213,"page_no":null,"line_no":113,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਯਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੧॥","translit_en":"satigur dhayaa nidh mahimaa agaadh bodh namo namo namo namo net net net hai ||111||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru is a repository of compassion that is beyond description and understanding. Therefore myriad salutations to Him because there is no one else like Him. (111)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41139,"next":41141}}
files.shabads/82/41141.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41141,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208214","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208214,"last_verse_id":208217,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208214,"page_no":null,"line_no":114,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਤ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran havai unaman unamat bisam bisavaiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a devotee meditating on His name is satiated with the drinking of loving nectar of Lord's name, he (devotee) enjoys supernatural ecstatic feeling in higher spiritual planes."}}},{"verse_id":208215,"page_no":null,"line_no":114,"gurmukhi":"ਆਤਮ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਊਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aatam tara(n)g bahu ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab anik anoop roop uoop ko pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With multi-coloured waves of spiritual thoughts growing in his (devotee) mind, every part of his body conveys the glory of the Lord by emittence of strange and unique radiance."}}},{"verse_id":208216,"page_no":null,"line_no":114,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਸੁਰਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaadh bisamaadh bahu bibidh surat sarab raag naadh baadh bahu baasanaa subaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The relishment of loving elixir of the Lord's name is astonishing. Enchanting tunes of all the musical modes and their consorts are heard in the ears. The nostrils feel the smell of myriad fragrances."}}},{"verse_id":208217,"page_no":null,"line_no":114,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਮੈਂ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਭਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਅਖੰਡਲ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੨॥","translit_en":"paramadhabhut brahamaasan si(n)ghaasan mai(n) sobhaa sabhaa ma(n)ddal akha(n)ddal bilaas hai ||112||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the residing of the consciousness in the highest spiritual seat (the tenth opening), one enjoys the magnificent glory of all the spiritual planes. This ultimate state of tranquility provides complete stability to the body, mind and soul. (112)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41140,"next":41142}}
files.shabads/82/41142.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41142,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208218","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208218,"last_verse_id":208221,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208218,"page_no":null,"line_no":115,"gurmukhi":"ਬਯਥਾਵੰਤੈ ਜੰਤੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਦ ਉਪਚਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਯਥਾ ਬਿਰਤਾਂਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਹਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"bayathaava(n)tai ja(n)tai jaise baidh upachaar karai bayathaa birataa(n)t sun harai dhukh rog kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a medicine practitioner listens to the ailment of a patient and treats him for the malady;"}}},{"verse_id":208219,"page_no":null,"line_no":115,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਕੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਸੁਤੈ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੋਖਿ ਤੋਖਿ ਹਰਤ ਹੈ ਸੋਗ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maataa pitaa hit chit kai milat sutai khaan paan pokh tokh harat hai sog kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As parents fondly and lovingly meet their son, bring him up by serving dainty dishes, feel happy to allay all his distresses;"}}},{"verse_id":208220,"page_no":null,"line_no":115,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਰਤਾਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੈ ਹਰਤ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"birahanee banitaa kau jaise bharataar milai prem ras kai harat bireh biog kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a wife separated from her husband for long relieves her pangs of separation and distresses with loving emotions;"}}},{"verse_id":208221,"page_no":null,"line_no":115,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਗਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਕਉ॥੧੧੩॥","translit_en":"taise hee bibekee jan paraupakaar het milat salil gat sahaj sa(n)jog kau||113||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly those wise and realised servers of Lord dyed in the hue of Lord's name become humble like water and meets the needy who yearn for the divine solace and clemency. (113)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41141,"next":41143}}
files.shabads/82/41143.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41143,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208222","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208222,"last_verse_id":208225,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208222,"page_no":null,"line_no":116,"gurmukhi":"ਬਯਥਾਵੰਤੈ ਬੈਦ ਰੂਪ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਗਤਿ ਗਾਹਕੈ ਬਿਆਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"bayathaava(n)tai baidh roop jaachik dhaataar gat gaahakai biaapaaree hoi maat pitaa poot kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gursikhs with contemplated knowledge extend all help to the needy as an act of welfare, just as a medicine practitioner does for a patient, a donor does for a beggar, a trader for a customer and parents for their son."}}},{"verse_id":208223,"page_no":null,"line_no":116,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਰਿ ਭਰਤਾਰਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਰੂਪ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖਾ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਸੂਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"naar bharataar bidh mitr mitraiee roop sujan kuTa(n)b sakhaa bhai chai soot kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As an act of benevolence, the relishers of Lord's name reach the distressed people to render them comfort They are husband to a distressed wife or vice versa, friends to friends and other loved ones; according to the defined moral code."}}},{"verse_id":208224,"page_no":null,"line_no":116,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਅਵਧੂਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar bedh kai bedh beechaar giaan gur eka(n)kaar avadhoot avadhoot kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sikhs blessed with Guru's wisdom acquire the supreme knowledge of the Lord and meet the common mortals as one of them and as intelligent and wise in the gathering of learned men. They approach the hermits as renouncers."}}},{"verse_id":208225,"page_no":null,"line_no":116,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਲੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਗਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਭੂਤ ਕਉ ॥੧੧੪॥","translit_en":"biralo bibekee jan paraupakaar het milat salil gat ra(n)g sraba(n)g bhoot kau ||114||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a rational and knowledgeable Sikh is very rare who for the sake of benevolence becomes humble like water and unites with the people of all denominations. (114)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41142,"next":41144}}
files.shabads/82/41144.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41144,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208226","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208226,"last_verse_id":208229,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208226,"page_no":null,"line_no":117,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dhiaan dhib dheh kai bidheh bhe dhirag dhib dhirasaT bikhai bhaau bhagat cheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the contemplated vision of the True Guru, the Guru-conscious Sikhs become free of ego while still in their body form. By virtue of divine sight of the True Guru, they acquire the wisdom of loving worship."}}},{"verse_id":208227,"page_no":null,"line_no":117,"gurmukhi":"ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਲਿਉ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"adhiaatam karam kar aatam praves paramaatam praves sarabaatam liau leen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of his spiritual knowledge and righteous actions, a follower of Guru finds peace and tranquillity in his self. By becoming one with Lord, he realises the presence of the divine light in the beings."}}},{"verse_id":208228,"page_no":null,"line_no":117,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਸਬਦਾਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh giaan paravaan hui nidhaan paae paramaarath sabadhaarath prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the knowledge acquired through meditation on divine word, a devoted Sikh is accepted by the Guru who blesses him with the treasure of Lord's Naam. He then becomes wise to understand the principles of spirituality."}}},{"verse_id":208229,"page_no":null,"line_no":117,"gurmukhi":"ਤਤੈ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਭਏ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੫॥","translit_en":"tatai mile tat jotee jot kai param jot prem ras bas bhe jaise jal meen hai ||115||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the quintessence merges into its origin, the soul of a Guru-conscious person merges with the Supreme soul like the flame of a beacon becomes one with the other flame. He gets engrossed in the pleasure of Lord's love like a fish in water. (115)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41143,"next":41145}}
