Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208230,"page_no":null,"line_no":118,"gurmukhi":"ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਤਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"adhiaatam karam paramaatam param padh tat mil tateh param tat vaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A rare Guru-conscious person attains the knowledge of spirituality through spiritual deeds and absorbs himself in Him as truth rejoins with Truth."}}},{"verse_id":208231,"page_no":null,"line_no":118,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh bibek Tek ek hee anek mek ja(n)tr dhun raag naadh anabhai abhiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As musical instruments produce melodious notes which also represent words in a song, so does a meditation practitioner merges in the fearless Lord who pervades in all and sundry."}}},{"verse_id":208232,"page_no":null,"line_no":118,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan unamaan praan praanapat abigat gat at alakh bilaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As meditation renders all our breaths one with Lord- the granter of life, so would a Guru-conscious man be engrossed in Him by contemplating on Him and becomes capable of enjoying all His bliss by this union with Him."}}},{"verse_id":208233,"page_no":null,"line_no":118,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੬॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat kaTaachh dhib dheh kai bidheh bhe jeevan mukat kouoo biralo udhaasee hai ||116||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the elixir-like divine glance of the True Guru, he becomes unconscious of his body (needs). Such a person with renounced and detached inclination is rare to come by. (116)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41144,"next":41146}}
files.shabads/82/41146.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41146,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208234","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208234,"last_verse_id":208237,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208234,"page_no":null,"line_no":119,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਗਤ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਰਭਾਤ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ॥","translit_en":"supan charitr chitr jaagat na dhekheeat taarakaa ma(n)ddal parabhaat na dhikhaieeaai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as dream events cannot be seen while awake, just as stars are not visible after sunrise;"}}},{"verse_id":208235,"page_no":null,"line_no":119,"gurmukhi":"ਤਰਵਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਚਪਲ ਬਲ ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਥਿਰ ਨ ਰਹਾਈਐ॥","translit_en":"taravar chhaiaa lagh dheeragh chapal bal teerath purab jaatraa thir na rahaieeaai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the shadow of a tree keeps changing in size with the falling rays of the sun; and the pilgrimage to the holy places does not last for ever."}}},{"verse_id":208236,"page_no":null,"line_no":119,"gurmukhi":"ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਕੋ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਨਗਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬਿਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"nadhee naav ko sa(n)jog log bahurio na milai ga(n)dhrab nagar mirag tirasanaa bilaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the fellow travellers of a boat do not get to travel together again, as the presence of water due to mirage or the imaginary abode of gods (in space) is an illusion."}}},{"verse_id":208237,"page_no":null,"line_no":119,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਐ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੧੭॥","translit_en":"taise maiaai moh dhroh kuTa(n)b saneh dheh gurmukh sabadh surat liv laieeaai ||117||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a Guru-conscious person regards mammon, attachment and love of the body an illusion and he keeps his consciousness focused on the divine word of the Guru. (117)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41145,"next":41147}}
files.shabads/82/41147.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41147,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208238","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208238,"last_verse_id":208241,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208238,"page_no":null,"line_no":120,"gurmukhi":"ਨੈਹਰ ਕੁਆਰਿ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਲਾਡਿਲੀ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਅਤਿ ਬਿਆਹੇ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਨਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"naihar kuaar ka(n)niaa laaddilee kai maaneeat biaahe sasuraar jai gunan kai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An unmarried daughter is loved by everyone in parental house and enjoys respect in the in-laws house because of her virtues."}}},{"verse_id":208239,"page_no":null,"line_no":120,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਲਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਦੇਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਹੀਏ ਸਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤ ਕੈ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"banaj biauhaar lag jaat hai bidhes praanee kahe'ee sapoot laabh labhat kai aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As one goes to other cities to trade and earn living, but one is known as an obedient son only when one makes profit;"}}},{"verse_id":208240,"page_no":null,"line_no":120,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਪਰ ਦਲ ਮੈ ਅਕੇਲੋ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੂਰੋ ਸੁਭਟੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sa(n)graam samai par dhal mai akelo jai jeet aavai soiee sooro subhaT bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a warrior ingresses into enemy ranks and comes out victorious is known as a brave man."}}},{"verse_id":208241,"page_no":null,"line_no":120,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਦਵਾਰਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੧੮॥","translit_en":"maanas janam pai charan saran gur saadh sa(n)g milai gur dhavaar pahichaaneeaai ||118||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly he who enjoins the holy gatherings, acquire the refuge of the True Guru is accepted in the court of the Lord. (118)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41146,"next":41148}}
files.shabads/82/41148.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41148,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208242","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208242,"last_verse_id":208245,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208242,"page_no":null,"line_no":121,"gurmukhi":"ਨੈਹਰ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤਜਿ ਬਿਆਹੇ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਨਨ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬਿਰਦ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"naihar kuTa(n)b taj biaahe sasuraar jai gunan kai kulaa badhoo biradh kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a girl leaves her parent's house after getting married and earns a respectable name for herself and her husband's family by virtue of her good traits;"}}},{"verse_id":208243,"page_no":null,"line_no":121,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਅਉ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੇਸੁਰਿ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran patibrat aau gur jan sevaa bhai gireh mai girahesur sujas pragaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earns the honourable title of all in all and revered one, by devotedly serving her elders and remaining loyal and faithful to her partner;"}}},{"verse_id":208244,"page_no":null,"line_no":121,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹ ਗਾਮਿਨੀ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਊਚ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)t kaal jai pria sa(n)g seh gaaminee hui lok paralok bikhai uooch padh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Departs from this world as an honourable companion of her husband and earns name for herself here and in world hereafter;"}}},{"verse_id":208245,"page_no":null,"line_no":121,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਧੰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੧੯॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag bhai bhai nirabaahu karai dha(n)n gursikh aadh a(n)t Thahiraaviee ||119||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is a Sikh of Guru worthy of praise and adulations from beginning to end who treads the path of the Guru, lives life in the reverential fear of the Lord. (119)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41147,"next":41149}}
files.shabads/82/41149.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41149,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208246","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208246,"last_verse_id":208249,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208246,"page_no":null,"line_no":122,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਧਾਮ ਭਾਮ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ ਨਾਇਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭਨ ਲਡਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nirap dhaam bhaam ek sai adhik ek naik anek raajaa sabhan laddaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a king has many queens in his palace, each of remarkable beauty, he cajoles and pampers each one of them;"}}},{"verse_id":208247,"page_no":null,"line_no":122,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਵਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਸਕਲ ਰਾਨੀ ਮੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"janamat jaa kai sut vaahee kai suhaag bhaag sakal raanee mai paTaraanee so kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who bears him a son enjoys higher status in the palace and is declared as the chief among the queens;"}}},{"verse_id":208248,"page_no":null,"line_no":122,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਸਬੈ ਰਾਜ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਤਉ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan sihajaasan sa(n)jogee sabai raaj adhikaar tau sapootee gireh aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Each one of them has the right and opportunities to enjoy the pleasures of the palace and share the bed of the king;"}}},{"verse_id":208249,"page_no":null,"line_no":122,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਜ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੧੨੦॥","translit_en":"gursikh sabai gur charan saran liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile nij padh paaviee ||120||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So do the Guru's Sikhs assemble in the refuge of the True Guru. But he who meets with the Lord after losing his self reaches the realm of spiritual peace and comfort. (120)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41148,"next":41150}}
files.shabads/82/41150.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41150,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208250","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208250,"last_verse_id":208253,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208250,"page_no":null,"line_no":123,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਬੋਇ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਗੁਨੋ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"tus mai ta(n)dhul boi nipajai saha(n)sr guno dheh dhaar karat hai paraupakaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A grain of rice covered by its husk when sowed yields many time more such grains and as rice (a staple food item) do much good in the world."}}},{"verse_id":208251,"page_no":null,"line_no":123,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨ ਘੁਨੁ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਹੈ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"tus mai ta(n)dhul nirabighan laagai na ghun raakhe rahai chira(n)kaal hot na bikaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The rice remains protected against insects as long as it remains in the husk. It remains preserved for long."}}},{"verse_id":208252,"page_no":null,"line_no":123,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਰੂਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਕਰਵਾਇ ਰਾਧੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"tus mai nikas hoi bhagan maleen roop savaiaadh karavai raadhe rahai na sa(n)saar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Outside the husk, rice breaks. It acquires a darkish hue and slight bitterness. It loses its worldly importance."}}},{"verse_id":208253,"page_no":null,"line_no":123,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਬਨਖੰਡ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਉਧਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੧੨੧॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes gursikh gireh mai bairaagee gireh taj banakha(n)dd hot na udhaar jee ||121||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a Sikh of Guru following the advice of Guru lives a householder's life without being attached and engrossed in it. He does good to others while living with his family members. He does not renounce the family and lives in jungles to emancipate himself from this world. (121)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41149,"next":41151}}
files.shabads/82/41151.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41151,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208254","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208254,"last_verse_id":208257,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208254,"page_no":null,"line_no":124,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਦੀ ਅਉ ਚੂਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰੁਨ ਬਰਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਕੈ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haradhee aau choonaa mil arun baran jaise chatur baran kai ta(n)bol ras roop hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As turmeric and lime when mixed produce red colour, but when betel leaf, lime, betelnut and catechu are all brought together, a very deep red colour is produced;"}}},{"verse_id":208255,"page_no":null,"line_no":124,"gurmukhi":"ਦੂਧ ਮੈ ਜਾਮਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhoodh mai jaaman milai dhadh kai bakhaaneeat khaa(n)dd ghirat choon mil bi(n)jan anoop hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a small cogulent added to the milk set it as curd but sugar, flour and clarified butter produces a very tasty dish;"}}},{"verse_id":208256,"page_no":null,"line_no":124,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਿਲ ਸੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਹੋਤ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਧੂਪ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kusam suga(n)dh mil til sai fulel hot sakal suga(n)dh mil aragajaa dhoop hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An extract of flowers when mixed with sesame oil become scented oil, but mixing of saffron musk, sandalwood and rose make a very fragrant product called argaja;"}}},{"verse_id":208257,"page_no":null,"line_no":124,"gurmukhi":"ਦੋਇ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਹੈ ਦਸ ਬੀਸ ਤੀਸ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਊਪ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੨॥","translit_en":"dhoi sikh saadh sa(n)g pa(n)ch paramesar hai dhas bees tees mile abigat uoop hai ||122||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So would two Sikhs together make a holy congregation while five of them would represent the Lord. But where ten, twenty or thirty like-minded Sikhs engrossed in the love of the Guru meet, their praise is beyond description. (122)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41150,"next":41152}}
files.shabads/82/41152.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41152,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208258","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208258,"last_verse_id":208261,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208258,"page_no":null,"line_no":125,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਹੀ ਗੋਰਸ ਮੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਦਹਿਓ ਮਹਿਓ ਮਾਖਨ ਅਉ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ek hee goras mai anek ras ko pragaas dhahio mahio maakhan aau ghirat unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"From milk alone several products like curd, butter milk, butter and ghee (clarified butter) are obtained;"}}},{"verse_id":208259,"page_no":null,"line_no":125,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਹੀ ਊਖਾਰੀ ਮੈ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ੁ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਂਡ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਅਉ ਕਲੀਕੰਦ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ek hee uookhaaree mai miThaas ko nivaas  guR khaa(n)dd misaree aau kaleeka(n)dh pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being sweet, sugarcane gives us jaggery cakes, sugar, crystal sugar etc;"}}},{"verse_id":208260,"page_no":null,"line_no":125,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਹੀ ਗੇਹੂ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਭੂਨੇ ਭੀਜੇ ਪੀਸੇ ਅਉ ਉਸੇਈ ਬਿਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ek hee gehoo sai hot naanaa bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh bhoone bheeje peese aau useiee bibidhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wheat is turned into various forms of dainty dishes; some 'fried, boiled, roasted or minced;"}}},{"verse_id":208261,"page_no":null,"line_no":125,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਵਕ ਸਲਿਲ ਏਕ ਏਕਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੰਚ ਕੈ ਪੰਚਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੨੩॥","translit_en":"paavak salil ek ekeh gun anek pa(n)ch kai pa(n)chaamirat su saadh sa(n)g jaaneeaai ||123||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fire and water have specific traits but when three others (wheat flour, clarified butter and sugar) join with them, elixir like Karhah Parshad results. Similarly coming together of obedient and loyal Sikhs of the Guru in the form of a congregation is considered holy and supreme. (123)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41151,"next":41153}}
files.shabads/82/41153.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41153,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208262","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208262,"last_verse_id":208265,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208262,"page_no":null,"line_no":126,"gurmukhi":"ਖਾਂਡ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੂਨ ਜਲ ਪਾਵਕ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੰਚਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khaa(n)dd ghirat choon jal paavak ikatr bhe pa(n)ch mil pragaT pa(n)chaamirat pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As coming together of sugar, clarified butter, flour, water and fire produces elixir like Karhah Parshad;"}}},{"verse_id":208263,"page_no":null,"line_no":126,"gurmukhi":"ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਗਉਰਾ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੁਸਮ ਦਲ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਕੈ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mirag madh gauraa choaa cha(n)dhan kusam dhal sakal suga(n)dh kai aragajaa subaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As all aromatic roots and materials like musk, saffron etc. when mixed produce scent."}}},{"verse_id":208264,"page_no":null,"line_no":126,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਪਾਨ ਚੂਨਾ ਅਉ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਾਥਾ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਤਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur baran paan choonaa aau supaaree kaathaa aapaa khoi milat anoop roop taas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As betel nut, betel leaf, lime and catechu lose their self-existence and merge with each other to produce a deep red colour more attractive than each one of them;"}}},{"verse_id":208265,"page_no":null,"line_no":126,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਐਸੋ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੪॥","translit_en":"taise saadh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aaiso saavadhaan pooran braham ko nivaas hai ||124||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the praise of the holy congregation of saints blessed by the True Guru. It drenches everyone with such hue of Naam Ras that it opens the path for mergence into the Lord. (124)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41152,"next":41154}}
files.shabads/82/41154.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41154,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208266","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208266,"last_verse_id":208269,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208266,"page_no":null,"line_no":127,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਖੰਡ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadhasa(n)gat mai saach kha(n)dd satigur pooran braham ko nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The congregation of holy men is like Realm of Truth where they get absorbed in the memory of the Lord, His abode."}}},{"verse_id":208267,"page_no":null,"line_no":127,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਫੁਲ ਫਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan saragun akaal moorat poojaa ful fal charanaamirat bisavaiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For the Sikhs of the Guru, focusing of mind on True Guru is like seeing the Transcendental Lord who is beyond time. There belief of enjoying the magnificence sight of the True Guru is like performing worship with flowers and fruits."}}},{"verse_id":208268,"page_no":null,"line_no":127,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nira(n)kaar chaar paramaarath param padh sabadh surat avagaahan abhiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A true servant of Guru realises the supreme state of the Absolute Lord through perpetual meditation and engrossment of his mind in the divine word."}}},{"verse_id":208269,"page_no":null,"line_no":127,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੫॥","translit_en":"sarab nidhaan dhaan dhik bhagat bhai kaam nihakaam dhaam pooran pragaas hai ||125||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the loving worship of the Lord, (the bestower of all treasures) in the true holy congregation, a Guru-conscious person is convinced of no alternate place for him and he rests in complete radiance of the light divine of the God Lord. (125)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41153,"next":41155}}
files.shabads/82/41155.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41155,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208270","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208270,"last_verse_id":208273,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208270,"page_no":null,"line_no":128,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੂਮੀ ਚਿਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਫਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਉਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)gat sukirat bhoomee chit chitavat fal praapat udhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in meditation on His name, holy congregation is the best place to sow the seeds of supreme deeds that satiates all desires and sails one across the worldly ocean."}}},{"verse_id":208271,"page_no":null,"line_no":128,"gurmukhi":"ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਹਾਟ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਾਭ ਰਤਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bajar kapaaT khule haaT saadh sa(n)gat mai sabadh surat laabh ratan biauhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The company of holy men removes ignorance and opens up the tightly shut doors of knowledge. In the union of consciousness and divine word, one enjoys the benefit of trading in the jewel like Naam."}}},{"verse_id":208272,"page_no":null,"line_no":128,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਆਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g braham sathaan gurdhev sev alakh abhev paramaarath aachaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The service of True Guru in the divine like place of holy congregation leads one to the realisation of the Lord who is imperceptible and indistinguishable."}}},{"verse_id":208273,"page_no":null,"line_no":128,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਸੁ ਖੇਤ ਹੇਤ ਬਨਤ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਲਾਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਹਾਈ ਬਰਦਾਈ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੬॥","translit_en":"safal su khet het banat amit laabh sevak sahaiee baradhaiee upakaar hai ||126||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Loving the fruitful place like holy congregation, one obtains immeasurable gain. Such a congregation is benefactor, helpful and philanthropic for the servers and slaves (of the Lord). (126)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41154,"next":41156}}
files.shabads/82/41156.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41156,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208274","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208274,"last_verse_id":208277,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208274,"page_no":null,"line_no":129,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਾਲ ਮੈ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan kaal mai akaal kaal biaal bikh maareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person enjoys the benefits of all the nine treasures in the company of holy men. Despite living in the wheel of time, he remains protected from its wrath. He destroys the poison of the time like snake."}}},{"verse_id":208275,"page_no":null,"line_no":129,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਭਏ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan kul akuleen bhe dhubidhaa nivaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He drinks deep the elixir of the Lord's name sitting in the dust of the feet of holy men. He becomes bereft of caste pride and is able to remove all differences of high and low from his mind."}}},{"verse_id":208276,"page_no":null,"line_no":129,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਕੀ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadh charanaamirat nidhaan paan sahaj samaadh nij aasan kee taareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of holy men and enjoying the treasure of elixir like Naam, he remains engrossed in his self and attached consciously in a state of equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208277,"page_no":null,"line_no":129,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਅਬਿਗਤ ਗਤਿ ਨਿਆਰੀਐ ॥੧੨੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadh charanaamirat param padh gurmukh pa(n)th abigat gat niaareeaai ||127||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Relishing the elixir like Naam of the Lord in the company of the holy men, he attains the supreme state. The path of Guru-conscious people is beyond description. It is imperishable and celestial. (127)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41155,"next":41157}}
files.shabads/82/41157.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41157,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208278","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208278,"last_verse_id":208281,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208278,"page_no":null,"line_no":130,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਖਾ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)gat sakhaa milaap gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd jugat kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The method of meeting with the Lord God through meditation in a holy gathering is like the gathering and formation of clouds that cause rain, lightening and thunder."}}},{"verse_id":208279,"page_no":null,"line_no":130,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਗਰਜਤ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh keeratan gur sabadh kai anahadh naadh garajat unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Acquiring a stable state of contemplation and meditation in the holy congregation, the continuous melody that is heard within should be regarded as sound of thunder of the clouds."}}},{"verse_id":208280,"page_no":null,"line_no":130,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)gat jotee saroop dhaaminee chamatakaar unaman maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The divine light that radiates during stable state meditation in the holy gathering is like miraculous lightening that blossoms the mind."}}},{"verse_id":208281,"page_no":null,"line_no":130,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੨੮॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh liv nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa a(n)mirat jal sarab nidhaaneeaai ||128||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The continuous flow of the elixir of Naam that takes place in the tenth door of the body as a result of meditation in the congregation of holy men is like rain of nectar that is the treasure house of all the boons. (128)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41156,"next":41158}}
files.shabads/82/41158.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41158,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208282","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208282,"last_verse_id":208285,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208282,"page_no":null,"line_no":131,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਗੋ ਬੰਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਖਾਇ ਦੁਹੇ ਗੋਰਸ ਦੈ ਗੋਰਸ ਅਉਟਾਏ ਦਧਿ ਮਾਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau go ba(n)s tiran khai dhuhe goras dhai goras aauTaae dhadh maakhan pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a cow grazes on grass and hay yields milk which when heated, cooled and set to coagulate as curd, butter is obtained;"}}},{"verse_id":208283,"page_no":null,"line_no":131,"gurmukhi":"ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਊਖ ਤਨ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕੇ ਪਿਰਾਏ ਰਸ ਕੇ ਅਉਟਾਏ ਖੰਡ ਮਿਸਰੀ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"uookh mai piuookh tan kha(n)dd kha(n)dd ke piraae ras ke aauTaae kha(n)dd misaree miThaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sugarcane is sweet. It is put through a crusher to obtain its juice that is heated and converted into jaggery cakes and sugar crystals;"}}},{"verse_id":208284,"page_no":null,"line_no":131,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕੈ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਢਾਕ ਅਉ ਪਲਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh kai banaasapatee ddaak aau palaas jaise cha(n)dhan subaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a sandalwood tree infuses its fragrance in the vegetation that grows around it;"}}},{"verse_id":208285,"page_no":null,"line_no":131,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੨੯॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g milat sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree hot gurmat paraupakaar ke nivaas hai ||129||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a worldly person become a humble servant of God in the company of saintly persons. By virtue of the teachings and initiation of Guru, he is blessed with the traits of doing good to all and sundry. (129)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41157,"next":41159}}
files.shabads/82/41159.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41159,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208286","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208286,"last_verse_id":208289,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208286,"page_no":null,"line_no":132,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਧ ਮੁਖ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan misaTaan paan sudhaa ras pujas na saadh mukh madhur bachan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Countless eatables of elixir like sweet tastes are nowhere equal to the sweet words uttered by saintly persons."}}},{"verse_id":208287,"page_no":null,"line_no":132,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਚੰਦ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਧ ਮਤਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸਚਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"seetal suga(n)dh cha(n)dh cha(n)dhan koTaan koT pujas na saadh mat ni(n)mrataa sachan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tranquillity and coolness of million moons and fragrance of million sandalwood trees cannot be even a patch on the humility of saintly Sikhs of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208288,"page_no":null,"line_no":132,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਅਉ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕੇ ਰਚਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan kaamadhen aau kalapatar pujas na ki(n)chat kaTaachh ke rachan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A little glance of grace and kindness of the True Guru as a result of perpetual meditation of Naam, cannot be compared with millions of heavenly cows (Kamdhenu) and all granting tree (Kalap-brichh)."}}},{"verse_id":208289,"page_no":null,"line_no":132,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਫਲ ਸਕਲ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਖਚਨ ਖਉ ॥੧੩੦॥","translit_en":"sarab nidhaan fal sakal koTaan koT pujas na paraupakaar ke khachan khau ||130||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All treasures and fruits of labour even when multiplied million times cannot reach the philanthropic deeds of Guru's Sikhs. (130)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41158,"next":41160}}
files.shabads/82/41160.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41160,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208290","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208290,"last_verse_id":208293,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208290,"page_no":null,"line_no":133,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan roop ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab koTan koTaan savaiaadh ras bi(n)janaadh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Countless forms and colours, beauty of various parts of body and enjoying the tastes of meals;"}}},{"verse_id":208291,"page_no":null,"line_no":133,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਰਸਿ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan koT baasanaa subaas ras koTan koTaan koT raag naadh baadh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Countless fragrances, sensualities, tastes, singing modes, melodies and sounding of musical instruments;"}}},{"verse_id":208292,"page_no":null,"line_no":133,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਕੋਟਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਮਾਦਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan koT ridh sidh nidh sudhaa koTin koTaan giaan dhiaan karamaadh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Countless miraculous powers, elixir like pleasure-giving store houses of goods, contemplation and following of rites and rituals;"}}},{"verse_id":208293,"page_no":null,"line_no":133,"gurmukhi":"ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹੁਇ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਗੁਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਧ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੈ ॥੧੩੧॥","translit_en":"sagal padhaarath hui koTan koTaan gun pujas na saadh upakaar bisamaadh kai ||131||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And if all that had been said above become million times more, cannot match with the good done by persons of saintly temperament. (131)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41159,"next":41161}}

by."}}},{"verse_id":208296,"page_no":null,"line_no":134,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਲ ਹੁਇ ਮਜੀਠ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਘਾਤੀ ਭਏ ਫੂਲ ਹੁਇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਰੰਗ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mool hui majeeTh ra(n)g sa(n)gam sa(n)ghaatee bhe fool hui kasu(n)bh ra(n)g cha(n)chal charitr hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Rubiaceous plant (Majitha) has its colour characteristic in the bottom part of the plant but when joined with a cloth gives it a beautiful red colour and integrates with it."}}},{"verse_id":208297,"page_no":null,"line_no":134,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਦਾਦਰ ਅਉ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal aapaa khoi baran baran milai taise hee bibekee paramaatam praves hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water mixes with several colours and acquires the same hue, similarly a disciple following Guru's advice becomes one with God."}}},{"verse_id":208300,"page_no":null,"line_no":135,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਆਵੇਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paaras paras jaise kanik anik dhaat cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baasanaa aaves hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As many metals when touched with philosopher stone become gold, bushes and plants grown in the vicinity of sandalwood attain its fragrance, similarly a devotee following Guru's advice becomes pure and one who spreads the fragrance of goodness all around."}}},{"verse_id":208301,"page_no":null,"line_no":135,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਅਦੇਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੩॥","translit_en":"ghaT ghaT pooram braham jot ot pot bhaavanee bhagat bhai aadh kau adhes hai ||133||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Making prayers and supplications to the Almighty Lord, a wise and rationalist person enjoins the divine radiance of the Omnipresent Lord like warp and weft of a fabric through complete faith and devotion instilled in him by the Guru. ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan subaas kai subaasanaa banaasapatee taahee te suga(n)dhataa sakal sai samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But vegetation around a Sandalwood tree become equally fragrant with the aroma released but it;"}}},{"verse_id":208304,"page_no":null,"line_no":136,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਤ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਰਾਇ ਸਬ ਰੰਗਨੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal milat sraba(n)g sa(n)g ra(n)g raakhai agan jarai sab ra(n)gan miTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water acquires the same colour that is mixed in it, but fire destroys all the colours by burning them (into ashes);"}}},{"verse_id":208305,"page_no":null,"line_no":136,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਂਤ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥੧੩੪॥","translit_en":"jaise rav sas siv sakat subhaav gat sa(n)jogee biogee dhirasaTaa(n)t kai dhikhaaviee ||134||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the effect of Sun is undesirable (Tamoguni) while the moon has virtuous effect, similarly a Guru-conscious person behaves peacefully and virtuously while a self willed and apostate person caught in the evil effects of mammon is conspicuous. (134)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41162,"next":41164}}
files.shabads/82/41164.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41164,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208306","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208306,"last_verse_id":208309,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208306,"page_no":null,"line_no":137,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਬਸਿ ਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur dharas dhiaan sree gur sabadh giaan sasatr sanaeh pa(n)ch dhoot bas aae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Contemplating on the vision of the True Guru and practicing His impressed divine word are the weapons for fighting the five evils like lust, anger, avarice etc."}}},{"verse_id":208307,"page_no":null,"line_no":137,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਧੇਨ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕਾਟਿ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur charan ren sree gur saran dhen karam bharam kaaT abhai padh paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The refuge of True Guru and by living in the dust of His feet, the ill effects and doubts of all past performed deeds are vanquished. One acquires a state of fearlessness."}}},{"verse_id":208308,"page_no":null,"line_no":137,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਲੇਖ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਛਲ ਅਲੇਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur bachan lekh sree gur sevak bhekh achhal alekh prabh alakh lakhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By imbibing the divine words of Satguru (True Guru), and by developing an attitude of a true slave, one realises the imperceptible, indeceivable and indescribable Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208309,"page_no":null,"line_no":137,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੫॥","translit_en":"gursikh saadh sa(n)g gosaT prem prasa(n)g ni(n)mrataa nira(n)taree kai sahaj samaae hai ||135||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of holy men of the True Guru, singing Gurbani (Guru's utterances in praise of the Lord) with humility and love, one gets absorbed in the spiritual peace. (135)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41163,"next":41165}}

॥","translit_en":"jaise tau majeeTh basudhaa sai khodh kaaddeeat a(n)bar sura(n)g bhe sa(n)g na tajat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the red colouring agent of a Rubiaceous plant is extracted from the bottom part of its stem, and the clothes coloured with it become beautiful to behold, while the colour does not fade;"}}},{"verse_id":208311,"page_no":null,"line_no":138,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਤਜਿ ਮੂਲ ਫੂਲ ਆਨੀਅਤ ਜਾਨੀਅਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਤਾਹੀ ਭਜਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kasu(n)bh taj mool fool aaneeat jaaneeat sa(n)g chhaadd taahee bhajat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the colour of Safflower plant resides in the flower and not in the lower part of the stem, so it is believed to leave or fade away when a cloth is dyed with it, since that is its character;"}}},{"verse_id":208312,"page_no":null,"line_no":138,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਸਲਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਸੀਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਮਲ ਅਮਲ ਸਜਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aradh uradh mukh salil soochee subhaau taa(n) te seet tapat mal amal sajat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the water flows downward while the fire extends upward, the fire is heat and soot-giving while water is cool and free of dross or dirt."}}},{"verse_id":208313,"page_no":null,"line_no":138,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਨੀਚ ਊਚ ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਹਾਰ ਜੀਤ ਲਜਾ ਨ ਲਜਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੬॥","translit_en":"gurmat dhuramat uooch neech neech uooch jeet haar haar jeet lajaa na lajat hai ||136||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The teachings of the Guru raise the consciousness of the humble, convert defeat into victory, and make a person honorable but base wisdom lowers the arrogant, converts victory into defeat, and makes a person bereft of shame and honour. (136)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41164,"next":41166}}
files.shabads/82/41166.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41166,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208314","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208314,"last_verse_id":208317,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208314,"page_no":null,"line_no":139,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat liv pooran braham sarabaatam kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person strings the word divine in the thread of his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. He acknowledges the presence of omnipresent Lord in the form of soul in every one."}}},{"verse_id":208315,"page_no":null,"line_no":139,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਹਸਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj subhai ridhai bhaavanee bhagat bhai bihas milan sam dharas dhiaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is ever engrossed in the love and faith of the Guru Lord in his mind. He treats all alike and smilingly too."}}},{"verse_id":208316,"page_no":null,"line_no":139,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ni(n)mrataa nivaas dhaas dhaasan dhaasaan mat madhur bachan mukh benatee bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru-conscious person who ever lives in the presence of the True Guru is always humble and has the intellect of being the slave of slaves (of the Guru). And when he speaks, his words are sweet and full of supplication."}}},{"verse_id":208317,"page_no":null,"line_no":139,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੩੭॥","translit_en":"poojaa praan giaan gur aagiaakaaree agrabhaag aatam aves paramaatam nidhaaneeaai ||137||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-oriented person remembers Him with every breath and stays in Lord's presence like an obedient being. Thus his soul remains absorbed in the treasure house of peace and tranquillity. (137)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41165,"next":41167}}
files.shabads/82/41167.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41167,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208318","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208318,"last_verse_id":208321,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208318,"page_no":null,"line_no":140,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan satigur mat sun sat kar maanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The granter of knowledge and contemplation of ever stable form and name (Lord) is True Guru. A Guru-conscious person listens to the teachings of the True Guru and practices His words in his deeds and actions."}}},{"verse_id":208319,"page_no":null,"line_no":140,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan samadharasee braham dhiaanee sabadh giaan gur braham giaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of glimpse and contemplation of the True Guru, a Guru-oriented person treats all uniformly. And as such he is Lord-conscious person and because of the knowledge of the words of Guru, he is Lord aware person."}}},{"verse_id":208320,"page_no":null,"line_no":140,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat nihachal pooran pragaas ridhai maanai man maane unaman unamaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing the teachings of the True Guru completely and with patience, the light effulgent appears within him. He is filled with the love of the Lord and he acquires higher state of spiritual being."}}},{"verse_id":208321,"page_no":null,"line_no":140,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਠਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੮॥","translit_en":"bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj mai adhabhut paramadhabhut gat Thaanee hai ||138||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the grace of the meditation of Naam of the Lord carried out by the blessings of the True Guru, he stays in most ecstatic, strange and blissful state all the time. (138)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41166,"next":41168}}
files.shabads/82/41168.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41168,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208322","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208322,"last_verse_id":208325,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208322,"page_no":null,"line_no":141,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਪੂਰਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਨਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran param jot satigur sat roop pooran giaan satigur satinaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru is the true and complete form of the Radiance supreme-the Lord. The blessings of Naam to the Sikhs is the complete knowledge of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208323,"page_no":null,"line_no":141,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran jugat sat sat gurmat ridhai pooran su sev saadh sa(n)gat bisraam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The slave Sikh of the True Guru imbibes the teachings of the Guru in his heart according to the manner taught and holds it as total truth. He practices it in the holy congregation very devotedly;"}}},{"verse_id":208324,"page_no":null,"line_no":141,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran poojaa padhaarabi(n)dh madhukar man prem ras pooran hui kaam nihakaam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the worship of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, the beetle-like mind is satiated with the love elixir of Lord-like Guru and feels free from all other desires and wants."}}},{"verse_id":208325,"page_no":null,"line_no":141,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਧਾਮ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੯॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran paramanidh pooran pragaas bisam sathal dhaam hai ||139||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The storehouse of all treasures are the form of complete form of True Guru. By virtue of the meditation on Naam (obtained from the True Guru) the heart that feels the light effulgence of the Lord, that heart is wondrous and astonishing. (139)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41167,"next":41169}}
files.shabads/82/41169.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41169,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208326","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208326,"last_verse_id":208329,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208326,"page_no":null,"line_no":142,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਲ ਛਬਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਛਕਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan jot ko udhot asacharaj mai taa mai til chhab paramadhabhut chhak hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The divine radiance of True Guru's light is astonishing. Even a miniscule part of that light is beautiful, marvellous and quaint."}}},{"verse_id":208327,"page_no":null,"line_no":142,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਬੋ ਕੌ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕੌ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕੌ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਮੈ ਉਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhekhabo kau dhirasaT na sunabe kau surat hai kahibe kau jihavaa na gayaan mai ukat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eyes have no power to see, ears have no power to hear and tongue has no power to describe the beauty of that light divine. Nor are there words in the world to describe it."}}},{"verse_id":208328,"page_no":null,"line_no":142,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟ ਲੈ ਛਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sobhaa koT sobh lobh lubhat hui loT poT jagamag jot koT oT lai chhipat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Numerous praises, lights of glittering lamp hide behind curtains before this supernatural light."}}},{"verse_id":208329,"page_no":null,"line_no":142,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੇਖ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਅਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੪੦॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g pekh man manasaa thakat bhiee net net namo namo at hoo te at hai ||140||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A very momentary glimpse of that divine effulgence ends all the notions and options of the mind. The praise of such glimpse is infinite, most wondrous and marvellous. Thus He should be saluted again and again. (140)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41168,"next":41170}}
files.shabads/82/41170.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41170,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208330","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208330,"last_verse_id":208333,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208330,"page_no":null,"line_no":143,"gurmukhi":"ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਛਬਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chhab kai anek chhab sobhaa kai anek sobhaa jot kai anek jot namo namo nam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Myriad beauties and many praises salute the beauty and praise of divine effulgence of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208331,"page_no":null,"line_no":143,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਤਤਿ ਉਪਮਾ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕਥਾ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ausatat upamaa mahaatam mahimaa anek ek til kathaa at agam agam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Praise of the True Guru equal to a sesame seed is beyond many praises, comparisons, and glories described."}}},{"verse_id":208332,"page_no":null,"line_no":143,"gurmukhi":"ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"budh bal bachan bibek jau anek mile ek til aadh bisamaadh kai bisam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If all the wisdom, strength, powers of speech, and worldly knowledge combine, these would be astonished by a momentary initial glimpse of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208333,"page_no":null,"line_no":143,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਹਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਭਈ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥੧੪੧॥","translit_en":"ek til kai anek bhaa(n)t nihakraa(n)t bhiee abigat gat gur pooran braham hai ||141||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the beauties become insipid and fade away before a momentary glimpse of the divine light of the True Guru. Therefore grandeur of complete God like True Guru is beyond apprehension. (141)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41169,"next":41171}}
files.shabads/82/41171.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41171,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208334","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208334,"last_verse_id":208337,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208334,"page_no":null,"line_no":144,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan jot ko udhot asacharaj mai ki(n)chat kaTaachh kai bisam koT dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A sight of the divine refulgence of the True Guru is full of astonishment. awesome and marvellous, whom no one can perceive, whose knowledge is imperceptible, many incantations uttered in total contemplation cannot reach him, such is the form of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208341,"page_no":null,"line_no":145,"gurmukhi":"ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਦੇਵਾਧਿ ਦੇਵ ਐਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਮੈ ॥੧੪੩॥","translit_en":"alakh abhev apara(n)par dhevaadh dhev aaise gurdhev sev gursikh sa(n)t mai ||143||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God who is beyond reach, whose secret cannot be known, who is infinite, who is God of gods, the service of such-like True Guru can only be performed in the congregation of saints and Gursikhs. (True God can only be meditated upon in the company of holy men). (143)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41171,"next":41173}}
files.shabads/82/41173.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41173,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208343","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208342,"last_verse_id":208345,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208342,"page_no":null,"line_no":146,"gurmukhi":"ਝੂਲਨਾ ਛੰਦ: ਆਦਿ ਧਰਮਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਗੁਰਏ ਨੇਮਹ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ॥","translit_en":"jhoolanaa chha(n)dh: aadh dharamaadh bisamaadh gure nemeh pragaT pooran braham jot raakhee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Salutation to the True Guru the wondrous form of the (root of all) Lord, in whom God Himself has lodged His light effulgent."}}},{"verse_id":208343,"page_no":null,"line_no":146,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਲਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਖੀ ॥","translit_en":"mil chatur baran ik baran hui saadh sa(n)g sahaj dhun keeratan sabadh saakhee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the congregation assembled before God-like True Guru, praises of the Lord are sung and recited. All four varnas (caste based sections of the society) then integrate into one caste society."}}},{"verse_id":208344,"page_no":null,"line_no":146,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਜ ਧਾਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਲਾਖੀ ॥","translit_en":"naam nihakaam nij dhaam gursikh sravan dhun gursikh sumat alakh laakhee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru whose base is Lord's name, listens to the melodious paeans of the Lord's praise. He then realises his self that helps him perceive the imperceptible."}}},{"verse_id":208345,"page_no":null,"line_no":146,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੈ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਲੈ ਤਾਂਹਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਾਖੀ ॥੧੪੪॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh kar kirapaa dhai jaa(n)h lai taa(n)h avagaeh pria preet chaakhee ||144||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru showers his benediction in very small measure on such a person who gets engrossed in it and relishes the loving elixir of Lord's love. (144)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41172,"next":41174}}
files.shabads/82/41174.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41174,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208346","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208346,"last_verse_id":208349,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208346,"page_no":null,"line_no":147,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਸਫੁਰਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਤੁਰਤ ਹੀ ਜੁਰਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੁਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh kee surat asafurat hui turat hee jurat hai saadh sa(n)g murat naahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of godly people, the mind readily focuses on the divine word. That results in perpetual and uninterrupted meditation on Naam."}}},{"verse_id":208347,"page_no":null,"line_no":147,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਤੀਤ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਤ ਮਨ ਜਗਤ ਮਨ ਦੁਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"prem parateet kee reet hit cheet kar jeet man jagat man dhurat naahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a result of union with holy gathering, the mundane distractions of daily life do not disturb any more. It adheres to the loving code with faith and confidence."}}},{"verse_id":208348,"page_no":null,"line_no":147,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਝਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaam nihakaam nihakaram hui karam kar aas niraas hui jharat naahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of keeping company of holy men, a God worshipping Guru-conscious person remains free of worldly desires despite living in their influence. He claims no credit for any deed performed. He remains bereft of all expectations and hopes and feels no distress for anything."}}},{"verse_id":208349,"page_no":null,"line_no":147,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਛਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧੪੫॥","translit_en":"giaan gur dhiaan ur maan pooran braham jagat meh bhagat mat chharat naahee ||145||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the virtue of holy congregation, with the instilling of Lords knowledge and perception in the mind, and feeling His presence around, such a devotee is never cheated or tricked in the world. (145)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41173,"next":41175}}
files.shabads/82/41175.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41175,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208350","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208350,"last_verse_id":208353,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208350,"page_no":null,"line_no":148,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan giaan giaan avagaahan kai koTin koTaan dhiaan dhiaan ur dhaarahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For searching the words of True Guru, millions keep the knowledge and contemplation of the Guru in their mind."}}},{"verse_id":208351,"page_no":null,"line_no":148,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan simaran simaran kar koTin koTaan unamaan baara(n) baar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For acquiring the vastness of Guru's perception and contemplation, millions of meditation methods of repeating/ reciting/uttering the words of the Guru are adopted."}}},{"verse_id":208352,"page_no":null,"line_no":148,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਅਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਝੁਨਕਾਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan surat sabadh aau dhirasaT kai koTin koTaan raag naadh jhunakaarahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of hearing powers try to perceive the divine word of Guru. Millions of singing modes are playing melodious tunes before the enchanting notes of Gur Shabad (Guru's words)."}}},{"verse_id":208353,"page_no":null,"line_no":148,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਕੋ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੀ ॥੧੪੬॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan prem nem gur sabadh ko net net namo namo kai namasakaarahee ||146||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Abiding by many codes of love and discipline, millions salute the words of the True Guru repeatedly calling it infinite, infinite and beyond. (146)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41174,"next":41176}}
files.shabads/82/41176.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41176,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208354","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208354,"last_verse_id":208357,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208354,"page_no":null,"line_no":149,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਭਏ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat livaleen akuleen bhe chatur baran mil saadh sa(n)g jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the union of the divine word and mind, a Guru-conscious person becomes free of high and low caste based differences. According to them, joining the ideal assembly of saintly people, the four castes become one only."}}},{"verse_id":208355,"page_no":null,"line_no":149,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਹਜ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat livaleen jal meen gat guhaj gavan jal paan unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is engrossed in the divine word should be considered like a fish in water who lives and eat in the water. Thus the Guru-conscious person latently continue with the practicing of Naam Simran (meditation) and enjoy the elixir of divine name."}}},{"verse_id":208356,"page_no":null,"line_no":149,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਪਰਬੀਨ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat livaleen parabeen bhe pooran braham ekai ek pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-oriented people absorbed in the divine word become aware completely. They acknowledge the presence of One Lord in all the living beings."}}},{"verse_id":208357,"page_no":null,"line_no":149,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਪਗ ਰੀਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੀਐ ॥੧੪੭॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat livaleen pag reen bhe gurmukh sabadh surat ur aaneeaai ||147||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are engrossed in the Gur Shabad (Divine Word) become humble of disposition and feel like dust of the feet of holy men. It is because they are perpetually practicing meditation on Lord's name. (147)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41175,"next":41177}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41177,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208358","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208358,"last_verse_id":208361,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208358,"page_no":null,"line_no":150,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਸਟਾ ਸੁਖੰਬਰ ਲੈ ਅਨਕਿ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh dhiaan kai patisaTaa sukha(n)bar lai anak paTa(n)bar kee sobhaa na suhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the grace of True Guru, a Guru-conscious person appreciates no other apparel than the comfort giving dress of respect and honour acquired by virtue of perpetual engrossment of the mind in the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208359,"page_no":null,"line_no":150,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਲਾਲਸਾ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal giaan misaTaan paan naanaa bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh laalasaa miTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He also feels no more desire for other foods after relishing the soul comforting sweet elixir like food of Naam Simran (Meditation on Lord's name)."}}},{"verse_id":208360,"page_no":null,"line_no":150,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ ਨ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"param nidhaan pria prem paramaarath kai sarab nidhaan kee ichhaa na upajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having attained access to the love filled treasure of the Lord, a Guru-obedient person desires for no other treasures."}}},{"verse_id":208361,"page_no":null,"line_no":150,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਟਾਛਯ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥੧੪੮॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur ki(n)chat kirapaa kaTaachhay man manasaa thakat anat na dhaaviee ||148||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By a miniscule grace of God-like True Guru for practicing meditation on Lord's name, all expectations of a Guru-oriented person are defeated. Except for indulgence in Naam Simran, they wander nowhere else. (148)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41176,"next":41178}}
files.shabads/82/41178.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41178,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208362","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208362,"last_verse_id":208365,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208362,"page_no":null,"line_no":151,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dha(n)n dha(n)n gur sikh sun gursikh bhe gur sikh man gursikh man maane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed is he who accepting Guru's advice become his disciple (devotee). In the process his mind is reassured in the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208363,"page_no":null,"line_no":151,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਭਾਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਭਾਉ ਚਾਉ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh bhai gursikh bhaau chaau ridhai gur sikh jaan gursikh jag jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By accepting his (Guru's) teachings with faith, love and enthusiasm develops in the heart of a devotee. He who labours on the teachings of Guru with singular mind, becomes known as a true Sikh of the Guru the world over."}}},{"verse_id":208364,"page_no":null,"line_no":151,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh milai gursikh pooran hui gursikh pooran braham pahichaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of Guru and his Sikh by virtue of strenuous meditation on Lord's name that enables him practice Guru's teachings sincerely and adeptly, the Sikh then recognises the complete Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208365,"page_no":null,"line_no":151,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੪੯॥","translit_en":"gur sikh prem nem gur sikh sikh gur soha(n) soiee bees ik iees ur aane hai ||149||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sincerity of the Sikh in labouring on the teachings of his Guru brings both together to the extent of becoming one. Believe it! By repeated incantations of Waheguru, Waheguru (Lord) and Tuhi Tuhi (He alone, He alone), he lodges the Lord in his heart. (149)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41177,"next":41179}}
files.shabads/82/41179.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41179,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208366","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208366,"last_verse_id":208369,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208366,"page_no":null,"line_no":152,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਿਦੈ ਨ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sat satigur mat sat ridhai bhidhai na dhuteeaa bhaau tiragun ateet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru has eternal form. His teachings are also for ever. He is never ridden with duality. He is free of the three traits of mammon (Tamas, Rajas and Saty)."}}},{"verse_id":208367,"page_no":null,"line_no":152,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਕਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran sarab miee ek hee anek mek sakal ke meet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Complete God Lord who is one and yet present in everyone, who is friend of everyone, manifests His form in True Guru, (Satguru)."}}},{"verse_id":208368,"page_no":null,"line_no":152,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰਲੰਭ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niravair niralep niraadhaar nirala(n)bh nira(n)kaar nirabikaar nihachal cheet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God-like True Guru is free of all animosity. He is beyond the influence of maya (mammon). He requires nobody's support, nor takes anyone's refuge. He is formless, beyond the grip of five vices and is ever stable of mind."}}},{"verse_id":208369,"page_no":null,"line_no":152,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਭੇਦ ਅਛਲ ਅਜੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੦॥","translit_en":"niramal niramol nira(n)jan niraahaar niramoh nirabhedh achhal ajeet hai ||150||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God-like True Guru is free of dross. He cannot be evaluated. He is beyond the smudge of maya (mammon). He is free of all bodily needs like food and sleep etc; He has no attachment with anyone and is free of all differences. He tricks no one, nor can be tricked by anybody. He is invincible. (150)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41178,"next":41180}}
files.shabads/82/41180.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41180,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208370","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":208370,"last_verse_id":208370,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208370,"page_no":null,"line_no":153,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗਰੁ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ॥ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sat satigar ko sabadh sat || sat saadh sa(n)gat hai gurmukh jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Lord (Satguru) is truth. His word is truth. His holy congregation is truth but this truth is realized only when one presents oneself before the True Lord (Satguru)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41179,"next":41181}}
files.shabads/82/41181.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41181,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208371","verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":208371,"last_verse_id":208373,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208371,"page_no":null,"line_no":154,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan dhiaan sat sabadh surat sat gursikh sa(n)g sat sat kar maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Contemplation on His vision is truth. Union of consciousness with Guru's word is truth. Company of the Sikhs of the Guru is truth but all this reality can be accepted only by becoming an obedient Sikh."}}},{"verse_id":208372,"page_no":null,"line_no":154,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਥਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dharas braham dhiaan sabadh braham giaan sa(n)gat braham thaan prem pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Vision of the True Guru is like vision and meditation of Lord. The sermon of the True Guru is the divine knowledge. The congregation of the Sikhs of the True Guru is the abode of the Lord. But this truth can only be realised when love resides in the mind."}}},{"verse_id":208373,"page_no":null,"line_no":154,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੫੧॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan kaam nihakaam unaman unamaaneeaai ||151||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The remembrance of the eternal and true name of the True Lord is contemplation and awareness of the True Guru. But this can only be realised after becoming bereft of all lusts and worldly desires and raising the soul to a higher realm. (151)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41180,"next":41182}}
files.shabads/82/41182.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41182,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208374","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208374,"last_verse_id":208377,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208374,"page_no":null,"line_no":155,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦੇਖੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pooran braham dhekhe dhirasaT kai gurmukh sabadh kai pooran braham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient Sikh of the Guru sees the Lord pervading everywhere. By his utterances and expressions, he shows His presence to others as well."}}},{"verse_id":208375,"page_no":null,"line_no":155,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pooran braham srut sravan kai madhur bachan keh benatee bisam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru's obedient slave hears the melodious sound of the complete God with his own ears by his very sweetly spoken words. He makes supplications which have marvellous sweetness in them."}}},{"verse_id":208376,"page_no":null,"line_no":155,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਸ ਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗਮਾਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pooran braham ras ga(n)dh sa(n)dh pres ras cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh gamaagam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious person always relishes the elixir of Lord's name even if he is lured by the combined attractions of his sense of smell and taste. The wondrous elixir obtained as a result of his love for the Lord is far more fragrant than the Sandalwood."}}},{"verse_id":208377,"page_no":null,"line_no":155,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੨॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pooran braham gur sarab mai gurmukh pooran braham namo nam hai ||152||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-oriented person considers the True Guru as a form of all-pervading Lord God. He makes his salutations and supplications to him again and again. (152)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41181,"next":41183}}
files.shabads/82/41183.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41183,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208378","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208378,"last_verse_id":208381,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208378,"page_no":null,"line_no":156,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਅਦਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas adharas dharas asacharaj mai herat hiraane dhirag dhirasaT agam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A vision of the Lord is beyond the knowledge of the six philosophies (of Hinduism). That vision is astonishing and wondrous. One is amazed at its sight. But that marvellous sight is beyond the capabilities of these eyes that can only see outwardly."}}},{"verse_id":208379,"page_no":null,"line_no":156,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸਬਦ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh agochar sabadh paramadhabhut akath kathaa kai srut sravan bisam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The form of divine word of the Lord is beyond speech and language. It is extremely wonderful. Even a description made and heard with ears is capable of sending one into a trance."}}},{"verse_id":208380,"page_no":null,"line_no":156,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਪੀਅ ਪਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਥਕਤ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaadh ras rahit apeea piaa prem ras rasanaa thakat net net namo nam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For His vision, relishing the elixir of Naam with love is beyond the worldly tastes. It is indeed unique. The tongue feels tired of making salutations to Him repeatedly and saying-Thou art infinite! Thou art infinite."}}},{"verse_id":208381,"page_no":null,"line_no":156,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਨ ਗਹਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੩॥","translit_en":"niragun saragun abigat na gahan gat sookham sathool mool pooran braham hai ||153||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No one can reach the latent and patent characteristics of the Transcendental and Immanent God who is complete in both forms: The complete and absolute God is the source of all the visible and invisible cosmos. (153)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41182,"next":41184}}
