{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41184,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208382","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208382,"last_verse_id":208385,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208382,"page_no":null,"line_no":157,"gurmukhi":"ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੀਚਾਨੋ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai bhalo hai seechaano jaa te jeev ghaat karai na bikaar hoi aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A falcon is better in captivity as it would keep him away from killing other birds."}}},{"verse_id":208383,"page_no":null,"line_no":157,"gurmukhi":"ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਚਕਈ ਭਲੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਰੇਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai chakiee bhalee jaa te raam rekh meT nis pria sa(n)g paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A red-legged partridge (Chakvi) is better in captivity that enables her meet her partner at night contrary to the curse of Sri Ram Chander."}}},{"verse_id":208384,"page_no":null,"line_no":157,"gurmukhi":"ਖੁਲੇ ਸੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਭਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੂਆ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"khule se ba(n)dhan bikhai bhalo hai sooaa prasidh sun upadhes raam naam liv laaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A parrot is better in cage where he can receive sermons from his master and repeat the name of the Lord perpetually."}}},{"verse_id":208385,"page_no":null,"line_no":157,"gurmukhi":"ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਸੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਭਲੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵਈ ॥੧੫੪॥","translit_en":"mokh padhavee sai taise maanas janam bhalo gurmukh hoi saadh sa(n)g prabh dhiaaviee ||154||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly being born in a human body is better since it helps an individual to be an obedient slave of the True Guru and remembers the Lord in the holy company of Lord's beloveds rather than acquiring emancipation outwardly. (154)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41183,"next":41185}}
files.shabads/82/41185.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41185,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208386","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208386,"last_verse_id":208389,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208386,"page_no":null,"line_no":158,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਆ ਉਡਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise sooaa uddat firat ban ban prat jaise iee birakh baiThe taiso fal chaakhiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a parrot flies from one tree to the other and eats fruit that is available on them;"}}},{"verse_id":208387,"page_no":null,"line_no":158,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਜੈਸੀ ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਤੈਸੀ ਭਾਖਾ ਲੈ ਸੁ ਭਾਖਈ ॥","translit_en":"par bas hoi jaisee jaiseeaai sa(n)gat milai sun upadhes taisee bhaakhaa lai su bhaakhiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In captivity, the parrot speaks language that he learns from the company that he keeps;"}}},{"verse_id":208388,"page_no":null,"line_no":158,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਜਲ ਕੋ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਖਈ ॥","translit_en":"taise chit cha(n)chal chapal jal ko subhaau jaise ra(n)g sa(n)g milai taise ra(n)g raakhiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the nature of this frolicsome mind that like water is very unstable and instable since it acquires colour that it mixes with."}}},{"verse_id":208389,"page_no":null,"line_no":158,"gurmukhi":"ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕਾਲ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਭਿਲਾਖਈ ॥੧੫੫॥","translit_en":"adham asaadh jaise baarunee binaas kaal saadh sa(n)g ga(n)g mil sujan bhilaakhiee ||155||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A lowly person and a sinner desires for liquor on his death bed, while a noble person desires company of noble and saintly persons when time for this departure from the world approaches. (155)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41184,"next":41186}}
files.shabads/82/41186.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41186,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208390","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208390,"last_verse_id":208393,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208390,"page_no":null,"line_no":159,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਸੇਤਾਂਬਰ ਹੁਇ ਤੈਸੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jaise ra(n)g sa(n)g milat setaa(n)bar hui taise taiso ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g lapaTai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every fibre of a white cloth in contact with any colour acquires the same hue."}}},{"verse_id":208391,"page_no":null,"line_no":159,"gurmukhi":"ਭਗਵਤ ਕਥਾ ਅਰਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਨੀਕ ਲਿਖਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਸ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਬੰਧ ਮੋਖਦਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhagavat kathaa araadhan kau dhaaraneek likhat kirataas patr ba(n)dh mokhadhai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Paper made of kritas leaf (considered to be impious) when used for recording the praises and paeans of the Lord, becomes capable of freeing one from the bondage of repeated births."}}},{"verse_id":208392,"page_no":null,"line_no":159,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਤ ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮਾਦਿ ਬਰਖਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਖ ਮੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨ ਹੋਇ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"seet greekhamaadh barakhaa tirabidh barakh mai nis dhin hoi lagh dheeragh dhikhai hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The periods of day light and the ambient conditions varies during summer, rainy season and winter;"}}},{"verse_id":208393,"page_no":null,"line_no":159,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਿਰਗੰਧ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੬॥","translit_en":"taise chit cha(n)chal chapal paun gaun gat sa(n)gam suga(n)dh biraga(n)dh pragaTai hai ||156||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the instable and frolicsome mind that blows like breeze. The air acquires fragrance or foul smell when it passes over stacks of flowers or heap of filth. Similarly a human mind acquires good traits in the company of good persons and ill traits when in contact with evil persons. (156)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41185,"next":41187}}
files.shabads/82/41187.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41187,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208394","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208394,"last_verse_id":208397,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208394,"page_no":null,"line_no":160,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਪਹਰ ਦਿਨ ਜਗਤਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਜੁਗ ਨਿਸਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਲੈ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur pahar dhin jagat chatur jug nis mahaa paralai samaan dhin prat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the four epoch world, consider the four quarters of day of life and the four quarters of night as great calamity, a game that is being played regularly."}}},{"verse_id":208395,"page_no":null,"line_no":160,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤਮ ਮਧਿਮ ਨੀਚ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਣ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਗਤਿ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਆਸਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"autam madhim neech tiragun sa(n)saar gat log bedh giaan unamaan aasakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the dice of Chaoparh-a black-gammon like game, the progress of the worldly game is sometimes supreme, modest or low. People living in the three traits of maya are entangled in debating about the worldly and spiritual knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":208396,"page_no":null,"line_no":160,"gurmukhi":"ਰਜਿ ਤਮਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਉਗਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raj tam sat gun aaugan simrat chit tiragun ateet biralo iee gurmat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A rare Guru-oriented, Guru follower holds these three traits of maya (Rajas, Tamas and Satv) as evil and strives to get rid of them."}}},{"verse_id":208397,"page_no":null,"line_no":160,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਸਾਰ ਚਉਪਰ ਕੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਜੁਗਲ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੭॥","translit_en":"chatur baran saar chaupar ko khel jag saadh sa(n)g jugal hoi jeevan mukat hai ||157||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The world is a game of four coloured dice. As in the game of Chaoparh where two dice are used and often fall favourably, one can achieve salvation from repeated births by keeping and adopting the company of godly men. (157)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41186,"next":41188}}
files.shabads/82/41188.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41188,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208398","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208398,"last_verse_id":208401,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208398,"page_no":null,"line_no":161,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਰੰਗ ਜਗਤੁ ਮੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ra(n)g sa(n)g milat salil mil hoi taiso taiso ra(n)g jagat mai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water acquires colour that it comes in contact with, so is the effect of good and bad company regarded in the world."}}},{"verse_id":208399,"page_no":null,"line_no":161,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਵਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ  ਸੰਗਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਗੰਧ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh mil pavan suga(n)dh  sa(n)g mal mootr sootr biraga(n)dh unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Air in contact with sandalwood acquires fragrance, while it becomes foul smelling when in contact with filth."}}},{"verse_id":208400,"page_no":null,"line_no":161,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕ ਸਾਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਤੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jaise paak saak bi(n)jan milat ghirat taiso taiso savaiaadh ras rasanaa kai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Clarified butter acquires the taste of the vegetable and other items cooked and fried in it."}}},{"verse_id":208401,"page_no":null,"line_no":161,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਮੂਰੀ ਅਉ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸ ਖਾਏ ਤੇ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੫੮॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh sa(n)gat subhaav gat mooree aau ta(n)bol ras khaae te pahichaaneeaai ||158||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The nature of good and bad people is not latent; like the taste of a radish leaf and betel leaf that is recognised on eating. Similarly good and evil persons may look alike outwardly but their good and bad characteristics can be known by keeping their company. (158)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41187,"next":41189}}
files.shabads/82/41189.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41189,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208402","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208402,"last_verse_id":208405,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208402,"page_no":null,"line_no":162,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕ ਕਿਸ਼ੋਰ ਜੋਬਨਾਦਿ ਅਉ ਜਰਾ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਹੋਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baalak kishor jobanaadh aau jaraa bivasathaa ek hee janam hot anik prakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one go through childhood, adolescence, youth and old age in one lifespan."}}},{"verse_id":208403,"page_no":null,"line_no":162,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਦਿਨਿ ਤਿਥਿ ਵਾਰ ਪਛ ਮਾਸੁ ਰੁਤਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਮਾਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਰਖ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nis dhin tith vaar pachh maas rut chatur maas tirabidh barakh bithaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As days, nights, dates, weeks, months, four seasons are the spread of one year;"}}},{"verse_id":208404,"page_no":null,"line_no":162,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸੁਪਨ ਅਉ ਸਖੋਪਤਿ ਅਵਸਥਾ ਕੈ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaagrat supan aau sakhopat avasathaa kai tureeaa pragaas gur giaan upakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As wakefulness, dream sleep, deep slumber and a state of nothingness (Turi) are different states;"}}},{"verse_id":208405,"page_no":null,"line_no":162,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੫੯॥","translit_en":"maanas janam saadh sa(n)g mil saadh sa(n)t bhagat bibekee jan braham beechaar hai ||159||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly meeting with saintly people and contemplating on Lord's glory and grandeur during human life, one becomes a godly person, a saint, a devotee and a wise man. (159)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41188,"next":41190}}

ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chakiee mudhit pekh pratibi(n)b nis si(n)gh pratibi(n)b dhekh koop mai parat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a red-legged partridge (chakvi) feels happy seeing its image and regarding it as her paramour, whereas a lion jumps in the well when he sees his image in the water and regards it as his rival;"}}},{"verse_id":208407,"page_no":null,"line_no":163,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਮਾਨਸ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਪੇਖਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਭੂਸ ਕੈ ਮਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kaach ma(n)dhar mai maanas ana(n)dh miee savaiaan pekh aapaa aap bhoos kai marat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a person feels ecstatic watching his image in the mirror-studded house while a dog barks perpetually considering all images as other dogs;"}}},{"verse_id":208408,"page_no":null,"line_no":163,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਵਿ ਸੁਤਿ ਜਮ ਰੂਪ ਅਉ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਕੈ ਭਾਉ ਭੈ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise rav sut jam roop aau dharamarai dharam adharam kai bhaau bhai karat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the son of Sun becomes an object of fear for the unrighteous people in the form of angel of death, but loves the righteous people by projecting himself as the king of righteousness;"}}},{"verse_id":208409,"page_no":null,"line_no":163,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨਤ ਨ ਚੀਨਤ ਚਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੦॥","translit_en":"taise dhuramat gurmat kai asaadh saadh aapaa aap cheenat na cheenat charat hai ||160||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So do the deceiver and trickster not recognise themselves due to their base wisdom. On the contrary, Godly people acquire the wisdom of the True Guru and recognise their real self. (160)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41189,"next":41191}}
files.shabads/82/41191.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41191,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208410","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208410,"last_verse_id":208413,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208410,"page_no":null,"line_no":164,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau salil mil baran baran bikhai jaahee jaahee ra(n)g milai soiee hui dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water acquires the hue of colour that is mixed in it, As the clarified butter conveys to the tongue the taste of the vegetable and other items cooked in it,"}}},{"verse_id":208411,"page_no":null,"line_no":164,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਾਹੀ ਜਾਹੀ ਪਾਕ ਸਾਕ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਤੈਸੋ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghirat jaahee jaahee paak saak sa(n)g milai taise taiso savaiaadh ras rasanaa chakhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a mimic has a definite character of his own adopts different characters for mimicry but he is known by the character that he is mimicking at that moment,"}}},{"verse_id":208412,"page_no":null,"line_no":164,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਗੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਭੇਖ ਧਾਰੈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗ ਕਾਛੈ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise savaiaagee ek hui anek bhaa(n)t bhekh dhaarai joiee joiee savaiaa(n)g kaachhai soiee tau kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a man of frolicsome mind takes to vices in the company of those whose minds are restless and playful. "}}},{"verse_id":208413,"page_no":null,"line_no":164,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਪਲ ਸੰਗ ਦੋਖ ਲੇਪ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੬੧॥","translit_en":"taise chit cha(n)chal chapal sa(n)g dhokh lep gurmukh hoi ek Tek Thahiraaviee ||161||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But an obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes God-oriented in the company and teachings of the True Guru. (161)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41190,"next":41192}}
files.shabads/82/41192.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41192,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208414","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208414,"last_verse_id":208417,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208414,"page_no":null,"line_no":165,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਮਥਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saagar mathat jaise nikase a(n)mirat bikh paraupakaar na bikaar samasar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Churning of ocean produced nectar and poison. Despite coming out of the same ocean, the goodness of nectar and harm of poison is not the same."}}},{"verse_id":208415,"page_no":null,"line_no":165,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਖੁ ਅਚਵਤ ਹੋਤ ਰਤਨ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕਾਲ ਅਚਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਮਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bikh achavat hot ratan binaas kaal ache a(n)mirat mooe jeevan amar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Poison ends the jewel-like life whereas nectar resuscitates or revives the dead making him immortal."}}},{"verse_id":208416,"page_no":null,"line_no":165,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਰੋ ਤਾਰੀ ਏਕ ਲੋਸਟ ਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੁਇ ਬੰਧ ਮੋਖ ਪਦਵੀ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਸਥਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise taaro taaree ek losaT sai pragaT hui ba(n)dh mokh padhavee sa(n)saar bisathar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the key and the lock are made of the same metal, but a lock results in bondage whereas a key frees the bonds."}}},{"verse_id":208417,"page_no":null,"line_no":165,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸਨ ਅਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਨ ਟਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੨॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh san aau majeeTh gat gurmat dhuramat Tev sai na Tar hai ||162||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a man does not give up his base wisdom but a person of Godly disposition never falters from the wisdom and teachings of the Guru. (162)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41191,"next":41193}}
files.shabads/82/41193.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41193,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208418","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208418,"last_verse_id":208421,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208418,"page_no":null,"line_no":166,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਓਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"barakhaa sa(n)jog mukataahal oraa pragaas paraupakaar aau bikaaree tau kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the rainy season, both pearl and hailstones are produced. Being of the same form, a pearl is considered good doer while the hailstone causes damage."}}},{"verse_id":208419,"page_no":null,"line_no":166,"gurmukhi":"ਓਰਾ ਬਰਖਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਧਾਨ ਪਾਸ ਕੋ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"oraa barakhat jaise dhaan paas ko binaas mukataa anoop roop sabhaa sobhaa paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hailstones destroy/damage crops and other vegetation, whereas a pearl is praised for its beauty and lustrous form."}}},{"verse_id":208420,"page_no":null,"line_no":166,"gurmukhi":"ਓਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਤ ਬਿਲਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"oraa tau bikaar dhaar dhekhat bilai jai paraupakaar mukataa jiau Thahiraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being damaging in nature, a hailstone melts away in no time, whereas a good doer pearl remains stable."}}},{"verse_id":208421,"page_no":null,"line_no":166,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੬੩॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh sa(n)gat subhaav gat gurmat dhuramat dhurai na dhuraaviee ||163||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similar is the effect of the company of vice/evil and virtuous people. The supreme wisdom acquired by the teachings of a True Guru and polluted intellect due to base wisdom cannot be hidden. (163)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41192,"next":41194}}
files.shabads/82/41194.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41194,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208422","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208422,"last_verse_id":208425,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208422,"page_no":null,"line_no":167,"gurmukhi":"ਲਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਅਉ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੀਲ ਡੀਲ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"lajaa kul a(n)kas aau gur jan seel ddeel kulaa badhoo brat kai patibrat kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of the good of the family honour, displaying calm and tranquil behaviour before the elders of the house and following the right ethos expected of a married woman, a daughter-in-law of a good family is called faithful and virtuous."}}},{"verse_id":208423,"page_no":null,"line_no":167,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬੁਲਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"dhusaT sabhaa sa(n)jog adham asaadh sa(n)g bahu bibichaar dhaar ganikaa bulaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A woman who keeps company of evil people, doing acts highly condemnable and indulging in licentious deeds is called a whore."}}},{"verse_id":208424,"page_no":null,"line_no":167,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਗੋਤ੍ਰਾਚਾਰ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਬਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"kulaa badhoo sut ko bakhaaneeat gotraachaar ganikaa suaan pitaa naam ko bataaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The son of a virtuous woman furthers the family lineage but who can tell the name of the father of a whore's son."}}},{"verse_id":208425,"page_no":null,"line_no":167,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਫਿਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੰਸ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਸੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੧੬੪॥","translit_en":"dhuramat laag jaise kaag ban ban firai gurmat ha(n)s ek Tek jas paaviee ||164||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a self-willed person of crow-like temperament wanders all over, a Guru-oriented person of swan-like attitude enjoys respect by taking the refuge of Lords name as taught and initiated to him by his Guru. (164)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41193,"next":41195}}
files.shabads/82/41195.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41195,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208426","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208426,"last_verse_id":208429,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208426,"page_no":null,"line_no":168,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਧਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਧਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maanas janam dhaar sa(n)gat subhaav gat gurmat dhuramat bibidh bidhaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the human birth, one is influenced by good or bad company. Thus the teachings of Guru instills virtues whereas bad company fills a person with base wisdom."}}},{"verse_id":208427,"page_no":null,"line_no":168,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਦਵੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g padhavee bhagat aau bibekee jan jeevan mukat saadhoo braham giaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of true people, one attains a position of a devotee, an analytical person, liberated alive and possessor of divine knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":208428,"page_no":null,"line_no":168,"gurmukhi":"ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਅਉ ਜੂਆਰੀ ਠਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"adham asaadh sa(n)g chor jaar aau jooaaree Thag baTavaaraa matavaaraa abhimaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Association with evil and vice-ridden people turns a man into thief, gambler, deceitful, dacoit, addict and arrogant."}}},{"verse_id":208429,"page_no":null,"line_no":168,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪੁਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੫॥","translit_en":"apune apune ra(n)g sa(n)g sukh maanai bis gurmat gat gurmukh pahichaanee hai ||165||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The whole world enjoys peace and pleasures in their own way. But a rare person has understood the intensity of the blessing of Guru's teaching and happiness it gives. (165)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41194,"next":41196}}
files.shabads/82/41196.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41196,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208430","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208430,"last_verse_id":208433,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208430,"page_no":null,"line_no":169,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਤਊ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau asaT dhaat ddaareeat naau bikhai paar parai taeh tuoo vaar paar soiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a bundle of eight metals loaded in a boat will reach the other bank without any change in its form or colour during transit,"}}},{"verse_id":208431,"page_no":null,"line_no":169,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਤਊ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪੈ ਸੁ ਘਾਟ ਠਾਟ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee dhaat agan mai hot hai agan roop tuoo joiee soiee pai su ghaaT ThaaT hoiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When these metals are put in fire, they melt and acquire the form of fire. It is then turned into beautiful ornaments of metal better looking than each individually."}}},{"verse_id":208432,"page_no":null,"line_no":169,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਹੁਇ ਮੋਲ ਕੈ ਅਮੋਲਾਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਵਲੋਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee dhaat paaras paras pun ka(n)chan hui mol kai amolaanoop roop avaloiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But when it comes in contact with philosopher-stone, it turns into gold. Beside becoming invaluable, it also becomes beautiful and attractive to look at."}}},{"verse_id":208433,"page_no":null,"line_no":169,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਪੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੬॥","translit_en":"param paaras gur paras paaras hot sa(n)gat hui saadh sa(n)g satasa(n)g poiee hai ||166||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly in the company of God-oriented and holy men, one becomes holy. Meeting with True Guru, the Supreme of all philosopher-stones, one becomes like a philosopher-stone. (166)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41195,"next":41197}}
files.shabads/82/41197.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41197,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208434","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208434,"last_verse_id":208437,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208434,"page_no":null,"line_no":170,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਖਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਰੋਸੀ ਧਾਇ ਜਰਤ ਬੁਝਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghar laagai aag bhaag nikasat khaan preetam parosee dhai jarat bujhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the owner of the house that catches fire escapes from the inferno to save his life, but sympathetic neighbours and friends rush to put the fire off,"}}},{"verse_id":208435,"page_no":null,"line_no":170,"gurmukhi":"ਗੋਧਨ ਹਰਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਗੋਪ ਗਾਉ ਮੈ ਗੁਹਾਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੁਰਤ ਛਡਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"godhan harat jaise karat pukaar gop gaau mai guhaar laag turat chhaddaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a herdsman shouts for help when his cattle are being stolen, the village folks chase the thieves and recover the cattle,"}}},{"verse_id":208436,"page_no":null,"line_no":170,"gurmukhi":"ਬੂਡਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੇਖਤ ਪੈਰਊਆ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਲੈ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"booddat athaeh jaise prabal pravaeh bikhai pekhat pairuooaa vaar paar lai lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a person may be drowning in rapid and deep water and an expert swimmer rescues him and reaches him on the other bank to safety,"}}},{"verse_id":208437,"page_no":null,"line_no":170,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੀ ॥੧੬੭॥","translit_en":"taise a(n)takaal jam jaal kaal biaal grase gursikh saadh sa(n)t sa(n)kaT miTaavahee ||167||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, when death-like snake is entangling a person in the throes of death, seeking help of saintly and holy persons allay that distress. (167)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41196,"next":41198}}
files.shabads/82/41198.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41198,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208438","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208438,"last_verse_id":208441,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208438,"page_no":null,"line_no":171,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿਰਲੋਭ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਨਿਹਮੇਵ ਨਿਹਟੇਵ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"neh kaam neh krodh niralobh niramoh nihamev nihaTev niradhokh vaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient disciple of True Guru is free of lust, anger, avarice, attachment, arrogance, base habits and other vices."}}},{"verse_id":208439,"page_no":null,"line_no":171,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਿਰ ਬਿਘਨਾਇ ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niralep nirabaan niramal niravair nir bighanai niraala(n)b abinaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is free of the influence of mammon (maya), bondage, dross, animosity, hindrances and support. He is indestructible of form."}}},{"verse_id":208440,"page_no":null,"line_no":171,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਿਹਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niraahaar niraadhaar nira(n)kaar nirabikaar nihachal nihabhraa(n)t nirabhai niraasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is free of all desires of taste, not dependent on the grace of gods and goddesses, transcendental of form, independent of all support, free of vices and doubts, fearless and stable of mind."}}},{"verse_id":208441,"page_no":null,"line_no":171,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਨਿਹਭਰਮ ਨਿਹ ਸਰਮ ਨਿਹ ਸੁਆਦ ਨਿਰ ਬਿਵਾਦ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਮੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੮॥","translit_en":"nihakaram nihabharam neh saram neh suaadh nir bivaadh nira(n)jan su(n)n mai sa(n)niaasee hai ||168||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is a recluse beyond rites and rituals, infatiguiable, undesirous of all worldly tastes and relishments, beyond all worldly disputes and discords, not smudged by the mammon (maya), who lives in a state of trance and tranquil thoughts. (168)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41197,"next":41199}}
files.shabads/82/41199.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41199,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208442","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208442,"last_verse_id":208445,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208442,"page_no":null,"line_no":172,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g paramadhabhut prem pooran pragaase hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Supernatural love grows in the heart of an obedient disciple of the Guru when he lodges the divine word in his consciousness and keeps the company of holy men."}}},{"verse_id":208443,"page_no":null,"line_no":172,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਤਰੰਗ ਗੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਸ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ra(n)g mai anek ra(n)g jiau tara(n)g ga(n)g prem ras mai anek ras hui bilaase hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The company of saintly persons and perpetual Naam Simran, creates a loving hue like the waves of river Ganges that generates multi-coloured effects. The Guru-conscious person enjoys many elixirs in this loving state."}}},{"verse_id":208444,"page_no":null,"line_no":172,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੰਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਮੈ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਉਲਾਸੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ga(n)dh sa(n)dh mai suga(n)dh sanaba(n)dh koT prem srut anik anaahadh ulaase hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Due to the practicing of Naam Simran, that fragrance is the combination of millions of fragrances. And the unstruck Music emerging from the loving fragrance of God, contains the pleasure of many modes of singing."}}},{"verse_id":208445,"page_no":null,"line_no":172,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੯॥","translit_en":"prem asaparas komalataa seetalataa kai akath kathaa binodh bisam bisavaiaase hai ||169||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"None can reach the sensitivity and coolness of that love generated by Naam Simran). The pleasures and ecstasy are describable. It generates marvellous faith. (169)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41198,"next":41200}}
files.shabads/82/41200.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41200,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208446","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208446,"last_verse_id":208449,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208446,"page_no":null,"line_no":173,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਰੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ra(n)g samasar pujas na kouoo ra(n)g prem ras pujas na an ras samaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No colour or shade can reach the hue of love nor anyone can reach near the elixir of love."}}},{"verse_id":208447,"page_no":null,"line_no":173,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੰਧ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਆਨ ਕੋਊਐ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਨ ਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ga(n)dh pujas na aan kouooaai suga(n)dh prem prabhutaa pujas prabhutaa na aan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving fragrance produced as a result of contemplation on Guru's words cannot be reached by any other fragrance in the world, nor any praise of the world can match the praise of love resulted from Naam Simran."}}},{"verse_id":208448,"page_no":null,"line_no":173,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਤੋਲੁ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਮੋਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem tol tul na pujas nahee tol tulaadhaar mol prem pujas na sarab nidhaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mergence of Guru's words in the consciousness cannot be measured by any balance or measures. The invaluable love cannot be reached by any treasure of the world."}}},{"verse_id":208449,"page_no":null,"line_no":173,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਬੋਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੋਲੁ ਕੋਊ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਅਸ ਥਕਤ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥੧੭੦॥","translit_en":"ek bol prem kai pujas nahee bol kouoo giaan unamaan as thakat koTaan kai ||170||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A loving word resulting from the Naam Simran cannot be matched by any explanation or elucidation of the world. Millions of volumes have consumed themselves trying to estimate this state. (170)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41199,"next":41201}}
files.shabads/82/41201.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41201,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208450","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208450,"last_verse_id":208453,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208450,"page_no":null,"line_no":174,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਸ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸਮ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur charan kamal jas aanadh sahaj sukh bisam koTaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of comforts of the world fall inadequate before the calming ecstasy of singing the praises of the True Guru, the epitome of Lord, the celestial knower."}}},{"verse_id":208451,"page_no":null,"line_no":174,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਕੈ ਲਭਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਛਬਿ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਲੁਭਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan sobh lobh kai labhit hoi koTan koTaan chhab chhab kai lubhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of grandeurs of the world are allured by the glory of the holy feet of the True Guru. Millions of worldly beauties go into trance over the beauty of the feet of True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208452,"page_no":null,"line_no":174,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੁਇ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟ ਚਾਹਤ ਹਿਰਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"komalataa koT loT poT hui komalataa kai seetalataa koT oT chaahat hiraan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of tenderness’s of the world are sacrificed over the tenderness of feet of the True Guru. Millions of calmness’s seek His refuge and are amazed."}}},{"verse_id":208453,"page_no":null,"line_no":174,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਹੋਤ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੧॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat koTaan anahadh gadh gadh hot man madhukar teh sa(n)paT samaan hai ||171||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of nectars are going gaga over the nectar of the holy feet of True Guru. As a bumble bee enjoys the sweet nectar of the flower by sucking deep into it, so does a Guru-conscious person remains immersed in the fragrance of the holy feet of the True Guru. (171)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41200,"next":41202}}
files.shabads/82/41202.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41202,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208454","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208454,"last_verse_id":208457,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208454,"page_no":null,"line_no":175,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਵਤ ਪੈ ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖੀਓ ਚਾਹੇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sovat pai supan charitr chitr dhekheeo chaahe sahaj samaadh bikhai unamanee jot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If someone desires to see the happenings of a dream in reality, it is not possible. Similarly the divine radiance of the celestial light generated due to Naam Simran cannot be described."}}},{"verse_id":208455,"page_no":null,"line_no":175,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਾਪਾਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮਤਵਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਜਿਉ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਅਨਭੈ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"suraapaan savaiaadh matavaaraa prat prasa(n)n jiau nijhar apaar dhaar anabhai udhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a drunkard feels satisfied and happy drinking liquor and he alone knows about it, similarly the continuous flow of the elixir of Naam generates divine awareness that is indescribable."}}},{"verse_id":208456,"page_no":null,"line_no":175,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕ ਪੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baalak pai naadh baadh sabadh bidhaan chaahai anahadh dhun runajhun surat srot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a child is unable to explain the notes of music in various modes, similarly a Guru-conscious person who listens to the unstruck music cannot describe its sweetness and melody."}}},{"verse_id":208457,"page_no":null,"line_no":175,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨ ਗੋਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੨॥","translit_en":"akath kathaa binodh soiee jaanai jaa mai beetai cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh jiau tarovar na got hai ||172||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The melody of unstruck music and continuous fall of elixir as a result is beyond description. One who has the process going in his mind, experiences it. Just as the trees which are fragranced by a Sandalwood are not regarded different than the Sandalwood tree itself. (172)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41201,"next":41203}}
files.shabads/82/41203.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41203,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208458","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208458,"last_verse_id":208461,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208458,"page_no":null,"line_no":176,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੇ ਮਦਨ ਮਦੋਨ ਮਤਿਵਾਰੋ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras ko prataap soiee jaanai jaa mai beete madhan madhon mativaaro jag jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He alone can appreciate the greatness of Lord's love-elixir who experiences it. It is just like a drunkard who is considered crazy by the world."}}},{"verse_id":208459,"page_no":null,"line_no":176,"gurmukhi":"ਘੂਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਘਾਇਲ ਸੋ ਘੂਮਤ ਅਰੁਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤੁ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਲਜ ਲਜਾ ਹੂ ਲਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"ghooram hui ghail so ghoomat arun dhirag mitr saturataa nilaj lajaa hoo lajaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a warrior wounded in the battlefield wanders around with his eyes blazing red, he shams the feeling of friendship and animosity,"}}},{"verse_id":208460,"page_no":null,"line_no":176,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਕਥਾ ਅਕਥ ਕੈ ਮੋਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਉਤਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa raseelee kathaa akath kai mon brat an ras rahit utar bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One enamoured by the love of God has his speech nectar-like due to perpetual recitation of Lord's indescribable traits. He adopts silence and is free from all other desires. He talks to no one and remains relishing the sweetness of Lord's naam."}}},{"verse_id":208461,"page_no":null,"line_no":176,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਕੋਚ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੭੩॥","translit_en":"surat sa(n)koch samasar asatut ni(n)dhaa pag ddagamag jat kat bisamaaneeaai ||173||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He keeps all his desires under wrap. Praise and insult is all alike to him. In the stupor of Naam he is seen living a life of wonders and marvels. (173)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41202,"next":41204}}
files.shabads/82/41204.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41204,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208462","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208462,"last_verse_id":208465,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208462,"page_no":null,"line_no":177,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਜਾਮਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਧ ਦਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਪਰੈ ਦੂਧ ਫਾਟਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tanak hee jaaman kai dhoodh dhadh hot jaise tanak hee kaa(n)jee parai dhoodh faaT jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a little coagulant turns the milk into curd, whereas a little citric acid would split it;"}}},{"verse_id":208463,"page_no":null,"line_no":177,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਬੀਜ ਬੋਏ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਚਿਨਗ ਪਰੈ ਭਸਮ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tanak hee beej boe birakh bithaar hoi tanak hee chinag parai bhasam hui samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a small seed grows into a mighty tree, but a spark of fire falling on such a mighty tree reduces it to ashes,"}}},{"verse_id":208464,"page_no":null,"line_no":177,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਖਾਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕਾਲ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tanak hee khaae bikh hot hai binaas kaal tanak hee a(n)mirat kai amar hoi gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a small quantity of poison causes death, whereas a little elixir makes a person imperishable,"}}},{"verse_id":208465,"page_no":null,"line_no":177,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬਿਵਾਹਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਨਕ ਮੈ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੪॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gat asaadh saadh ganikaa bivaahitaa jiau tanak mai upakaar aau bikaar ghaat hai ||174||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the contrast between a harlot and a loyal married woman, company of self-willed persons causes much damage and destruction to good deeds while the company of Guru-oriented people cause destruction of ill deeds. (174)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41203,"next":41205}}
files.shabads/82/41205.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41205,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208466","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208466,"last_verse_id":208469,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208466,"page_no":null,"line_no":178,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g dhirasaT dharas kai braham dhiaan soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g dhirasaT bikaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the vision rests on the congregation of holy people, one's consciousness attaches with the Lord. The same vision turns into vices in the company of self-willed people."}}},{"verse_id":208467,"page_no":null,"line_no":178,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat kai braham giaan soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g baadh aha(n)kaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the holy company, one realises the Lord through the union of the True Guru's words and the consciousness. But the same consciousness becomes a cause of arrogance and discord in the company of ill reputed persons."}}},{"verse_id":208468,"page_no":null,"line_no":178,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਅਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g asan basan kai mahaa prasaadh soiee tau asaadh sa(n)g bikham ahaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of the company of Guru-conscious persons simplicity in life and eating becomes supreme blessing. But eating (of meat etc.) in the company of ill-famed and self-willed people become painful and distressing."}}},{"verse_id":208469,"page_no":null,"line_no":178,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੫॥","translit_en":"dhuramat janam maran hui asaadh sa(n)g gurmat saadh sa(n)g mukat dhuaar hai ||175||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Due to base wisdom, the company of the self-willed people become a cause of birth and death repeatedly. On the contrary, adopting Guru's wisdom and keeping company of holy persons become a cause of emancipation. (175)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41204,"next":41206}}
files.shabads/82/41206.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41206,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208470","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208470,"last_verse_id":208473,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208470,"page_no":null,"line_no":179,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਛਤ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat charam dhirasaT dhib dhirasaT hui dhuramat lochan achhat a(n)dh ka(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accepting the initiation sermon of the True Guru turns the outward vision of a person into divine vision. But the base wisdom makes a person blind despite the presence of eyes. Such a person is bereft of knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":208471,"page_no":null,"line_no":179,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਠਿਨ ਕਪਾਟ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat surat kai bajar kapaaT khulai dhuramat kaThin kapaaT sanaba(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the sermon of the True Guru, the tight shut doors of the consciousness become ajar whereas this does not happen in the case of a person of base wisdom and self will."}}},{"verse_id":208472,"page_no":null,"line_no":179,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan dhuramat mukh dhurabachan dhuraga(n)dh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By adopting the counsel of the True Guru, one relishes the elixir of God's love perpetually. But base wisdom emanates foul smell from the mouth as a result of ill and bad words spoken."}}},{"verse_id":208473,"page_no":null,"line_no":179,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੬॥","translit_en":"gurmat sahaj subhai na harakh sog dhuramat bigreh birodh krodh sa(n)dh hai ||176||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Adopting the wisdom of True Guru produces true love and peace. He is never touched by happiness or sorrow in this state. However, base wisdom remains a cause of discord, quarrels and distress. (176)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41205,"next":41207}}
files.shabads/82/41207.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41207,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208474","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208474,"last_verse_id":208477,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208474,"page_no":null,"line_no":180,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਕਾਮ ਚੇਸਟਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਜਤ ਸਤਵੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhuramat gurmat sa(n)gat asaadh saadh kaam chesaTaa sa(n)jog jat satava(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The impure intelligence and company of evil persons generates lust and passion but adopting the teachings of True Guru, makes a person disciplined and chaste."}}},{"verse_id":208475,"page_no":null,"line_no":180,"gurmukhi":"ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੇ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰੰਤਰ ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰ ਜੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"krodh ke birodh bikhai sahaj sa(n)tokh mokh lobh lahara(n)tar dharam dheer ja(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The impure wisdom entangles a person in the waves of hatred and greed under the influence of anger, whereas in the company of saints he attains, humility, patience and kindness."}}},{"verse_id":208476,"page_no":null,"line_no":180,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੈ ਅਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਰਥ ਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਦਇਆ ਦ੍ਰਵੀਭੂਤ ਸੰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa moh dhroh kai arath pramaarath sai aha(n)mev Tev dhiaa dhraveebhoot sa(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A person with base wisdom is ever engrossed in the love of maya (mammon). He becomes deceitful and arrogant. But with the intellect of the True Guru, one becomes clement, kind, humble and saintly."}}},{"verse_id":208477,"page_no":null,"line_no":180,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੭॥","translit_en":"dhukirat sukirat chit mitr satrataa subhaav paraupakaar aau bikaar mool ma(n)t hai ||177||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One with impure intellect remains absorbed in base deeds and is ridden with animosity, whereas a Guru-conscious person is friendly and of good dispositions. The welfare of everyone is his/her mission in life. (177)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41206,"next":41208}}
files.shabads/82/41208.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41208,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208478","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208478,"last_verse_id":208481,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208478,"page_no":null,"line_no":181,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਨਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sikh ridhai pratham kirapaa kai basai taa paachhai karat aagiaa miaa kai manaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru becomes clement and enters the heart of a Sikh first. Then he asks the Sikh to meditate on Naam and showers his kindness to make him meditate."}}},{"verse_id":208479,"page_no":null,"line_no":181,"gurmukhi":"ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"aagiaa maan giaan gur param nidhaan dhaan gurmukh sukh fal nij padh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Obeying the command of the True Guru, a Guru-conscious person indulges in Naam Simran- a supreme treasure of the Lord and enjoys the spiritual comfort. He also attains the ultimate spiritual state."}}},{"verse_id":208480,"page_no":null,"line_no":181,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"naam nihakaam dhaam sahaj samaadh liv agam agaadh kathaa kahat na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In that spiritual realm, he achieves that high state of Naam where all desires of reward or fruit vanish. Thus he gets engrossed in a deep concentration. This state is beyond description."}}},{"verse_id":208481,"page_no":null,"line_no":181,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਤ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੭੮॥","translit_en":"jaiso jaiso bhaau kar poojat padhaarabi(n)dh sakal sa(n)saar kai manorath pujaaviee ||178||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With whatever desires and sentiments one worships the True Guru, He fulfils all his wants and desires. (178)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41207,"next":41209}}
files.shabads/82/41209.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41209,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208482","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208482,"last_verse_id":208485,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208482,"page_no":null,"line_no":182,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭੇਟਤ ਅਧਾਨ ਨਿਰਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pria bheTat adhaan niramaan hot baa(n)chhat bidhaan khaan paan agrabhaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a wife presents herself to her husband with humility and becomes pregnant, the husband brings her all the foods of her liking and taste. "}}},{"verse_id":208483,"page_no":null,"line_no":182,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਤ ਹਿਤ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਕਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"janamat sut khaan paan ko sa(n)jam karai sut hit ras kas sakal tiaag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On birth of a son, she abstains from eating all that may be harmful to the child."}}},{"verse_id":208484,"page_no":null,"line_no":182,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran kaamanaa pujai naam nihakaam dhaam anat na laag hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly taking the refuge of the True Guru with devotion; the desires of a Gursikh are fulfilled. He is blessed with the Naam by the True-Guru which is the source of desirelessness. One craves for nothing more and observes no rituals."}}},{"verse_id":208485,"page_no":null,"line_no":182,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਸਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੰਚ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੀਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਹੀ ਸੁਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੯॥","translit_en":"nis a(n)dhakaar bhav saagar sa(n)saar bikhai pa(n)ch tasakar jeet sikh hee sujaag hai ||179||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh who has received the boon of elixir-like Naam can win over the five evils cautiously and swims across worldly ocean that is frightening like a dark night. (179)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41208,"next":41210}}
files.shabads/82/41210.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41210,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208486","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208486,"last_verse_id":208489,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208486,"page_no":null,"line_no":183,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਬਾਲਕ ਸਿਖ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur aagiaa pratipaalak baalak sikh charan kamal raj mahimaa apaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devotee who obeys the command of the True Guru with the innocence of a child, the glory of the dust of his feet is infinite."}}},{"verse_id":208487,"page_no":null,"line_no":183,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਹੈ ਨਿਗਮ ਸੇਖਾਦਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕੈ ਉਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"siv sanakaadhik brahamaadhik na ga(n)mitaa hai nigam sekhaadh net net kai uchaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shiv, Sanak etc., the four sons of Brahma and other gods of Hindu triology cannot reach the praise of the Sikh of Guru who obeys the command of doing Naam Simran. Even the Vedas and Shesh Naag praise the glory of such a disciple saying-great, limitless."}}},{"verse_id":208488,"page_no":null,"line_no":183,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਰਸਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur padhaarath tirakaal tirabhavan chaahai jog bhog surasar saradhaa sa(n)saar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the four desirable goals-dharam, arth, kam and mokh, three times (past, present and future) desire refuge of such a devotee. The Yogis, householders, river Ganges the river of the gods and the whole world devotion craves for the dust of the feet of such a disciple."}}},{"verse_id":208489,"page_no":null,"line_no":183,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਜ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਬਿਮਲ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੦॥","translit_en":"poojan ke pooj ar paavan pavitr karai akath kathaa beechaar bimal bithaar hai ||180||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The dust of the feet of a disciple of the True Guru blessed with the Naam Simran is sacred even for those who are believed to be pious souls as it purifies them further. The state of such a person is beyond elucidation and his views are pure and clear. (180)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41209,"next":41211}}
files.shabads/82/41211.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41211,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208490","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208490,"last_verse_id":208493,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208490,"page_no":null,"line_no":184,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਤ ਭਈ ਉਲਟੀ ਤਨ ਸਨਾਤਨ ਮਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal chaakhat bhiee ulaTee tan sanaatan man unaman maane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Enjoying the taste of the pleasure-giving True Guru blessed Naam elixir, practicing the command of the Guru diligently, the inclinations of such Sikhs of the Guru turn away from the worldly attractions."}}},{"verse_id":208491,"page_no":null,"line_no":184,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਲਟਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਸੁਰਜਨ ਕਰਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhuramat ulaT bhiee hai gurmat ridhai dhurajan surajan kar pahichaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The base intellect is shed and the wisdom of Guru comes and resides in them. They are then known not as unworthy of trust but persons of divine traits."}}},{"verse_id":208492,"page_no":null,"line_no":184,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਸੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਲਟਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਭਏ ਬਗ ਬੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)saaree sai ulaT palaT nira(n)kaaree bhe bag ba(n)s ha(n)s bhe satigur giaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Freeing themselves from the affairs of the world, the mammon entangled people become the devotees of the formless God. By the True Guru blessed knowledge, they become praise worthy like a swan from that of a heron like inclination."}}},{"verse_id":208493,"page_no":null,"line_no":184,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਭਏ ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਭੇਦ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੧॥","translit_en":"kaaran adheen dheen kaaran karan bhe haran bharan bhedh alakh lakhaane hai ||181||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By obeying the command of Guru of doing Naam Simran, those who were under the influence of worldly affairs now become their masters. They become aware of the Lord's indefinable traits who is the creator, the sustainer and destroyer of all things in the Universe. (181)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41210,"next":41212}}
files.shabads/82/41212.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41212,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208494","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208494,"last_verse_id":208497,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208494,"page_no":null,"line_no":185,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਤ ਉਲਟੀ ਭਈ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੈ ਅਜੋਨਿ ਭਏ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal chaakhat ulaTee bhiee jon kai ajon bhe kul akuleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"State of Guru-conscious disciples blessed by the True Guru with elixir of Naam turns opposite from the worldly involvements and are rid of the cycle of birth and death, ego and attachment."}}},{"verse_id":208495,"page_no":null,"line_no":185,"gurmukhi":"ਜੰਤਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਅਉ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਭਏ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ja(n)tan te sa(n)t aau binaasee abinaasee bhe adham asaadh bhe saadh prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such persons who are ever relishing the Naam like elixir of the True Guru become saintly from the worldly beings. The mortal beings become immortal. They become noble and worthy persons from their ill bred and low status."}}},{"verse_id":208496,"page_no":null,"line_no":185,"gurmukhi":"ਲਾਲਚੀ ਲਲ ੂਜਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਨ ਕੈ ਪੂਜ ਕੀਨੇ ਅੰਜਨ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਈ ਦੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"laalachee lal oojan te paavan kai pooj keene a(n)jan jagat mai nira(n)janiee dheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pleasure giving Naam elixir turns the greedy and covetous people into pure and worthy beings. Living in the world, makes them untouchable and unaffected by the worldly attractions."}}},{"verse_id":208497,"page_no":null,"line_no":185,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਟਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੨॥","translit_en":"kaaT maiaa faasee gur gireh mai udhaasee keeno anabhai abhiaasee priaa prem ras bheen hai ||182||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the initiation of a Sikh by the True Guru, his bondage of maya (mammon) is sheared. He becomes indifferent from it. The practice of Naam Simran makes a person fearless, and immerses him in the love-elixir of beloved Lord. (182)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41211,"next":41213}}
files.shabads/82/41213.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41213,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208498","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208498,"last_verse_id":208501,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208498,"page_no":null,"line_no":186,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਦਰਸਸਨੀ ਹੋਤ ਖਟ ਦਰਸ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur dharas dhiaan asacharaj mai dharasasanee hot khaT dharas ateet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The contemplation on the vision of True Guru for a devotee is wonderful. Those who see the True Guru in their vision go beyond the teachings of the six philosophies (of Hinduism)."}}},{"verse_id":208499,"page_no":null,"line_no":186,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੀ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur charan saran nihakaam dhaam sevak na aan dhev sev kee na preet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The refuge of the True Guru is the home of desirelessness. Those in the refuge of True Guru hold no love for serving any other god."}}},{"verse_id":208500,"page_no":null,"line_no":186,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਆਨ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sabadh surat liv mool ma(n)tr aan ta(n)tr ma(n)tr kee na sikhan prateet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossing the mind in the words of the True Guru is the supreme incantation. The true disciples of the Guru hold no faith in any other form of worship."}}},{"verse_id":208501,"page_no":null,"line_no":186,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਚੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੩॥","translit_en":"satigur kirapaa saadh sa(n)gat pa(n)gat sukh ha(n)s ba(n)s maanasar anat na cheet hai ||183||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is by the grace of True Guru that one gets the pleasure of sitting and enjoying the holy gathering. The swan-like Guru-conscious people attach their mind in the highly respected divine company of holy people and nowhere else. (183)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41212,"next":41214}}
files.shabads/82/41214.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41214,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208502","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208502,"last_verse_id":208505,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208502,"page_no":null,"line_no":187,"gurmukhi":"ਘੋਸਲਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਤਜਿ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਹੋਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"ghosalaa mai a(n)ddaa taj uddat akaasachaaree sa(n)dhiaa samai a(n)ddaa hot chet fir aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bird flies away in the open sky from the comfort of its nest, leaving its egg behind but returns due to its concern for the baby bird in the egg,"}}},{"verse_id":208503,"page_no":null,"line_no":187,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਰੀਆ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਨਖੰਡ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"tireeaa tiaag sut jaat banakha(n)dd bikhai sut kee surat gireh aai sukh paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a labour woman leaves her child home under compulsion and goes to the jungle to pick up firewood, but keeps the memory of her child in the mind and finds comfort on returning home;"}}},{"verse_id":208504,"page_no":null,"line_no":187,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡੀਅਤਿ ਜਲਚਰੀ ਜਬ ਚਾਹੇ ਤਬ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal ku(n)dd kar chhaaddeeat jalacharee jab chaahe tab geh let man bhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a pool of water is made and fish released in it to be caught again at one's will."}}},{"verse_id":208505,"page_no":null,"line_no":187,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੮੪॥","translit_en":"taise chit cha(n)chal bhramat hai chatur ka(n)uT satigur bohith biha(n)g Thahiraaviee ||184||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does the frolicsome mind of a human being wanders in all the four directions. But due to the ship-like Naam blessed by the True Guru, the wandering bird-like mind comes and rests in the self. (184)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41213,"next":41215}}
files.shabads/82/41215.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41215,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208506","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208506,"last_verse_id":208509,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208506,"page_no":null,"line_no":188,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਰਨ ਤੈਸੋ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur baran mai na paieeaai baran taiso khaT dharasan mai na dharasan jot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is nothing as marvellous available for the Guru-conscious persons in the four castes (Brahmin, Khatri et al.) like the wonderful elixir-like Naam of the Lord. Even the six philosophical scriptures do not have the glory and grandeur of the divine radiance obtainable in practicing of Naam."}}},{"verse_id":208507,"page_no":null,"line_no":188,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਮੈ ਨ ਸਬਦ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"si(n)mirat puraan bedh saasatr samaan khaan raag naadh baadh mai na sabadh udhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The treasure that Guru-conscious people possess is not available in the Vedas, Shastras and Simritis. The melody that is available with them as a result of Guru's words is not found in any musical mode."}}},{"verse_id":208508,"page_no":null,"line_no":188,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਰਸ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਮੈ ਨ ਗੰਧਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naanaa bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh a(n)tar na premaras sakal suga(n)dh mai na ga(n)dh sa(n)dh hot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The relishment that Guru-conscious persons enjoy is so wonderful that it is not available in any type of food. The ecstatic fragrance that they enjoy is not available in any other form of fragrances."}}},{"verse_id":208509,"page_no":null,"line_no":188,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਸਪਰਸ ਅਪਰਸ ਨ ਗਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਤੁਲਿ ਓਤ ਪੋਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੫॥","translit_en":"ausan seetalataa saparas aparas na garamukh sukh fal tul ot pot hai ||185||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pleasure of Naam-like elixir that the Guru-conscious people enjoy is beyond all comforts of allaying or relieving hot or cold conditions by cool or hot means respectively. The hot and cold conditions keep altering but the relishment of Naam elixir remain alike and constant. (185)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41214,"next":41216}}
files.shabads/82/41216.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41216,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208510","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208510,"last_verse_id":208513,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208510,"page_no":null,"line_no":189,"gurmukhi":"ਲਿਖਨੁ ਪੜ੍ਹਨੁ ਤਉ ਲਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਕਹਿਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"likhan paRhan tau lau jaanai dhisa(n)tar jau lau kahit sunat hai bidhes ke sa(n)dhes kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So long the husband is away on business or work tour, the wife keeps receiving his commands and news of well being through letters. They exchange their emotions through letters."}}},{"verse_id":208511,"page_no":null,"line_no":189,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਤ ਅਉ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਭੇਟਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਬਿਰਹ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhekhat aau dhekheeat it ut dhoi hoi bheTat parasapar bireh aves kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When two lovers separate, they look here and there. When reunited, they become one again. When one separates from his Guru, he looks elsewhere for spirituality. But as soon as he meets his True Guru, he abandons all else and unites with the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208512,"page_no":null,"line_no":189,"gurmukhi":"ਖੋਇ ਖੋਇ ਖੋਜੀ ਹੋਇ ਖੋਜਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"khoi khoi khojee hoi khojat chatur ka(n)uT mirag madh jugat na jaanat praves kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer keeps wandering and searching for the musk that he keeps smelling and is unaware of the means to find it, so would a seeker keep wandering till he meets with True Guru and learns the way of God-realisation."}}},{"verse_id":208513,"page_no":null,"line_no":189,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਆਦੇਸ ਕੈ ॥੧੮੬॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile a(n)tar a(n)tarajaamee savaiaamee sev sevak nira(n)tar aadhes kai ||186||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a disciple meets with Guru, the all knowing Lord then comes and resides in the heart of the disciple. He then meditates, contemplates and worships the Master Lord as a slave and serves His command and will. (186)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41215,"next":41217}}
files.shabads/82/41217.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41217,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208514","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208514,"last_verse_id":208517,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208514,"page_no":null,"line_no":190,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਚਕੋਰ ਘਨ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pata(n)g sa(n)g preet ik a(n)gee hoi cha(n)dhramaa chakor ghan chaatirak na hot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Love of a lamp and a moth (winged insect) is one-sided. Similarly is the love of Chakor with the moon and of rain bird (Papiha) with clouds;"}}},{"verse_id":208515,"page_no":null,"line_no":190,"gurmukhi":"ਚਕਈ ਅਉ ਸੂਰ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਜਿਉ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chakiee aau soor jal meen jiau kamal al kaasaT agan mirag naadh ko udhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as love of Casarca ferruginea (Chakv) with Sun, fish with water, a bumble bee with lotus flower, wood and fire, a deer and musical sound is one-sided,"}}},{"verse_id":208516,"page_no":null,"line_no":190,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤ ਹਿਤ ਅਰੁ ਭਾਮਨੀ ਭਤਾਰ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਅਉ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਛੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pit sut hit ar bhaamanee bhataar gat maiaa aau sa(n)saar dhuaar miTat na chhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the love of father with son, wife and husband, attachment with worldly attractions is one-sided and like chronic contagious disease cannot be eradicated."}}},{"verse_id":208517,"page_no":null,"line_no":190,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੭॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap saacho lok paralok sukhadhaiee ot pot hai ||187||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Contrary to the above union and grandeur of the True Guru with his Sikhs is True. It is uniform like warp and woof of a cloth. It is comforting in the world beyond. (187)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41216,"next":41218}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41218,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208518","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208518,"last_verse_id":208521,"source_english":"Bhai
