Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208518,"page_no":null,"line_no":191,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਪਿਆਰ ਮਿਥਨ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"logan mai logaachaar anik prakaar piaar mithan biauhaar dhukhadhaiee pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There are several types of worldly loves but all these are false and considered a source of distress."}}},{"verse_id":208519,"page_no":null,"line_no":191,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਦ ਮਰਜਾਦ ਮੈ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਕਥਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨ ਤੈਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bedh marajaadh mai kahat hai kathaa anek suneeaai na taisee preet man mai na maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Several love episodes are found used in the Vedas in order to explain certain point but none is heard or believed to be anywhere near the love of a Sikh with his Guru and holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":208520,"page_no":null,"line_no":191,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਜਗਤ ਭਗਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੰੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"giaan unamaan mai na jagat bhagat bikhai raag naadh baadh aadh a(n)t ha(n)oo na jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such true love cannot be found in methods and statements of knowledge, in saying of pious persons in the melodies sung in various modes with accompaniment of musical instruments from one end of world to the other."}}},{"verse_id":208521,"page_no":null,"line_no":191,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਉਰ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ॥੧੮੮॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap jaiso taiso na tiralok bikhai aaur ur aaneeaai||188||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The expression of love between the Sikhs and the holy congregation of the True Guru has unique grandeur and such love cannot find its match in anyone's heart in the three worlds. (188)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41217,"next":41219}}
files.shabads/82/41219.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41219,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208522","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208522,"last_verse_id":208525,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208522,"page_no":null,"line_no":192,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਉ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran kirapaa jau karai harai haumai rog ridhai nimrataa nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the True Guru, an embodiment of complete and the only Lord becomes clement, he destroys the melody of ego, instilling humility in the heart."}}},{"verse_id":208523,"page_no":null,"line_no":192,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat livaleen saadh sa(n)g mil bhaavanee bhagat bhai dhubidhaa binaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the kindness of the True Guru, one gets attached with Word Guru (Shabad Guru) in the company of saintly persons. The sentiment of loving worship destroys the duality from the mind."}}},{"verse_id":208524,"page_no":null,"line_no":192,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan pooran hoi bisam bisavaiaas bikhai anabhai abhiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the magnificence of the True Guru, the relishing of loving elixir-like Naam, one feels satiated. Becoming wondrous and devoted, one indulges in the meditation on the name of fearless Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208525,"page_no":null,"line_no":192,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੈ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੮੯॥","translit_en":"sahaj subhai chai chi(n)taa mai ateet cheet satigur sat gurmat gur dhaas hai ||189||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the kindness of True Guru renouncing fear and worry one gets into a state of ecstasy and by adopting consecration of True Guru one becomes a slave of the Guru. (189)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41218,"next":41220}}
files.shabads/82/41220.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41220,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208526","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208526,"last_verse_id":208529,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208526,"page_no":null,"line_no":193,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਆਸਾ ਮੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g tiragun ateet cheet aasaa mai niraas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient disciple of the True Guru lodges the Guru's word in his consciousness in the holy company of God-loving people. He protects his mind from the influence of maya (mammon) and remains free from the worldly options and conceptions."}}},{"verse_id":208527,"page_no":null,"line_no":193,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਰਤੈ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naam nihakaam dhaam sahaj subhai ridhai baratai baratamaan giaan ko pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living and dealing with the world, the Naam of the Lord which is treasure-house of indifference to the worldly attractions gets lodged in his mind. Thus the divine light effulges in his heart."}}},{"verse_id":208528,"page_no":null,"line_no":193,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sookham sathool ek ek aau anek mek braham bibek Tek braham bisavaiaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Supreme Lord who manifests in perceptible and subtle ways in everything of the world becomes his support when he contemplates on Him. He reposes his confidence in that Lord alone."}}},{"verse_id":208529,"page_no":null,"line_no":193,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋੁਇ ਰੇਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੦॥","translit_en":"charan saran liv aapaa khoi huoi ren satigur sat gurmat gur dhaas hai ||190||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By engrossing and attaching the mind in the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru, one destroys his egocentricity and adopts humility. He lives in the service of holy men and becomes a true servant of the Guru by accepting the teachings of the True Guru. (190)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41219,"next":41221}}
files.shabads/82/41221.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41221,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208530","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208530,"last_verse_id":208533,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208530,"page_no":null,"line_no":194,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haumai abhimaan kai agiaanataa avagiaa gur ni(n)dhaa gur dhaasan kai naam gurdhaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Under the influence of self-pride, ego and ignorance, I show scant respect to the Guru and indulge in slander of his servants. Yet I have named myself the slave of Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208531,"page_no":null,"line_no":194,"gurmukhi":"ਮਹੁਰਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਗਈ ਸੋ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਆਈ ਰੂਠੀ ਕਉ ਕਹਿਤ ਤੂਠੀ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਹਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mahuraa kahaavai meeThaa giee so kahaavai aaiee rooThee kau kahit tooThee hot upahaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This is like poisonous root or tuber of Aconytum Ferox (Mitha Mauhra) that is called sweet or an infected eye that is called 'akh ai hai' and one who suffers from smallpox is said to have been visited and blessed by mother (Mata). This is a big joke."}}},{"verse_id":208532,"page_no":null,"line_no":194,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਂਝ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ  ਕੁਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਰੀਤਿ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਨਕਟਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baa(n)jh kahaavai sapootee dhuhaagan suhaagan  kureet sureet kaaTio nakaTaa ko naas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just out of fun a barren woman is called Saputi (one blessed with sons), an abandoned woman is called happily married, it is no different than calling an evil rite as auspicious or one with chopped nose as beautiful."}}},{"verse_id":208533,"page_no":null,"line_no":194,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਵਰੋ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਭੋਰੋ ਆਂਧਰੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਜਾਖੋ ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੧॥","translit_en":"baavaro kahaavai bhoro aa(n)dharai kahai sujaakho cha(n)dhan sameep jaise baa(n)s na subaas hai ||191||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crazy person is called simple, a blind person called sighted. Similarly a bamboo tree even in close proximity to a Sandalwood tree cannot acquire its fragrance, so would I, named Gurdas, cannot qualify to be the slave of Guru. (191)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41220,"next":41222}}

॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj gur sikh maathai laagee baachhat sakal gursikh pag ren hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who is blessed by the holy dust of the feet of the True Guru (who receives the boon of Naam Simran from the True Guru), the entire Universe crave for the dust of his feet."}}},{"verse_id":208539,"page_no":null,"line_no":196,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਕਲਪਤਰੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan koT kamalaa kalapatar paaras a(n)mirat chi(n)taaman kaamadhen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of goddesses of wealth, tree of Indra's heavenly garden (Kalap- Variksh), philosopher stones, elixirs, distress removing forces and heavenly cows (Kamdhenu) desire the touch of such a Sikh of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208540,"page_no":null,"line_no":196,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਨਾਥ ਮੁਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਅਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਜੇਨ ਕੇਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sur nar naath mun tirabhavan aau tirakaal log bedh giaan unamaan jen ken hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of gods, humans, sages, master yogis, all the three worlds, the three times, wondrous knowledge of Vedas and many such estimates beg for the holy dust of the feet of such a disciple of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208541,"page_no":null,"line_no":196,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਦੇਨ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੩॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan sikh sa(n)gat asa(n)kh jaa kai namo namo gurmukh sukh fal dhen hai ||193||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There are numerous congregations of such Sikhs of the True Guru. I bow again and again before such True Guru who is the blesser of such elixir-like Naam that provides comfort and peace. (193)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41222,"next":41224}}
files.shabads/82/41224.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41224,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208542","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208542,"last_verse_id":208545,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208542,"page_no":null,"line_no":197,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਈਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at bhaavanee bhagat bhai chai kai chieele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory and grandeur of the Sikhs of Guru who are one with the True Guru and are perpetually in touch with His holy feet is beyond mention. Such Sikhs are ever motivated to meditate more and more on the Lord's name."}}},{"verse_id":208543,"page_no":null,"line_no":197,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਬਚਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirashaT dharas liv at asacharaj mai bachan ta(n)bol sa(n)g ra(n)g hui ra(n)geele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The vision of the Sikhs of the Guru is ever fixed in the astonishing form of the True Guru. Such Sikhs are ever dyed in the hue of Naam Simran that they repeatedly meditate on like perpetually chewing betel leaf and nut."}}},{"verse_id":208544,"page_no":null,"line_no":197,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv leen jal meen gat prem ras a(n)mirat kai rasik raseele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a fish meeting water, the divine word of the True Guru when lodged in the mind, they remain engrossed in Lord's name. They themselves become nectar-like by constant meditation on the elixir-like Naam that they keep relishing all the time."}}},{"verse_id":208545,"page_no":null,"line_no":197,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੋਭ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟ ਲੋਭ ਕੈ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਹ ਛਿਪੈ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੪॥","translit_en":"sobhaa nidh sobh koT oT lobh kai lubhit koT chhab chhaeh chhipai chhab kai chhabeele hai ||194||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These pious Sikhs are store-house of adulations. Millions of adulations crave for their praise and seek their refuge. They are so handsome and beautiful that millions of beautiful forms are nothing before them. (194)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41223,"next":41225}}
files.shabads/82/41225.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41225,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208546","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208546,"last_verse_id":208549,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208546,"page_no":null,"line_no":198,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਮੇਕ ਰੋਮ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh ek mek rom kee akath kathaa gursikh saadh sa(n)g mahimaa ko paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of a hair of a Sikh who has become one with the True Guru cannot be narrated. Then who can fathom the greatness of a congregation of such glorious Sikhs?"}}},{"verse_id":208547,"page_no":null,"line_no":198,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੋ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"ek oa(n)kaar ke bithaar ko na paaraavaar sabadh surat saadh sa(n)gat samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The One Formless God whose expanse is limitless is always permeating in the congregation of devotees absorbed in His name."}}},{"verse_id":208548,"page_no":null,"line_no":198,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਆਪਾ ਨ ਜਤਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur saadh sa(n)g mai nivaas dhaasan dhaasaan mat aapaa na jataaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru who is manifest of the Lord resides in the congregation of holy men. But such Sikhs who are united with True Guru are very humble and they remain servants of Lord's servants. They shed all their ego."}}},{"verse_id":208549,"page_no":null,"line_no":198,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਾ ਕੀ ਵਾਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੧੯੫॥","translit_en":"satigur gur gursikh saadh sa(n)gat hai ot pot jot vaa kee vaahee ban aaviee ||195||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru is great and so are His disciples who constitute his holy congregation. The light divine of such a True Guru. entangled in the holy gathering like warp and 'weft of a cloth. Grandeur of such True Guru befits only Him and nobody can reach Him. (195)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41224,"next":41226}}
files.shabads/82/41226.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41226,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208550","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208550,"last_verse_id":208553,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208550,"page_no":null,"line_no":199,"gurmukhi":"ਪਵਨਹਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖੀਅਤ ਸਲਿਲੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"pavaneh pavan milat nahee pekheeat salilai salil milat naeh pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Air mixed with air and water mixed with water cannot be distinguished."}}},{"verse_id":208551,"page_no":null,"line_no":199,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਤੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਿ ਭਸਮਹਿ ਭਸਮ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jotee mile jot hot bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kaise kar bhasameh bhasam samaanee kaise jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can light merging with another light be seen separately? How can ashes mixed with ashes be distinguished?"}}},{"verse_id":208552,"page_no":null,"line_no":199,"gurmukhi":"ਕੈਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kaise pa(n)ch tat mel khel hot pi(n)dd praan bichhurat pi(n)dd praan kaise unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who knows how a body constituted of five elements take shape? How can one discern what happens to the soul when it leaves the body?"}}},{"verse_id":208553,"page_no":null,"line_no":199,"gurmukhi":"ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਗਮਿਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥੧੯੬॥","translit_en":"abigat gat at bisam asacharaj mai giaan dhiaan agamit kaise ur aaneeaai ||196||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly no one can assess the state of such Sikhs who have become one with the True Guru. That state is astonishing and wonderful. It cannot be known through the knowledge of scriptures nor through contemplation. One cannot even make an estimate or a guess. (196)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41225,"next":41227}}
files.shabads/82/41227.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41227,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208554","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208554,"last_verse_id":208557,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208554,"page_no":null,"line_no":200,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਸਾਤ ਦੀਪ ਮੈ ਨ ਨਵਖੰਡ ਬਿਖੈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਨ ਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"chaar ka(n)uT saat dheep mai na navakha(n)dd bikhai dheh dhis dhekheeaai na ban gireh jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Glory of the union of True Guru and the devotees cannot be known or estimated in all the four directions, seven seas, in all the forests and nine regions."}}},{"verse_id":208555,"page_no":null,"line_no":200,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"log bedh giaan unamaan kai na dhekhio sunio savairag piaal mirat ma(n)ddal na maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This grandeur has not been heard or read in wondrous knowledge of the Vedas. It is not believed to exist in heavens, nether regions nor in the worldly regions."}}},{"verse_id":208556,"page_no":null,"line_no":200,"gurmukhi":"ਭੂਤ ਅਉ ਭਵਿਖ ਨ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਚਾਰੋ ਜੁਗ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਖਟ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bhoot aau bhavikh na baratamaan chaaro jug chatur baran khaT dharas na dhiaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It cannot be perceived in the four eons, three periods, four sections of the society and even in the six philosophical Scriptures."}}},{"verse_id":208557,"page_no":null,"line_no":200,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਜੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਅਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੧੯੭॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap jaiso taiso aaur Thaur suneeaai na pahichaaneeaai ||197||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of True Guru and his Sikhs is so indescribable and marvellous that such state is not heard or seen anywhere else. (197)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41226,"next":41228}}
files.shabads/82/41228.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41228,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208558","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208558,"last_verse_id":208561,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208558,"page_no":null,"line_no":201,"gurmukhi":"ਉਖ ਮੈ ਪਯੂਖ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aukh mai payookh ras rasanaa rahit hoi cha(n)dhan subaas taas naasakaa na hot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sugarcane has elixir-like sweet juice but it has no tongue to enjoy it. Sandalwood has fragrance but the tree is without nostrils to enjoy the smell."}}},{"verse_id":208559,"page_no":null,"line_no":201,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਬਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naadh baadh surat bihoon bisamaadh gat bibidh baran bin dhirasaT su jot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Musical instruments produce sound to bring awe to the listeners but it is without the ears that can listen to its melody. Myriads of colour and shapes are there to attract the eyes but they are without any ability to see such beauty themselves."}}},{"verse_id":208560,"page_no":null,"line_no":201,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਨ ਸਪਰਸ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਕਰ ਚਰਨ ਹੀਨ ਧਰ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paaras paras na saparas usan seet kar charan heen dhar aaukhadhee udhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Philosopher-stone has power to turn any metal into gold but it is without any sense of touch even to feel cold or heat. Many herbs grow in the earth but without hands and feet, it can do nothing to reach anywhere."}}},{"verse_id":208561,"page_no":null,"line_no":201,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਇ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਹੁਇ ਅਛੋਤ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੮॥","translit_en":"jai pa(n)ch dhokh niradhokh mokh paavai kaise gurmukh sahaj sa(n)tokh hui achhot hai ||198||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A person has five senses of knowledge and five vices of relishment. How can one achieve viceless salvation? Only the patient, content, and obedient Sikhs of Guru who obey the command of a True Guru can overcome the misuse of these five senses. (198)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41227,"next":41229}}
files.shabads/82/41229.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41229,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208562","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208562,"last_verse_id":208565,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208562,"page_no":null,"line_no":202,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਆਦ ਹੀਨ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nihafal jihabaa hai sabadh suaadh heen nihafal surat na anahadh naadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A tongue without savouring the elixir-like Naam and ears that are without hearing the unstruck melody of recitation of Lord's name are useless and vain."}}},{"verse_id":208563,"page_no":null,"line_no":202,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਫਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਦੇਖੀਅਤਿ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਆਸ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਸੁ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nihafal dhirasaT na aapaa aap dhekheeat nihafal saas nahee baas paramaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The eyes that do not see the true vision of thyself and the breaths that do not smell of Lord's fragrance are no good either."}}},{"verse_id":208564,"page_no":null,"line_no":202,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਰ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਪਗ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nihafal kar gur paaras paras bin gurmukh maarag bihoon pag baadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The hands that have not touched the philosopher-stone like feet of the True Guru are of no use. Those feet which have not treaded towards the door of the True Guru are no good either."}}},{"verse_id":208565,"page_no":null,"line_no":202,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਲਿਵ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੯੯॥","translit_en":"gurmukh a(n)g a(n)g pa(n)g saraba(n)g liv dhirasaT surat saadh sa(n)gat prasaadh hai ||199||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every limb of the Sikhs who are obedient to the True Guru are pious. By the grace of the company of holy people, their mind and vision remains focused in meditation on Naam and glimpse of the True Guru. (199)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41228,"next":41230}}
files.shabads/82/41230.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41230,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208566","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208566,"last_verse_id":208569,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208566,"page_no":null,"line_no":203,"gurmukhi":"ਪਸੂਆ ਮਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਇਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਅਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pasooaa manukh dheh a(n)tar a(n)tar ihai sabadh surat ko bibek abibek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The only difference in human and animal body is that a human is aware of the union of consciousness and the holy word of the Guru but animal has no such knowledge nor any ability."}}},{"verse_id":208567,"page_no":null,"line_no":203,"gurmukhi":"ਪਸੂ ਹਰਿਆਉ ਕਹਿਓ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਅਨਸੁਨਿਓ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pasoo hariaau kahio sunio anasunio karai maanas janam upadhes ridhai Tek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If an animal is asked to stay away from green fields, or pasture land, it ignores it but a human being lodges the teachings of the True Guru in his heart and adheres to it."}}},{"verse_id":208568,"page_no":null,"line_no":203,"gurmukhi":"ਪਸੂਆ ਸਬਦ ਹੀਨ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pasooaa sabadh heen jihabaa na bol sakai maanas janam bolai bachan anek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Devoid of words, an animal cannot speak with its tongue but a human can speak several words."}}},{"verse_id":208569,"page_no":null,"line_no":203,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਨਾਤੁਰ ਅਚੇਤ ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਹੰੂ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੦॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat sun samajh bolai bibekee naatur achet pas pret ha(n)oo mai ek hai ||200||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a man listens, understands and speaks the words of Guru, he is a wise and intelligent person. Otherwise he too is one among the ignorant animal and a fool. (200)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41229,"next":41231}}
files.shabads/82/41231.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41231,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208570","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208570,"last_verse_id":208573,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208570,"page_no":null,"line_no":204,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਪਸੂਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਹ ਖੜ ਖਾਏ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਉ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat heen pasooaa pavitr dheh khaR khaae a(n)mirat pravaeh ko suaau hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has no perception of Guru’s words is far inferior than an animal who eats hay and grass and yields nectar like milk."}}},{"verse_id":208571,"page_no":null,"line_no":204,"gurmukhi":"ਗੋਬਰ ਗੋ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹੀ ਨਿਖਿਧ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਅਪਿਆਉ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gobar go mootr sootr param pavitr bhe maanas dhehee nikhidh a(n)mirat apiaau hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"According to Hindu mythology, cowdung and cow's urine are considered sacred but cursed is a human body that eats elixir- like food and spreads filth all around."}}},{"verse_id":208572,"page_no":null,"line_no":204,"gurmukhi":"ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਖਲ ਬਚਨ ਦੁਰਾੳੇੁ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bachan bibek Tek saadhan kai saadh bhe adham asaadh khal bachan dhuraaue hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who take the support of the knowledgeable sermons of the True Guru and practice these in their life are superb saintly persons. On the contrary, those who shy away from the teachings of the True Guru are low of status, evil and foolish."}}},{"verse_id":208573,"page_no":null,"line_no":204,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਹੁਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਧਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੧॥","translit_en":"rasanaa a(n)mirat ras rasik rasain hui maanas bikhai dhar bikham bikh taau hai ||201||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By meditation on His name, such saintly persons themselves become the fountains of elixir-like Naam. Those who are bereft of the words of the Guru and are engrossed in maya are scary like poisonous snakes and full of venom. (201)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41230,"next":41232}}
files.shabads/82/41232.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41232,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208574","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208574,"last_verse_id":208577,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208574,"page_no":null,"line_no":205,"gurmukhi":"ਪਸੂ ਖੜ ਖਾਤ ਖਲ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਮੋਨ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਪੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pasoo khaR khaat khal sabadh surat heen mon ko mahaatam pai a(n)mirat pravaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An animal eats green grass and hay. He is bereft of all knowledge of Lord's word. Due to his inability to speak, gives nectar-like milk."}}},{"verse_id":208575,"page_no":null,"line_no":205,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਮਾਨਸ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"naanaa misaTaan khaan paan maanas mukh rasanaa raseelee hoi soiee bhalee taeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A man eats and enjoys many types of food materials with his tongue but he becomes praiseworthy only if his tongue is sweetened with the sweetness of Lord's name."}}},{"verse_id":208576,"page_no":null,"line_no":205,"gurmukhi":"ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਫਲ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਪਸੁ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਆਹਿ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"bachan bibek Tek maanas janam fal bachan bihoon pas paramit aaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Purpose of human life is to take refuge in the meditation of His Naam. But one devoid of the teachings of the True Guru is the worst kind of animal."}}},{"verse_id":208577,"page_no":null,"line_no":205,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਗਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਖ ਧਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਚਕਤ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥੨੦੨॥","translit_en":"maanas janam gat bachan bibek heen bikh dhar bikham chakat chit chaeh jee ||202||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is bereft of teachings of True Guru, craves and wanders in search of worldly pleasure and remains vexed for their acquisition. His state is like a dangerous poisonous snake. (202)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41231,"next":41233}}
files.shabads/82/41233.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41233,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208578","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208578,"last_verse_id":208581,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208578,"page_no":null,"line_no":206,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਹੁਇ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan birahaa biaapai dhiragan hui sravan birahu biaapai madhur bachan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a married woman temporarily separated from her husband feels the pangs of separation, her inability to hear the sweet sound of her husband distresses her, so do the Sikhs suffer the pangs of separation."}}},{"verse_id":208579,"page_no":null,"line_no":206,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਬਿਰਹੋਂ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਕੀ ਰਚਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gam samaagam biraho(n) biaapai jihabaa kai paaras paras a(n)kamaal kee rachan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife feels a strong desire to speak to her husband after a long separation, her fond desire to feel her husband against her breast troubles her, so do the Sikhs long to feel the divine embrace of their True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208580,"page_no":null,"line_no":206,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਗਵਨ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਰਹ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਸਚਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa gavan birahaa biaapai charan hui prem ras bireh sraba(n)g hui sachan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As reaching the nuptial bed of her husband troubles the wife when her husband is not there but she is filled with passion and love; so does a Sikh separated from his Guru craves like a fish out of water to touch the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208581,"page_no":null,"line_no":206,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਬਿਰਹ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਹਬਲ ਭਈ ਸਸਾ ਜਿਉ ਬਹੀਰ ਪੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਤਚਨ ਕੈ ॥੨੦੩॥","translit_en":"rom rom bireh birathaa kai bihabal bhiee sasaa jiau baheer peer prabal tachan kai ||203||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A separated wife feels love sickness in every hair of her body and remains distressed like a rabbit that has been surrounded by hunters from all sides. So does a Sikh feel the pangs of separation and longs to meet his True Guru at the earliest. (203)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41232,"next":41234}}
files.shabads/82/41234.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41234,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208582","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208582,"last_verse_id":208585,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208582,"page_no":null,"line_no":207,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਬਦਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa badhan anoop roop at asacharaj mai naikaa kahaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A momentary look of the True Guru brings a very attractive and ecstatic look on the face of wife-like Sikh of the True Guru. She (Sikh) then is honoured to be an astoundingly beautiful heroine."}}},{"verse_id":208583,"page_no":null,"line_no":207,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਸਿਆਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬ ਤਿਲ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਨਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan kee putaree mai tanak taarakaa siaam taa ko pratibi(n)b til banitaa banaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the casting of a look of grace by the True Guru, the small black spot in the eyes of True Guru leaves a mole on the face of the wife-like Sikh. Such a mole enhances the beauty of the wife-like Sikh further."}}},{"verse_id":208584,"page_no":null,"line_no":207,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਛਬਿ ਤਿਲ ਛਿਪਤ ਛਾਹ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਲਲਚਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan chhab til chhipat chhaeh koTin koTaan sobh lobh lalachaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Beauties of the world get hidden in the shadow of that mole and millions desire eagerly to covet glory of that mole."}}},{"verse_id":208585,"page_no":null,"line_no":207,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਭਈ ਤਿਲ ਕੇ ਤਿਲਕ ਸਰਬ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੪॥","translit_en":"koT brahama(n)dd ke naik kee naikaa bhiee til ke tilak sarab naikaa miTaiee hai ||204||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The grace that a wife-like Sikh gets by an impression of True Guru's kind glance makes her the maid of the Master of millions of celestial regions. Because of that mole, she surpasses all other seeker-wives in beauty. None can match her. (204)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41233,"next":41235}}
files.shabads/82/41235.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41235,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208586","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208586,"last_verse_id":208589,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208586,"page_no":null,"line_no":208,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਨਕ ਬਨੇ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਆਜ ਮੋਰੇ ਆਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"supan charitr chitr baanak bane bachitr paavan pavitr mitr aaj more aae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Himself holy and capable of making other pious-the friendly True Guru has come into my dream beautifully attired and adored. It is indeed a wonderful marvel for me."}}},{"verse_id":208587,"page_no":null,"line_no":208,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਦਯਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਲੋਚਨ ਬਿਸਾਲ  ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਰਸਾਲ ਮਧੁ ਮਧੁਰ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"param dhayaal laal lochan bisaal  mukh bachan rasaal madh madhur peeaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Beloved Lord is sweet of words, big eyed and clement of form. Believe me! It is like He blessing us with honeyed elixir."}}},{"verse_id":208588,"page_no":null,"line_no":208,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਭਤ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨ ਬਿਲਾਸਨ ਦੈ ਅੰਕਮਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"sobhat sihajaasan bilaasan dhai a(n)kamaal prem ras bisam haivai sahaj samaae hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He looked pleased and honoured me by occupying my bedlike heart. I was lost in the love filled trance of Nam Amrit that merged me into a state of equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208589,"page_no":null,"line_no":208,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਖੀਆਂ ਉਘਰ ਗਈ ਭਈ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਰਹ ਜਗਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥੨੦੫॥","translit_en":"chaatirak sabadh sun akheeaa(n) ughar giee bhiee jal meen gat bireh jagaae hai(n) ||205||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Enjoying the bliss of divine dream, I was woken up by the voice of rain-bird and that broke my celestial dream. The awe and marvel of love-filled state disappeared reawakening the pangs of separation. I was restless like a fish out of water. (205)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41234,"next":41236}}
files.shabads/82/41236.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41236,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208590","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208590,"last_verse_id":208593,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208590,"page_no":null,"line_no":209,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਬੇ ਕੌ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਇਬੇ ਕੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhekhabe kau dhirasaT na dharas dhikhaibe kau kaise pria dharasan dhekheeaai dhikhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I neither have enlightened eyes to have a glimpse of my unique, radiant and dear lover nor have I the power to show His glimpse to anyone. Then how can one see or even show a glimpse of the lover?"}}},{"verse_id":208591,"page_no":null,"line_no":209,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"kahibe kau surat hai na sravan sunabe kau kaise gun nidh gun suneeaai sunaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I do not have the wisdom to describe the virtues of my beloved who is treasure-house of goodness. Nor do I have ears to listen to his adulations. Then how should we listen and recite the panegyrics of the fountain of merits and excellence?"}}},{"verse_id":208592,"page_no":null,"line_no":209,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਨ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"man mai na gurmat gurmat mai na man nihachal havai na unaman liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind neither inhabits the teachings of the True Guru nor does it engross itself in the sermons of Guru. The mind does not achieve stability in the words of Guru. Then how can one get engrossed in higher spiritual state?"}}},{"verse_id":208593,"page_no":null,"line_no":209,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਈਐ ॥੨੦੬॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g bha(n)g ra(n)g roop kul heen dheen kaise bahu naik kee naikaa kahaieeaai ||206||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My whole body is aching. I, the meek and devoid of respect, has neither beauty nor high caste. Then how can I become and be known as the most favourite love of my Master Lord? (206)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41235,"next":41237}}
files.shabads/82/41237.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41237,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208594","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208594,"last_verse_id":208597,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208594,"page_no":null,"line_no":210,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਰੋਗ ਦੁਖਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਕਹਿਤ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਪਥਿਕਨ ਪੈ ਉਸਾਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"bireh biog rog dhukhat haivai birahanee kahit sa(n)dhes pathikan pai usaas te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The to pangs of separation and disunion from her beloved husband, a distressed wife heaves big sighs and sends messages to her beloved husband through the wayfarers."}}},{"verse_id":208595,"page_no":null,"line_no":210,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰੇਵਾ ਪਰ ਕਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਟੂਟਤ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"dhekhahu tiragadh jon parem kai parevaa par kar naar dhekhe TooTat akaas te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My beloved! Look how a lovelorn pigeon, a species of devious origin, impatiently flies down from high sky to his mate."}}},{"verse_id":208596,"page_no":null,"line_no":210,"gurmukhi":"ਤੁਮ ਤੋ ਚਤੁਰ ਦਸ ਬਿਦਯਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਨ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਰਿਪੁ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"tum to chatur dhas bidhayaa ke nidhaan pria triaa na chhaddaavahu bireh rip traas te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"My beloved! You are a store-house of all the knowledge; why don't you rid your woman from the pangs of separation?"}}},{"verse_id":208597,"page_no":null,"line_no":210,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਤਾਰਿਕ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਹ ਰਵਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤੇ ॥੨੦੭॥","translit_en":"charan bimukh dhukh taarik chamatakaar herat hiraeh rav dharas pragaas te ||207||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The twinkling stars frighten everyone during the dark night, so am I being distressed by the separation from your holy feet. All these distressing twinkling stars will disappear soon as your Sun-like effulgent glimpse become visible. (207)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41236,"next":41238}}
files.shabads/82/41238.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41238,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208598","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208598,"last_verse_id":208601,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208598,"page_no":null,"line_no":211,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਔ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਆਪ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਮਿਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੈ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai taeh dhekh aau dhikhaavai aap dhirasaT dharas mil sobhaa dhai suhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman, who is liked by the True Guru Master, is glanced at with a look of clemency by the beloved Master who reveals Himself to her. By His clemency and glimpse, the hapless woman is blessed with goodness making her praiseworthy."}}},{"verse_id":208599,"page_no":null,"line_no":211,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਾਵੇ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai mukh bachan sunaave taeh sabadh surat gur giaan upajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is liked by the beloved Master, is blessed with His divine words. By the union of His words and consciousness, He enlightens her with Guru's sermons."}}},{"verse_id":208600,"page_no":null,"line_no":211,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਸ ਦਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai dhas dhis pragaTaavai taeh soiee bahu naik kee naikaa kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman who is loved by her True Guru, is revealed by Him in all the ten directions of the world. Then she is addressed and known as supreme beloved of the Master who is the master of many more seeker brides."}}},{"verse_id":208601,"page_no":null,"line_no":211,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਿਹਜਾਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਵਈ ॥੨੦੮॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai sihajaasan milaavai taeh prem ras bas kar apio peeaaviee ||208||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker bride who is liked by beloved True Guru, is united with Him on the mind like divine bed. Enamoured by her love, He makes her drink deep the elixir of Naam Amrit. (208)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41237,"next":41239}}
files.shabads/82/41239.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41239,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208602","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208602,"last_verse_id":208605,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208602,"page_no":null,"line_no":212,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁੰਦਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai taeh su(n)dharataa kai suhaavai soiee su(n)dharee kahaavai chhab kai chhabeelee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The female living being (jeev Istri) who has found favour with the True Guru Master the manifest form of the Lord, becomes virtuous and praiseworthy due to the blessing of spiritual beauty to her. That truly is called the beauty."}}},{"verse_id":208603,"page_no":null,"line_no":212,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਾਨਕ ਬਧੂ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਰੰਗੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai taeh baanak badhoo banaavai soiee banitaa kahaavai ra(n)g mai ra(n)geelee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She who is loved by her beloved master, is made into a highly adorable bride by Him. One who is ever engrossed in the hue of Lord's meditation is truly a blessed married woman."}}},{"verse_id":208604,"page_no":null,"line_no":212,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੀਲ ਕੈ ਸੁਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai taa kee sabai kaamanaa pujaavai soiee kaamanee kahaavai seel kai suseelee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The (seeker) female living being who gains the favour of her beloved master has all her desires fulfilled by Him. By virtue of her superior nature, she is well behaved and that makes her famous as beautiful lady in the true sense."}}},{"verse_id":208605,"page_no":null,"line_no":212,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਲੈ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੦੯॥","translit_en":"joiee pria bhaavai taeh prem ras lai peeaavai soiee premanee kahaavai rasik raseelee hai ||209||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seeker woman who is liked by dear True Guru, she is blessed with relishing the Nam elixir of Lord's love. One who drinks deep the divine elixir is loved one in the true sense. (209)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41238,"next":41240}}
files.shabads/82/41240.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41240,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208606","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208606,"last_verse_id":208609,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208606,"page_no":null,"line_no":213,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਰੋਗ ਸੇਤ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਾਸ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਭਏ ਪਾਤੀ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"bireh biog rog set roop hoi kirataas Took Took bhe paatee likheeaai bidhes te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A sentient woman (devoted Sikh) separated from her beloved True Guru writes letter to her beloved stating that his separation and long disjunction has made her complexion paper white while her limbs are losing their strength to the extent of falling apart."}}},{"verse_id":208607,"page_no":null,"line_no":213,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਵਾਨੀ ਮਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਭੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਬਿਖਮ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"bireh agan se savaanee maas kirasan hui birahanee bhekh lekh bikham sa(n)dhes te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The separated woman writes the state of her distress and the pangs she has been bearing. She wails that his separation has virtually turned the colour of her skin black."}}},{"verse_id":208608,"page_no":null,"line_no":213,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਰੋਗ ਲੇਖਨ ਕੀ ਛਾਤੀ ਫਟੀ ਰੁਦਨ ਕਰਤ ਲਿਖੈ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਤੇ ॥","translit_en":"bireh biog rog lekhan kee chhaatee faTee rudhan karat likhai aatam aves te ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Crying from the core of her heart, the separated woman writes that because of the distress of bearing separation, even the breast of the pen that she is writing with has cracked."}}},{"verse_id":208609,"page_no":null,"line_no":213,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਹ ਉਸਾਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਨ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਐ ਬਿਰਹ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਤੇ ॥੨੧੦॥","translit_en":"bireh usaasan pragaasan dhukhit gat birahanee kaise jeeaai bireh paraves te ||210||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Heaving cold sighs and lamenting, she expresses her distressed state and asks how could anyone live when the weapon of separation had penetrated deep into her heart. (210)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41239,"next":41241}}
files.shabads/82/41241.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41241,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208610","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208610,"last_verse_id":208613,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208610,"page_no":null,"line_no":214,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੁਜਨ ਸਗਾਈ ਹੋਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੰਦੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"poorab sa(n)jog mil sujan sagaiee hot simarat sun sun sravan sa(n)dhes kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Deeds of previous births bring together noble people and they join in the form of holy congregation to establish union with True Guru. Such a maid who is betrothed thus hears the messages of her True Guru master from others and remembers them."}}},{"verse_id":208611,"page_no":null,"line_no":214,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਧਿ ਸੈ ਬਿਵਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਦਯਮਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਭੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"bidh sai bivaahe mil dhirasaT dharas liv bidhayamaan dhiaan ras roop ra(n)g bhes kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When according to tradition, marriage is solemnised, that is to say she is consecrated by Guru and an accord gets established between them, then her mind is engrossed in the form, colour, attire and pleasure of the master True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208612,"page_no":null,"line_no":214,"gurmukhi":"ਰੈਨ ਸੈਨ ਸਮੈ ਸ੍ਰੁੂਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"rain sain samai sruoot sabadh bibek Tek aatam giaan pramaatam praves kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"At night when it is time for people to sleep, a seeker of the Lord takes refuge in the knowledge of the divine words and achieving soulful ecstasy through practicing of Naam, unites in the holy feet of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208613,"page_no":null,"line_no":214,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੈ ॥੨੧੧॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan simaran ula(n)gh ikatr hoi prem ras bas hot bisam aves kai ||211||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Contemplating thus she (jeev istri) crosses all the stages of knowledge and becomes one with dear beloved and influenced by His loving pleasure, she gets engrossed in wondrous and marvellous spiritual state. (211)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41240,"next":41242}}
files.shabads/82/41242.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41242,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208614","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208614,"last_verse_id":208617,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208614,"page_no":null,"line_no":215,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਏਕ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਿਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek sai adhik ek naikaa anek jaa kai dheen ke dhiaal hoi kirapaal kirapaa dhaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The dear beloved who has not one but many obedient consorts; the dispenser of kindness on the distressed, the  beloved has been clement on me."}}},{"verse_id":208615,"page_no":null,"line_no":215,"gurmukhi":"ਸਜਨੀ ਰਜਨੀ ਸਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਔਸਰ ਮੈ ਅਬਲੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਉਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sajanee rajanee sas prem ras aauasar mai abale adheen gat benatee uchaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That moonlit night (the auspicious moment) when the time for me to belong to and enjoy the loving elixir of the Lord came, this humble maid slave in all the humility· made a supplication before the beloved True Guru;"}}},{"verse_id":208616,"page_no":null,"line_no":215,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਆਗਿਆ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਜੋਰੈ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਗਯਾਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"joiee joiee aagiaa haivai soiee soiee maan jaan haath jorai agrabhaag hoi aagayaakaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Oh beloved! Whatever will be your command, I shall obey implicitly. I shall ever serve you obediently and with humility."}}},{"verse_id":208617,"page_no":null,"line_no":215,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਈਲੋ ਭਜੋ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮ ਧੰਨਿ ਆਜੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੨॥","translit_en":"bhaavanee bhagat bhai chai kai chieelo bhajo safal janam dha(n)n aaj meree baaree hai ||212||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I shall serve you with dedication and devotion of loving worship in my heart. This moment when you have so kindly blessed me with your consecration, my human birth has become purposeful since my turn to meet my beloved Lord has come. (212)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41241,"next":41243}}
files.shabads/82/41243.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41243,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208618","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208618,"last_verse_id":208621,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208618,"page_no":null,"line_no":216,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਮੈ ਤਨਿਕ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਸਿਆਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਕ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"preetam kee putaree mai tanik taarikaa siaam taa ko pratibi(n)b til tilak tiralok ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the True Guru casts a sight of grace on the seeker woman, the thin black star-like line in the pupil of my beloved True Guru has cast a very subtle image on the face of the seeker woman that is adoring and beseeming like a mole in the three worlds."}}},{"verse_id":208619,"page_no":null,"line_no":216,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਦਨ ਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਬਨਾਇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਕਾਮਦੇਵ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"banitaa badhan par pragaT banai raakhio kaamadhev koT loT poT avilok ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That subtle image of the star like shinning line has made beauty so conspicuous and astonishing that millions of cupids are becoming restless. Heaving cold sighs and lamenting, she expresses her distressed state and asks how could anyone live when the weapon of separation had penetrated deep into her heart."}}},{"verse_id":208620,"page_no":null,"line_no":216,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਛਬਿ ਸਕਲ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਕੋ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan roop kee anoop roop chhab sakal si(n)gaar ko si(n)gaar sarab thok ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The unique beauty as a result of that mole cannot be matched by millions of beautiful forms. The beauty of that mole is beyond the beauty of all adoring things of the world."}}},{"verse_id":208621,"page_no":null,"line_no":216,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਿਲ ਕੀ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਾਨ ਭੰਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋਕ ਕੋ ॥੨੧੩॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa til kee atul sobhaa surasatee koT maan bha(n)g dhiaan kok ko ||213||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of a little kindness of the True Guru, the fame and glory of that miniscule mole is infinite. It is capable of shattering the pride of millions of goddesses of beauty. (213)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41242,"next":41244}}
files.shabads/82/41244.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41244,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208622","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208622,"last_verse_id":208625,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208622,"page_no":null,"line_no":217,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਖਟ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਕਲ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur dharas dhiaan khaT dharas na dhekhe sakal dharas sam dharas dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has fixed his attention on the vision of the True Guru. is not reassured by the six schools of philosophy nor towards other religious sects. He sees all philosophies in the vision of one True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208623,"page_no":null,"line_no":217,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਮਝਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur sabadh pa(n)ch sabadh giaan ga(n)m sarab sabadh anahadh samajhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has received Guru's consecration hears melodies of five types of musical instruments deep in his soul because the unstruck music that has appeared in his being due to perpetual meditation on Lord's name has all the melodies in it."}}},{"verse_id":208624,"page_no":null,"line_no":217,"gurmukhi":"ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ਅਵੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ma(n)tr upadhes paraves kai aves ridhai aadh kau aadhes kai braham brahamaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing meditation on the Lord, He comes and resides he in the heart. In this state an initiated disciple sees the all-pervading Lord everywhere."}}},{"verse_id":208625,"page_no":null,"line_no":217,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਕੇ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੪॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan simaran prem ras rasik hui ek aau anek ke bibek pragaTaae hai ||214||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikh who is blessed with knowledge, contemplation and Simran by the True Guru and who relishes the loving elixir, learns the truth of one Lord who pervades in all despite being one. (214)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41243,"next":41245}}
files.shabads/82/41245.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41245,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208626","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208626,"last_verse_id":208629,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208626,"page_no":null,"line_no":218,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਜਨੇਊ ਜਤ ਹੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sat bin sa(n)jam na pat bin poojaa hoi sach bin soch na janeuoo jat heen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Except the name of the stable and firm Lord, no other deed is righteous. Except for the prayer and worship of Master Lord, worship of gods/goddesses is futile. No piety is beyond the truth and wearing of sacred thread without morality is futile."}}},{"verse_id":208627,"page_no":null,"line_no":218,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕਥਨੀ ਭੈ ਭੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bin gur dheekhiaa giaan bin dharasan dhiaan bhaau bin bhagat na kathanee bhai bheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without obtaining initiation from a True Guru, no knowledge is worthwhile. No contemplation is useful except that of the True Guru. No worship is worth anything if not performed love, nor any view point expressed can invite respect."}}},{"verse_id":208628,"page_no":null,"line_no":218,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saa(n)t na sa(n)tokh bin sukh na sahaj bin sabadh surat bin prem na prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without patience and contentment, peace cannot reside. No true peace and comfort is achievable without acquiring a state of equipoise. Similarly no love can be stable without the union of the word and mind (consciousness)."}}},{"verse_id":208629,"page_no":null,"line_no":218,"gurmukhi":"ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੫॥","translit_en":"braham bibek bin hiradhai na ek Tek bin saadh sa(n)gat na ra(n)g livaleen hai ||215||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without deliberation on His name, one cannot establish faith in the heart and without the holy congregation of divine and saintly persons, engrossment in Lord's name is not possible. (215)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41244,"next":41246}}

॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui charan kamal taeh jag madhukar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh who is engrossed in the elixir-like name of the Lord by virtue of ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur sabadh dhun sun gadh gadh hoi a(n)mirat bachan taeh jagat udhar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru whose every hair blooms hearing the melody of True Guru blessed Naam Simran, his elixir-like words can sail the world across the worldly ocean."}}},{"verse_id":208632,"page_no":null,"line_no":219,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa gur dhiaa nidhaan sarab nidhaan dhaan dhokh dhukh har hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who receives even a very small blessing of the True Guru, becomes capable of giving away all the treasures and allaying the distresses of the others."}}},{"verse_id":208633,"page_no":null,"line_no":219,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਦਾਸ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੬॥","translit_en":"sree gur dhaasan dhaas dhaasan dhaasaan dhaas taas na i(n)dhraadh brahamaadh samasar hai ||216||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh who serves the servants of the slaves of the True Guru (who becomes down to earth humble) cannot even be (216)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41245,"next":41247}}
files.shabads/82/41247.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41247,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208634","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208634,"last_verse_id":208637,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208634,"page_no":null,"line_no":220,"gurmukhi":"ਜਬ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jab te param gur charan saran aai charan saran liv sakal sa(n)saar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since the time a human being takes the refuge in the holy feet of the True Guru, the people of the world then start contemplating in the refuge of his feet."}}},{"verse_id":208635,"page_no":null,"line_no":220,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਚਾਹਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਸਕਲ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh charanaamirat kai chaahit charan ren sakal akaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By taking the foot-wash of the True Guru while staying in His refuge, the entire mankind desires to be blessed by his holy feet."}}},{"verse_id":208636,"page_no":null,"line_no":220,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT sahaj ghar nihachal mat paramaarath beechaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By living in the peaceful refuge of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, one gets absorbed in a state of equipoise. Because of higher spiritual wisdom, they become stable of mind and consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208637,"page_no":null,"line_no":220,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਿਤ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੭॥","translit_en":"charan kamal gur mahimaa agaadh bodh net nit namo namo kai namasakaar hai ||217||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru is beyond comprehension, It is limitless, infinite. He is worthy of salutation again and again. (217)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41246,"next":41248}}
files.shabads/82/41248.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41248,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208638","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208638,"last_verse_id":208641,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208638,"page_no":null,"line_no":221,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਅਸਥਰਿ ਚਿਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal gur jab te ridhai basaae tab te asathar chit anat na dhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since the time a human being attaches his mind with the lotus like feet of ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh charanaamirat kai praapat amar padh sahaj samaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The refuge of the True Guru's feet provides one with the foot-wash of the True Guru that helps him acquire inimitable state and engrossment in equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208640,"page_no":null,"line_no":221,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕੀਉ ਆਨ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਆਗ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal sukh man mai nivaas keeau aan sukh tiaag har naam liv laavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since the holy feet of the True Guru got lodged in the heart of a
