name."}}},{"verse_id":208641,"page_no":null,"line_no":221,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਆਨ ਵਾਸ ਫੀਕੀ ਭਈ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੨੧੮॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh vaasanaa nivaas aan vaas feekee bhiee hiradhe na bhaaviee ||218||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since the fragrance of the holy lotus-feet of the True Guru got lodged in the mind of the devotee, all other fragrances have become prosaic and indifferent for him. (218)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41247,"next":41249}}
files.shabads/82/41249.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41249,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208642","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208642,"last_verse_id":208645,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208642,"page_no":null,"line_no":222,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੇਰੀ ਘੇਰੀ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੁਇ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨੈਨ ਛਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baaree bahu naik kee naikaa piaaree keree gheree aan prabal hui ni(n)dhraa nain chhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Known as favourite and loved one of the Master who has many women, when her turn to receive her Master's blessings came she was over-powered by the sleep of ignorance. The sleep-filled eyes made me unaware of everything."}}},{"verse_id":208643,"page_no":null,"line_no":222,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਚਈਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਆਗਮ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਾਦਰ ਕੈ ਸੋਈ ਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"premanee patibrataa chieelee priaa aagam kee ni(n)dhraa ko niraadhar kai soiee na bhai bhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But those Sikh sentient beings who were filled with love in their hearts when they heard that their Master was coming, they forsake sleep and remained alert in their faith and love for the meeting."}}},{"verse_id":208644,"page_no":null,"line_no":222,"gurmukhi":"ਸਖੀ ਹੁਤੀ ਸੋਤ ਥੀ ਭਈ ਗਈ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਪੈ ਜਹਾ ਕੇ ਤਹਾ ਲੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakhee hutee sot thee bhiee giee sukhadhaik pai jahaa ke tahaa le raakhe sa(n)gam sulai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite being favourite of my Master, I remained sleeping in ignorance. I remained bereft of meeting my comfort-giving beloved. I remained wherever I was, separated and bereft of His love and blessings. This is what sleep of ignorance did to me."}}},{"verse_id":208645,"page_no":null,"line_no":222,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਮ ਰੂਪ ਜਾਮਿਨੀ ਨ ਨਿਬਰੈ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੨੧੯॥","translit_en":"supan charitr mai na mitreh milan dheenee jam roop jaaminee na nibarai bihai kai ||219||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This dream like happening did not let me meet my beloved. Now the death-like night of separation neither ends nor terminates. (219)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41248,"next":41250}}
files.shabads/82/41250.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41250,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208646","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208646,"last_verse_id":208649,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208646,"page_no":null,"line_no":223,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਹੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ ਗੁਨ ਹੀਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਹੀਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੀਨ ਭਾਗ ਹੀਨ ਤਪ ਹੀਨ ਬਾਵਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"roop heen kul heen gun heen gayaan heen sobhaa heen bhaag heen tap heen baavaree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am without a physical form, without a family, without good virtue, without knowledge, without beauty, without good fortune, without spiritual practice, and I have become crazy."}}},{"verse_id":208647,"page_no":null,"line_no":223,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਹੀਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲ ਹੀਨ ਸੂਧੇ ਹਸਤ ਨ ਪਾਵ ਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas heen sabadh surat heen budh bal heen soodhe hasat na paav ree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am bereft of the kind looks and glimpse of the True Guru, without meditation, weak of power and wisdom, of warped hands and feet because of not doing service of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208648,"page_no":null,"line_no":223,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਰੀਤ ਹੀਨ ਭਾਇ ਭੈ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤ ਹੀਨ ਚਿਤ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਤ ਹੀਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਰੀ ॥","translit_en":"preet heen reet heen bhai bhai prateet heen chit heen bit heen sahaj subhaav ree ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am vacuous of my beloved's love, unaware of Guru's teachings, hollow of devotion, unstable of mind, poor of the wealth of meditation and even lacking in calmness of nature."}}},{"verse_id":208649,"page_no":null,"line_no":223,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨਾ ਧੀਨ ਪਰਚੀ ਨ ਲਗ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਰਾਵਰੀ ॥੨੨੦॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g heen dheenaa dheen parachee na lag charan saran kaise praapat havai raavaree ||220||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am inferior from every aspect of life. I don't become humble in order to please my beloved. With all these shortcomings, O my True Guru! How can I acquire the refuge of your holy feet. (220)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41249,"next":41251}}
files.shabads/82/41251.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41251,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208650","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208650,"last_verse_id":208653,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208650,"page_no":null,"line_no":224,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੇਤ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਉਨ ਰਾਖੈ ਘਰੁ ਮੂਸੈ ਪਾਹਰੂਆ ਕਹੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jananee suteh bikh dhet het kaun raakhai ghar moosai paaharooaa kaho kaise raakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a mother poisons her son then who will love him? If a watchman robs the house then how can it be protected?"}}},{"verse_id":208651,"page_no":null,"line_no":224,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰੀਆ ਜਉ ਬੋਰੈ ਨਾਵ ਕਹੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ਅਗੂਆਊ ਬਾਟ ਪਾਰੈ ਕਾ ਪੈ ਦੀਨ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kareeaa jau borai naav kaho kaise paavai paar agooaauoo baaT paarai kaa pai dheen bhaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a boatman sinks the boat, then how can the passengers reach the shore beyond? If the-leader cheats on the way, then who can be prayed for justice?"}}},{"verse_id":208652,"page_no":null,"line_no":224,"gurmukhi":"ਖੈਤੇ ਜਉ ਖਾਇ ਬਾਰ ਕਉਨ ਧਾਇ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਿਆਉ ਪੂਛੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"khaite jau khai baar kaun dhai raakhanahaar chakravai karai aniaau poochhai kaun saakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the protecting fence starts eating the crop (caretaker starts destroying the crop) then who will take care of it? If a king becomes unjust who will examine the witness?"}}},{"verse_id":208653,"page_no":null,"line_no":224,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਗੀਐ ਜਉ ਬੈਦ ਮਾਰੈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਉ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਦ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਰੈ ਕਾ ਪੈ ਅਭਿਲਾਖੀਐ ॥੨੨੧॥","translit_en":"rogeeaai jau baidh maarai mitr jau kamaavai dhroh gur na mukat karai kaa pai abhilaakheeaai ||221||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a physician kills the patient, a friend betrays his friend, then who can be trusted? If a Guru does not bless his disciple with salvation, then who else can be expected to be saved? (221)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41250,"next":41252}}
files.shabads/82/41252.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41252,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208654","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208654,"last_verse_id":208657,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208654,"page_no":null,"line_no":225,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"man madhukar gat bhramat chatur ku(n)T charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT samaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind wanders like a bumble bee in all four directions. But by coming into the refuge of True Guru and by the blessings of Naam Simran, he merges into peace and comfort of equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":208655,"page_no":null,"line_no":225,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"seetal suga(n)dh at komal anoop roop madh makara(n)dh ras anat na dhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Once the calming, scented, delicate and very beautiful elixir-like holy dust of the feet of True Guru is received, the mind does not wander in any direction."}}},{"verse_id":208656,"page_no":null,"line_no":225,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh unaman jagamag jot anahadh dhun run jhun liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On account of his association with the holy feet of the True Guru, by remaining in a state of divine will and tranquil state of meditation and ever enjoying a glimpse of the light effulgent, he remains engrossed in the melodious unstruck celestial music."}}},{"verse_id":208657,"page_no":null,"line_no":225,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਪਾ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨੨੨॥","translit_en":"gurmukh bees ik iees soha(n) soiee jaanai aapaa apara(n)par param padh paieeaai ||222||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Believe it! An obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes aware of the One Lord who is beyond all limits. And thus he reaches the supreme spiritual state. (222)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41251,"next":41253}}
files.shabads/82/41253.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41253,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208658","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208658,"last_verse_id":208661,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208658,"page_no":null,"line_no":226,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਅਛਤ ਅਮਤਰਗਤਿ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਖੋਜਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"man mirag mirag madh achhat amataragat bhoolio bhram khojat firat ban maahee jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Human mind is like a fast running deer who has Naam-like musk within him. But under various doubts and misgivings, he keeps searching it in forest."}}},{"verse_id":208659,"page_no":null,"line_no":226,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦਰ ਸਰੋਜ ਗਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar saroj gat ekai saravar bikhai a(n)tar dhisa(n)tar hui samajhat naahee jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Frog and lotus flower live in the same pond but despite that the frog-like mind does not know lotus as if he is residing in a foreign land. The frog eats moss and not lotus flower. Such is the state of mind who is not aware of the Naam Amrit co-existing with it, and stays indulged in vices."}}},{"verse_id":208660,"page_no":null,"line_no":226,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਧਰ ਤਜੈ ਨ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਕਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਲਪਟਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bikhiaa dhar tajai na bikh bikham kau ahinis baavan birakh lapaTaahee jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a snake never sheds his venom although he keeps coiled around a sandalwood tree so is the state of that person who does not shed his vices even in the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":208661,"page_no":null,"line_no":226,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਭਰਮ ਮਿਟਾਹੀ ਜੀ ॥੨੨੩॥","translit_en":"jaise narapat supana(n)tar bhekhaaree hoi gurmukh jagat mai bharam miTaahee jee ||223||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The state of our wandering mind is like a king who becomes a beggar in his dream. But the mind of a Sikh of the Guru dispels all his doubts and misgivings with the power of Naam Simran and recognising his self, lives a purposeful, contented and a happy life. (223)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41252,"next":41254}}
files.shabads/82/41254.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41254,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208662","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208662,"last_verse_id":208665,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208662,"page_no":null,"line_no":227,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਇ ਹੁਇ ਬਘੂਲਾ ਬਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਫਿਰੈ ਤਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bai hui baghoolaa bai ma(n)ddal firai tau kahaa baasanaa kee aag jaag jugat na jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So what if someone through spiritual powers become a whirlwind of air and wanders in the atmosphere when all desires are kindred in his mind and he does not know how to get rid of them?"}}},{"verse_id":208663,"page_no":null,"line_no":227,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂਪ ਜਲੁ ਗਰੋ ਬਾਧੇ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨ ਹੁਇ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਚੀਲ ਹੁਇ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਖਗਪਤਿ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"koop jal garo baadhe nikasai na hui samu(n)dhr cheel hui uddai na khagapat unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water drawn out of a well with a pitcher tied to a rope does not become an ocean and a vulture, who roams about in the sky looking for corpses, cannot be accepted as god of birds, similarly, an evil-filled man cannot claim to be a spiritually awakened."}}},{"verse_id":208664,"page_no":null,"line_no":227,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਸਾ ਬਿਲ ਖੋਦਿ ਨ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸਰਪ ਹੁਇ ਚਿਰੰਜੀਵ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਬਲਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"moosaa bil khodh na jogeesur gufaa kahaavai sarap hui chira(n)jeev bikh na balaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A person who has done no good to anyone is like a rat living in a burrow even if he puts hismelf through rigorous penance to realise his beloved God.  Similarly, acquiring long life of a snake does not dispel the venom of vices and desires from one's mind. "}}},{"verse_id":208665,"page_no":null,"line_no":227,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਹੁਇ ਅਤੀਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਰੇਨੁ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੨੪॥","translit_en":"gurmukh tiragun ateet cheet hui ateet haumai khoi hoi ren kaamadhen maaneeaai ||224||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But an obedient Sikh of the Guru keeps himself clear from the effect of tri-traits of maya and is a recluse by heart. He loses his ego and becomes an epitome of humility by serving all and accomplishing others' tasks admirably. (224)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41253,"next":41255}}
files.shabads/82/41255.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41255,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208666","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208666,"last_verse_id":208669,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208666,"page_no":null,"line_no":228,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile aatam aves pramaatam prabeen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the union of a disciple coming in the refuge of True Guru and when his mind is engrossed in the divine word, he becomes an adept in uniting his self with the Supreme soul."}}},{"verse_id":208667,"page_no":null,"line_no":228,"gurmukhi":"ਤਤੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tatai mil tat savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh mukataahal hui paaras kai paaras parasapar keen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the mythical rain-drop (Swati) turns into a pearl when it falls on an Oyster shell and becomes highly valuable, so would a person uniting with Supreme become like Him. Like philosopher-stone, the True Guru makes a Sikh like Himself."}}},{"verse_id":208668,"page_no":null,"line_no":228,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪਕੈ ਦਿਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧੀਅਤ ਆਪੈ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jot mil jot jaise dheepakai dhipat dheep heerai heeraa bedheeat aapai aapaa cheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As an oil lamp lights the other, so does a true devotee (Gursikh) meeting with True Guru becomes an embodiment of His light and shines in the diamond like a diamond. He reckons his self then."}}},{"verse_id":208669,"page_no":null,"line_no":228,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਗਤਿ ਚਤਰੁ ਬਰਨ ਜਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੫॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baasanaa subaas gat chatar baran jan kul akuleen hai ||225||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the vegetation around a sandalwood tree becomes fragrant. Similarly the people of all the four castes become of higher caste after meeting with True Guru. (225)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41254,"next":41256}}
files.shabads/82/41256.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41256,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208670","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208670,"last_verse_id":208673,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208670,"page_no":null,"line_no":229,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat ridhai sat roop dhekhe dhirag sat naam jihabaa kai prem ras paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By lodging the teachings of the True Guru in the heart, the eyes of the Sikh of the Guru sees the True Lord pervading in everyone everywhere. He repeats the name of the Lord incessantly and relishes the loving nectar of Naam Simran all the time."}}},{"verse_id":208671,"page_no":null,"line_no":229,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਦ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਸਤਿ ਆਘ੍ਰਨ ਅਘਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh bibek sat sravan surat naadh naasikaa suga(n)dh sat aaghran aghaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having listened to the true words of wisdom from the Guru, the ears of a disciple remain engrossed in listening to that tune. Smelling the fragrance of the Naam, his nostrils are satiated by the sweet smell of the Naam."}}},{"verse_id":208672,"page_no":null,"line_no":229,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਸਤ ਅਵਿਲੰਬ ਸਤਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)t charanaamirat hasat avila(n)b sat paaras paras hoi paaras dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the hands getting a touch of the feet of the True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru is seen to have become a philosopher stone like the True Guru Himself."}}},{"verse_id":208673,"page_no":null,"line_no":229,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੬॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan gur sikh sa(n)dh mile alakh lakhaae hai ||226||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus relishing the words of the Guru with all five senses and his becoming one with the True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru becomes aware of the Lord whose form and name is eternal. All this happens through the knowledge dispensed by the True Guru. (226)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41255,"next":41257}}
files.shabads/82/41257.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41257,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208674","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208674,"last_verse_id":208677,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208674,"page_no":null,"line_no":230,"gurmukhi":"ਆਤਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧੀ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਸੈ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aatam tirabidhee jatr katr sai ikatr bhe gurmat sat nihachal man maane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the acquisition of True Guru's consecration and His wisdom, the mind wandering in three traits of maya becomes stable and then it feels reassured in the words of the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208675,"page_no":null,"line_no":230,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਗ ਜਗ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਰ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jagajeevan jag jag jagajeevan mai pooran braham giaan dhiaan ur aane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has received the elixir-like Name of the Lord, practiced it, sees the Lord and the world intermingled. That Sikh of the Guru imbibes the knowledge in his heart since it has been blessed by the complete God-like True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208676,"page_no":null,"line_no":230,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਗੋਰਸ ਗੋਬੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sookham sathool mool ek hee anek mek goras goba(n)s gat prem pahichaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving hue of Lord's name, the Sikh of the Guru recognises the presence of the Lord in gross and imperceptible species just as well species of cows yield same type of milk."}}},{"verse_id":208677,"page_no":null,"line_no":230,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਨ ਮੈੈ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਚਿਤੇਰੋ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜਨਕ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੭॥","translit_en":"kaaran maiai kaaran karan chitr mai chitero ja(n)tr dhun ja(n)tree jan kai janak jaane hai ||227||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He realises that the Lord is permeated in His creation as is a painter in his painting, a tune in the musical instrument and qualities of father in his son. (227)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41256,"next":41258}}
files.shabads/82/41258.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41258,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208678","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208678,"last_verse_id":208681,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208678,"page_no":null,"line_no":231,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਇਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਅਸਟ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਕੇ ਪਾਂਚ ਪਾਂਚ ਪੂਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naik hai ek ar naikaa asaT taa kai ek ek naikaa ke paa(n)ch paa(n)ch poot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There is only one master of the house. He has eight wives and each wife has five sons."}}},{"verse_id":208679,"page_no":null,"line_no":231,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪੂਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਨਾਤੀ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਨਾਤੀ ਦੋਇ ਪਤਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਸੂਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek ek poot gireh chaar chaar naatee ekai ekai naatee dhoi patanee prasoot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every son has four sons. Thus every grandson of the master has two child-bearing wives."}}},{"verse_id":208680,"page_no":null,"line_no":231,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਪਾਂਚ ਪਾਂਚ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਸੁਤ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਸੰਭੂਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taahoo te anek pun ekai ekai paa(n)ch paa(n)ch taa te chaar chaar sut sa(n)tat sa(n)bhoot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then several children were born of those wives. Each bore five sons and then four more sons."}}},{"verse_id":208681,"page_no":null,"line_no":231,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਤੇ ਆਠ ਆਠ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਸੁਤਾ ਆਠ ਸੁਤ ਐਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਇ ਏਕ ਸੂਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੮॥","translit_en":"taa te aaTh aaTh sutaa sutaa sutaa aaTh sut aaiso paravaar kaise hoi ek soot hai ||228||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Each of these sons produced eight daughters and then eight sons came forth from each daughter. One who has such a big family, how can he be stringed in one thread. This is the spread of the mind. Its expanse has no end. How can a mind with such vast spread be concentrated? (228)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41257,"next":41259}}
files.shabads/82/41259.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41259,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208682","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208682,"last_verse_id":208685,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208682,"page_no":null,"line_no":232,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਮਨੁ ਆਠ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਪਾਂਚ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਚਾਰਿ ਫਾਰਿ ਫਾਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਫਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek man aaTh kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kha(n)dd paa(n)ch Took Took Took chaar faar faar dhoi faar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One maund is divided into eight parts. Each part is five seer, which is divided into four parts. Each quarter is a pao. (All the weight measures mentioned are old Punjabi weight measures)."}}},{"verse_id":208683,"page_no":null,"line_no":232,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਹੂ ਤੇ ਪਈਸੇ ਅਉ ਪਈਸਾ ਏਕ ਪਾਂਚ ਟਾਂਕ ਟਾਂਕ ਟਾਂਕ ਮਾਸੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taahoo te pieese aau pieesaa ek paa(n)ch Taa(n)k Taa(n)k Taa(n)k maase chaar anik prakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These half paos are then reduced to Sarsahi. Each Sarsahi contains five Tank. Each Tank has four Mashas. Thus these weight measures have much spread."}}},{"verse_id":208684,"page_no":null,"line_no":232,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਸਾ ਏਕ ਆਠ ਰਤੀ ਰਤੀ ਆਠ ਚਾਵਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਟ ਹਾਟ ਕਨੁ ਕਨੁ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maasaa ek aaTh ratee ratee aaTh chaavar kee haaT haaT kan kan tol tulaadhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One masha contains eight ratis (a small red and black seed of Allarams, used as a weight measure by jewellers for weighing gold) and one rati has eight grains of rice. Thus are being weighed items in a shop."}}},{"verse_id":208685,"page_no":null,"line_no":232,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਏਤੋ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੯॥","translit_en":"pur pur poor rahe sakal sa(n)saar bikhai bas aavai kaise jaa ko eto bisathaar hai ||229||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This is the spread of a maund in the cities of the world. A mind which has such an expanse of lust, anger, avarice attachment, arrogance, desires and other vices, how can that mind be controlled? (229)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41258,"next":41260}}
files.shabads/82/41260.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41260,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208686","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208686,"last_verse_id":208689,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208686,"page_no":null,"line_no":233,"gurmukhi":"ਖਗਪਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪਰਾਕ੍ਰਮੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਪਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khagapat prabal paraakramee param ha(n)s chaatur chatur mukh cha(n)chalaa chapal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mind is like a large Garud (a bird that according to Hindu mythology is the transport of Lord Vishnu) that has very sharp flight, is very powerful, shrewd, clever, well aware of happenings in all four directions and is brisk like electricity."}}},{"verse_id":208687,"page_no":null,"line_no":233,"gurmukhi":"ਭੁਜ ਬਲੀ ਅਸਟ ਭੁਜਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਾਲੀਸ ਕਰ ਏਕ ਸਉ ਸਾਠ ਪਾਉ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਚਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhuj balee asaT bhujaa taa ke chaalees kar ek sau saaTh paau chaal chalaachal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a maund, the mind is also powerful with eight arms (eight arms of maund-each of 5 seers) 40 hands (each hand is one seer of a maund). Thus it has 160 feet (each feet of a maund is of one pao). Its gait is very sharp and not likely to stop anywhere."}}},{"verse_id":208688,"page_no":null,"line_no":233,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਗ੍ਰਤ ਸੁਪਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਦਹਿਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ਏਕ ਪਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaagrat supan ahinis dhahidhis dhaavai tirabhavan prat hoi aavai ek pal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This mind awake or asleep, day or night keeps wandering in all ten directions all the time. It visits all the three worlds in no time."}}},{"verse_id":208689,"page_no":null,"line_no":233,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਅਛਤ ਉਡਤ ਪਹੁੰਚੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਪੂਰ ਗਿਰ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੦॥","translit_en":"pi(n)jaree mai achhat uddat pahu(n)chai na kouoo pur pur poor gir tar thal jal hai ||230||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A bird in a cage cannot fly, but mind though in cage of the body flies to places where no one can reach. It has reach to the cities, mountains, jungles, in the water and even the deserts. (230)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41259,"next":41261}}
files.shabads/82/41261.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41261,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208690","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208690,"last_verse_id":208693,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208690,"page_no":null,"line_no":234,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੰਛੀ ਉਡਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਹੈ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ ਜਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਰਾਖੀਅਤਿ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pa(n)chhee uddat firat hai akaasachaaree jaar ddaar pi(n)jaree mai raakheeat aan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a high flying bird keep flying to distant places, but once it is caught with the help of a net and put in a cage, it cannot fly anymore."}}},{"verse_id":208691,"page_no":null,"line_no":234,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਗਹਿਬਰ ਬਨ ਮੈ ਮਦੋਨ ਬਸਿ ਹੁਇ ਮਹਾਵਤ ਕੈ ਅੰਕੁਸਹਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gajaraaj gahibar ban mai madhon bas hui mahaavat kai a(n)kuseh maan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a frolicsome elephant roams about in the dense jungle excitedly, it is brought under control under the fear of a goad once captured."}}},{"verse_id":208692,"page_no":null,"line_no":234,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਖਿਆਧਰ ਬਿਖਮ ਬਿਲ ਮੈ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਗਹੇ ਸਾਪਹੇਰਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bikhiaadhar bikham bil mai paataal gahe saapaheraa taeh ma(n)tran kee kaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a snake lives in deep and winding burrow is caught by snake-charmer with mystic incantations."}}},{"verse_id":208693,"page_no":null,"line_no":234,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੋਤ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥੨੩੧॥","translit_en":"taise tirabhavan prat bhramat cha(n)chal chit nihachal hot mat satigur giaan kai ||231||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the mind that wanders in all the three worlds become calm and steady with teachings and advice of the True Guru. By practicing meditation on the Naam obtained from the True Gum, its wandering ends. (231)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41260,"next":41262}}
files.shabads/82/41262.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41262,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208694","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208694,"last_verse_id":208697,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208694,"page_no":null,"line_no":235,"gurmukhi":"ਰਚਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ ੍ਰਪਨ ਏਕ ਮੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rachan charitr chitr bisam bachit rapan ek mai anek bhaa(n)t anik prakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The picture of miraculous creation of the Lord is full of astonishment and wonder. How has He spread such countless variations and diversities in this one picture?"}}},{"verse_id":208695,"page_no":null,"line_no":235,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਸਕਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਉਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan mai dhirasaT sravan mai surat raakhee naasakaa subaas ras rasanaa uchaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He has filled energy in the eyes to see, in the ears to hear, in the nostrils to smell and in the tongue to taste and relish."}}},{"verse_id":208696,"page_no":null,"line_no":235,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਤਰ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀਨ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਨ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਖਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar hee a(n)tar nira(n)tareen srotan mai kaahoo kee na kouoo jaanai bikham beechaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What is difficult to understand is that each of these senses has so much difference in them that one does not know how the other is engaged."}}},{"verse_id":208697,"page_no":null,"line_no":235,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਚਿਤੇਰੋ ਕੈਸੋ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੨॥","translit_en":"agam charitr chitr jaaneeaai chitero kaiso net net net namo namo namasakaar hai ||232||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The picture of creation of the Lord that is beyond comprehension, how can then its creator and His creation be understood? He is limitless, infinite in all the three periods and is worthy of salutations repeatedly. (232)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41261,"next":41263}}
files.shabads/82/41263.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41263,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208698","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208698,"last_verse_id":208701,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208698,"page_no":null,"line_no":236,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਉਦਮਾਦ ਠਟ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maiaa chhaiaa pa(n)ch dhoot bhoot udhamaadh ThaT ghaT ghaT ghaTikaa mai saagar anek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lust, anger etc., the five vices are shadows of maya (mammon). These have created turbulence in human beings like demons. Many oceans of vices and evils are in rage in me mind of a human being as a result of these."}}},{"verse_id":208699,"page_no":null,"line_no":236,"gurmukhi":"ਅਉਧ ਪਲ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪਰਜੰਤ ਆਸਾ ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaudh pal ghaTikaa jugaadh paraja(n)t aasaa lahar tara(n)g mai na tirasanaa kee Tek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Human life is very brief but his expectations and desires are of eons. There are waves of vices in the ocean-like mind whose cravings are unimaginable."}}},{"verse_id":208700,"page_no":null,"line_no":236,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਧਾਵਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਛਿਨਕ ਮੈ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man manasaa prasa(n)g dhaavat chatur ka(n)uT chhinak mai kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd jaavadhek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Under the influence of all these cravings and desires, the mind roams about in all four directions and reaches regions beyond in split second time."}}},{"verse_id":208701,"page_no":null,"line_no":236,"gurmukhi":"ਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਕੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਿਬੇ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੩॥","translit_en":"aadh kai biaadh kai upaadh kai asaadh man saadhibe kau charan saran gur ek hai ||233||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite its engrossment in worries, physical ailments and many types of other maladies, it cannot be stopped from wandering. The refuge of the True Guru is the only means of controlling it. (233)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41262,"next":41264}}
files.shabads/82/41264.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41264,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208702","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208702,"last_verse_id":208705,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208702,"page_no":null,"line_no":237,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਮਨ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਲੇਖਕ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸ ਲਿਖਤ ਨ ਤੈਸੋ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso man laagat hai lekhak ko lekhai bikhai har jas likhat na taiso Thahiraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the mind of an accountant is ever engrossed in maintaining and writing accounts of worldly affairs, it does not focus on writing the paeans of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208703,"page_no":null,"line_no":237,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਮਨ ਬਨਜ ਬਯੋਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਨ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso man banaj bayohaar ke bithaar bikhai sabadh surat avagaahan na bhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the mind is engrossed in trading and business, it does not like to involve and engross itself in the meditation of Lord's name."}}},{"verse_id":208704,"page_no":null,"line_no":237,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਮਨ ਕਨਿਕ ਔ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਨੇਹ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਤੈਸੇ ਨੇਹ ਪਲ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso man kanik aau kaamanee saneh bikhai saadh sa(n)g taise neh pal na lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a man is enamoured by gold and love of woman, he does not show that type of love in his heart for a moment for the congregation of holy men."}}},{"verse_id":208705,"page_no":null,"line_no":237,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਯਾ ਬੰਧ ਧੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਆਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਹੀਨ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਈ ॥੨੩੪॥","translit_en":"maayaa ba(n)dh dha(n)dh bikhai aavadh bihai jai gur upadhes heen paachhe pachhutaaviee ||234||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Life is spent in the worldly bondages and affairs. One bereft of practicing and following the teachings of True Guru repents when one's time to depart from this world draws near. (234)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41263,"next":41265}}

॥","translit_en":"jaiso man dhaavai par tan dhan dhookhan lau sree gur saran saadh sa(n)g lau na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the mind runs after other's woman, other's wealth and ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso man laagai paraadheen heen dheenataa mai saadh sa(n)g satigur sevaa na lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the mind remains involved in inferior, disrespectful service of others, it does not do similar service of the True Guru and holy assembly of saintly persons."}}},{"verse_id":208708,"page_no":null,"line_no":238,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਮਨ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਬਿਰਤਿ ਮੈ ਮਗਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso man kirat birat mai magan hoi saadh sa(n)g keeratan mai na Thahiraaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the mind remains engrossed in the worldly affairs, it does not attach itself with the adulations of God arid pious congregation."}}},{"verse_id":208709,"page_no":null,"line_no":238,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂਕਰ ਜਯੋਂ ਚੋਂਚ ਕਾਢਿ ਚਾਕੀ ਚਾਟਬੇ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੇਖੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਪਾਛੈ ਧਾਵਈ ॥੨੩੫॥","translit_en":"kookar jayo(n) cho(n)ch kaadd chaakee chaaTabe ko jai jaa ke meeThee laagee dhekhai taahee paachhai dhaaviee files.shabads/82/41266.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41266,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208710","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208710,"last_verse_id":208713,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208710,"page_no":null,"line_no":239,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਵਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਦ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਤਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saravar mai na jaanee dhaadhar kamal gat mirag mirag madh gat a(n)tar na jaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A frog living in a pool is unaware of the presence of a lotus flower growing in the same pool. Even a deer is unaware of the musk pod that he is carrying within his body."}}},{"verse_id":208711,"page_no":null,"line_no":239,"gurmukhi":"ਮਣਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਅਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਸੰਖ ਨਿਧਿ ਹੀਨ ਬਕ ਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man mahimaa na jaanee eh bikh bikham kai saagar mai sa(n)kh nidh heen bak baanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a poisonous snake because of its poison is not aware of the invaluable pearl that he carries in his hood and a conch shell keeps wailing although it lives in the ocean but unaware of the wealth stored therein."}}},{"verse_id":208712,"page_no":null,"line_no":239,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਉਲੂਐ ਅਲਖ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep jaise baa(n)s niraga(n)dh ka(n)dh ulooaai alakh dhin dhinakar dhiaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a bamboo plant remains bereft of fragrance despite living in the close proximity of a Sandalwood tree, and as an owl keeps his eyes shut during the day behaving ignorantly of the Sun,"}}},{"verse_id":208713,"page_no":null,"line_no":239,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਮਮ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਭੇਟਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਸੇਬਲ ਜਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੬॥","translit_en":"taise baa(n)jh badhoo mam sree gur purakh bheT nihachal sebal jiau haumai abhimaanee hai ||236||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, because of my ego and pride, I like an infertile woman remained fruitless despite acquiring the touch of True Guru. I am no better than the tall fruitless tree like silk Cotton. (236) "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41265,"next":41267}}
files.shabads/82/41267.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41267,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208714","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208714,"last_verse_id":208717,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208714,"page_no":null,"line_no":240,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਮਾਸ ਭਿਦੈ ਨ ਪਖਾਨ ਸਿਲਾ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਨ ਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"barakhaa chatur maas bhidhai na pakhaan silaa nipajai na dhaan paan anik upaav kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a stone accumulates no water even during monsoon rains and does not become soft, it can yield no crop despite diligent efforts,"}}},{"verse_id":208715,"page_no":null,"line_no":240,"gurmukhi":"ਉਦਿਤ ਬਸੰਤ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮਉਲੈ ਨ ਕਰੀਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਬੰਸ ਕੇ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"audhit basa(n)t parafulit banaasapatee maulai na kareer aadh ba(n)s ke subhaav kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all the trees and bushes blossom in the spring season, but due to peculiarity of the species, (Acacia arabica) Keekar trees do not flower,"}}},{"verse_id":208716,"page_no":null,"line_no":240,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਆਧਾਨ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਾਵ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog nihafal baa(n)jh badhoo hui na aadhaan dhukho dhubidhaa dhuraav kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an infertile woman remains bereft of pregnancy despite enjoying nuptial bed with her husband, and she keeps hiding her distress."}}},{"verse_id":208717,"page_no":null,"line_no":240,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਮ ਕਾਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਪਿਆਵ ਕੈ ॥੨੩੭॥","translit_en":"taise mam kaag saadh sa(n)gat maraal sabhaa rahio niraahaar mukataahal apiaav kai ||237||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly I, a crow (used to eating filth) remained bereft of pearl-like food of Naam Simran even in the company of swans. (237)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41266,"next":41268}}

self-willed people while association with Guru-conscious people enlightens the mind with Guru's wisdom which highly comforting. (238)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41267,"next":41269}}
files.shabads/82/41269.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41269,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208722","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208722,"last_verse_id":208725,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208722,"page_no":null,"line_no":242,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਅਤੀਤ ਮਾਖੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਇਛਾਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kucheel pavitrataa ateet maakhee raakhee na rahit jai baiThe ichhaachaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a dirty and defiled fly sits here and there at its will and does not stop even when made to flyaway repeatedly, so do dross-filled and evil-doers come to the holy congregation and impose their will on others;"}}},{"verse_id":208723,"page_no":null,"line_no":242,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਨਿ ਜਉ ਅਹਾਰ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਰੈ ਨ ਅਜਰ ਉਕਲੇਦੁ ਖੇਦੁ ਭਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pun jau ahaar sanaba(n)dh paraves karai jarai na ajar ukaledh khedh bhaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And then if the same fly enters our stomach along with food, being indigestible, makes us vomit causing much distress. Like fly, unauthorised persons cause much disturbance in the holy company."}}},{"verse_id":208724,"page_no":null,"line_no":242,"gurmukhi":"ਬਧਿਕ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਟਾਟੀ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"badhik bidhaan jiau udhiaan mai TaaTee dhikhai karai jeev ghaat aparaadh adhikaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a hunter uses a mock contraption to hunt wild animals, he becomes eligible for punishment of his sins. So would a deceitful person be punished who keep deceiving gullible people in his garb of a saint or a loving devotee."}}},{"verse_id":208725,"page_no":null,"line_no":242,"gurmukhi":"ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਿਲਾਉ ਅਰੁ ਨੈਨ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਦੇਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਖਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੩੯॥","translit_en":"hiradhai bilaau ar nain bag dhiaanee praanee kapaT sanehee dhehee a(n)t hui dhukhaaree hai ||239||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly one whose heart (like a he-cat) is ever engrossed in avarice, who harbours ill intentions and fake love in his eyes like a heron, falls a prey to the angels of death and is put through untold sufferings. (239)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41268,"next":41270}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41270,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208726","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208726,"last_verse_id":208729,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208726,"page_no":null,"line_no":243,"gurmukhi":"ਗਊ ਮੁਖ ਬਾਘੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਈਆ ਖਗ ਮੋਹਈ ॥","translit_en":"guoo mukh baagh jaise base mirag maal bikhai ka(n)gan pahir jiau bilieeaa khag mohiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lion posing cow-like innocence enters a herd of deer, or a cat deceives the birds impressing upon them that she has just returned from pilgrimage and thus holy,"}}},{"verse_id":208727,"page_no":null,"line_no":243,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਹਾਰ ਮੀਨ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਾਜਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਭਚਾਰ ਜੋਹਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bag dhiaan dhaar karat ahaar meen ganikaa si(n)gaar saaj birabhachaar johiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a heron shows himself contemplating standing on one leg in water but pounces on small fish as these come near him, a whore adores herself like married Woman and waits for a lust-filled person to visit her,"}}},{"verse_id":208728,"page_no":null,"line_no":243,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਚ ਬਟਵਾਰੋ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਸਘਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਫਾਸੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹਈ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ch baTavaaro bhekhadhaaree jiau saghaatee hoi a(n)t faasee ddaar maarai dhroh kar dhrohiee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a dacoit adopts the garb of a noble person and become a murderer and kills others with a noose around their neck, turning out to be untrusting and treacherous."}}},{"verse_id":208729,"page_no":null,"line_no":243,"gurmukhi":"ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਮਿਲਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਬਾਂਸ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਨ ਬੋਹਈ ॥੨੪੦॥","translit_en":"kapaT saneh kai milat saadh sa(n)gat mai cha(n)dhan suga(n)dh baa(n)s gaTheelo na bohiee ||240||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a person with mock and fake love comes to the company of saintly persons, he does not acquire or assimilate the good influence of the holy congregation, just as a knotted bamboo tree acquire no fragrance despite growing in the near proximity of a Sandalwood tree. (240)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41269,"next":41271}}
files.shabads/82/41271.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41271,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208730","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208730,"last_verse_id":208733,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208730,"page_no":null,"line_no":244,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਹੀ ਅਧਾਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਸ ਦਸ ਗਨਤ ਹੀ ਗਨਤ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aadh hee adhaan bikhai hoi niramaan praanee maas dhas ganat hee ganat bihaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A human form is first created in the mother's womb and the ten months period of conception just role by;"}}},{"verse_id":208731,"page_no":null,"line_no":244,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਸਬ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਅਨੰਦ ਮਈ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਗਨਤ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਨਿਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"janamat sut sab kuTa(n)b ana(n)dh miee baal budh ganat biteet nis praat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the birth of a son the whole family rejoices. The days of fun and frolic of his childhood and infancy just pass with everyone 'enjoying his pranks."}}},{"verse_id":208732,"page_no":null,"line_no":244,"gurmukhi":"ਪਢਤ ਬਿਹਾਵੀਅਤ ਜੋਬਨ ਮੈ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paddat bihaaveeat joban mai bhog bikhai banaj biauhaar ke bithaar lapaTaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He then studies, marries and gets entangled in the enjoyments of youth, looking after his business and other mundane worldly affairs."}}},{"verse_id":208733,"page_no":null,"line_no":244,"gurmukhi":"ਬਢਤਾ ਬਿਆਜ ਕਾਜ ਗਨਤ ਅਵਧ ਬੀਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਮਪੁਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੧॥","translit_en":"baddataa biaaj kaaj ganat avadh beetee gur upadhes bin jamapur jaat hai ||241||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He thus spends his life involved in worldly affairs. As a result, the interest on all his bad deeds and subtle impressions of past birth increases. And so he leaves for his abode in.-the other world without acquiring initiation/consecration at the hands of Guru. (241)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41270,"next":41272}}
files.shabads/82/41272.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41272,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208734","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208734,"last_verse_id":208737,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208734,"page_no":null,"line_no":245,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚਕਈ ਚਕਵਾ ਬੰਧਿਕ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chakiee chakavaa ba(n)dhik ikatr keene pi(n)jaree mai base nis dhukh sukh maane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a bird-catcher catches male and female ruddy sheldrake (Chakvi, Chakva) and put them in the same cage where they remain together for the night, they happily bear the pain of being prisoners because they are spared the pangs of separation for the night."}}},{"verse_id":208735,"page_no":null,"line_no":245,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਜਨ ਵਾਰਉ ਓਟ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਪਰ ਜਾਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kahat parasapar koT sur jan vaarau oT dhurajan par jaeh geh aane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They feel so grateful to the hunter for catching them together and lodging them in the same cage that they sacrifice millions of good people unto him who has given them both a shelter."}}},{"verse_id":208736,"page_no":null,"line_no":245,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਪਦਾ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਆਪਦਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"simaran maatr koT aapadhaa sa(n)padhaa koT sa(n)padhaa aapadhaa koT prabh bisaraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If millions of distresses fall upon a person who is a regular practitioner of Naam Simran, he considers them as having come to aid in his meditation and union with Lord. And if God is slipping out of the memory, then all the luxurious items of life that give pleasure are like millions of sufferings."}}},{"verse_id":208737,"page_no":null,"line_no":245,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੨॥","translit_en":"sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan satigur mat sat sat kar jaane hai ||242||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The practitioner of Lord's name regard His name that the True Guru has blessed him with as the eternal truth and living for ever. He regards and accepts the teachings of True Guru as true and true only. He meditates on Naam with complete devotion. (242)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41271,"next":41273}}
files.shabads/82/41273.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41273,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208738","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208738,"last_verse_id":208741,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208738,"page_no":null,"line_no":246,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਮੇਲੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pun kat pa(n)ch tat mel khel hoi kaise bhramat anek jon kuTa(n)b sa(n)jog hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After wandering in many species of life, I have been able to get a chance of living a family life as a human being. When will I get this body of five elements again?"}}},{"verse_id":208739,"page_no":null,"line_no":246,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਨਿਰਮੋਲ ਹੁਇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਭੋਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pun kat maanas janam niramol hui dhirasaT sabadh surat ras kas bhog hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I get this invaluable birth as human being again? A birth when I shall be able to enjoy the relishments of sight, taste, hearing etc."}}},{"verse_id":208740,"page_no":null,"line_no":246,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਨਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pun kat saadh sa(n)g charan saran gur giaan dhiaan simaran prem madh prajog hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This is an opportunity of uniting into the knowledge, contemplation, meditation and enjoying the loving elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed me with."}}},{"verse_id":208741,"page_no":null,"line_no":246,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਚਾਖਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੩॥","translit_en":"safal janam gurmukh sukh fal chaakh jeevan mukat hoi log mai alog hai ||243||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient Sikh of the True Guru endeavours to make this birth a success by living his worldly life and yet remaining aloof. He relishes and repeatedly drink deep the elixir-like Naam that the True Guru has blessed him with and thus he becomes emancipated while still alive. (243)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41272,"next":41274}}
files.shabads/82/41274.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41274,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208742","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208742,"last_verse_id":208745,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208742,"page_no":null,"line_no":247,"gurmukhi":"ਰਚਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਚਿਤੈ ਚਿਤੈ ਚਿਤੇਰਾ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"rachan charitr chitr bisam bachitr pan chitreh chitai chitai chiteraa ur aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The process and event of creation is full of wonder, marvel, colourful and picturesque. Watching and appreciating the beautiful and picturesque creation, one should lodge the Creator in the heart."}}},{"verse_id":208743,"page_no":null,"line_no":247,"gurmukhi":"ਬਚਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bachan bibek Tek ek hee anek mek sun dhun ja(n)tr ja(n)tradhaaree unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the support of the words of Guru, and practicing of these words, one should see the presence of the Almighty in everything; just as listening to the tune of a musical instrument one feels the presence of the player in that melody."}}},{"verse_id":208744,"page_no":null,"line_no":247,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan dhan sarab nidhaan dhaan karunaa nidhaan sukhadhaiee pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One should recognise the provider of peace and comfort, the treasure-house of kindness from the food, bedding, wealth and donation of all other treasures that He has blessed us with."}}},{"verse_id":208745,"page_no":null,"line_no":247,"gurmukhi":"ਕਥਤਾ ਬਕਤਾ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਬਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੪੪॥","translit_en":"kathataa bakataa srotaa dhaataa bhugataa srabag pooran braham gur saadh sa(n)g jaaneeaai ||244||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The utterer of all words, demonstrator of everything, the listener, the donor of all things and relisher of all pleasures. the Omnipotent complete Lord like True Guru is known in the holy congregation of saintly people only. (244)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41273,"next":41275}}
files.shabads/82/41275.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41275,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208746","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208746,"last_verse_id":208749,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208746,"page_no":null,"line_no":248,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮੁਖ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਹਸਤ ਪਗ ਚਿਹਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮਨ ਮੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"lochan sravan mukh naasikaa hasat pag chihan anek man mek jaise jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the mind is associated with eyes, ears, mouth, nose, hand, feet etc., and other limbs of the body; it is the driving force behind them:"}}},{"verse_id":208747,"page_no":null,"line_no":248,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਤੁਸ਼ਟਮਾਨ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਰਸ ਅਰਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)g a(n)g pushaT tushaTamaan hot jaise ek mukh savaiaadh ras arapat maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As tasty and wholesome food is eaten by the mouth that makes every limb of the body strong, and blooming;"}}},{"verse_id":208748,"page_no":null,"line_no":248,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਰ ਸਾਖਾ ਜਲ ਜਿਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਉਰ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"mool ek saakhaa par saakhaa jal jiau anek braham bibek jaavadhek ur aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As watering the trunk of a tree conveys water to its many big or small branches. So far as the question of the universe arises, one should bring to mind the thought of one Lord who is all-pervading."}}},{"verse_id":208749,"page_no":null,"line_no":248,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਪਨ ਦੇਖੀਆਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਗਿਆਨੀਐ ॥੨੪੫॥","translit_en":"gurmukh dharapan dhekheeaat aapaa aap aatam aves paramaatam giaaneeaai ||245||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As one sees self in the mirror, so does an obedient disciple of the Guru focuses his mind in his self (a miniscule part of the Lord-soul) and recognises the all-pervading Lord. (245)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41274,"next":41276}}
files.shabads/82/41276.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41276,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208750","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208750,"last_verse_id":208753,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208750,"page_no":null,"line_no":249,"gurmukhi":"ਜਤ ਸਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਧਰਮ ਧੀਰਜ ਧੁਜਾ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jat sat si(n)ghaasan sahaj sa(n)tokh ma(n)tree dharam dheeraj dhujaa abichal raaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The obedient Gursikh of the True Guru has truth and true morals as his throne while patience and contentment are his ministers. His flag is the eternal persevering righteousness."}}},{"verse_id":208751,"page_no":null,"line_no":249,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਦਇਆ ਦੁਲਹਨੀ ਮਿਲੀ ਭਾਗ ਤਉ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਸਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"siv nagaree nivaas dhiaa dhulahanee milee bhaag tau bha(n)ddaaree bhaau bhojan sakaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That Sikh of the Guru resides in the tenth opening like capital of his body. Kindness is his prime queen. His past deeds and fortune is his treasurer while love is his royal feast and food. He is not a slave of worldly delicacies,"}}},{"verse_id":208752,"page_no":null,"line_no":249,"gurmukhi":"ਅਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਕੈ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਛਿਮਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"arath beechaar paramaarath kai raajaneet chhatrapat chhimaa chhatr chhaiaa chhab chhaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His policy of reigning is to establish a kingdom of humility and righteousness. Forgiveness is his canopy under which he sits. The comforting and peace giving shade of his canopy is known all around."}}},{"verse_id":208753,"page_no":null,"line_no":249,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨਦ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੬॥","translit_en":"aanadh samooh sukh saa(n)t parajaa prasa(n)n jagamag jot anahadh dhun baaj hai ||246||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Peace and comfort to all are his happy subjects. By the practice of Naam Simran and his capital being in the tenth door where the divine radiance is ever effulgent, the unstruck melody is constantly playing in his capital. (246)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41275,"next":41277}}
files.shabads/82/41277.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41277,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208754","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208754,"last_verse_id":208757,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208754,"page_no":null,"line_no":250,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਂਚੋ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟ ਭੇਦਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੇ ਕਹਾਏ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਬੇਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paa(n)cho mu(n)dhraa chakr khaT bhedh chakrave kahaae ula(n)gh tirabenee tirakuTee tirakaal jaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the perpetual practice of Naam Simran, a Guru-conscious person discards the five ear-rings and six stages of spiritual planes of the Yogi and is known as a an emperor. The place that is difficult to reach, he reaches there very conveniently."}}},{"verse_id":208756,"page_no":null,"line_no":250,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੰਸ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਬਿਸਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aan sar tiaag maanasar nihachal ha(n)s param nidhaan bisamaeh bisamaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a Guru-conscious swan-like disciple gives up company of the self-willed people and resides in the Mansarover lake-like congregation of holy persons. He practices the Naam like treasure there and achieves marvellous and astonishing spiritual state."}}},{"verse_id":208757,"page_no":null,"line_no":250,"gurmukhi":"ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੭॥","translit_en":"aunaman magan gagan anahadh dhun baajat neesaan giaan dhiaan bisaraane hai ||247||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He thus gets absorbed in the highest spiritual state. He listens to such melodious tunes in his tenth door that he forgets and discards all other worldly interests. (247)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41276,"next":41278}}
files.shabads/82/41278.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41278,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208758","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208758,"last_verse_id":208761,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208758,"page_no":null,"line_no":251,"gurmukhi":"ਅਵਘਟ ਉਤਰਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਜਪਤ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"avaghaT utar sarovar majan karai japat ajapaa jaap anabhai abhiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Crossing the difficult discipline of the Yogi; a Guru-oriented person bathes himself in the mystical tenth door of the spiritual realm. He dwells in the elixir-like Naam and becomes practitioner of fearless Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208759,"page_no":null,"line_no":251,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਕਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa akaas baas jagamag jot anahadh abinaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He experiences a continuous flow of the celestial nectar in the mystical tenth opening. He experiences light divine and continuous playing of celestial unstruck melody."}}},{"verse_id":208760,"page_no":null,"line_no":251,"gurmukhi":"ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਕੈ ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aatam aves paramaatam praves kai adhiaatam giaan dhiaan ridh sidh nidh dhaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-oriented person settles in self and gets absorbed in the Lord God. By virtue of his spiritual knowledge all the miraculous powers now become his slaves."}}},{"verse_id":208761,"page_no":null,"line_no":251,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਸਲਿਲ ਕਮਲ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੮॥","translit_en":"jeevan mukat jag jeevan jugat jaanee salil kamal gat maiaa mai udhaasee hai ||248||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One, who, in this life has learnt the means of reaching the Lord is liberated while still alive. He remains unaffected by worldly matters (maya), like a lotus flower that lives in water and is not affected by it. (248)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41277,"next":41279}}
files.shabads/82/41279.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41279,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208762","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208762,"last_verse_id":208765,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208762,"page_no":null,"line_no":252,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰ ਕੰਚਨ ਪਾਰਸ ਭਏ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal saran gur ka(n)chan bhe manoor ka(n)chan paaras bhe paaras paras kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By acquiring the philosophical stone-like art of Naam Simran in the refuge of the lotus-like feet of True Guru, the mammon-entangled living beings who are like iron sludge turn into bright and shining gold. A bamboo like egoistic person becomes humble, submissive and fragrant. A pig like polluted person becomes kind hearted and does good for everyone like the cow Kamdhen."}}},{"verse_id":208765,"page_no":null,"line_no":252,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਨਮਸ ਕੈ ॥੨੪੯॥","translit_en":"sree gur charan raj mahimaa agaadh bodh log bedh giaan koT bisam namas kai ||249||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Understanding grandeur of the dust of Satguru’s lotus feet is very difficult. Millions of marvellous knowledge of Vedas are astonished too and bow before such knowledge. (249)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41278,"next":41280}}
files.shabads/82/41280.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41280,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208766","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208766,"last_verse_id":208769,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208766,"page_no":null,"line_no":253,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan asacharaj asacharaj mai koTan koTaan bisamaadh bisamaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of astonishments are feeling astonished at the grandeur of a Guru-conscious person who has been able to achieve union of mind and Guru's words in the holy gathering. Millions of tunes are feeling pleasure and ecstasy listening to the unstruck melody of the word in the consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208768,"page_no":null,"line_no":253,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਗਨੀ ਜਾਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan unamanee ganee jaat nahee koTan koTaan koT su(n)n ma(n)ddalaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of states of knowledge become redundant before the ecstasy of the engrossment of the united state of the word and consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208769,"page_no":null,"line_no":253,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਦਿ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੦॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g a(n)t kai ana(n)t prabh aadh paramaadh hai ||250||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-oriented person practices union of Guru's blessed words in his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. He focuses his mind on the Lord who is infinite and sans beginning. (250)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41279,"next":41281}}
files.shabads/82/41281.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41281,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208770","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208770,"last_verse_id":208773,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208770,"page_no":null,"line_no":254,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat liv saadh sa(n)g ulaT pavan man meen kee chapal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Practicing Naam Simran in the holy congregation, the wind-like frolicsome mind who is very swift like a fish reaches the tenth mystical door where he engrosses himself in perpetual union of words and consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":208771,"page_no":null,"line_no":254,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪ ਚੀਨੀਅਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soha(n) so ajapaa jaap cheeneeat aapaa aap unamanee jot ko udhot hui prabal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And likewise, due to the philosopher-stone like perpetual meditation that he remains engrossed in without any conscious effort, he becomes aware of himself. In the state when the mind is God-oriented, the bright effulgence of the Lord's name appears."}}},{"verse_id":208772,"page_no":null,"line_no":254,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਰੁਨ ਝੁਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਨਿ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"anahadh naadh bisamaadh run jhun sun nijhar jharan barakhaa a(n)mirat jal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This state of strong God-oriented refulgence, he hears the melodious tunes of the unstruck music and remains in a state of trance."}}},{"verse_id":208773,"page_no":null,"line_no":254,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਲ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੧॥","translit_en":"anabhai abhiaas ko pragaas asacharaj mai bisam bisavaiaas baas braham sathal hai ||251||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This experience that is felt in the tenth opening of the body, its radiance is astonishing and full of ecstasy. The stay of the mind in the mystical tenth door is of strange faith. (251)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41280,"next":41282}}
files.shabads/82/41282.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41282,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208774","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208774,"last_verse_id":208777,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208774,"page_no":null,"line_no":255,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas sam dharas dhiaan dhaar dhubidhaa nivaar ek Tek geh leejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With harbouring the thought of seeing all alike and beholding the Lord and discarding feelings of I, my or me from the mind, 'acquire the support of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208775,"page_no":null,"line_no":255,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੌਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv asatut ni(n)dhaa chhaadd akath kathaa beechaar mauan brat keejeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Leaving praise and slander of others, one should Endeavour, to unite the divine words of the Guru in the mind, feel engrossed in it. Its contemplation is beyond description. So it is best to remain quiet."}}},{"verse_id":208776,"page_no":null,"line_no":255,"gurmukhi":"ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਗ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਜੀਐ॥","translit_en":"jag jeevan mai jag jag jagajeevan kai jaaneeaai jeevan mool jug jug jeejeeaai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Consider God, the Creator and the Universe-His creation is as one. And once God is known thus, then one lives for many eons."}}},{"verse_id":208777,"page_no":null,"line_no":255,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥੨੫੨॥","translit_en":"ek hee anek aau anek ek sarab mai braham bibek Tek prem ras peejeeaai ||252||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If one understands that His light pervades in all the Living beings and light of all living beings pervades in Him. Then this knowledge of the Lord dispenses loving elixir to seeker. (252)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41281,"next":41283}}
files.shabads/82/41283.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41283,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208778","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208778,"last_verse_id":208781,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208778,"page_no":null,"line_no":256,"gurmukhi":"ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਤ ਆਵਤ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਸੁ ਕਹਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"abigat gat kat aavat a(n)tar gat akath kathaa su keh kaise kai sunaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can the mysteries of the eternal Lord be brought into mind? He cannot be described. How can He be explained through words?"}}},{"verse_id":208779,"page_no":null,"line_no":256,"gurmukhi":"ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਕਿਧੌ ਪਾਈਅਤਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਦਰਸ ਕੋ ਕੈਸੇ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"alakh apaar kidhau paieeat paar kaise dharas adharas ko kaise kai dhikhaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How can we reach the beyond end of the infinite Lord? How can the invisible Lord be shown?"}}},{"verse_id":208780,"page_no":null,"line_no":256,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਹੁ ਗਹੀਐ ਧੌ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਲੰਬੁ ਕਉਨ ਅਵਲੰਬ ਠਹਿਰਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"agam agochar agahu gaheeaai dhau kaise nirala(n)b kaun avala(n)b Thahiraieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who is beyond the reach of the senses and perception, how can the Lord who cannot be caught be held and known? The Lord Master needs no support. Who can be assigned as His support?"}}},{"verse_id":208781,"page_no":null,"line_no":256,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਬੀਤੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਜਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਹੁਇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫੩॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)dh milai soiee jaanai jaa mai beetai bisam bidheh jal boo(n)dh hui samaieeaai ||253||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only the Guru-conscious seeker experiences the infinite Lord when he himself goes through that state and feels free of his body bondages. He merges with the Guru like a drop of water merges with the sea. (253)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41282,"next":41284}}
files.shabads/82/41284.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41284,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208782","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208782,"last_verse_id":208785,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208782,"page_no":null,"line_no":257,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat saadh sa(n)g mil pooran braham prem bhagat bibek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious persons assemble in the company of saintly persons and meditating on the loving name of the Lord acquire knowledge of his loving worship."}}},{"verse_id":208783,"page_no":null,"line_no":257,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"roop kai anoop roop at asacharaj mai dhirasaT dharas liv Tarat na Tek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who is amazing and most beautiful being of the form of the True Guru, a Guru-conscious person cannot cast his eyes away even if he tries doing it."}}},{"verse_id":208784,"page_no":null,"line_no":257,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raag naadh baadh bisamaadh keeratan samai sabadh surat giaan gosaT anek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For a Guru-conscious person, the melody of wonder and astonishment is the singing of paeans of the Lord to the accompaniment of musical instruments. Engrossing the mind in the divine word is like participating in many debates and discussions."}}},{"verse_id":208785,"page_no":null,"line_no":257,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਚਾਹ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਦੀਵ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੪॥","translit_en":"bhaavanee bhai bhai chai chaeh charanaamirat kee aas pria sadheev a(n)g sa(n)g jaavadhek hai ||254||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With devotion, respect and love for the Lord and craze for meeting Him, Guru-oriented person is ever desirous of obtaining the elixir of the feet of the True Guru. Every limb of such a devotee craves and hopes to meet the dear Lord. (254)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41283,"next":41285}}
