{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41285,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208786","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208786,"last_verse_id":208789,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208786,"page_no":null,"line_no":258,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"hom jag nieebedh kai poojaa anek jap tap sa(n)jam anek pu(n)n dhaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Performing ritualistic worships, making offerings to the gods, performing worship of many kinds, living life in penance and Strict discipline, making charity;"}}},{"verse_id":208787,"page_no":null,"line_no":258,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰੁ ਤੀਰਥ ਭਵਨ ਭੂਅ ਹਿਮਾਚਲ ਧਾਰਾ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਅਰਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal thal gir tar teerath bhavan bhooa himaachal dhaaraa agr arapan praan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Roaming in deserts, water bodies mountains, places of pilgrimage and wasteland, giving up life while approaching the snow clad summits of Himalaya;"}}},{"verse_id":208788,"page_no":null,"line_no":258,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸਾਅੰਗੀਤ ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਬਹੁ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"raag naadh baadh saa(n)geet bedh paaTh bahu sahaj samaadh saadh koT jog dhiaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Performing recitation of Vedas, singing in modes to the accompaniment of musical instruments, practicing obstinate exercises of Yoga, and indulging in millions of contemplations of Yogic discipline;"}}},{"verse_id":208789,"page_no":null,"line_no":258,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਉ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਹਠ ਜਤਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥੨੫੫॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur sikh saadh sa(n)g par vaar ddaarau nigreh haTh jatan koTaan kai ||255||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Abstaining the senses from vices and trying other obstinate practices of Yoga, all this is sacrificed by a Guru-conscious person over the company of saintly persons and the refuge of the True Guru. All these practices are trivial and inane. (255)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41284,"next":41286}}
files.shabads/82/41286.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41286,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208790","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208790,"last_verse_id":208793,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208790,"page_no":null,"line_no":259,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਸਿ ਮਧੁ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਖਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan samasar na pujas madh karak sabadh sar bikh na bikham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sweetness of honey cannot match the sweetness of sweetly spoken words. No poison is as discomforting as bitter words."}}},{"verse_id":208791,"page_no":null,"line_no":259,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਸ ਤਪਤ ਕਟੁ ਕਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan seetalataa misaTaan paan karak sabadh s tapat kaT kam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sweet words cools the mind as cold drinks cool the body and provide comfort (during summer), but highly bitter thing is nothing compared to very sharp and harsh words."}}},{"verse_id":208792,"page_no":null,"line_no":259,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਉ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਅਸੰਤੋਖ ਦੋਖ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan kai tirapat aau sa(n)tokh saa(n)t karak sabadh asa(n)tokh dhokh sram hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sweet words render one with peace, satiation and contentment whereas harsh words create restlessness, vice and fatigue."}}},{"verse_id":208793,"page_no":null,"line_no":259,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਲਗਿ ਅਗਮ ਸੁਗਮ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਕ ਸਬਦ ਲਗਿ ਸੁਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੬॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan lag agam sugam hoi karak sabadh lag sugam agam hai ||256||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sweet words make a difficult task easy to perform whereas harsh and bitter words make an easy task difficult to accomplish. (256)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41285,"next":41287}}
files.shabads/82/41287.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41287,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208794","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208794,"last_verse_id":208797,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208794,"page_no":null,"line_no":260,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat saadh sa(n)g mil bhaan giaan jot ko udhot pragaTaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient Sikh of the Guru unites the divine word with his consciousness in the company of saintly persons. That illuminates a light of Guru's knowledge in his mind"}}},{"verse_id":208795,"page_no":null,"line_no":260,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਭ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਛਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naabh saravar bikhai braham kamal dhal hoi prafulit bimal jal chhaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a lotus flower blooms with the rise of the Sun, so does the lotus in the navel-region pond of a Sikh of the Guru blossoms with the rising of the Sun of Guru's knowledge that helps him make spiritual progress. Meditation of Naam then progresses with every breath."}}},{"verse_id":208796,"page_no":null,"line_no":260,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਿਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"madh makara(n)dh ras prem paripooran kai man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the development as described above, the bumble beelike mind absorbs in the peace-giving fragrant elixir of Naam captured by love. He is engrossed in the bliss of Naam Simran."}}},{"verse_id":208797,"page_no":null,"line_no":260,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੋਦ ਅਮੋਦ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੋਦ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਇਓ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੭॥","translit_en":"akath kathaa binodh modh amodh liv unaman hoi manodh anat na dhaio hai ||257||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The description of the ecstatic state of a Guru oriented person absorbed in His name is beyond words. Intoxicated in this higher spiritual state, his mind does not wander anywhere else. (257)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41286,"next":41288}}
files.shabads/82/41288.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41288,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208798","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208798,"last_verse_id":208801,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208798,"page_no":null,"line_no":261,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਚੋ ਪਾਰੋ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਖਾਇਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਕਲੰਕ ਹੁਇ ਕਲੰਕਨ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kaacho paaro mahaa bikham khaio na jai maare nihakala(n)k hui kala(n)kan miTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as raw mercury is very harmful to eat but when treated and processed, it becomes edible and a medicine to cure many ailments."}}},{"verse_id":208799,"page_no":null,"line_no":261,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਕਾਰਨ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"taise man sabadh beechaar maar haumai meT paraupakaaree hui bikaaran ghaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So should the mind be treated with the words of wisdom of the Guru. Dispelling ego and pride, then becoming benevolent it reduces other vices. It frees the evil and vice-ridden people from evil deeds."}}},{"verse_id":208800,"page_no":null,"line_no":261,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਹੁਇ ਮਿਲਤ ਚੂਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g adham asaadh hui milat choonaa jiau ta(n)bol ras ra(n)g pragaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a lowly person joins the saintly congregation, he too becomes superior just as lime when joined by a betel leaf and other ingredients yield beautiful red colour."}}},{"verse_id":208801,"page_no":null,"line_no":261,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੨੫੮॥","translit_en":"taise hee cha(n)chal chit bhramat chatur ku(n)T charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT samaaviee ||258||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So would a base and frolicsome mind wandering in four directions get absorbed in the blissful spiritual state by coming into the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru and the blessing of the saintly assembly. (258)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41287,"next":41289}}
files.shabads/82/41289.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41289,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208802","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208802,"last_verse_id":208805,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208802,"page_no":null,"line_no":262,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਬਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag hui dhaavat baraj raakhai sahaj bisraam dhaam nihachal baas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person is able to arrest the wandering of the mind by following the teachings of the Guru. He is thus able to live in stable, peaceful and equipoise state."}}},{"verse_id":208803,"page_no":null,"line_no":262,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਊਪ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮ ਦਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran raj roop kai anoop uoop dharas dharas sam dharas pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Coming into the refuge of the True Guru and feeling the holy dust of the True Guru's feet, a Guru-conscious person becomes beautiful of radiance. Beholding a glimpse of the True Guru, he is enlightened with the rare quality of treating all living beings alike."}}},{"verse_id":208804,"page_no":null,"line_no":262,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv bajar kapaaT khule anahadh naadh bisamaadh ko bisavaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the union of Guru's teachings with consciousness and achieving absorption in Naam, his ego and arrogance of self-assertion is destroyed. Hearing the sweet tune of Naam Simran, he experiences an astonishing state."}}},{"verse_id":208805,"page_no":null,"line_no":262,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਅਲੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਕੈ ਅਲੇਖ ਭਏ ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੯॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat baanee alekh lekh kai alekh bhe paradhachhanaa kai sukh dhaasan ke dhaas hai ||259||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By imbibing the unreachable teachings of the Guru in mind, a Guru-conscious person is freed from rendering account of his life before God. By the circumambulation of the True Guru, he achieves spiritual comfort. Living in humility, he serves as servant of the servants of the True Guru. (259)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41288,"next":41290}}
files.shabads/82/41290.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41290,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208806","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208806,"last_verse_id":208809,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208806,"page_no":null,"line_no":263,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਅਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh saadh roop ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab dheh kai bidheh aau sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes divinely of form and complexion. Every limb of his body radiates the glow of the Guru. He becomes free of all external adorations. (260)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41289,"next":41291}}
files.shabads/82/41291.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41291,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208810","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208810,"last_verse_id":208813,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208810,"page_no":null,"line_no":264,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਕੋ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag hui bhraman ko bhram khoio charan saran gur ek Tek dhaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By becoming a traveller on the path set by the True Guru, disciple of the Guru sheds the illusion of wandering at places and takes the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208811,"page_no":null,"line_no":264,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਦਰਸਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dharas samadharas dhiaan dhaar sabadh surat kai sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Concentrating his mind on the True Guru, he starts looking at others as equal. By the union of the True Guru's blessed teaching in his consciousness, he becomes divine from being worldly."}}},{"verse_id":208812,"page_no":null,"line_no":264,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਜਗੁ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur sevaa kar sur nar sevak hai maan gur aagiaa sabh jag aagiaakaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By serving the True Guru diligently, gods and other humans become his servants. Having obeyed the command of the True Guru, the whole world then starts obeying him."}}},{"verse_id":208813,"page_no":null,"line_no":264,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੧॥","translit_en":"poojaa praan praanapat sarab nidhaan dhaan paaras paras gat paraupakaaree hai ||261||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By worshipping the life granting and bestower of all treasures of the world, he becomes like a philosopher-stone. Whosoever comes in his contact, he does good turn to him. (261)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41290,"next":41292}}
files.shabads/82/41292.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41292,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208814","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208814,"last_verse_id":208817,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208814,"page_no":null,"line_no":265,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਹਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਸੁ ਥੋਰੀ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur mihamaa kahai su thoree kathanee badhanee baadh net net net hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How much one may praise the True Guru, the embodiment of the complete God on the Earth, is still not enough. It is futile to say in words because He is infinite, limitless and fathomless."}}},{"verse_id":208815,"page_no":null,"line_no":265,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੁ ਕਾਂ ਕੀ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran sarab miee ni(n)dhaa kareeaai su kaa(n) kee namo namo het hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru the embodiment of all-pervading Lord is completely manifested in all living beings. Then who should be cursed and slandered? He is worthy of salutation again and again."}}},{"verse_id":208816,"page_no":null,"line_no":265,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਬਿਵਰਜਿਤ ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taahee te bivarajit asatut ni(n)dhaa dhouoo akath kathaa beechaar mon brat let hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And it is for this reason that a Guru-conscious person is forbidden to praise or slander anyone. He remains engrossed in the contemplation of the indescribable True Guru of unique form."}}},{"verse_id":208817,"page_no":null,"line_no":265,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੨॥","translit_en":"baal budh sudh kar dheh kai bidheh bhe jeevan mukat gat bisam suchet hai ||262||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A disciple of the Guru advances towards the state of living dead by leading a life of childlike innocence and discarding all external adorations. files.shabads/82/41293.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41293,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208818","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208818,"last_verse_id":208821,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208818,"page_no":null,"line_no":266,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at prem kai parasapar bisam sathaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The importance of assembling in the company of obedient disciples of the True Guru is very significant. Because of a sight of the True Guru, his attention from other interests wane away. By His glimpse, he becomes unaware of all that is around him."}}},{"verse_id":208820,"page_no":null,"line_no":266,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਸਬਦ ਹਰੇ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਗਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh kai surat surat kai sabadh hare kahat sunat gat rahat na giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of Guru's disciples, one hears the melody of Guru's words and that dispels listening of other melodies cram the mind. files.shabads/82/41294.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41294,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208822","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208822,"last_verse_id":208825,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208822,"page_no":null,"line_no":267,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਲਗ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਨ ਪੜਤ ਅਉਰ ਕਉ ਅਉਰ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤ ਪੂਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise lag maatr heen paRat aaur kau aaur pitaa poot poot pitaa samasar jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a word devoid of vowel symbol would sound different, word 'pita' and 'putt' would be read alike."}}},{"verse_id":208823,"page_no":null,"line_no":267,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਅਉਰ ਕਹੇ ਅਉਰ ਕਛੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮੈ ਆਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"surat bihoon jaise baavaro bakhaaneeat aaur kahe aaur kachh hiradhai mai aaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person is called demented when not in his full senses, he understands different than what is being said."}}},{"verse_id":208824,"page_no":null,"line_no":267,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁੰਗ ਸਭਾ ਮਧਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਬਾਤ ਬੋਲਤ ਹਸਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gu(n)g sabhaa madh keh na sakat baat bolat hasai hoi bachan bidhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mute person cannot express himself in any gathering, even if he tries to utter a word, he becomes a laughing stock for all,"}}},{"verse_id":208825,"page_no":null,"line_no":267,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਥਕਤ ਹੁਇ ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੬੪॥","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag mai manmukh thakat hui lagan sagan maane kaise man maaneeaai ||264||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No self-oriented or self-willed person can tread the path of Guru-conscious persons. How can one feel persuaded to tread the path of Guru-conscious people when one is bound by the omens-good or bad. (264)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41293,"next":41295}}
files.shabads/82/41295.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41295,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208826","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208826,"last_verse_id":208829,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208826,"page_no":null,"line_no":268,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਛਬਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan chhab roop ra(n)g sobhaa nidh koTin koTaan koT jagamag jot kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite presence of millions of beauties, forms, complexions, treasure-houses of splendour and glory, presence of lights effulgent;"}}},{"verse_id":208827,"page_no":null,"line_no":268,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਭਾਗ ਪ੍ਰਭੁਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਉਦੋਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan raaj bhaag prabhutaa prataap koTin koTaan sukh aana(n)dh udhot kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Appearing of kingdoms, rules, grandeurs and glory, comforts and peace;"}}},{"verse_id":208828,"page_no":null,"line_no":268,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਨ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan raag naadh baadh giaan gun koTin koTaan jog bhog ot pot kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite presence of millions of tunes and melodies of music, classical knowledge, pleasures and relishments integrated like weft and woof,"}}},{"verse_id":208829,"page_no":null,"line_no":268,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਤਿਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਕੈ ॥੨੬੫॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan til mahimaa agaadh bodh namo namo dhirasaT dharas sabadh srot kai ||265||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All these glories are paltry. The glory of merging once consciousness in the words of Guru, a glimpse of and a graceful look of the True Guru is beyond expression. Salutations to Him again and again. (265)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41294,"next":41296}}
files.shabads/82/41296.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41296,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208830","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208830,"last_verse_id":208833,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208830,"page_no":null,"line_no":269,"gurmukhi":"ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮਦਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਸਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛਰਤ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਆਪਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"ahinis bhramat kamal kumadhanee ko sas mil bichharat sog harakh biaapahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The lotus longs for the sun during the day while the Nymphea lotus longs for the moon at night. The lotus is distressed during the night and happy during the day. The Nymphea lotus is distressed during the day and happy at night."}}},{"verse_id":208831,"page_no":null,"line_no":269,"gurmukhi":"ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਿਲਾਪਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"rav sas ula(n)gh saran satigur gahee charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT milaapahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Going beyond the attitude of the Sun and Moon where they meet or separate from their beloved, a Guru-conscious person takes the refuge of the True Guru, and remains absorbed in the tranquil and comforting holy feet of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208832,"page_no":null,"line_no":269,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸੁਬਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਜਾਪਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh nij aasan subaasan kai madh makara(n)dh ras lubhit ajaapahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bumble bee is enamored by the fragrance of a flower and remains enticed in its love, so does a Guru-oriented person remains engrossed in the fragrance of elixir-like Naam in the seat of the mystical tenth door."}}},{"verse_id":208833,"page_no":null,"line_no":269,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਅਲਾਪਹੀ ॥੨੬੬॥","translit_en":"tiragun ateet hui bisraam nihakaam dhaam unaman magan anaahadh alaapahee ||266||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Free from the influence of three traits of the maya (mammon), a Guru-conscious person is ever absorbed in singing the melody of the Naam in the mystical tenth door state of high spirituality. (266)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41295,"next":41297}}
files.shabads/82/41297.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41297,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208834","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208834,"last_verse_id":208837,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208834,"page_no":null,"line_no":270,"gurmukhi":"ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦਰਸ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮਦਨੀ ਹਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਬਿਓਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rav sas dharas kamal kumadhanee hit bhramat bhramat man sa(n)jogee biogee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Both lotus and Nymphea lotus crave for a sight of The Sun and The Moon respectively. Because of their meeting and separating frequently, their love is besmirched."}}},{"verse_id":208835,"page_no":null,"line_no":270,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰੋਗ ਰਹਤ ਅਰੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tiragun ateet gur charan kamal ras madh makara(n)dh rog rahat arogee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person is ever engrossed in the elixir-like relishment of True Guru's feet after freeing himself from the influence of three traits of maya (mammon). His love is blemishless."}}},{"verse_id":208836,"page_no":null,"line_no":270,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੈ ਲੋਗ ਮੈ ਅਲੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nihachal makara(n)dh sukh sa(n)paT sahaj dhun sabadh anaahadh kai log mai alogee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a God-oriented person stays free from the worldly affairs and remains engrossed in the mystical tenth door because of the unstruck music melody that keeps playing ere."}}},{"verse_id":208837,"page_no":null,"line_no":270,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਜੋਗੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal mahimaa agaadh bodh jog bhog alakh nira(n)jan prajogee hai ||267||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wondrous state and glory of such a Guru-oriented person is beyond explanation and description. Guru-oriented person remains absorbed in the Lord who is imperceptible, beyond worldly pleasures, yet who is a yogi and a relisher (Bhogi) as well. (267)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41296,"next":41298}}
files.shabads/82/41298.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41298,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208838","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208838,"last_verse_id":208841,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208838,"page_no":null,"line_no":271,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਦਨੁ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤ ਐਸੇ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਸਾਖੀ ਭੂਤ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dharapan bikhai badhan bilokeeat aaise saragun saakhee bhoot gur dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As one sees one's face in the mirror, so is the True Guru, the image of Transcendental God that can be comprehended by concentrating the mind on True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208839,"page_no":null,"line_no":271,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਜਤ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਕੋ ਮਨੁ ਤੈਸੇ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ja(n)tr dhun bikhai baajat ja(n)tree ko man taise ghaT ghaT gur sabadh giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the player's mind is in harmony with the tune that he is playing on his musical instrument, so is the knowledge of absolute God merged in the words of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208840,"page_no":null,"line_no":271,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਸੈਂ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach kram jatr katr sai(n) ikatr bhe pooran pragaas prem param nidhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of contemplation on the lotus feet of the True Guru and practicing his teachings in life, concentrating the mind that wanders about due to spurious utterances and deeds, a Guru-conscious person becomes a lover of the great treasure of Lord's name. That enlightens him and his inner self."}}},{"verse_id":208841,"page_no":null,"line_no":271,"gurmukhi":"ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਗਗਨ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੮॥","translit_en":"aunaman magan gagan anahadh dhun sahaj samaadh niraala(n)b nirabaan hai ||268||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By contemplating the Guru's teachings, the disciple acquires higher spiritual state and is immersed in the melodious tune that plays in his mystical tenth door. In this state of equipoise,the eternal being destroys all his wants and desires. (268)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41297,"next":41299}}
files.shabads/82/41299.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41299,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208842","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208842,"last_verse_id":208845,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208842,"page_no":null,"line_no":272,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਮਿਲਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan dhiaan dhirasaT dharas mil at asacharaj mai herat hiraae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wondrous and marvellous state that befalls upon a Sikh of the True Guru when he integrates his vision in that of the Lord, defeats millions of other contemplations."}}},{"verse_id":208843,"page_no":null,"line_no":272,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਨ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan giaan sabadh surat mil mahimaa mahaatam na alakh lakhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The importance of union of Guru's words in the consciousness of a Guru-devoted Sikh is beyond comprehension. That glory and grandeur cannot be reached by the knowledge of millions of books and tomes."}}},{"verse_id":208844,"page_no":null,"line_no":272,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਲ ਕੀ ਅਤੁਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਤੁਲਤ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਪਾਰ ਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"til kee atul sobhaa tulat na tulaadhaar paar kai apaar na ana(n)t a(n)t paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even a little glory (equivalent to a sesame seed) in respect of a Sikh, who has achieved union with the Guru's words, is beyond assessment and evaluation. That grandeur is infinite and limitless, and can never be weighed or assessed."}}},{"verse_id":208845,"page_no":null,"line_no":272,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਾਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਬਾਰੰਬਾਰ ਨ ਅਘਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੯॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan cha(n)dhr bhaan jot ko udhot hot balihaar baara(n)baar na aghaae hai ||269||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a result of the light effulgence in the Sikh of the Guru who has perpetually practiced in his mind the contemplation on the words of the Guru millions of Moons and Suns go sacrifice unto him again and again. (269)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41298,"next":41300}}
files.shabads/82/41300.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41300,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208846","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208846,"last_verse_id":208849,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208846,"page_no":null,"line_no":273,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਰੋਮ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਕਹਾ ਧੌ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"koT brahamaa(n)dd jaa(n) ke ek rom agrabhaag pooran pragaas taas kahaa dhau samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who has millions of Universes existing in the tip of His each hair, to what extent is His complete radiance spread?"}}},{"verse_id":208847,"page_no":null,"line_no":273,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਹਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa(n) ke ek til ko mahaatam agaadh bodh pooran braham jot kaise keh aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord-significance of whose marvellous and wonderful radiance equal to a sesame seed is beyond description, how can His complete light be described?"}}},{"verse_id":208848,"page_no":null,"line_no":273,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਗਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕੈਸੇ ਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa ke oa(n)kaar ke bithaar kee apaar gat sabadh bibek ek jeeh kaise gaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose complete extent and expanse is infinite, how can a tongue describe His divine word and His divine form the True Guru?"}}},{"verse_id":208849,"page_no":null,"line_no":273,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਮਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕਰਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੨੭੦॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur mahamaa akath kathaa net net net namo namo kar aaviee ||270||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Praise and panegyrics of the True Guru who is an image of the complete Lord is beyond mention and elucidation. The best way to express one's love and respect for Him is to salute Him again and again while addressing Him- \"0 Lord, Master! You are infinite, infinite.\" (270)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41299,"next":41301}}

॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The bumble bee-like mind of a Guru-oriented person acquires strange comfort and peace by meditating on the nectar-like dust of the feet of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":208851,"page_no":null,"line_no":274,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਥਲ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"param suga(n)dh at komal seetalataa kai bimal sathal nihachal na ddulaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of the influence of strange fragrance and very more."}}},{"verse_id":208852,"page_no":null,"line_no":274,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਨਝੁਨ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਰ ਗਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh at agam agaadh liv anahadh runajhun dhun ur gaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In a state of equipoise and by virtue of inaccessible and immeasurable concentration, he keeps repeating the sweet rune of Naam giaan dhiaan simaran bisaraane hai ||271||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By acquiring the great treasure of the Lord's name who is light supreme and complete in all respects, he forgets all other forms (271)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41300,"next":41302}}
files.shabads/82/41302.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41302,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208854","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208854,"last_verse_id":208857,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208854,"page_no":null,"line_no":275,"gurmukhi":"ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਹੰਕਾਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਹਕ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raj tam sat kaam krodh lobh moh ha(n)kaar haar gur giaan baan kraa(n)t nihakraa(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of initiation by the Guru and practicing of meditation on the Lord's name, all the traits of maya (Raja, Sato, Tamo) and vices like lust, anger, avarice, attachment and pride are defeated. Their influence also becomes negligible."}}},{"verse_id":208855,"page_no":null,"line_no":275,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਨਿਹਭ੍ਰਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaam nihakaam nihakaram karam gat aasaa kai niraas bhe bhraa(n)t nihabhraa(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the acquisition of Guru's knowledge, a Guru-oriented person loses attachment with all desires, and all his actions become benevolent. All his worldly desires end and his wandering stops."}}},{"verse_id":208856,"page_no":null,"line_no":275,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਨਿਹ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਰੁ ਬਾਦ ਨਿਹ ਬਾਦ ਭਏ ਅਸੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਨਿਸਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਗੇਹ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaadh neh savaiaadh ar baadh neh baadh bhe asa(n) preh nisapreh dheh geh paa(n)t hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-oriented person becomes free of all attachments and relishments by virtue of Guru's teachings. Engrossed in Naam Simran, he does not indulge in other debates and arguments. He becomes totally desireless and contended. His attachment with worldly attractions ends."}}},{"verse_id":208857,"page_no":null,"line_no":275,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਸਿਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਏਕਾਕੀ ਏਕਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੨॥","translit_en":"gurmukh prem ras bisam bidheh sikh maiaa mai udhaas baas ekaakee ekaa(n)t hai ||272||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtues of Naam Simran, a follower of Guru's teachings become free of all his body needs. He remains in a state of . trance and unsullied in maya. He is ever engrossed in the memory of the Lord. (272)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41301,"next":41303}}
files.shabads/82/41303.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41303,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208858","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208858,"last_verse_id":208861,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208858,"page_no":null,"line_no":276,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਹੀ ਤਿਲ ਬੋਏ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੂਟੁ ਬਾਧੈ ਏਕ ਸੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"piratham hee til boe dhoor mil booT baadhai ek sai anek hot pragaT sa(n)saar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A sesame seed is Sown that mixes with earth to become a plant. One seed gives several seeds and spreads in the world in many forms."}}},{"verse_id":208859,"page_no":null,"line_no":276,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਚਬਾਇ ਕੋਊ ਖਾਲ ਕਾਢੈ ਰੇਵਰੀ ਕੈ ਕੋਊ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਲਵਾ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਬਾਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo lai chabai kouoo khaal kaaddai revaree kai kouoo karai tilavaa milai gur baar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Some munch them (sesame seeds), some coat sugar balls with them (Rewari) while others mix them with jaggery syrup and make cake/biscuit like eatables."}}},{"verse_id":208860,"page_no":null,"line_no":276,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਉਖਲੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਕੂਟਿ ਤਿਲ ਕੁਟ ਕਰੈ ੂ ਕੋਊ ਕੋਲ੍ਹੂ ਪੀਰਿ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤਿ ਅੰਧਿਆਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo ukhalee ddaar kooT til kuT karai oo kouoo kolhoo peer dheep dhipat a(n)dhiaar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Some grind them and mix them with milk paste to make a form of sweet-meat, some squeeze them to extract oil and use it for burning lamp and lighting up their homes."}}},{"verse_id":208861,"page_no":null,"line_no":276,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੇ ਏਕ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਤ ਆਵੈ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਤ ਆਵਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਮੈ ॥੨੭੩॥","translit_en":"jaa ke ek til ko beechaar na kahit aavai abigat gat kat aavat beechaar mai ||273||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When multiplicity of one sesame seed of the creator cannot be explained, how can the unknowable, formless Lord be known? (273)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41302,"next":41304}}
files.shabads/82/41304.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41304,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208862","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208862,"last_verse_id":208865,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208862,"page_no":null,"line_no":277,"gurmukhi":"ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਏਕ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੋ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"rachanaa charitr chitr bisam bachitr pan ek cheeTee ko charitr kahat na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The picture of miraculous creation of the Creator-God is full of wonder and awe. We cannot even describe the deeds of a small ant created by Him."}}},{"verse_id":208863,"page_no":null,"line_no":277,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਦੇਖੋ ਸਹਸ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਬਿਲ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pratham hee cheeTee ke milaap ko prataap dhekho sahas anek ek bil mai samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just see how thousands of ants get organised in a small burrow/hole."}}},{"verse_id":208864,"page_no":null,"line_no":277,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਛੈ ਏਕੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਵਤ ਮਿਠਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਤਹੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"agrabhaagee paachhai ekai maarag chalat jaat paavat miThaas baas tahee mil dhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All of them tread and walk on the same path that is defined by the leading ant. Wherever they smell sweetness, they all reach there."}}},{"verse_id":208865,"page_no":null,"line_no":277,"gurmukhi":"ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਾਤਕਾਲ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗੀ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਚੀਟੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲਖ ਚਿਤੇਰੈ ਕਤ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੨੭੪॥","translit_en":"bhira(n)gee mil taatakaal bhira(n)gee roop hui dhikhaavai cheeTee chitr alakh chiterai kat paaviee ||274||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting an insect with wings, they adopt their life-style. When we are unable to know the wonders of a small ant, how can we know the super naturalness of the Creator who has created countless things in this universe? (274)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41303,"next":41305}}
files.shabads/82/41305.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41305,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208866","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208866,"last_verse_id":208869,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208866,"page_no":null,"line_no":278,"gurmukhi":"ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤੁ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rachanaa charitr chit bisam bachitr pan ghaT ghaT ek hee anek hui dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Creation of the wonderful play of the creator's creation is amazing and astonishing. He alone resides in all in several shapes and forms."}}},{"verse_id":208867,"page_no":null,"line_no":278,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਤ ਇਤ ਪਢਤ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਇਤ ਹੰੂ ਤੇ ਲਿਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਉਤਰ ਪਠਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aut te likhat it paddat a(n)taragat it ha(n)oo te likh prat utar paThaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a letter is written by somebody who sends it to someone in another city, it is read there and after understanding it sends back a reply."}}},{"verse_id":208868,"page_no":null,"line_no":278,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤ ਤੇ ਸਬਦ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਇਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਕੈ ਉਤ ਸਮਝਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aut te sabadh raag naadh ko prasa(n)n kar it sun samajh kai ut samajhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a singer sings a song in a mode and tune that pleases someone who understands it and educate others about it."}}},{"verse_id":208869,"page_no":null,"line_no":278,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖਿਯਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੫॥","translit_en":"ratan pareekhiyaa pekh paramit kai sunaavai gurmukh sa(n)dh mile alakh lakhaae hai ||275||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a jewel evaluator inspects a jewel, learns about its characteristics and educate others about it, so would a Guru oriented Sikh who has become one with True Guru by virtue of His teachings and words, he alone can brief and educate others about the imperceptible Lord. (275)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41304,"next":41306}}
files.shabads/82/41306.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41306,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208870","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208870,"last_verse_id":208873,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208870,"page_no":null,"line_no":279,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਨੋ ਸਾਚ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran kirapaa kai dheeno saach upadhes ridhai nihachal mat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Perfect Guru, embodiment of complete Lord becoming kind lodges true sermon in the heart of a disciple of the Guru. That makes him stable of intelligence and saves him from wanderings."}}},{"verse_id":208871,"page_no":null,"line_no":279,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਪੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv leen jal meen bhe pooran sarab miee pai ghirat jugat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in the word, his condition becomes like that of a fish enjoying the bliss of his surroundings. He then realises the presence of God in everyone just as fat, that is present in all milks."}}},{"verse_id":208872,"page_no":null,"line_no":279,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saach ridhai saach dhekhai sunai bolai ga(n)dh ras pooran parasapar bhaavanee bhagat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lord resides in the heart of a Sikh who sees him everywhere, hears Him, enjoys His sweet smell, and relishes his name with his tongue. Feeling the presence of the perfect Lord, loving worship resides in his heart."}}},{"verse_id":208873,"page_no":null,"line_no":279,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫੂਲ ਫਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੬॥","translit_en":"pooran braham dhraum saakhaa patr fool fal ek hee anek mek satigur sat hai ||276||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru who is eternal of form has dispensed this knowledge that just as the seed resides in the trees, plants, branches, flowers etc, one God who is perfect and all-knowing pervades in all. (276)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41305,"next":41307}}
files.shabads/82/41307.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41307,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208874","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208874,"last_verse_id":208877,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208874,"page_no":null,"line_no":280,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਗਤਿ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur pooran param jot ot pot sootr gat ek hee anek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The complete Lord has permeated Himself in His creation like weft and woof of a cloth. Despite being one, He has manifested Himself into many forms. The complete light of the perfect Lord resides in the consummate Guru like weft and woof."}}},{"verse_id":208875,"page_no":null,"line_no":280,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸ੍ਰੋਤ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੂਲ ਗਤਿ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan sravan srot ek hee dharas sabadh vaar paar kool gat saritaa bibek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Although eyesight and hearing power of ears is different, yet their engrossment in divine words is alike. Just as both banks of a river are alike, so is the True Guru and the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":208876,"page_no":null,"line_no":280,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਜਾਨੀਅਤ ਜਾਵਦੈਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan banaasapatee kanik anik dhaat paaras paras jaaneeat jaavadhaik hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Various plants that grow near a sandalwood tree all have the fragrance of sandalwood; various metals by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone are turned into gold. In the same way, Vaheguru and the Guru are one."}}},{"verse_id":208877,"page_no":null,"line_no":280,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੭॥","translit_en":"giaan gur a(n)jan nira(n)jan a(n)jan bikhai dhubidhaa nivaar gurmat ek Tek hai ||277||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A seeker disciple of the Guru, who gets collorium of knowledge in his eyes from the True Guru, is free of all blemishes of maya even while living in it. He sheds all duality and takes refuge in the wisdom of the Guru. (277)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41306,"next":41308}}
files.shabads/82/41308.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41308,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208878","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208878,"last_verse_id":208881,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208878,"page_no":null,"line_no":281,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਚਲ ਭਈ ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸ੍ਰੁੁਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਅਚਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan liv dhirasaT achal bhiee sabadh bibek sraut sravan achal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By engrossment of his mind in the vision of True Guru, a true servant disciple of Guru achieves stability of mind. By the sound of exposition of Guru's words and Naam Simran, his power of reflection and recollection also stabilizes."}}},{"verse_id":208879,"page_no":null,"line_no":281,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਧਾ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਅਚਲ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਅਚਲ ਉਨਮਨ ਅਸਥਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"simaran maatr sudhaa jihabaa achal bhiee gur mat achal unaman asathal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By relishing the elixir-like Naam with tongue, his tongue desires nothing else. By virtue of his initiation and Guru's wisdom, he stays attached with his spiritual side of life."}}},{"verse_id":208880,"page_no":null,"line_no":281,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਕਰ ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਾਮ ਪਰਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naasikaa subaas kar komalataa seetalataa kai poojaa pranaam paras charan kamal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The nostrils enjoy the fragrance of the dust of True Guru's holy feet. Touching and sensing the tenderness and coolness of His holy feet and the head touching the holy feet, he becomes stable and tranquil."}}},{"verse_id":208881,"page_no":null,"line_no":281,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਚਰ ਅਚਰ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਲਿਲ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੮॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th char achar hui a(n)g a(n)g pa(n)g saraba(n)g boo(n)dh saagar salil hai ||278||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The feet become still following the path of the True Guru. Every limb becomes pious and like a drop of water mixing with the water of the ocean, he is absorbed in the service of the True Guru. (278)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41307,"next":41309}}
files.shabads/82/41309.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41309,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208882","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208882,"last_verse_id":208885,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208882,"page_no":null,"line_no":282,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan sobhaa dhirag dhirasaT giaan ga(n)m dhirasaT dhiaan prabh dharas ateet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing the well adored God-like True Guru with one's eyes, the devoted Sikh of the True Guru acquires the divine knowledge. By the focusing of mind in the vision of Lord Guru, one is freed from watching the worldly merriments."}}},{"verse_id":208883,"page_no":null,"line_no":282,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਪਰੈ ਜਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਅਲਖ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਨਾਸ ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat parai surat sabadh parai jaas baas alakh subaas naas reet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the sound of Naam Simran enters the ears, the ability of concentration of a Guru's disciple turns away from other sounds and modes. The fragrance of the Guru's words that is so supernatural, the nostrils become free of all other smells."}}},{"verse_id":208884,"page_no":null,"line_no":282,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸ ਕਰ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਰਾਜੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ras rasanaa rahit rasanaa rahit ras kar asaparas parasan karaajeet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tongue of practitioner of meditation becomes engrossed in the pleasure of Naam Simran and it becomes bereft of all other worldly tastes. The hands when able to touch and feel the untouchable Lord are freed from the impressions of touching worldly things:"}}},{"verse_id":208885,"page_no":null,"line_no":282,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਗਵਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਗਵਨ ਚਰਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੯॥","translit_en":"charan gavan ga(n)m gavan charan ga(n)m aas piaas bisam bisavaiaas pria preet hai ||279||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The feet of a Guru-oriented person tread towards the path of the True Guru. files.shabads/82/41310.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41310,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208886","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208886,"last_verse_id":208889,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208886,"page_no":null,"line_no":283,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sabadh surat haumai maar marai jeevan mukat jagajeevan kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person is freed from his self and ego by engrossment in Naam Simran. files.shabads/82/41311.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41311,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208890","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208890,"last_verse_id":208893,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208890,"page_no":null,"line_no":284,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran gur dhaavat baraj raakhai nihachal chit sukh sahaj nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The unique servant of the True Guru keeps the wandering mind under control by taking the refuge of the Guru and practicing meditation on the consecrated words of the Guru. The teachings and wisdom of the Guru takes over his mind."}}},{"verse_id":208892,"page_no":null,"line_no":284,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਹੋਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਈ ਭਲੋ ਮਾਨੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aapaa khoi honahaar hoi soiee bhalo maanai sevaa sarabaatam kai dhaasan ko dhaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He discards and destroys his self-assertion and accepts the dispensation of the Almighty as fair and just. He serves all living beings and thus becomes a slave of the slaves."}}},{"verse_id":208893,"page_no":null,"line_no":284,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਸਬਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੧॥","translit_en":"sree gur dharas sabadh braham giaan dhiaan pooran sarab miee braham bisavaiaas hai ||281||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By practicing the words of Guru, he acquires the divine knowledge and contemplation. files.shabads/82/41312.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41312,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208894","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208894,"last_verse_id":208897,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208894,"page_no":null,"line_no":285,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਮ ਨਿਰੁਦਮ ਉਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal kaam nihakaam keene gurmukh udham nirudham ukat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A disciple coming face to face of the Guru frees himself from all desires and wants by receiving the unique and comforting words of the True. files.shabads/82/41313.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41313,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208898","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208898,"last_verse_id":208901,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208898,"page_no":null,"line_no":286,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਨਾਦੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sree gur sabadh sun sravan kapaaT khule naadhai mil naadh anahadh liv laiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the sermon of the True Guru, ignorance of a Guru-conscious disciple is removed. files.shabads/82/41314.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41314,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208902","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208902,"last_verse_id":208905,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208902,"page_no":null,"line_no":287,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at prem kai parasapar pooran pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Significance of meeting of Guru and Guru-oriented men is limitless. files.shabads/82/41315.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41315,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208906","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208906,"last_verse_id":208909,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208906,"page_no":null,"line_no":288,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap at pooran pragaas prem nem kai parasapar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Significance of an obedient disciple of True Guru meeting with His congregation is highly astonishing. files.shabads/82/41316.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41316,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208910","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208910,"last_verse_id":208913,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208910,"page_no":null,"line_no":289,"gurmukhi":"ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਤਪਤ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"navan gavan jal seetal amal jaise agan uradh mukh tapat maleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As water flows downwards and consequently remains cold and clear, but fire goes upward and therefore burns and causes pollution."}}},{"verse_id":208911,"page_no":null,"line_no":289,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਿਲ ਬਰਨ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਆਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਬਰਨ ਛਬਿ ਛੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baran baran mil salil baran soiee siaam agan sarab baran chhab chheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water when mixed with different colours also turns into same shades but fire that blackens ruin the complexion and beauty of all that comes in its contact."}}},{"verse_id":208912,"page_no":null,"line_no":289,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਬਿੰਬ ਪਾਲਕ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਦਗਧ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal pratibi(n)b paalak prafulit banaasapatee agan pradhagadh karat sukh heen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water is like mirror, clean and good doer. It helps in the growth of vegetation, plants and trees. Fire consumes and burns the vegetation and destroys them. Therefore, it is distressing."}}},{"verse_id":208913,"page_no":null,"line_no":289,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh sa(n)gam subhaav gat gurmat dhuramat sukh dhukh heen hai ||286||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similar are the behaviour patterns of Guru-oriented and self oriented people. A Guru-oriented person gives peace and comfort to all since he lives under the refuge and direction of Guru; whereas a self-willed person is cause of sufferings for all because of his base wisdom. (286)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41315,"next":41317}}
files.shabads/82/41317.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41317,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208914","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208914,"last_verse_id":208917,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208914,"page_no":null,"line_no":290,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਇਆਰਥ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaam krodh lobh moh aha(n)mev kai asaadh saadh sat dharam dhiaarath sa(n)tokh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Self-willed persons remain engrossed in vices like lust, anger, greed, attachment, pride, whereas Guru-conscious persons are kind, sympathetic and contented."}}},{"verse_id":208915,"page_no":null,"line_no":290,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat saadh sa(n)g bhaavanee bhagat bhai dhuramat kai asaadh sa(n)g dhukh dhokh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the company of saintly persons, one attains faith, love and devotion; whereas in the company of base and fake people, one gets pain, suffering and base wisdom."}}},{"verse_id":208916,"page_no":null,"line_no":290,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਖ ਪਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤ ਚੋਖ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"janam maran gur charan saran bin mokh padh charan kamal chit chokh kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the refuge of the True Guru self-oriented persons fall in the cycle of birth and death. Obedient Sikhs of the Guru drink deep the nectar of Guru's words, imbibe them in their heart and thus achieve salvation."}}},{"verse_id":208917,"page_no":null,"line_no":290,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਸ ਹੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੰਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਸੋਖ ਪੋਖ ਕੈ ॥੨੮੭॥","translit_en":"giaan a(n)s ha(n)s gat gurmukh ba(n)s bikhai dhukirat sukirat kheer neer sokh pokh kai ||287||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the clan of Guru-conscious persons, knowledge is clean and invaluable like swans. Just as a swan is capable of separating milk from water, so do the Guru-oriented Sikhs discard all that is base and feel satiated with superior deeds. (287)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41316,"next":41318}}
files.shabads/82/41318.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41318,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208918","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208918,"last_verse_id":208921,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208918,"page_no":null,"line_no":291,"gurmukhi":"ਹਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਝਗਰੋ ਮਿਟਤ ਰੋਸ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਡੰਡੁ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"haar maanee jhagaro miTat ros maare sai rasain hui poT ddaare laagat na dda(n)dd jag jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accepting defeat ends all discords. Shedding anger gives much peace. If we discard the results/income of all our deeds/business, we are never taxed. This fact is known to the whole world."}}},{"verse_id":208919,"page_no":null,"line_no":291,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਮਤ ਨਵਨ ਥਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"haume abhimaan asathaan uooche naeh jal nimat navan thal jal pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The heart where ego and pride dwells is like a high ground where no water can accumulate. Lord cannot stay either."}}},{"verse_id":208920,"page_no":null,"line_no":291,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਤਰਹਰ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਚਰਨ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)g saraba(n)g tarahar hot hai charan taa te charanaamirat charan ren maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Feet are located at the lowest end of the body. That is why the dust of the feet and the foot wash are regarded sacred and thus respected."}}},{"verse_id":208921,"page_no":null,"line_no":291,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਜਗ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ॥੨੮੮॥","translit_en":"taise har bhagat jagat mai ni(n)maree bhoot jag pag lag masatak paravaaneeaai ||288||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the devotee and worshipper of God who is sans pride and full of humility. The whole world falls at his feet and consider their forehead blessed. (288)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41317,"next":41319}}
files.shabads/82/41319.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41319,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208922","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208922,"last_verse_id":208925,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208922,"page_no":null,"line_no":292,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਸੀਸੁ ਈਸ ਊਚੌ ਦੇਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"poojeeaai na sees iees uoochau dhehee mai kahaavai poojeeaai na lochan dhirasaT dhirasaTaa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Head is located above all other parts of the body but is not worshipped. Nor are eyes worshipped which see far in the distance."}}},{"verse_id":208923,"page_no":null,"line_no":292,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਕ੍ਰਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"poojeeaai na sravan surat sanaba(n)dh kar poojeeaai na naasikaa subaas savaiaas kraa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ears are not worshipped for their power of hearing nor nostrils for their ability to smell and breathe."}}},{"verse_id":208924,"page_no":null,"line_no":292,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਮੁਖ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਬਦ ਸੰਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨ ਹਸਤ ਸਕਲ ਅੰਗ ਪਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"poojeeaai na mukh savaiaadh sabadh sa(n)jugat kai poojeeaai na hasat sakal a(n)g paa(n)t kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mouth which enjoys all the tastes and make speech, is not worshipped nor the hands which nourish all other limbs."}}},{"verse_id":208925,"page_no":null,"line_no":292,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਰਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਨਵਨ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਕੈ ॥੨੮੯॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT sabadh surat ga(n)dh ras rahit hui poojeeaai padhaarabi(n)dh navan mahaa(n)t kai ||289||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Feet which are devoid of ability to see, talk, hear, smell or taste are worshipped for their traits of humility. (289)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41318,"next":41320}}
files.shabads/82/41320.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41320,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208926","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208926,"last_verse_id":208929,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208926,"page_no":null,"line_no":293,"gurmukhi":"ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੈ ਨਵਨ ਬਸੰੁਧਰ ਸਰਬ ਰਸ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"navan gavan jal niramal seetal hai navan basa(n)udhar sarab ras raas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water that flows downward is always cool and clear. The earth that remains under the feet of all is the treasure-house of all the goods that are pleasurable and worth relishing."}}},{"verse_id":208927,"page_no":null,"line_no":293,"gurmukhi":"ਉਰਧ ਤਪਸਿਆ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰੀਖੰਡ ਬਾਸੁ ਬੋਹੈ ਬਨ ਨਵਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੋਤ ਰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"auradh tapasiaa kai sreekha(n)dd baas bohai ban navan samu(n)dhr hot ratan pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sandalwood tree wilted under the weight of its branches and leaves as if in supplication, spreads its fragrance and makes all the vegetation in the near vicinity fragrant."}}},{"verse_id":208928,"page_no":null,"line_no":293,"gurmukhi":"ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਪਗ ਪੂਜੀਅਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਚਾਹੈ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਤਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"navan gavan pag poojeeat jagat mai chaahai charanaamirat charan raj taas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Of all the limbs of body, feet which remain on earth and at the lowest end of the body are worshipped. The whole world desires nectar and dust of holy feet."}}},{"verse_id":208929,"page_no":null,"line_no":293,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਨਿੰਮਰੀ ਭੂਤ ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੦॥","translit_en":"taise har bhagat jagat mai ni(n)maree bhoot kaam nihakaam dhaam bisam bisavaiaas hai ||290||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the worshippers of the Lord live as humble human beings in the world. Unsullied by the worldly sensualities, they remain stable and unmoved in unique love and devotion. (290)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41319,"next":41321}}
files.shabads/82/41321.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41321,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208930","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208930,"last_verse_id":208933,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208930,"page_no":null,"line_no":294,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਹੁਇ ਉਲਟ ਪਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv leen jal meen gat sukhamanaa sa(n)gam hui ulaT pavan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fish swims through towards upstream swiftly, so does a disciple of Guru engrossed in the Guru's word crosses the confluence of all the three veins (Irha, Pingla and Sukhmana) with the methodology of reverse breathing/air."}}},{"verse_id":208931,"page_no":null,"line_no":294,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਧੁ ਅਪੀਉ ਪੀਐ ਗੁਹਜੁ ਗਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"bisam bisavaiaas bikhai anabhai abhiaas ras prem madh apeeau peeaai guhaj gavan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming fearless in the strange devotion and love, engrossed in the practice of Naam Simran and reaching there through strangely mysterious ways, one drinks deep the loving eternal nectar."}}},{"verse_id":208932,"page_no":null,"line_no":294,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਉਨਮਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਸਹਜ ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh kai anahadh surat kai unamanee prem kai nijhar dhaar sahaj ravan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By plentiful practicing of meditation on Guru's teachings, the mind starts listening to the unstruck melody. As a result, it changes its stance and becomes God-oriented. Then one relishes the continuous flow of the divine nectar that is produced as a result of celestial love."}}},{"verse_id":208933,"page_no":null,"line_no":294,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਦਸਮ ਸਥਲ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੈ ॥੨੯੧॥","translit_en":"tirakuTee ula(n)gh sukh saagar sa(n)jog bhog dhasam sathal nihakeval bhavan kai ||291||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By crossing the confluence of three nerves, one enjoys the bliss of meeting the Lord. The mystical door there is the unique place of enjoying peace, union, relishment and pleasure. (291)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41320,"next":41322}}

॥","translit_en":"jaise jal jalaj aau jal dhudh seel meen chakiee kamal dhinakar prat preet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lotus flower loves water, water has affinity for milk, fish loves water, ruddy Sheldrake and lotus love the sun;"}}},{"verse_id":208935,"page_no":null,"line_no":295,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਚਕੋਰ ਸਸਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਘਨ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸੁਚੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pata(n)g al kamal chakor sas mirag naadh baadh ghan chaatirak sucheet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A winged insect (patanga) is attracted to the flame of the light, a black bee is crazy of the fragrance of the lotus flower, a red legged partridge is ever craving for a glimpse of the moon, a deer has affinity for music, while a rain-bird is ever alert for the swati drop."}}},{"verse_id":208936,"page_no":null,"line_no":295,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਰਿ ਅਉ ਭਤਾਰ ਸੁਤ ਮਾਤ ਜਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ ਖੁਧਿਆਰਥੀ ਭੋਜਨ ਦਾਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਧਨ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naar aau bhataar sut maat jal tirakhaava(n)t khudhiaarathee bhojan dhaaridhr dhan meet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a wife loves her husband, a son is deeply attached with his mother, a thirsty man craves for water, a hungry for food, and a pauper is always trying to befriend wealth."}}},{"verse_id":208937,"page_no":null,"line_no":295,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੨॥","translit_en":"maiaa moh dhroh dhukhadhaiee na sahaiee hot gur sikh sa(n)dh mile tiragun ateet hai ||292||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The love of maya is deceitful, its tricks cause suffering and it doesn't accompany us in the finals hours of our life. Love that a Sikh has for his Guru is beyond the influence of maya and supports the Sikh when he departs from this world. (292)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41321,"next":41323}}
files.shabads/82/41323.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41323,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208938","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208938,"last_verse_id":208941,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208938,"page_no":null,"line_no":296,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਬਿਸਮ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਮੈ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui a(n)g a(n)g bisam sraba(n)g mai samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving disciples of the True Guru whose every limb of the body is intoxicated in the elixir-like Naam of the Lord remain absorbed in the Lord whose form is awesome and enrapturing."}}},{"verse_id":208939,"page_no":null,"line_no":296,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨਾਦ ਹੁਇ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas liv dheepak pata(n)g sa(n)g sabadh surat mirag naadh hui hiraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Devotee's mind is akin to a moth who is always absorbed in love of light. "}}},{"verse_id":208940,"page_no":null,"line_no":296,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਾਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿਰਲੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਹੰੂ ਲਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaam nihakaam krodhaakrodh niralobh lobh moh niramoh aha(n)mev ha(n)oo lajaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-oriented Sikh is free from the effects of lust, anger, avarice, attachment and shy of pride and other vices."}}},{"verse_id":208941,"page_no":null,"line_no":296,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਥਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੩॥","translit_en":"bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj mai adhabhut paramadhabhut asathaane hai ||293||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind of Guru-conscious and practitioners of Naam resides in the mystical tenth door. This is a place that is full of ecstasy, astonishing beyond astonishments and most amazing. (293)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41322,"next":41324}}
files.shabads/82/41324.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41324,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208942","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208942,"last_verse_id":208945,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208942,"page_no":null,"line_no":297,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਛਬਿ ਤਿਲ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharasan jot ko udhot sukh saagar mai koTik usatat chhab til ko pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The radiance of the light of the True Guru, the ocean of happiness and comfort is repository of all the happiness of the world. The glory of millions of nymphea flowers is sacrifice unto it."}}},{"verse_id":208945,"page_no":null,"line_no":297,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੪॥","translit_en":"man madhukar makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui sahaj samaadh liv bisam bisavais hai ||294||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devoted and loving Sikh of the Guru enamoured by the elixir-like relishment of Naam Simran practiced through the teachings of the True Guru remains absorbed in a state of equipoise and astonishing devotion of the Lord.
