files.shabads/82/41325.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41325,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208946","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208946,"last_verse_id":208949,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208946,"page_no":null,"line_no":298,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਨ ਦਰਪਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan saran raj majan maleen man dharapan gat gurmat nihachal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By taking True Guru's shelter and meditating on the Lord's name, the mind polluted by vices become clear like a mirror."}}},{"verse_id":208947,"page_no":null,"line_no":298,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਦੈ ਚਪਲ ਖੰਜਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan gur a(n)jan dhai chapal kha(n)jan dhirag akul nira(n)jan dhiaan jal thal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Under the, influence of mind and intelligence, putting colorium. of Guru's teachings in the bird-like playful eyes, the consciousness gets engrossed in the Lord Almighty who is caste and creedless, beyond the blemish of maya and residing in oceans and deserts alike."}}},{"verse_id":208948,"page_no":null,"line_no":298,"gurmukhi":"ਭੰਜਨ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਅਰਿ ਗੰਜਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ਪਾਂਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਬਲਬੰਚ ਨਿਰਦਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bha(n)jan bhai bharam ar ga(n)jan karam kaal paa(n)ch parapa(n)ch balaba(n)ch niradhal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such celestial cogitation, (Reflection) of Lord is capable of ridding myriads suspicions, destroyer of vices and virtues that a person in the dragnet of births and deaths. It shatters the five enemies and their tricks as well."}}},{"verse_id":208949,"page_no":null,"line_no":298,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੰਜਨ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਲਿਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੫॥","translit_en":"sevaa kara(n)jan sarabaatam nira(n)jan bhe maiaa mai udhaas kalimal niramal hai ||295||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Guru-conscious person, seeing the light of mammon-less Lord effulging in all the living beings and serving the mankind devotedly becomes like unsullied Lord. Renouncing attachment of maya, he saves himself from grave vices and become pure and clean (of heart and soul). (295)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41324,"next":41326}}
files.shabads/82/41326.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41326,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208950","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208950,"last_verse_id":208953,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208950,"page_no":null,"line_no":299,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਅਛਤ ਰਵਿ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹੁਇ ਸੂਰਜ ਗ੍ਰਹਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhramaa achhat rav raahu na sakat gras dhirasaT agochar hui sooraj grahan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the presence of the moon, Rahu cannot devour the Sun, But when the Sun hides from the moon, the solar eclipse takes place. (Here the moon is symbol of noble person in whose company the maya does not devour the hot natured Sun)."}}},{"verse_id":208951,"page_no":null,"line_no":299,"gurmukhi":"ਪਛਮ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਪੂਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਸਿ ਕੇਤੁ ਖੇਤ ਹਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pachham udhot hot cha(n)dhramai namasakaar poorab sa(n)jog sas ket khet han hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"East and West are the directions of Sun and Moon respectively. When two days after the new moon day, the moon becomes visible in the West, all salutes him (according to Indian traditions). But on full moon day, the moon rises in the East and it is not eclipsed. (Company of a noble person is like Cool moon that is the means of protection of the hot-tempered Sun. On the contrary, company of hot Sun-like person becomes a source of distress for the cool-tempered moon)."}}},{"verse_id":208952,"page_no":null,"line_no":299,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਸਟ ਮੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਗਨਿ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਰਹੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਪਰਤ ਹੀ ਦਹਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaasaT mai agan magan chira(n)kaal rahai agan mai kaasaT parat hee dhahan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fire remains hidden in wood for long but as soon as wood touches fire, it burns (Here fire is symbolic of low sinful man whereas cool-minded wood is shown as a God-fearing person)."}}},{"verse_id":208953,"page_no":null,"line_no":299,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਸਹ ਸਹਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੬॥","translit_en":"taise siv sakat asaadh saadh sa(n)gam kai dhuramat gurmat dhuseh sahan hai ||296||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, keeping company of wicked-minded self-willed persons, one has to suffer pain and distress but keeping company of Guru-oriented persons, one achieves salvation. (296)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41325,"next":41327}}
files.shabads/82/41327.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41327,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208954","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208954,"last_verse_id":208957,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208954,"page_no":null,"line_no":300,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੁਜਨਤਾਈ ਪਾਹਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬੈਰ ਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh kee sujanataiee paahan kee rekh preet bair jal rekh hui bisekh saadh sa(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving relationship of Guru-oriented persons is like a line drawn on stone slab and is indelible. That is, the significance of company of Guru oriented persons is, that there is no ill feeling or animosity."}}},{"verse_id":208955,"page_no":null,"line_no":300,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਜਨਤਾ ਅਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਬੈਰ ਤਉ ਪਖਾਨ ਰੇਖ ਸੇਖ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhurajanataa asaadh preet jal rekh ar bair tau pakhaan rekh sekh a(n)g a(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Love of self oriented persons is momentary like a line drawn on water while their enmity remains like a line on a stone slab. It becomes part of their limb."}}},{"verse_id":208956,"page_no":null,"line_no":300,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਜਲ ਬਾਰੂਨੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਲ ਗੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaasaT agan gat preet bipreet surasaree jal baaroonee saroop jal ga(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Gurmukhs love is like that of wood; it keeps it’s fuel of fire hidden within. Company of evil-minded people leaves bad effects and company of good people leaves good effect.  Similarly, pure water from the river Ganges can be polluted with wine."}}},{"verse_id":208957,"page_no":null,"line_no":300,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਜਯਾ ਸਰਪ ਗਤਿ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਢੰਗ ਹੀ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਮੈ ॥੨੯੭॥","translit_en":"dhuramat gurmat ajayaa sarap gat upakaaree aau bikaaree dda(n)g hee kudda(n)g mai ||297||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A person with base and impure mind is like a snake who commits evil due to its bad trait. It is always ready to harm. But a Guru-oriented person is like a goat which is always ready to do a good deed. (297)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41326,"next":41328}}
files.shabads/82/41328.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41328,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208958","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208958,"last_verse_id":208961,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208958,"page_no":null,"line_no":301,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਕਾਸਟ ਅਗਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਟੇਵ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhuramat gurmat sa(n)gat asaadh saadh kaasaT agan gat Tev na Tarat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like wood and fire, the companies of Manmukh and Gurmukh dispense base wisdom and Guru's intelligence respectively. Wood hordes the fire within but fire destroys the wood. Both good and bad do not refrain from their nature. "}}},{"verse_id":208959,"page_no":null,"line_no":301,"gurmukhi":"ਅਜਯਾ ਸਰਪ ਜਲ ਗੰਗ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਸਨ ਅਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਖਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਲਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ajayaa sarap jal ga(n)g baarunee bidhaan san aau majeeTh khal pa(n)ddit larat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A goat is good doer while a snake causes distress by its bite. River Ganges purifies the wine poured in it, while a drop of wine in Ganges water pollutes it. A rope of jute binds while Rubia munjista plant colours fast. Similarly fools and intelligent men are of opposite nature."}}},{"verse_id":208960,"page_no":null,"line_no":301,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਟਕ ਪੁਹਪ ਸੈਲ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਸਨਾਹ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੰਸ ਕਾਗ ਬਗ ਬਿਆਧ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)Tak puhap sail ghaTikaa sanaeh sasatr ha(n)s kaag bag biaadh mirag hoi nibarat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A thorn pains, flowers emit fragrance. A pitcher gives cold water, a stone breaks the pitcher. An armour coat saves, weapons cause injury. A swan is of good intellect, crows and herons eat flesh. Hunters hunt dears, dears give musk and hide. All settle on who and what is good or bad."}}},{"verse_id":208961,"page_no":null,"line_no":301,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਸਟ ਕਨਿਕ ਸੀਪ ਸੰਖ ਮਧੁ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਇਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੮॥","translit_en":"losaT kanik seep sa(n)kh madh kaalakooT sukh dhukh dhaik sa(n)saar bicharat hai ||298||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Iron made into weapons gives distress, while gold is comfort giving. (298)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41327,"next":41329}}

॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar saroj baa(n)s baavan maraal bag paaras pakhaan bikh a(n)mirat sa(n)jog hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A frog and lotus flower, a bamboo and sandalwood tree, a crane and food for a patient are like disease."}}},{"verse_id":208965,"page_no":null,"line_no":302,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੀਜ ਜਮਤ ਨ ਕਾਲਰ ਮੈ ਅੰਕੁਰ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬਿਓਗ ਹੈ ॥੨੯੯॥","translit_en":"taise gurmat beej jamat na kaalar mai a(n)kur udhot hot naahin biog hai ||299||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly sullied and vice-ridden hearts cannot be fertile to the seeds of Guru's sermons and teachings. It just does not sprout. Such a person remains separated from his God. (299)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41328,"next":41330}}
files.shabads/82/41330.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41330,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208966","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208966,"last_verse_id":208969,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208966,"page_no":null,"line_no":303,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕਉ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਮੀਨ ਭਲ ਜਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gam sa(n)jog prem nem kau pata(n)g jaanai bireh biog sog meen bhal jaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The loving atmosphere that gets generated when a lover is about to meet his beloved can best be known by a moth. The pang of separation is best described by a fish that has been separated from its beloved water."}}},{"verse_id":208967,"page_no":null,"line_no":303,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਟਕ ਦੀਪਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੀਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"eik Tak dheepak dhiaan praan paraharai salil biog meen jeevan na maaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A moth burns itself for the love of the flame that he keeps watching and playing with. Similarly a fish separated from water has no meaning of life. She dies when out of it."}}},{"verse_id":208968,"page_no":null,"line_no":303,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਨ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮ ਅਗਿਆਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal mil bichhurai madhup man kapaT saneh dhirag janam agiaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These beings lay down their lives in love of their beloveds. Contrarily, an evil person's mind, like a black bee, hops from one flower to another, knowingly seperating from the holy feet of True Guru. Human life is a waste and a curse for such a person."}}},{"verse_id":208969,"page_no":null,"line_no":303,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਨ ਦੋਊ ਉਰ ਆਨਈ ॥੩੦੦॥","translit_en":"nihafal jeevan maran gur bimukh hui prem ar bireh na dhouoo ur aaniee ||300||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A follower of his own heart turned away from the refuge of the Guru, who does not feel the pangs of separation and love of the holy feet of the. True Guru, has wasted away his birth and death thus living a worthless life. (300)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41329,"next":41331}}
files.shabads/82/41331.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41331,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208970","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208970,"last_verse_id":208973,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208970,"page_no":null,"line_no":304,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਉ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਦਰਸ ਏਕ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas liv dhekhai aau dhikhaavai soiee sarab dharas ek dharas kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient disciple of the Guru who has focused his vision in the glimpse of the True Guru, he observes the impermeable Lord everywhere and every place. He makes others see Him too. He regards and understands that all philosophies are present in His sight."}}},{"verse_id":208971,"page_no":null,"line_no":304,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦ ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv kahat sunat soiee sarab sabadh ek sabadh kai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a Guru-oriented person acquires the teachings of the True Guru, his mind gets absorbed in the practicing of Lord's Naam Simran. He then speaks and hears the words of the True Guru deep in his soul. He regards all singing modes engrossed in the melody of the divine words."}}},{"verse_id":208972,"page_no":null,"line_no":304,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਤਗਿ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"kaaran karan karatag sarabag soiee karam karatoot karataar pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this state of immersion in the elixir of Naam, a Guru oriented slave recognises the cause of all causes, the knower of all deeds and capable of knowing all; who is the doer of all the deeds-the Doer and Creator,"}}},{"verse_id":208973,"page_no":null,"line_no":304,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ॥ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੀਐ ॥੩੦੧॥","translit_en":"satigur giaan dhiaan ek hee anek mek|| braham bibek Tek ekai ur aaneeaai ||301||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And thus a Guru-conscious person becomes aware of One God through the knowledge blessed by the True Guru and perpetual contemplation of Him, Such a person leans on none else for support except One All-pervading Lord, (301)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41330,"next":41332}}
files.shabads/82/41332.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41332,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208974","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208974,"last_verse_id":208977,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208974,"page_no":null,"line_no":305,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਮੈ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਤ ਮਗਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ki(n)chat kaTaachh maiaa mohe brahama(n)dd kha(n)dd saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g mai bimohit magan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose one transverse glance can infatuate millions of people of the regions and realms in maya, that God, enamoured by the love of the assembly of true God-loving meditating people remains absorbed in them."}}},{"verse_id":208975,"page_no":null,"line_no":305,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਂ ਕੇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੌ ਲਗਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaa(n) ke oa(n)kaar kai akaar hai naanaa prakaar keeratan samai saadh sa(n)g sau lagan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord whose expanse and forms are indescribable, He remains involved in the pious people through the singing of His hymns of praise."}}},{"verse_id":208976,"page_no":null,"line_no":305,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਨਨੁ ਅਗਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"siv sanakaadh brahamaadh aagiaakaaree jaa ke agrabhaag saadh sa(n)g gunan agan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who has the services of all the three deities and the four sons of Brahma at His beck and call and obedience, that Lord of countless traits remains obedient in the company of the holy and saintly persons who are ever engrossed in Him."}}},{"verse_id":208977,"page_no":null,"line_no":305,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਾਧ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਪਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਅਤਿ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਅਭਗਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੨॥","translit_en":"agam apaar saadh mahimaa apaar bikhai at livaleen jal meen abhagan hai ||302||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Praise of congregation immersed in His loving remembrance is beyond comprehension. A Guru-conscious devotee remains in love with Him like a fish in water. (302)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41331,"next":41333}}
files.shabads/82/41333.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41333,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208978","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208978,"last_verse_id":208981,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208978,"page_no":null,"line_no":306,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nij ghar mero saadh sa(n)gat naaradh mun dharasan saadh sa(n)g mero nij roop hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lord (Bhagwan) tells sage Narad, 0 dear devotee! Congregation of Guru-conscious and true people is my abode if company is my glimpse."}}},{"verse_id":208979,"page_no":null,"line_no":306,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਔ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਤ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਅਨੂਪ ਹੈ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g mero maataa pitaa aau kuTa(n)b sakhaa saadh sa(n)g mero sut sresaT anoop hai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Company of godlike people of the True Guru is like my friends and whole family. The company of true is my beautiful and supreme son."}}},{"verse_id":208980,"page_no":null,"line_no":306,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੀਪ ਧੂਪ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g sarab nidhaan praan jeevan mai saadh sa(n)g nij padh sevaa dheep dhoop hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Congregation is a treasure-house of all comforts and happiness. It is my life-support. Congregation of true people is means of gaining higher spiritual state. It is also a place of performing service which is true worship."}}},{"verse_id":208981,"page_no":null,"line_no":306,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸੋਭਾ ਅਤਿ ਉਪਮਾ ਔ ਊਪ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੩॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g ra(n)g ras bhog sukh sahaj mai saadh sa(n)g sobhaa at upamaa aau uoop hai ||303||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Company of Guru beloveds is a place of relishing the elixir of Naam Simran and enjoying spiritual peace. The glory and grandeur of the holy congregation is beyond praise unique and wondrous. (303)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41332,"next":41334}}
files.shabads/82/41334.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41334,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208982","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208982,"last_verse_id":208985,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208982,"page_no":null,"line_no":307,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਅਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"agam apaar dhev alakh abhev at anik jatan kar nigreh na paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord who is highly inaccessible, infinite, light effulgent and beyond comprehension, cannot be reached by controlling the senses with all available means."}}},{"verse_id":208983,"page_no":null,"line_no":307,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਜਗ ਭੋਗ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਕੈ ਅਗਹੁ ਨ ਗਹਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"paieeaai na jag bhog paieeaai na raaj jog naadh baadh bedh kai agahu na gahaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He cannot even be realised through holding/performing of Yag, hom (offerings to fire god), holding of feast for holy men, nor through Raj Yog. He cannot be reached through playing of musical instruments nor recitation of Vedas."}}},{"verse_id":208984,"page_no":null,"line_no":307,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਨੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"teerath purab dhev dhev sevakai na paieeaai karam dharam brat nem liv laieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such God of gods can also not be reached by visiting places of pilgrimage, celebrating days considered auspicious or by the service of gods. Even fasts of myriad kind cannot even bring Him closer. Contemplations are futile as well."}}},{"verse_id":208985,"page_no":null,"line_no":307,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਹਫਲ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਚਾਰ ਸਬੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਸਬਦ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩੦੪॥","translit_en":"nihafal anik prakaar kai achaar sabai saavadhaan saadh sa(n)g hui sabadh gaieeaai ||304||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the methods of God-realisation are of no use. He can only be realised by singing His paeans in the company of holy men and meditating on Him with concentrated and singular mind. (304)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41333,"next":41335}}
files.shabads/82/41335.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41335,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208986","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208986,"last_verse_id":208989,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208986,"page_no":null,"line_no":308,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਫਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਜੋਈ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sufan charitr chitr joiee dhekhai soiee jaanai dhoosaro na dhekhai paavai kahu kaise jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The miracle of a dream is known to the one who has seen it. No one else can see it. Then how can anyone else know about it?"}}},{"verse_id":208987,"page_no":null,"line_no":308,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਤ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਕਾਨ ਦੀਏ ਬਕਤਾ ਅਉ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾ ਪੈ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"naal bikhai baat ke'ee suneeat kaan dhe'ee bakataa aau srotaa bin kaa pai unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If something is spoken in one end of a tube and the other end is put in one's own ears, then only he alone would know who has said or heard what. No one else can know."}}},{"verse_id":208988,"page_no":null,"line_no":308,"gurmukhi":"ਪਘੂਲਾ ਕੇ ਮੂਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਲੀਜੀਐ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"paghoolaa ke mool bikhai jaise jal paan keejai leejeeaai jatan kar pe'ee man maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lotus flower or any other plant draws water through its roots from the soil, the flower or plant alone knows about the state of its bloom, who drinks according to his desire."}}},{"verse_id":208989,"page_no":null,"line_no":308,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਹਜ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੦੫॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)dh mile guhaj kathaa binodh giaan dhiaan prem ras bisam bidhaaneeaai ||305||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The event of a Sikh meeting with his Guru and obtaining initiation from him is very wondrous, blissful and mysterious. The description of the knowledge obtained from the True Guru, contemplation on Him, His love and ecstasy is very strange to describe. No one else can know about it. (305)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41334,"next":41336}}
files.shabads/82/41336.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41336,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208990","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208990,"last_verse_id":208993,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208990,"page_no":null,"line_no":309,"gurmukhi":"ਨਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਸੀਤਲ ਅ ਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਤਪਤ ਮਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"navan gavan jal seetal a mal jaise agan uradh mukh tapat maleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water flowing downward remains cool and clear of contamination but fire that goes upward causes heat and pollution;"}}},{"verse_id":208991,"page_no":null,"line_no":309,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਆਂਬ ਝੁਕੇ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨਿਵੈ ਨ ਅਰਿੰਡ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਰਬਲਾ ਛੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"safal hui aa(n)b jhuke rahat hai chira(n)kaal nivai na ari(n)dd taa(n) te aarabalaa chheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mango tree bends down when it yields fruit, and lives a long life, but a castor oil seed plant does not bend. It would break if we bend it, it breaks. Thus it has a short span of life."}}},{"verse_id":208992,"page_no":null,"line_no":309,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਸੀਐ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਸੰਗ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan subaas jaise baaseeaai banaasapatee baa(n)s tau baddaiee booddio sa(n)g livaleen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the sweet smell of a small sized sandalwood tree gets infused in the vegetation around it, but a tall and high bamboo plant arrogant of its size absorbs no fragrance of the sandalwood tree."}}},{"verse_id":208993,"page_no":null,"line_no":309,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਨ ਅਉ ਮਜੀਠ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh aha(n)budh nimrataa kai san aau majeeTh gat paap pu(n)n keen hai ||306||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly evil and apostate people bound by their pride and ego commit sins. On the contrary those good people who live in the way of the Guru and are humble, do good work like Rubia munjista (Majith). (306)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41335,"next":41337}}
files.shabads/82/41337.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41337,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208994","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208994,"last_verse_id":208997,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208994,"page_no":null,"line_no":310,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੀਰਘ ਦੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਭਏ ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal banaasapatee bikhai dhrum dheeragh dhui nihafal bhe boodde bahut baddaiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Amongst all the vegetation, both Silk cotton (Simhal) and Bamboo are the tallest but feeling proud of their size and greatness, they remain failures."}}},{"verse_id":208995,"page_no":null,"line_no":310,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਗਾਂਠਨ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਕੈ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan subaasanaa kai se(n)bal subaas hot baa(n)s niraga(n)dh bahu gaa(n)Than ddiThaiee kai||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"At least a Silk cotton tree do acquire some fragrance from a Sandalwood tree but due to the obstinacy of the knots, a Bamboo tree remains bereft of Sandalwood smell."}}},{"verse_id":208996,"page_no":null,"line_no":310,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਂਬਲ ਕੇ ਫਲ ਤੂਲ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਛਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਤਉ ਬਰਨ ਦੋਖੀ ਜਾਰਤ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"se(n)bal ke fal tool khag mirag chhaiaa taa kai baa(n)s tau baran dhokhee jaarat buraiee kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The cotton of the Silk cotton tree is put to use. The vast expanse of the tree provides shade for birds and other animals, but a Bamboo is family destroyer and due to its evil nature, it burns the other Bamboos that it rubs with."}}},{"verse_id":208997,"page_no":null,"line_no":310,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੩੦੭॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh hot saadh sa(n)gat kai tirasaTai na gur gop dhroh gur bhaiee kai ||307||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly an apostate Sikh becomes an obedient of the Guru by obtaining his sermons and enjoying the company of godly persons. But one who turns his face despite belonging to Guru, who is guilty of doing wrong to his Guru-brothers pushed around from door to door.(307)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41336,"next":41338}}
files.shabads/82/41338.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41338,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"208998","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":208998,"last_verse_id":209001,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":208998,"page_no":null,"line_no":311,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਖ ਬਲੀ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਸਫਲ ਸਘਨ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਰਨ ਦੋਖੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਰੈ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"birakh balee milaap safal saghan chhaiaa baa(n)s tau baran dhokhee milai jarai jaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many fruit-bearing trees along with creepers climbing upon them become dense of shade. They provide comfort to all wayfarers. But Bamboo that rubs with each other becomes cause of its own destruction through fire and for others as well who are near it."}}},{"verse_id":208999,"page_no":null,"line_no":311,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਤਰਹਰਿ ਝੁਕਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਤਰੁ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਬਡਾਈ ਬੂਡਿਓ ਆਪਨੁ ਸੰਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"safal hui tarahar jhukat sakal tar baa(n)s tau baddaiee booddio aapan sa(n)maar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All other fruit-bearing trees bow down but a Bamboo tree sublimed in his own praise keep accumulating pride."}}},{"verse_id":209000,"page_no":null,"line_no":311,"gurmukhi":"ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਤਉ ਰੀਤੋ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਬਾਜੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sakal banaasapatee sudh ridhai mon gahe baa(n)s tau reeto gaTheelo baaje dhaar maar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All fruit trees remain at peace at heart and are silent of disposition. They produce no sounds. But the tall Bamboo is hollow from inside and is knotted. It wails and produces noise."}}},{"verse_id":209001,"page_no":null,"line_no":311,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪਿ ਹੀ ਅਛਤ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਦੋਖੀ ਬਜਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਨ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੦੮॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep hee achhat niraga(n)dh rahe gursikh dhokhee bajar praanee na udhaar hai ||308||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who remains proud and hypocrite despite living in the close proximity of Sandalwood like True Guru, (remains fragrance-less) and does not acquire Guru's wisdom, such a person whoever wishes ill of Guru's disciples can never sail across the worldly ocean. (308)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41337,"next":41339}}
files.shabads/82/41339.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41339,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209002","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209002,"last_verse_id":209005,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209002,"page_no":null,"line_no":312,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੇਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਪਗ ਲਪਟਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aeso prem kai parasapar pag lapaTaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of the meeting of obedient and truthful persons of the True Guru is such that they bend down to touch each others feet regardless of their high or low status or age."}}},{"verse_id":209003,"page_no":null,"line_no":312,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil pooran braham giaan dhiaan liv laavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having seen the True Guru and by the divine effect of words residing in their mind, such Sikhs of the Guru remain engrossed in perfect Lord by virtue of Guru's knowledge and contemplation. The effect is always visible on them."}}},{"verse_id":209004,"page_no":null,"line_no":312,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਲਾਵਤ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਏਕ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਿਖਨ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"ek misaTaan paan laavat mahaa prasaadh ek gurapurab kai sikhan bulaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many of these devotees of the Guru bring dainty dishes for the consumption of the saintly persons of the congregation. Others send invitations to the Sikhs of Guru and hold Religious functions on the days associated with their Gurus."}}},{"verse_id":209005,"page_no":null,"line_no":312,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬਾਛੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਉਚਿਸਟ ਕਉ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਕਵਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੦੯॥","translit_en":"siv sanakaadh baachhai tin ke uchisaT kau saadhan kee dhookhanaa kavan fal paavahee ||309||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even gods like Shiv, Sanak crave for the leftovers of such Sikhs of the Guru who are blessed with divine traits of Naam Simran. What good will one reap who thinks ill of such godly ones? It is evident that such a person will be severely 'shed in the court of Almighty. (309)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41338,"next":41340}}
files.shabads/82/41340.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41340,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209006","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209006,"last_verse_id":209009,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209006,"page_no":null,"line_no":313,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੋਝ ਭਰੀ ਨਾਵ ਆਂਗੁਰੀ ਦੈ੍ਵ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਪੂਰ ਸਬੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bojh bharee naav aa(n)guree dhaivai baahar haivai paar parai poor sabai kusal bihaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fully loaded boat remains above water-level by no more than two fingers. Everyone rejoices when all the travellers are able to disembark on the other bank/shore;"}}},{"verse_id":209007,"page_no":null,"line_no":313,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕਾਹਾਰੀ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਬੈਠਿ ਭੋਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦਿ ਕੇ ਅਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ekaahaaree ek gharee paakasaalaa baiTh bhojan kai bi(n)janaadh savaiaadh ke aghaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a person who eats food once in 24 hours (though hungry) feels his hunger satiated when he spends sometime in the kitchen where the food is being prepared;"}}},{"verse_id":209008,"page_no":null,"line_no":313,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਦ੍ਵਾਰ ਜਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਜੁਹਾਰ ਜਨ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਪਾਛੈ ਦੇਸ ਭੋਗਤਾ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raaj dhavaiaar jai karat juhaar jan ek gharee paachhai dhes bhogataa haivai khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a servant shows much respect at the door of the king or his master, and later on, he reaps the fruit of his service when he himself becomes landlord."}}},{"verse_id":209009,"page_no":null,"line_no":313,"gurmukhi":"ਆਠ ਹੀ ਪਹਰ ਸਾਠ ਘਰੀ ਮੈ ਜੌ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਸਾਧ ਸਮਾਗਮ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੦॥","translit_en":"aaTh hee pahar saaTh gharee mai jau ek gharee saadh samaagam karai nij ghar jaat hai ||310||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a person keeps company of holy men who are perpetually meditating on Lord's name for a watch out of 24 hrs (24 hrs=60 watches), he is able to rest in his own self and would realise the God gradually. (310)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41339,"next":41341}}
files.shabads/82/41341.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41341,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209010","verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":209010,"last_verse_id":209012,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209010,"page_no":null,"line_no":314,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਤਿਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪਮਾਲਿਕਾ ਰਜਨੀ ਸਮੈ ਦੀਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਹੀ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaaratik jaise dheepamaalikaa rajanee samai dheep jot ko udhot hot hee bilaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as on festival of Diwali, that falls in the Indian month of Kartik, many earthen lamps are lit at night, and their light go off after a short period;"}}},{"verse_id":209011,"page_no":null,"line_no":314,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖਾ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਨਾਮ ਪਲਕ ਮੈ ਨ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"barakhaa samai jaise tau budhabudhaa ko pragaas taas naam palak mai na Thahiraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as bubbles appear on water when rain-drops on it, and very soon these bubbles explode and disappear from the surface;"}}},{"verse_id":209012,"page_no":null,"line_no":314,"gurmukhi":"ਗ੍ਰੀਖਮ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ॥ ਝਾਈ ਸੀ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਉਪਜਿ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"greekham samai jaise tau mirag tirasanaa charitr|| jhaiee see dhikhaiee dhet upaj samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a thirsty deer is disillusioned of the presence of water, the hot shimmering sand (mirage) that disappears in time then he reaches that spot;"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41340,"next":41342}}
files.shabads/82/41342.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41342,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209013","verse_count":1,"first_verse_id":209013,"last_verse_id":209013,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209013,"page_no":null,"line_no":315,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਖ ਚਪਲ ਛਲ॥ ਛਲੈ ਛੈਲ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੧॥","translit_en":"taise moh maiaa chhaiaa birakh chapal chhal|| chhalai chhail sree gur charan lapaTaat hai ||311||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the love of Maya that keeps changing its master like the shadow of a tree. But the Naam practitioner devotee of the Guru who remains engrossed in the holy feet of the True, he is able to control the attractive and trickster maya with ease. (311)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41341,"next":41343}}
files.shabads/82/41343.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41343,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209014","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209014,"last_verse_id":209017,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209014,"page_no":null,"line_no":316,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸਨ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ਸਲਿਲ ਸਾਬੁਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau basan a(n)g sa(n)g mil hoi maleen salil saabun mil niramal hot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as clothes become soiled by their touching the body but are washed clean with water and soap"}}},{"verse_id":209015,"page_no":null,"line_no":316,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਿਵਾਲ ਕੈ ਅਛਾਦਿਓ ਜਲੁ ਝੋਲਿ ਪੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਅਛੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sarovar sivaal kai achhaadhio jal jhol pe'ee niramal dhekheeaai achhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the water in a pond is covered with thin film of algae and dropped leaves, but by brushing aside the film with hand, clean drinkable water appears."}}},{"verse_id":209016,"page_no":null,"line_no":316,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਾਰਕਾ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਉਜੀਆਰੋ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਕੇ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nis a(n)dhakaar taarakaa chamatakaar hot ujeeaaro dhinakar ke udhot hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the night is dark even with the twinkling of stars but with the rising Sun-light spreads all over."}}},{"verse_id":209017,"page_no":null,"line_no":316,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੨॥","translit_en":"taise maiaa moh bhram hot hai maleen mat satigur giaan dhiaan jagamag jot hai ||312||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does the love of maya sully the mind. But by the teachings of True Guru and His contemplation, it becomes radiant. (312)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41342,"next":41344}}
files.shabads/82/41344.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41344,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209018","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209018,"last_verse_id":209021,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209018,"page_no":null,"line_no":317,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰ ਅਛਿਤ ਹੀ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਗਵਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਰੇ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਕ ਜਉ ਧਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar achhit hee dhisa(n)tar gavan karai paachhai pare pahuchai na paik jau dhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite well hidden in the body, mind still reaches far off places. If someone tries to chase it, he just cannot reach it."}}},{"verse_id":209019,"page_no":null,"line_no":317,"gurmukhi":"ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਰਥ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਗਜ ਰਾਜ ਬਾਜੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਫਾਂਧਤ ਉਡਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pahuchai na rath pahuchai na gaj raaj baaj pahuchai na khag mirag faa(n)dhat uddaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No chariot, a swift horse or even Airawat (a legendary elephant) can reach it. Neither a fast flying bird nor a galloping deer can match it."}}},{"verse_id":209020,"page_no":null,"line_no":317,"gurmukhi":"ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਪਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਅੰਤਰੀਛ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pahuchai na pavan gavan tirabhavan prat aradh uradh a(n)tareechh hui na paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even the wind which has its reach in the three worlds cannot reach it. One who is capable of reaching the land of the world beyond, cannot win the race of mind."}}},{"verse_id":209021,"page_no":null,"line_no":317,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਲਗਿ ਅਧਮੁ ਅਸਾਧੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਿ ਆਵਈ ॥੩੧੩॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ch dhoot bhoot lag adham asaadh man gahe gur giaan saadh sa(n)g bas aaviee ||313||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Inveigled by the five vices of maya that has embraced it like a demon, the low and incorrigible mind can only be controlled and disciplined if it accepts the initiation of the True Guru through the kind blessings of saintly and true devotees of the Lord. (313)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41343,"next":41345}}
files.shabads/82/41345.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41345,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209022","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209022,"last_verse_id":209025,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209022,"page_no":null,"line_no":318,"gurmukhi":"ਆਂਧਰੋ ਕਉ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਟੇਕ ਬਹਰੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aa(n)dharo kau sabadh surat kar char Tek baharai charan kar dhirasaT sabadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A blind person has support of the words, ability to hear, hands and feet. A deaf has much reliance on his hands feet, vision of the eyes and the words that he speaks."}}},{"verse_id":209023,"page_no":null,"line_no":318,"gurmukhi":"ਗੂੰਗੈ ਟੇਕ ਚਰ ਕਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੂਲੇ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਪਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"goo(n)gai Tek char kar dhirasaT sabadh surat liv loole Tek dhirasaT sabadh srut padh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A dumb has support of ears for listening, feet, hands vision of the eyes. A handless person relies much on eyes speech, hearing and feet."}}},{"verse_id":209024,"page_no":null,"line_no":318,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਗੁਰੇ ਕਉ ਟੇਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ  ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਅੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਅਛਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paagure kau Tek dhirasaT sabadh surat kar  Tek ek ek a(n)g heen dheenataa achhadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who is lame or without legs rely on sight of his eyes speech, ability to hear, and use of his hands. Despite capacitated of one limb or faculty, the dependence on others remain hidden."}}},{"verse_id":209025,"page_no":null,"line_no":318,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਪੰਗ ਲੁੰਜ ਦੁਖ ਪੁੰਜ ਮਮ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪਰਬੀਨ ਸਦ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੪॥","translit_en":"a(n)dh gu(n)g su(n)n pa(n)g lu(n)j dhukh pu(n)j mam a(n)tar ke a(n)tarajaamee parabeen sadh hai ||314||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But I am blind, dumb, deaf, maimed of hand and feet a mass of suffering. 0 my True Lord! You are the wisest and completely informed of all my innate pains. 0 My Lord, please be merciful and remove all my pains. (314)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41344,"next":41346}}
files.shabads/82/41346.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41346,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209026","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209026,"last_verse_id":209029,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209026,"page_no":null,"line_no":319,"gurmukhi":"ਆਂਧਰੇ ਕਉ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਟੇਕ ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aa(n)dhare kau sabadh surat kar char Tek a(n)dh gu(n)g sabadh surat kar char hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A blind person has the-support of power of speech, hands and feet. And if someone is blind and dumb as well, then he is dependent on others for listening power, hands and feet."}}},{"verse_id":209027,"page_no":null,"line_no":319,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਕਰ ਚਰ ਅਵਿਲੰਬ ਟੇਕ ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਪੰਗ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਕਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)dh gu(n)g su(n)n kar char avila(n)b Tek a(n)dh gu(n)g su(n)n pa(n)g Tek ek kar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If someone is blind, deaf and dumb, he has support of hands and feet. But if one is blind, deaf, dumb and lame, he has support only of hands."}}},{"verse_id":209028,"page_no":null,"line_no":319,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਦ ਗੁੰਗ ਸੁੰਨ ਪੰਗ ਲੁੰਜ ਦੁਖ ਪੁੰਜ ਮਮ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਅਧਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)dh gu(n)g su(n)n pa(n)g lu(n)j dhukh pu(n)j mam saraba(n)g heen dheen dhukhit adhar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But I am a bundle of pains and sufferings, because I am blind, deaf, dumb, crippled and have no support. I am deeply distressed."}}},{"verse_id":209029,"page_no":null,"line_no":319,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਮਤਰਗਤਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਰੈ ਨਰਹਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੫॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar kee a(n)tarajaamee jaanai amataragat kaise nirabaahu karai sarai narahar hai ||315||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Oh Omnipotent Lord! You are Omniscient. How can I tell you my pain, how will I live and how will I cross this worldly ocean of life. (315)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41345,"next":41347}}
files.shabads/82/41347.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41347,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209030","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209030,"last_verse_id":209033,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209030,"page_no":null,"line_no":320,"gurmukhi":"ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਅਉ ਪਤੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chakiee chakor mirag meen bhira(n)g aau pata(n)g preet ik a(n)gee bahu ra(n)gee dhukhadhaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The love of a Ruddy Sheldrake with Sun, Allictoris gracea with Moon, deer with melody of Ghandey Herhey, fish with water, a black bee with lotus flower and of a moth with light is one-sided. Such one-sided love is often painful in many ways."}}},{"verse_id":209031,"page_no":null,"line_no":320,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਕੀ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੀ ਜਗ ਆਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ek ek Tek sai Tarat na marat sabai aadh a(n)t kee su chaal chalee jag aaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All these lovers do not abstain from their faith of one-sided love and in the process give away their lives. This tradition of worldly love is going on since the beginning of ages."}}},{"verse_id":209032,"page_no":null,"line_no":320,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਅੇਸੋ ਲੋਗ ਪਰਲੋਗ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aeso log paralog sukhadhaik sahaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But the importance of two-sided love of a Sikh of the Guru and his True Guru is such that can prove helpful and peaceful in this world and the world beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209033,"page_no":null,"line_no":320,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੬॥","translit_en":"gurmat sun dhuramat na miTat jaa kee eh mil cha(n)dhan jiau bikh na miTaiee hai ||316||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With such comforting love of the Guru available close at hand, if one does not listen to the teachings of the Guru and who does not dispel one's base wisdom, then such a person is no better than a snake who does not shed his venom even after embracing Sandalwood tree. (316)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41346,"next":41348}}
files.shabads/82/41348.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41348,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209034","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209034,"last_verse_id":209037,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209034,"page_no":null,"line_no":321,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜਲ ਕਉ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"meen kau na surat jal kau sabadh giaan dhubidhaa miTai na sakat jal meen kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fish is not a ware that the water will assist nor does water have knowledge of speech or hearing in order to help the fish in distress. Therefore the water cannot allay its pain while it is in distress."}}},{"verse_id":209035,"page_no":null,"line_no":321,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਥਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਬਸੈ ਗ੍ਰਸੈ ਲੋਹ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"sar saritaa athaeh prabal pravaeh basai grasai loh raakh na sakat mat heen kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fish resides in the vast and rapid flow of the river. But when it swallows the iron bait of an angler, the bemused fish cannot be saved by water-her beloved."}}},{"verse_id":209036,"page_no":null,"line_no":321,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਰਫਿ ਤਜਤ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੀਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਪੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਦੀਨਤਾਈ ਦੀਨ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jal bin taraf tajat pria praan meen jaanat na peer neer dheenataiee dheen kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Removed from water, a fish writhes in pain for life having been separated from its beloved (life support). But the water is not aware of the sufferings of the fish."}}},{"verse_id":209037,"page_no":null,"line_no":321,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਮੀਨ ਕੁਲ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਬੰਸ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਰਧੀਨ ਕੀ ॥੩੧੭॥","translit_en":"dhukhadhaiee preet kee prateet meen kul dhiraR gur sikh ba(n)s dhirag preet paradheen kee ||317||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A clan of fish bears one-sided love forever. The love of a Guru and his disciple is always two-sided. Guru helps a Sikh in distress but one who leaves the love of the True Guru, submits himself and serves false Gurus, his love is condemned. (317)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41347,"next":41349}}
files.shabads/82/41349.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41349,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209038","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209038,"last_verse_id":209041,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209038,"page_no":null,"line_no":322,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪੈ ਆਵਤ ਪਤੰਗ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਦੀਪਕਹਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pai aavat pata(n)g preet reet lag dheepakeh mahaa(n) bipareet mile jaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A moth approaches a light out of love but the attitude of a lamp is to the contrary. It singes him to death."}}},{"verse_id":209039,"page_no":null,"line_no":322,"gurmukhi":"ਅਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਆਵਤ ਕਮਲ ਪਹਿ ਸਨੇਹ ਕਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਪੁਟਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਹਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"al chal aavat kamal peh saneh kar kamal sa(n)puT baa(n)dh praan parahaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fulfilling his desire for love, a black bee approaches a lotus flower. But as the Sun sets, the lotus flower closes its petals and snuffs out life from the black bee."}}},{"verse_id":209040,"page_no":null,"line_no":322,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਲਿਵਲੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਗਹਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"man bach kram jal meen livaleen gat bichhurat raakh na sakat geh ddaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is the character of fish to stay in water but when a fisherman or angler catches it with the help of a net or a hook, and throws it out of the water, the water does not help it in anyway."}}},{"verse_id":209041,"page_no":null,"line_no":322,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੧੮॥","translit_en":"dhukhadhaiee preet kee prateet kai marai na Tarai gur sikh sukhadhaiee preet kiau bisaar hai ||318||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One-sided love of fish is full of trust. Every lover dies for its beloved but loves forever. The love of Guru and Sikh is two-sided; the Guru loves his Sikh completely and protects him. So how can a Sikh neglect such warming love of his Guru? (318)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41348,"next":41350}}
files.shabads/82/41350.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41350,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209042","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209042,"last_verse_id":209045,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209042,"page_no":null,"line_no":323,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਹੀਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pata(n)g dhib dhirasaT dharas heen sree gur dharas dhiaan tirabhavan ga(n)mitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What light of vision could he have found in an oil beacon, the moth becomes devoid of even seeing it since it dies on its flame. But the contemplation of True Guru's sight illuminates the vision of the slave of Guru that he is able to see all the happenings of the three worlds."}}},{"verse_id":209043,"page_no":null,"line_no":323,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਰੰਮਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"baasanaa kamal al bhramat na raakh sakai charan saran gur anat na ra(n)mitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A black bee is fascinated by the smell of a lotus flower. However a lotus flower cannot stop him from visiting other flowers. But a devoted Sikh coming into the refuge of True Guru does not go anywhere else."}}},{"verse_id":209044,"page_no":null,"line_no":323,"gurmukhi":"ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਹੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸੰਮਿਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"meen jal prem nem a(n)t na sahaiee hot gur sikh saagar hai it ut sa(n)mitaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fish sees through her love for water till the end. But when hooked to a bait, the water does not help her and can't save her. However a Sikh who is ever swimming in the safe ocean of True Guru is always helped by Him here and in the world beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209045,"page_no":null,"line_no":323,"gurmukhi":"ਏਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਸੀ੍ਰ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਬੰਗੀ ਸੰਗੀ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ॥੩੧੯॥","translit_en":"ek ek Tek sai Tarat na marat sabai seer gur saraba(n)gee sa(n)gee mahaatam a(n)mritaa ||319||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fish never gives up it's one-sided love and infatuation. They die living in the love of their beloved. But the love of the True Guru frees one from the cycle reincarnation. Why should anyone turn their face away from such love of their Guru?"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41349,"next":41351}}
files.shabads/82/41351.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41351,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209046","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209046,"last_verse_id":209049,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209046,"page_no":null,"line_no":324,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਰਤ ਨ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕੈ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ ਆਗੇ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pata(n)g mil jarat na raakh sakai jare mare aage na param padh paae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Coming near the flame of oil lamp, the lamp cannot save the moth from burning. This type of death cannot provide salvation in the world beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209047,"page_no":null,"line_no":324,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਪ ਕਮਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਮੈ ਮੂਏ ਸੈ ਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"madhup kamal mil bhramat na raakh sakai sa(n)puT mai mooe sai na sahaj samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A lotus flower cannot stop a black bee from visiting other flowers. So, if a black bee gets shut up in the box of lotus petals when the Sun sets, it cannot merge with Lord Almighty."}}},{"verse_id":209048,"page_no":null,"line_no":324,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਸਕੀ ਬਿਛੁਰਿ ਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਕ ਨ ਪਠਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal mil meen kee na dhubidhaa miTai sakee bichhur marat har lok na paThaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Separating from water, the pain suffered by a fish cannot be removed by water. Thus, a death of this type cannot land the fish in heaven."}}},{"verse_id":209049,"page_no":null,"line_no":324,"gurmukhi":"ਇਤ ਉਤ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੦॥","translit_en":"eit ut sa(n)gam sahaiee sukhadhaiee gur giaan dhiaan prem ras a(n)mirat peeaae hai ||320||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting the True Guru provides support and assistance in this world and the next. Such a love is the result of contemplation and meditation on the teachings of the Guru. It fills a Sikh with elixir-like love for the Guru which liberates him/her from all worldly encumbrances. (320)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41350,"next":41352}}
files.shabads/82/41352.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41352,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209050","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209050,"last_verse_id":209053,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209050,"page_no":null,"line_no":325,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਲਿਲ ਮੀਨ ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਨਾਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak pata(n)g al kamal salil meen chakiee chakor mirag rav sas naadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A moth, black bee, fish, ruddy Sheldrake, (Allectoris gracea) and a deer loves flame of a lamp, lotus flower, water, Sun, moon and sound of music produced by Ghanda Herha respectively."}}},{"verse_id":209051,"page_no":null,"line_no":325,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ਕੋਊ ਸਬੈ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"preet ik a(n)gee bahu ra(n)gee nahee sa(n)gee kouoo sabai dhukhadhaiee na sahaiee a(n)t aadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All their love being one-sided is very painful that does not help neither in the beginning nor in the end."}}},{"verse_id":209052,"page_no":null,"line_no":325,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਤ ਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੂਏ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jeevat na saadh sa(n)g mooe na param gat giaan dhiaan prem ras preetam prasaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These living beings of subhuman life can neither be blessed with holy congregation of true devotees nor salvation after death. They cannot even be the recipient of Guru's teachings, His contemplation and the divine nectar that the grace of True Guru can dispense."}}},{"verse_id":209053,"page_no":null,"line_no":325,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੧॥","translit_en":"maanas janam pai sree gur dhiaa nidhaan charan saran sukh fal bisamaadh hai ||321||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Coming to the refuge of the True Guru, the store-house of mercy and that too in the life of a human being and practicing on the True Guru-given Naam Simran can bless one with that unique fruit of comfort and peace. (321)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41351,"next":41353}}
files.shabads/82/41353.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41353,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209054","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209054,"last_verse_id":209057,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209054,"page_no":null,"line_no":326,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਰਹੈ ਲਹੈ ਨਿਜੁ ਘਰੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th gur dhiaan saavadhaan rahai lahai nij ghar ar sahaj nivaas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Treading the path of Sikhism, he who remains alert in the form of the True Guru, recognises his self and lives in a state of equipoise thereafter."}}},{"verse_id":209055,"page_no":null,"line_no":326,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh bibek ek Tek nihachal mat madhur bachan gur giaan ko pragaas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the single support of the teachings of True Guru, his mind becomes stable. As a result of his comforting utterances, his practice of Naam Simran blossoms."}}},{"verse_id":209056,"page_no":null,"line_no":326,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸਿ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal charanaamirat nidhaan paan prem ras bas bhe bisam bisavaiaas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By the acquisition of the initiation of the True Guru and elixir-like Naam, nectar-like love resides in his mind. Unique and wondrous devotion grows in his heart."}}},{"verse_id":209057,"page_no":null,"line_no":326,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਪੂੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਬਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸ ਜੀ ॥੩੨੨॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan prem nem pooooran prateet cheet ban gireh samasar maiaa mai udhaas jee ||322||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fulfilling all the loving requirements with devotion and love, he who stays alert in the teachings and the presence of the True Guru, living in the jungle or in the house is alike for him. He remains unsullied from the effects of maya despite living in it. (322)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41352,"next":41354}}
files.shabads/82/41354.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41354,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209058","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209058,"last_verse_id":209061,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209058,"page_no":null,"line_no":327,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਦੇਖ ਚੋਰ ਨ ਤਜਤ ਚੋਰੀ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ਬਟਵਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਤਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maarabe ko traas dhekh chor na tajat choree baTavaaraa baTavaaree sa(n)g haivai takat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite fear of death lurking around, a thief doesn't give up Stealing. A dacoit keeps targeting other wayfarers along with other members of his gang."}}},{"verse_id":209059,"page_no":null,"line_no":327,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਰਤੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਸੰਕਾ ਮਾਨੈ ਜੂਆਰੀ ਨ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਹਾਰੈ ਸੈ ਥਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"besavaiaa rat birathaa bhe man mai naa sa(n)kaa maanai jooaaree na sarabas haarai sai thakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Knowing that his visit to the house of a whore can cause him serious disease, a licentious person still doesn't feel hesitant to go there. A gambler never feels tired of gambling even after losing all his assets and the family."}}},{"verse_id":209060,"page_no":null,"line_no":327,"gurmukhi":"ਅਮਲੀ ਨ ਅਮਲ ਤਜਤ ਜਿਯੋਂ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਛਕਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"amalee na amal tajat jiyo(n) dhikaar ke'ee dhokh dhukh log bedh sunat chhakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An addict keeps consuming drugs and intoxicants despite monitions, learning the effects of drug abuse from religious scriptures and people who have societal interests at heart, just can't give up his addiction."}}},{"verse_id":209061,"page_no":null,"line_no":327,"gurmukhi":"ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਛਾਡਤ ਨ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਛਾਡ ਕਯੋਂ ਸਕਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੩॥","translit_en":"adham asaadh sa(n)g chhaaddat na a(n)geekaar gursikh saadh sa(n)g chhaadd kayo(n) sakat hai ||323||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even all these low and base people cannot give up their deeds, then how can an obedient devotee of Guru leave company of true and noble people? (323)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41353,"next":41355}}
files.shabads/82/41355.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41355,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209062","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209062,"last_verse_id":209065,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209062,"page_no":null,"line_no":328,"gurmukhi":"ਦਮਕ ਦੈ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਖ ਅਪ ਜਸ ਲੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਮੁਖ ਸਿਆਮਤਾ ਲਗਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhamak dhai dhokh dhukh ap jas lai asaadh lok paralok mukh siaamataa lagaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A self-willed and base person acquires vices, sufferings and bad name after spending his wealth. He earns a stigma on himself both in this world and the world hereafter."}}},{"verse_id":209063,"page_no":null,"line_no":328,"gurmukhi":"ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਅਉ ਜੂਆਰ ਮਦ ਪਾਨੀ ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੈ ਕਲਹ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੇਸ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"chor jaar aau jooaar madh paanee dhukirat sai kaleh kales bhes dhubidhaa kau dhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A thief, immoral person, gambler and an addict is always involved in some discord or dispute on account of his base and infamous deeds."}}},{"verse_id":209064,"page_no":null,"line_no":328,"gurmukhi":"ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹਾਨਿ ਕਾਨਿ ਮੈ ਕਨੌਡੀ ਸਭਾ ਨਾਕ ਕਾਨ ਖੰਡ ਡੰਡ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਲਜਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"mat pat haan kaan mai kanauaddee sabhaa naak kaan kha(n)dd dda(n)dd hot na lajaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such an evil-doer loses his intellect, respect, esteem and glory; and after bearing the punishment of cutting of nose or ear, he feels no shame in the society despite the stigma that he carries. Becoming more shameless, he keeps indulging in his nefarious activities."}}},{"verse_id":209065,"page_no":null,"line_no":328,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਇਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਚਲਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥੩੨੪॥","translit_en":"sarab nidhaan dhaan dhaik sa(n)gat saadh gur sikh saadhoo jan kiau na chal aavahee ||324||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When such ill-doers and infamous people do not abstain from doing bad deeds, then why should a Sikh of the Guru not come to the congregation of true and saintly persons that is capable of blessing one with all the treasures? (324)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41354,"next":41356}}
files.shabads/82/41356.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41356,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209066","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209066,"last_verse_id":209069,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209066,"page_no":null,"line_no":329,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਕਸਮਾਤ ਬਾਦਰ ਉਦੋਤ ਹੋਤ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau akasamaat baadhar udhot hot gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd karat bithaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as deep dark clouds appear in the sky all of a sudden and spread themselves in all the directions."}}},{"verse_id":209067,"page_no":null,"line_no":329,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਘਨ ਗਰਜਤ ਅਤਿ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਮਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"taahee te sabadh dhun ghan garajat at cha(n)chal charitr dhaamanee chamatakaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Their thunder produces a very strong sound and sprightly lightning flashes."}}},{"verse_id":209068,"page_no":null,"line_no":329,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਪੂਰ ਤਾਤੇ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਉਪਾਰਜਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"barakhaa a(n)mirat jal mukataa kapoor taate aaukhadhee upaarajanaa anik prakaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then sweet, cold, nectar-like raindrops from where a swati drop falls on oyster to produce a pearl, camphor when it falls on a plantain beside producing many useful herbs."}}},{"verse_id":209069,"page_no":null,"line_no":329,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਜਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਪਰ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੩੨੫॥","translit_en":"dhib dheh saadh janam maran rahit jag pragaTat karabe kau par upakaar jee ||325||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like good-doer cloud, the body of Guru-conscious disciple is divine. He is free from the cycle of birth and death. He comes to this world to do good. He helps others reach and realise Lord. (325)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41355,"next":41357}}
