{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41357,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209070","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209070,"last_verse_id":209073,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209070,"page_no":null,"line_no":330,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤ ਸਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"safal birakh fal dhet jiau paakhaan maare sir karavat seh geh paar paar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree laden with fruit drops fruit to the person who throws stone at it, then it bears the pain of a saw on its head and in the form of a raft or boat takes the iron saw across the river;"}}},{"verse_id":209071,"page_no":null,"line_no":330,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਮੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਫੋਰੀਅਤਿ ਸੀਪ ਕੋ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saagar mai kaadd mukh foreeat seep ko jiau dhet mukataahal avagiaa na beechaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an oyster is taken out of the sea, is broken and it yields a pearl to the one who breaks it open and feels not the insult that it faces;"}}},{"verse_id":209072,"page_no":null,"line_no":330,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਨਤ ਹਨਤ ਘਨ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khanavaaraa khaan khanat hanat ghan maanik heeraa amol paraupakaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a labourer strives the ore in a mine with his shovel and pick-axe and the mine rewards him with precious stones and diamonds;"}}},{"verse_id":209073,"page_no":null,"line_no":330,"gurmukhi":"ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਿਊਖ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਤ ਕੋਲੂ ਪਚੈ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੬॥","translit_en":"uookh mai piuookh jiau paragaas hot koloo pachai avagun ke'ee gun saadhan kai dhuaar hai ||326||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sweet nectar-like juice is extracted out by putting it through a crusher, so are the evil-doers treated with sympathy and welfare by the true and saintly persons when they come to them. (326)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41356,"next":41358}}
files.shabads/82/41358.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41358,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209074","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209074,"last_verse_id":209077,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209074,"page_no":null,"line_no":331,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਿਤਨੇਮ ਜਾਂ ਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਦਰਸਨੀ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saadh sa(n)g dharashan ko hai nitanem jaa(n) ko soiee dharasanee sam dharas dhiaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who· is regular in seeing and visiting the saintly persons, is the contemplator of the Lord in the true sense. He sees all alike and feels the presence of Lord in everyone."}}},{"verse_id":209075,"page_no":null,"line_no":331,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਮਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sabadh bibek ek Tek jaa(n) kai man basai maan gur giaan soiee braham giaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who holds the contemplation of Guru's words as his primary support and lodges it in his heart is the true follower of the Guru's teachings and knower of the Lord in true sense."}}},{"verse_id":209076,"page_no":null,"line_no":331,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਅਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT dharas ar sabadh surat mil premee pria prem unaman unamaanee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He whose vision is focused on seeing the True Guru and hearing power concentrated on hearing the divine words of Guru, is a lover of his beloved Lord in the true sense."}}},{"verse_id":209077,"page_no":null,"line_no":331,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੭॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh saadh sa(n)g ik ra(n)g joiee soiee gurmukh niramal nirabaanee hai ||327||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who is dyed in the love of one Lord engrosses himself deep meditation of the Lord's name in the company of the saintly persons is truly liberated and a clean Guru-oriented individual. (327)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41357,"next":41359}}
files.shabads/82/41359.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41359,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209078","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209078,"last_verse_id":209081,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209078,"page_no":null,"line_no":332,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਬਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ੳੋੁਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dharas dhiaan dhiaanee sabadh giaan giaanee charan saran dhiraR maiaa mai uoudhaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who focuses his mind on the vision of the True Guru is a true contemplator. He who is aware of the Guru's teachings is wise in the real sense. Such a person is free of all bondages of maya when he stays in the refuge of True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":209079,"page_no":null,"line_no":332,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਭਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤਿ ਚੀਤ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haumai tiaag tiaagee bisamaadh kai bairaagee bhe tiragun ateet cheet anabhai abhiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A true renouncer is one who has forsaken ego and pride; and attached himself with the name of the Lord. He is an ascetic when he feels engrossed in the ecstatic hues of the Lord. Having kept his mind dross free from the effect of maya, he is the true practitioner of Naam of the Fearless Lord."}}},{"verse_id":209080,"page_no":null,"line_no":332,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅਪਰਸ ਅਉ ਸਾਧ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਆਤਮ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhubidhaa aparas aau saadh i(n)dhree nigreh kai aatam poojaa bibekee su(n)n mai sa(n)niaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having lost his feelings of mine and yours, he is free of all touches. Since he has control over his senses, he is a saintly person or a hermit. Due to worshipping of· the Lord, he is full of true wisdom. Since he remains engrossed in absolute Lord, he is a renouncer."}}},{"verse_id":209081,"page_no":null,"line_no":332,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੮॥","translit_en":"sahaj subhaav kar jeevan mukat bhe sevaa sarabaatam kai braham bisavaiaasee hai ||328||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Since he is naturally involved in the worldly duties, he is liberated while still alive (Jeevan Mukt). Seeing the divine light pervading in all, and serving His creation, he holds total faith on Almighty God. (328)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41358,"next":41360}}
files.shabads/82/41360.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41360,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209082","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209082,"last_verse_id":209085,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209082,"page_no":null,"line_no":333,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਭਿਦੈ ਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਕਠੋਰ ਬੂਡੈ ਬਜਰ ਭਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal a(n)tar juga(n)tar basai paakhaan bhidhai na ridhai kaThor booddai bajar bhaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a stone stays in water for ages, yet it never softens since it is hard-hearted. Because of its density and solid mass, it sinks; "}}},{"verse_id":209083,"page_no":null,"line_no":333,"gurmukhi":"ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਕਰੈ ਤੋੰਬਰੀ ਤਊ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਕਰਵਾਈ ਧੋਏ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"aThasaTh teerath majan karai to(n)baree tuoo miTat na karavaiee dhoe vaar paar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as colocynth (Tumma) does not lose its bitterness even it is washed both from inside and outside at sixty-eight places of pilgrimage"}}},{"verse_id":209084,"page_no":null,"line_no":333,"gurmukhi":"ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ਰਹੈ ਚੰਦਨਹਿ ਤਜਤ ਨ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਊ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"ahinis eh lapaTaano rahai cha(n)dhaneh tajat na bikh tuoo haumai aha(n)kaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a snake keeps entangled with the trunk of a Sandalwood tree all his life but because of the pride of long age, it does not shed its venom;"}}},{"verse_id":209085,"page_no":null,"line_no":333,"gurmukhi":"ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੇਹ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਭਏ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੨੯॥","translit_en":"kapaT saneh dheh nihafal bhe jagat mai sa(n)tan ko hai dhokhee dhubidhaa bikaar kai ||329||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, he who is debased and spurious at heart, has deceitful and suspicious love. His life in the world is useless and futile. He is a slanderer of saintly and Guru-oriented persons and is caught in the mesh of vices and sins account of his 'mine' and 'yours' attitude. (329)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41359,"next":41361}}
files.shabads/82/41361.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41361,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209086","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209086,"last_verse_id":209089,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209086,"page_no":null,"line_no":334,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਰਪਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਛੂ ਸਕਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise niramal dharapan mai na chitr kachhoo sakal charitr chitr dhekhat dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a clean mirror has no image in it, but when one looks in it, it shows all the details in their true colours,"}}},{"verse_id":209087,"page_no":null,"line_no":334,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਬਰਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਬਰਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise niramal jal baran ateet reet sakal baran mil baran banaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as clean water is bereft of all shades of colours, but acquires the colour that it mixes with,"}}},{"verse_id":209088,"page_no":null,"line_no":334,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਸੁੰਧਰਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau basu(n)dharaa suaadh baasanaa rahit aaukhadhee anek ras ga(n)dh upajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Earth is free of all tastes and desires but produces myriads of herbs of different effects, plants capable of giving many types of medicinal and aromatic extracts,"}}},{"verse_id":209089,"page_no":null,"line_no":334,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਗਤਿ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੩੩੦॥","translit_en":"taise gurdhev sev alakh abhev gat jaiso jaiso bhaau taisee kaamanaa pujaaviee ||330||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly with whatever sentiment one performs service of indescribable and inaccessible Lord-like True Guru, one's desires are filled accordingly. (330)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41360,"next":41362}}
files.shabads/82/41362.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41362,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209090","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209090,"last_verse_id":209093,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209090,"page_no":null,"line_no":335,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹਾਨਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲੇਖ ਜੰਤ੍ਰਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਬਸਿ ਕਛੁ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sukh dhukh haan mirat poorab likhat lekh ja(n)tran kai na bas kachh ja(n)tree jagadhees hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All events of happiness and sorrow, gain and loss, birth and death etc., take place according to what has been written by the Almighty or is preordained. Nothing is in the hands of living beings. It is all in the hands of the Almighty."}}},{"verse_id":209091,"page_no":null,"line_no":335,"gurmukhi":"ਭੋਗਤ ਬਿਵਸਿ ਮੇਵ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤ ਗਤਿ ਜਸਿ ਕਰ ਤਸਿ ਲੇਪ ਕਾਰਨ ਕੋ ਈਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhogat bivas mev karam kirat gat jas kar tas lep kaaran ko iees hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All living beings bear the fruits of what they had done. Whatever deeds they perform, they are rewarded accordingly. He the Almighty Himself involves the human beings in the performance of various deeds/actions."}}},{"verse_id":209092,"page_no":null,"line_no":335,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਕਿਧੌ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਧੌ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ਘਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਮਤਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾ ਬੀਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"karataa pradhaan kidhau karam kidhau hai jeeau ghaaT baadd kaun kaun mat bisavaiaa bees hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And thus surprised, a question rises in everyone's minds who is the primary cause, God, human being or the action itself? Which of these causes is more or less? What is definitely right? Nothing can be said with any degree of assurance."}}},{"verse_id":209093,"page_no":null,"line_no":335,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਹਾ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਕਹੌ ਕਹਾ ਗਾਰਿ ਅਉ ਅਸੀਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੧॥","translit_en":"asatut ni(n)dhaa kahaa biaapat harakh sog honahaar kahau kahaa gaar aau asees hai ||331||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How does one go through praise and slander, pleasure or sorrow? What is a blessing and what is a curse? Nothing can be said conclusively. One can only reason that all is happening and being caused by the Lord Himself. (331)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41361,"next":41363}}
files.shabads/82/41363.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41363,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209094","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209094,"last_verse_id":209097,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209094,"page_no":null,"line_no":336,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸਰ ਪਰ ਜਉ ਬੈਠਾਈਐ ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਬਗ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਤਜਿ ਮੀਨ ਬੀਨਿ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maanasar par jau baiThaieeaai le jai bag mukataa amol taj meen been khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a heron is taken to Mansarover lake, he will only be picking up small fish instead of invaluable pearls."}}},{"verse_id":209095,"page_no":null,"line_no":336,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਜਉ ਲਗਾਈਐ ਜੋਕ ਪੀਅਤ ਨ ਪੈ ਲੈ ਲੋਹੂ ਅਚਏ ਅਘਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"asathan paan karabe kau jau lagaieeaai jok peeat na pai lai lohoo ache aghaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a leech is put to the teats of a cow, it will not suckle milk but suck blood to satiate its hunger."}}},{"verse_id":209096,"page_no":null,"line_no":336,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਪਰਿ ਮਾਖੀ ਨ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਾਖੀ ਮਹਾਂ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਪਰਿ ਬੇਗ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"param suga(n)dh par maakhee na rahit raakhee mahaa(n) dhuraga(n)dh par beg chal jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A fly when placed on a fragrant article does not stay there but hurriedly reaches where filth and stench is present."}}},{"verse_id":209097,"page_no":null,"line_no":336,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਜ ਮਜਨ ਕੇ ਡਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਛਾਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੨॥","translit_en":"jaise gaj majan ke ddaarat hai chhaar sir sa(n)tan kai dhokhee sa(n)t sa(n)g na suhaat hai ||332||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an elephant sprinkles dust on its head after bathing in clean water, so do the slanderers of saintly persons do not like the company of true and noble persons. (332)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41362,"next":41364}}
files.shabads/82/41364.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41364,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209098","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209098,"last_verse_id":209101,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209098,"page_no":null,"line_no":337,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gurmat sat ek Tek dhuteeaa naasat siv na sakat gat anabhai abhiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Obedient disciple of the True Guru considers the support of Guru teachings and wisdom as authentic and true. He has no one else in his heart other than One God. He does not recognise god-Shiv or goddess-Shakti as a means of emancipation. He remains a meditator of One Fearless God."}}},{"verse_id":209099,"page_no":null,"line_no":337,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਹਾਰ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"tiragun ateet jeet haar na harakh sog sa(n)jog biog meT sahaj nivaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He remains unsullied of the influence of maya. Defeat or victory, happiness or sorrow does not disturb or please him. He remains absorbed in supreme spiritual state discarding all thoughts of achievements and failures."}}},{"verse_id":209100,"page_no":null,"line_no":337,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਬਰਨ ਇਕ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur baran ik baran hui saadh sa(n)g pa(n)ch parapa(n)ch tiaag bisam bisavaiaasee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By joining true congregation he destroys the differences of high low caste and belongs to One God. Detaching from the love of five elements, he takes to Naam Simran of the wondrous God Lord and holds his faith in Him."}}},{"verse_id":209101,"page_no":null,"line_no":337,"gurmukhi":"ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰੈ ਪਾਰ ਹੁਇ ਸਪਤ ਸਰ ਨਵ ਦੁਆਰ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਦਸਮਈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੩॥","translit_en":"khaT dharasan parai paar hui sapat sar nav dhuaar ula(n)gh dhasamiee udhaasee hai ||333||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Gursikh stays in the company of true seekers beyond the garbs of the six philosophical schools. He frees himself from the bonds of nine doors of the body and lives blissfully in of the tenth door (Dasam Duar). (333)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41363,"next":41365}}
files.shabads/82/41365.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41365,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209102","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209102,"last_verse_id":209105,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209102,"page_no":null,"line_no":338,"gurmukhi":"ਨਦੀ ਨਾਵ ਕੋ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਲੋਗ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਓ ਸੋੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"nadhee naav ko sa(n)jog sujan kuTa(n)b log hoigo jo dheeo sooiee milai aagai jai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union with friends, family members and other acquaintances in this world is like voyagers in a boat that lasts for a short period of time. Therefore whatever is donated for good deeds in. this world will be received in the world beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209103,"page_no":null,"line_no":338,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਧਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਲਤ ਚਲੇ ਅਰਪੇ ਦੀਜੈ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ਪਹੁਚਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan dhan sa(n)g na chalat chale arape dheejai dharamasaalaa pahuchai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Food, clothing and wealth does not go with one in the next world. Whatever has been assigned to the Guru in the true company is what one's wealth or earnings are for life beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209104,"page_no":null,"line_no":338,"gurmukhi":"ਆਠੋ ਜਾਮ ਸਾਠੋ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹ ਸਫਲ ਪਲਕ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaTho jaam saaTho gharee nihafal maayaa moh safal palak saadh sa(n)gat samai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Spending all the time in the love of maya and its actions are futile but enjoying the company of saintly persons even for a few seconds is a big achievement and useful."}}},{"verse_id":209105,"page_no":null,"line_no":338,"gurmukhi":"ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਔ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੋਤ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੩੪॥","translit_en":"mal mootr dhaaree aau bikaaree nira(n)kaaree hot sabadh surat saadh sa(n)g liv lai kai ||334||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By uniting the words/teachings of the Guru with mind, and by the grace of holy company, this filth-filled and vice-ridden human being becomes an obedient disciple of the Guru. (334)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41364,"next":41366}}
files.shabads/82/41366.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41366,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209106","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209106,"last_verse_id":209109,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209106,"page_no":null,"line_no":339,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਬੰਝ ਬਨ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haumai abhimaan asathaan taj ba(n)jh ban charan kamal gur sa(n)paT samaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The black bee like mind of a Guru-oriented person who is attached with the congregation of saintly persons, forsakes pride and ego which is like a jungle of bamboos. He leaves attachment and infatuations. Enamoured by the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, he remains engrossed in it."}}},{"verse_id":209107,"page_no":null,"line_no":339,"gurmukhi":"ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਨਹਦ ਗੁੰਜਤ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹੂ ਸਿਰਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"at hee anoop roop herat hiraane dhirag anahadh gu(n)jat sravan hoo siraae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing the most beautiful form of the True Guru, his eyes are amazed. Listening to the pleasing and enchanting notes of the words of Guru, his ears feel calm and tranquil."}}},{"verse_id":209108,"page_no":null,"line_no":339,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਨਾ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਨਾਸਿਕਾ ਚਕਿਤ ਹੀ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਮਹਿਕਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rasanaa bisam at madh makara(n)dh ras naasikaa chakit hee subaas mahikaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Relishing the sweet elixir-like dust of the feet of the True Guru, the tongue enjoys strange bliss and pleasure. The nostrils are amazed by the sweet smell of that dust of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":209109,"page_no":null,"line_no":339,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਮਲਤਾ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਪੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਪੁਨਿ ਅਨਤ ਨਾ ਧਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੫॥","translit_en":"komalataa seetalataa pa(n)g saraba(n)g bhe man madhukar pun anat naa dhaae hai ||335||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Experiencing the calmness and tenderness of the sweet smell of the holy feet of the True Guru, all limbs of the body become stable. The black bee like mind then does not wander anywhere else and remains attached with lotus-like feet. (335)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41365,"next":41367}}
files.shabads/82/41367.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41367,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209110","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209110,"last_verse_id":209113,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209110,"page_no":null,"line_no":340,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਸੁ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਕਾਲ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baasanaa ko baas dhoot sa(n)gat binaas kaal charan kamal gur ek Tek paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who has taken the refuge of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, is freed from attraction of all other smells and involvement in the five vices."}}},{"verse_id":209111,"page_no":null,"line_no":340,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈਜਲ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਸੰਪਟ ਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaijal bhiaanak lahar na biaap sakai nij ghar sa(n)paT kai dhubidhaa miTaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The worldly waves of wants and desires cannot influence him anymore. Having engrossed himself in the Self, he has destroyed all type of duality."}}},{"verse_id":209112,"page_no":null,"line_no":340,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸਿ ਬਸਿ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਨ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aan giaan dhiaan simaran bisimaran kai prem ras bas aasaa manasaa na paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The black bee like lover of the lotus-feet of the True Guru, forgets all other type of knowledge, contemplations and incantations of meditations. He has destroyed all his wants and desires by virtue of his love for the lotus feet of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":209113,"page_no":null,"line_no":340,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੬॥","translit_en":"dhuteeaa naasat ek Tek nihachal mat sahaj samaadh unaman liv laiee hai ||336||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh of the Guru who is lover of the lotus feet (of the Guru) sheds his duality. He remains absorbed in the refuge of the lotus feet. In the higher spiritual state, he is absorbed in the stable contemplation of the Lord. (336)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41366,"next":41368}}
files.shabads/82/41368.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41368,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209114","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209114,"last_verse_id":209117,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209114,"page_no":null,"line_no":341,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੈ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਲੇਖ ਸਯਾਮਤਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj masatak lepan kai bharam karam lekh sayaamataa miTaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The application of the holy dust of the lotus-like feet of the true Guru obliterates the dross of all deeds performed in the previous births under the influence of doubts, suspicions and lack of faith."}}},{"verse_id":209115,"page_no":null,"line_no":341,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਲੀਨ ਮਨਿ ਕਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal charanaamirat maleen man kar niramal dhoot dhubidhaa miTaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By quaffing the nectar-like elixir of the holy feet of the True Guru, the dross of the mind is dispensed and one becomes clean (of heart). He is also freed from the influence of the five evils and other dualities."}}},{"verse_id":209116,"page_no":null,"line_no":341,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਘਰ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਠਹਿਰਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT sahaj ghar nihachal mat ek Tek Thahiraiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in the meditation of the holy name, one lives in abode of God. The consciousness becomes stable and in the refuge of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":209117,"page_no":null,"line_no":341,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਔ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਦਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੭॥","translit_en":"charan kamal gur mahimaa agaadh bodh sarab nidhaan aau sakal fal dhaiee hai ||337||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The knowledge of the glory of True Guru's holy feet is limitless and vast. He is the store-house of all material goods and a perfect and complete donor. (337)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41367,"next":41369}}
files.shabads/82/41369.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41369,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209118","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209118,"last_verse_id":209121,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209118,"page_no":null,"line_no":342,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਕੈ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਕੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj majan kai dhib dheh mahaa mal mootr dhaaree nira(n)kaaree keene hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bathing in the holy dust of the True Guru's feet, the body of an individual acquires golden hue. One who is evil of thoughts, becomes Guru-oriented and divine of temperaments."}}},{"verse_id":209119,"page_no":null,"line_no":342,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਆਪਾ ਆਪ ਚੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal charanaamirat nidhaan paan tiragun ateet cheet aapaa aap cheene hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By relishing the elixir of the True Guru's feet, the mind is freed from the triple traits of maya (mammon). He then recognises his self."}}},{"verse_id":209120,"page_no":null,"line_no":342,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਔ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal nij aasan si(n)ghaasan kai tirabhavan aau tirakaal ga(n)mitaa prabeene hai(n) ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By instilling the lotus-like holy feet of the True Guru in self, I.e. mind, one becomes aware of all the three times and the three worlds."}}},{"verse_id":209121,"page_no":null,"line_no":342,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਰੂਪ ਸੀਤਲਤਾ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨੇ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੩੮॥","translit_en":"charan kamal ras ga(n)dh roop seetalataa dhuteeaa naasat ek Tek liv leene hai(n) ||338||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By relishing the coolness, sweetness, fragrance and beauty of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, the duality disappears from the mind. One remains absorbed in the refuge and support of the holy feet (of the True Guru). (338)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41368,"next":41370}}
files.shabads/82/41370.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41370,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209122","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209122,"last_verse_id":209125,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209122,"page_no":null,"line_no":343,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪੁਰਬ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj majan prataap at purab teerath koT charan saran hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bathing in the holy dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru has great significance. Millions of places of pilgrimage reside in the refuge of the True Guru. One is deemed to have visited all the holy places by the touch of the dust of His holy feet."}}},{"verse_id":209123,"page_no":null,"line_no":343,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਪੂਜਤ ਚਰਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj majan prataap at dhevee dhev sevak hui poojat charan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory and grandeur of the dust of True Guru's holy feet supreme. All gods and goddesses worship Him as His humble servants. (worship of all gods and goddesses lie in feet of the True Guru)."}}},{"verse_id":209124,"page_no":null,"line_no":343,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਕਾਰਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਕੀਨ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj majan prataap at kaaran adheen keen kaaran karan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The significance of bathing in the dust of the holy feet of True Guru is so great· that he who is ever under the causes, himself becomes the creator of those causes, by becoming a devoted slave of the True Guru."}}},{"verse_id":209125,"page_no":null,"line_no":343,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਜ ਮਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਭਏ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੩੯॥","translit_en":"charan kamal raj majan prataap at patit puneet bhe taaran taran hai ||339||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Importance of touching of True Guru's holy feet is so supreme that a human being badly soiled in sins of maya becomes pious in his refuge. He even becomes a ship for others to sail across the worldly ocean. (339)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41369,"next":41371}}
files.shabads/82/41371.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41371,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209126","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209126,"last_verse_id":209129,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209126,"page_no":null,"line_no":344,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੰਸ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਧਰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ਚਲਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"maanasar ha(n)s saadh sa(n)gat param ha(n)s dharam dhujaa dharamasaalaa chal aavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as swans visit lake Mansarover, so do the righteous people with divine wisdom visit the holy congregation of Lord's loving servants/devotees."}}},{"verse_id":209127,"page_no":null,"line_no":344,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਅਗਰ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਇਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"aut mukataahal agar dhuteeaa naasat it gur sabadh surat liv laavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There, at Mansarover, the swans relish pearls as their food and nothing else; so do these devotees engross their minds in the holy Naam of the Lord and remains attached with His divine words."}}},{"verse_id":209128,"page_no":null,"line_no":344,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਇਤ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"aut kheer neer niravaaro kai bakhaaneeat it gurmat dhuramat samajhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The swans are believed to disintegrate milk in its constituents of water and milk; while here in the holy congregation, one learns about those who are Guru-oriented and self-oriented."}}},{"verse_id":209129,"page_no":null,"line_no":344,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤ ਬਗ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਕੈ ਇਤ ਕਾਗ ਪਾਗਿ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੪੦॥","translit_en":"aut bag ha(n)s ba(n)s dhubidhaa na meT sakai it kaag paag sam roop kai milaavahee ||340||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The temperament of herons cannot be changed into those of swans but here in the holy congregation, those who are like filth-eating crows are transformed into holy and devoted persons through the hue of Naam blessed by the True Guru. (340)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41370,"next":41372}}
files.shabads/82/41372.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41372,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209130","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209130,"last_verse_id":209133,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209130,"page_no":null,"line_no":345,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਛਿਨ ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap chhin siv sanakaadh brahamaadhik na paavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even gods like Shiv, Brahma, Sanak etc. are unable to acquire the importance of the congregation that one achieves by keeping the company of the obedient and devoted disciples of the True Guru even for a second."}}},{"verse_id":209131,"page_no":null,"line_no":345,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਉ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਹੂ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"simirat puraan bedh saasatr aau naadh baadh raag raaganee hoo net net kar gaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A very short while spent in the holy congregation is sung as infinite, infinite by various religious scriptures like Simritis, Purans, Vedas beside the musical instruments, and various modes of singing."}}},{"verse_id":209132,"page_no":null,"line_no":345,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਉ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhevee dhev sarab nidhaan aau sakal fal savairag samooh sukh dhiaan dhar dhiaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All goddesses, gods, treasures, fruits and comforts of heaven sing and remember the peace that they enjoyed even with a fractional association with congregation of the saints."}}},{"verse_id":209133,"page_no":null,"line_no":345,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੪੧॥","translit_en":"pooran braham satigur saavadhaan jaan gursikh sabadh surat liv laavahee ||341||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The obedient disciples attach their mind and engross themselves in the words of the True Guru with singular mind considering the True Guru to be complete and perfect form of Lord. (341)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41371,"next":41373}}
files.shabads/82/41373.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41373,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209134","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209134,"last_verse_id":209137,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209134,"page_no":null,"line_no":346,"gurmukhi":"ਰਚਨਾ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਕੀਨੋ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rachanaa charitr chitr bisam bachitr pan kaahoo so na kouoo keeno ek hee anek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Miracle of His creation is wondrous and astonishing. No human being has been created like another. Yet His light prevails in all."}}},{"verse_id":209135,"page_no":null,"line_no":346,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਪਟ ਕਪਟ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਟ ਵਟ ਨਟ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਅਟ ਪਟ ਜਾਵਦੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nipaT kapaT ghaT ghaT naT vaT naT gupat pragaT aT paT jaavadhek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This world is an illusion. But every creation that is part of this entangled illusion, He, Himself is causing these wondrous acts both conspicuously and latently like a juggler."}}},{"verse_id":209136,"page_no":null,"line_no":346,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਚਨ ਸੋ ਬਚਨ ਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮੇਕ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhirasaT see dhirasaT na dharasan so dharas bachan so bachan na surat samek hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this creation, no one looks alike, talks alike, thinks alike or sees alike. No one's wisdom is the same."}}},{"verse_id":209137,"page_no":null,"line_no":346,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਰੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੨॥","translit_en":"roop rekh lekh bhekh naadh baadh naanaa bidh agam agaadh bodh braham bibek hai ||342||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living beings are of myriad forms, fortune, posture, sound and rhythm. All this is beyond comprehension and knowledge. In fact it is beyond human capability to understand the strange and wondrous creation of the Lord. (342)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41372,"next":41374}}
files.shabads/82/41374.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41374,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209138","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209138,"last_verse_id":209141,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209138,"page_no":null,"line_no":347,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sat roop satigur pooran braham dhiaan sat naam satigur te paarabraham hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True of form, the True Guru is the embodiment of the perfect Lord. Focusing on True Guru is truly focusing on the Lord. True Guru helps us realise the Lord of Eternal Name."}}},{"verse_id":209139,"page_no":null,"line_no":347,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਸਤਿ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sat gur sabadh anaahadh braham giaan gurmukh pa(n)th sat ga(n)mitaa aga(n)m hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru-blessed unstruck word is eternal of form and this is the means of divine knowledge and His realisation. The Guru-wise path defined by the True Guru is eternal of form, but this path is beyond reach."}}},{"verse_id":209140,"page_no":null,"line_no":347,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਸਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਮੈ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸਮ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh saadh sa(n)g braham sathaan sat keeratan samai hui saavadhaan sam hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The assembly of Guru's obedient and saintly disciples is the abode of the eternal Lord. Singing His praises through Gurbani with singular mind, a devoted disciple becomes one with God, the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":209141,"page_no":null,"line_no":347,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਚਾਉ ਸਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੩॥","translit_en":"gurmukh bhaavanee bhagat bhaau chaau sat sahaj subhaau gurmukh namo nam hai ||343||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The heart of a Guru-conscious disciple of the Guru is ever filled with loving devotion and enthusiasm of His worship. Salute such a cool-natured Guru-conscious disciple again and again. (343)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41373,"next":41375}}
files.shabads/82/41375.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41375,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209142","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209142,"last_verse_id":209145,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209142,"page_no":null,"line_no":348,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਨਿਰਾਹਾਰ ਨਿਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਭੇਵ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"nira(n)kaar niraadhaar niraahaar nir bikaar ajonee akaal apara(n)par abhev hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The eternal form of the Lord whose embodiment is True Guru, is formless, who is bereft of all support, who has no desire of any food, who is free of all vices, free of entering wombs to take birth, who is imperishable, limitless and who cannot be fathomed."}}},{"verse_id":209143,"page_no":null,"line_no":348,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਮੋਹ ਨਿਰਬੈਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਤਹ ਪਰ ਅਤ ਏਵ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niramoh nirabair niralep niradhokh nirabhai nira(n)jan ateh par at ev hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is sans attachment, animosity, free of all allurements and stigmas, fearless, uninfluenced by maya and is beyond the beyond."}}},{"verse_id":209144,"page_no":null,"line_no":348,"gurmukhi":"ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਲਖ ਅਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਵ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"abigat agam agochar agaadh bodh achut alakh at achhal achhev hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whose extent cannot be known, is imperceptible, beyond the senses, whose expanse is unknowable, who is ever stable, beyond perceptions, is beyond deception nor can be hurt by anyone."}}},{"verse_id":209145,"page_no":null,"line_no":348,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਸਚਰਜੈ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੪॥","translit_en":"bisamai bisam asacharajai asacharaj mai adhabhut paramadhabhut gurdhev hai ||344||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Knowing Him is most baffling, amazing and astonishing that can make anyone blissfully ecstatic. The effulgent of form the True Guru is the form of such an eternal and radiant God Lord. (344)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41374,"next":41376}}
files.shabads/82/41376.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41376,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209146","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209146,"last_verse_id":209149,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209146,"page_no":null,"line_no":349,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਰਤਕ ਮਾਸ ਰੁਤਿ ਸਰਦ ਪੂਰਨਮਾਸੀ ਆਠ ਜਾਮ ਸਾਠ ਘਰੀ ਆਜ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaaratak maas rut saradh pooranamaasee aaTh jaam saaTh gharee aaj teree baaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is the month of Karlik, and winter season with full moon night. In these eight watches, here is your chance to meet your beloved at any time. (Guru Nanak Dev Ji was born on this day)."}}},{"verse_id":209147,"page_no":null,"line_no":349,"gurmukhi":"ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਹੁਇ ਰੂਪ ਗੁਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aausar abheech bahu naik kee naikaa hui roop gun joban si(n)gaar adhikaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Therefore, you too be the rightful person to meet the beloved Lord of myriad other female-like seekers, with your loving devotion, love, worship like beauty and adornment of youthful virtues on this auspicious moment of star configuration."}}},{"verse_id":209148,"page_no":null,"line_no":349,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਤਿਰ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਠ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸਾਠਿ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chaatir chatur paaTh sevak sahelee saaTh sa(n)padhaa samagree sukh sahaj suchaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You are alert and adept in Naam Simran, the sixty main veins of your body are your friends and in your obedience, and you are the possessor of equipoise, beauteous treasure and other items of great value."}}},{"verse_id":209149,"page_no":null,"line_no":349,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਭ ਲਗਨ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਨਮ ਧੰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੫॥","translit_en":"su(n)dhar ma(n)dhar subh lagan sa(n)jog bhog jeevan janam dha(n)n preetam piaaree hai ||345||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In this auspicious occasion, acquiring the union of the temple-like body with the beloved Lord on the nuptial bed of the heart will make your human birth and life a blessed one. And thus you become the beloved of your dear and loving husband (God). (345)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41375,"next":41377}}
files.shabads/82/41377.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41377,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209150","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209150,"last_verse_id":209153,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209150,"page_no":null,"line_no":350,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਨਕਰ ਕਿਰਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਅੰਗ ਰਚਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਖੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhinakar kiran suhaat sukhadhaiee a(n)g rachat si(n)gaar abharan sakhee aai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(Before the girl is married off, the bride is adorned with ornaments and jewellery) and the rays of Sun falling on her, make her look more good. Her friends come to embellish her more."}}},{"verse_id":209151,"page_no":null,"line_no":350,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਉਬਟਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੀਸ ਮੈ ਮਲਉਨੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਜਨ ਉਸਨ ਜਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"piratham ubaTanaa kai sees mai malaunee mel majan usan jal niramal bhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Paste of herbs, oil and salts is rubbed on her body, the hair are massaged with scents and oil and then shampooed with lukewarm water. Her body then starts radiating like gold."}}},{"verse_id":209152,"page_no":null,"line_no":350,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਸਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਕੇਸ ਬਾਸਤ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਮੇਲ ਅੰਗ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਲੇਪ ਹੇਤ ਉਪਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kusam aves kes baasat fulel mel a(n)g aragajaa lep het upajai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Adoring the hair with flowers, applying the mixture of fragranced and scented mixture on the body, the feeling of romance and love is incited."}}},{"verse_id":209153,"page_no":null,"line_no":350,"gurmukhi":"ਚੀਰ ਚਾਰ ਦਰਪਨ ਮਧਿ ਆਪਾ ਆਪੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਬੈਠੀ ਪਰਜੰਕ ਪਰਿ ਧਾਵਰੀ ਨ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੪੬॥","translit_en":"cheer chaar dharapan madh aapaa aap cheen baiThee paraja(n)k par dhaavaree na dhai kai ||346||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wearing beautiful dresses, seeing her beautiful form in the mirror, she occupies the bed of her dear husband. Then her wandering mind does not wander any more and becomes stable and restful. (346)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41376,"next":41378}}
files.shabads/82/41378.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41378,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209154","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209154,"last_verse_id":209157,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209154,"page_no":null,"line_no":351,"gurmukhi":"ਕਕਹੀ ਦੈ ਮਾਂਗ ਉਰਝਾਏ ਸੁਰਝਾਏ ਕੇਸ ਕੁੰਕਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਕੋ ਤਿਲਕ ਦੇ ਲਿਲਾਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"kakahee dhai maa(n)g urajhaae surajhaae kes ku(n)kam cha(n)dhan ko tilak dhe lilaar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She should comb her entangled hair and create a neat parting in her hair, apply a dot of saffron and sandalwood on her forehead."}}},{"verse_id":209155,"page_no":null,"line_no":351,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਜਨ ਖੰਜਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਬੇਸਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਫੁਲ ਬਾਰੀ ਸੀਸ ਫੂਲ ਦੈ ਤਮੋਲ ਮੁਖ ਦੁਆਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)jan kha(n)jan dhirag besar karan ful baaree sees fool dhai tamol mukh dhuaar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Put collyrium in her frolicsome eyes, a ring in the nose, earrings, wear dome-shaped ornament on the head and wait at the main entrance chewing betel leaf."}}},{"verse_id":209156,"page_no":null,"line_no":351,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਠ ਸਰੀ ਕਪੋਤਿ ਮਰਕਤ ਅਉ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫੂਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)Th saree kapot marakat aau mukataahal baran baran fool sobhaa ur haar mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wear diamond and pearl-studded necklace and adorn her heart with colourful flowers of virtuous qualities,"}}},{"verse_id":209157,"page_no":null,"line_no":351,"gurmukhi":"ਚਚਰ ਚਰੀ ਕੰਕਨ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਿਕਾ ਮਹਦੀ ਬਨੀ  ਅੰਗੀਆ ਅਨੂਪ ਛੁਦ੍ਰਪੀਠਿ ਕਟਿ ਧਾਰ ਮੈ ॥੩੪੭॥","translit_en":"chachar charee ka(n)kan mu(n)dhirakaa mahadhee banee  a(n)geeaa anoop chhudhrapeeTh kaT dhaar mai ||347||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wear colourful rings in her fingers, bracelets, bangles on her wrists, apply henna on her hands, wear a beautiful bodice and a black thread with trinkets around her waist. Note: All the above adornments are related to the virtues and Naam Simran of the Sikh philosophy as preached by Gurus. (347)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41377,"next":41379}}
files.shabads/82/41379.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41379,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209158","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209158,"last_verse_id":209161,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209158,"page_no":null,"line_no":352,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਭਿਤ ਸਰਦ ਨਿਸਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sobhit saradh nis jagamag jot sas pratham sahelee kahai prem ras chaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Note: Abandon bashfulness and enjoy the love of the beloved husband at the time of meeting Him. It is a wintry night and the Moon is spreading its light all around. A friend of the holy congregation urges to obtain Guru's sermons in order to enjoy the elixir of Lord husband's love."}}},{"verse_id":209159,"page_no":null,"line_no":352,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਏ ਹੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ  ਮਿਲੀਐ ਨਿਰੰਤਰ ਹੁਇ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"pooran kirapaa kai terai aae hai kirapaa nidhaan  mileeaai nira(n)tar hui a(n)tar na raakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And when the clement Lord in His complete blessings comes and rests on your bed-like heart, then meet Him without any reservations and inhibitions."}}},{"verse_id":209160,"page_no":null,"line_no":352,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਭਿਲਾਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras lubhit hui man madhukar sukh sa(n)paT bhilaakheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"May the frolicsome mind remain longing for the fragrant dust of the lotus feet of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":209161,"page_no":null,"line_no":352,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਲਜਾਇ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਦਮ ਦੈ ਪਲਕ ਅਮੋਲ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗ ਮੁਖ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥੩੪੮॥","translit_en":"joiee lajai paieeaai na pun padham dhai palak amol pria sa(n)g mukh saakheeaai ||348||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious persons testify that any seeker bride who remains shy and bashful at the time of meeting with husband Lord, loses that rare opportunity. She is then unable to obtain the invaluable moment even after spending countless money. (348)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41378,"next":41380}}
files.shabads/82/41380.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41380,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209162","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209162,"last_verse_id":209165,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209162,"page_no":null,"line_no":353,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਚਨ ਅਸੁਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕੁਠਾਲੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੁਧ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)chan asudh jaise bhramat kuThaalee bikhai sudh bhe bhramat na paavak pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As impure gold when heated in a crucible, keep on moving here and there but when purified becomes stable and glitters like fire."}}},{"verse_id":209163,"page_no":null,"line_no":353,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰ ਕੰਕਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kar ka(n)kan anek mai pragaT dhun ekai ek Tek pun dhun ko binaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If many bangles are worn in one arm, they keep making noise by striking with each other but when melted and made into one become quiet and noiseless."}}},{"verse_id":209164,"page_no":null,"line_no":353,"gurmukhi":"ਖੁਧਿਆ ਕੈ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khudhiaa kai baalak bilalaat akulaat at asathan paan kar sahaj nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a child cries when hungry but becomes quiet and peaceful after suckling milk from his mother's breasts."}}},{"verse_id":209165,"page_no":null,"line_no":353,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਧਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪਦ ਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੪੯॥","translit_en":"taise maiaa bhramat bhramat chatur ka(n)uT dhaavai gur upadhes nihachal gireh padh baas hai ||349||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a human mind engulfed in worldly attachments and love keeps on wandering all over. But by the sermons of the True Guru, he becomes stable and calm. (349)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41379,"next":41381}}
files.shabads/82/41381.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41381,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209166","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209166,"last_verse_id":209169,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209166,"page_no":null,"line_no":354,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਭਵਨ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਹੋਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep dhipat bhavan ujiaaro hot sagal samagree gireh pragaT dhikhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a house is lit up when a lamp is lighted in it, it makes everything visible clearly;"}}},{"verse_id":209167,"page_no":null,"line_no":354,"gurmukhi":"ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਬਾਛਤ ਸਿਧਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ot pot jot hot kaaraj baachhat sidh aana(n)dh binodh sukh sahaj bihaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With light spreading all around, all the tasks can be accomplished with ease and the time passes in peace and happiness;"}}},{"verse_id":209168,"page_no":null,"line_no":354,"gurmukhi":"ਲਾਲਚ ਲੁਭਾਇ ਰਸ ਲੁਬਿਤ ਨਾਨਾ ਪਤੰਗ ਬੁਝਤ ਹੀ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"laalach lubhai ras lubit naanaa pata(n)g bujhat hee a(n)dhakaar bhe akulaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many moths are enamoured by the light of the lamp but are distressed when the light goes off and darkness descends;"}}},{"verse_id":209169,"page_no":null,"line_no":354,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਦਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਅੰਤਿਰੀਛ ਭਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਲੋਗ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੦॥","translit_en":"taise bidhamaan jaaneeaai na mahimaa mahaa(n)t a(n)tireechh bhe paachhe log pachhutaat hai ||350||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as those alive do not value a lamp until it turns off, similarly people repent and feel sad for not taking advantage of the presence of the True Guru after they have gone. They do not bother to know the greatness of the True Guru. (350)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41380,"next":41382}}
files.shabads/82/41382.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41382,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209170","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209170,"last_verse_id":209173,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209170,"page_no":null,"line_no":355,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਮਹਾਤਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ਬੁਝਤ ਹੀ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਭਟਕਤ ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dheep dhipat mahaatamai na jaanai kouoo bujhat hee a(n)dhakaar bhaTakat raat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the significance of a lit lamp is not appreciated by anyone, but when it is extinguished, one has to wander in the darkness."}}},{"verse_id":209171,"page_no":null,"line_no":355,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੂ੍ਰਮ ਆਂਗਨਿ ਅਛਿਤ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਟਤ ਹੀ ਛਾਂਹਿ ਬੈਠਬੇ ਕਉ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhaooram aa(n)gan achhit mahimaa na jaanai kaTat hee chhaa(n)h baiThabe kau bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree in the courtyard is not appreciated, but when felled or uprooted one longs for its shade."}}},{"verse_id":209172,"page_no":null,"line_no":355,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਚੈਨ ਹੁਇ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਢਾਲਾ ਚਾਲ ਭਏ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raajaneet bikhai chain hui chatur ka(n)uT chhatr ddaalaa chaal bhe jatr katr jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as enforcement of law and order of the kingdom ensures peace and prosperity everywhere, but chaos prevails when enforcement is compromised."}}},{"verse_id":209173,"page_no":null,"line_no":355,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਮ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਅੰਤਿਰੀਛ ਭਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਲੋਗ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੧॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh saadh sa(n)gam jugat jag a(n)tireechh bhe paachhe log pachhutaat hai ||351||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the unique opportunity for the Sikhs of the Guru to meet with the saintly True Guru. Once missed, everyone repents. (351)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41381,"next":41383}}
files.shabads/82/41383.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41383,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209174","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209174,"last_verse_id":209177,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209174,"page_no":null,"line_no":356,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉਪੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਕੈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਛਤ ਅੰਧ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਪੇਖਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaupai jaanai anoop roop dhiragan kai dhekheeat lochan achhat a(n)dh kaahe na pekhahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we believe that we see the beauty of the nature because of our eyes, then why can't a blind person who has no eyes, enjoy the same spectacle?"}}},{"verse_id":209175,"page_no":null,"line_no":356,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਬਦ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਅਛਤ ਕਤ ਗੰੁਗ ਨ ਸਰੇਖ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jau jaanai sabadh ras rasanaa bakhaaneeat jihabaa achhat kat ga(n)ug na sarekh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we believe that we speak sweet words because of our tongue, then why can't a dumb person with his tongue intact speak these words?"}}},{"verse_id":209176,"page_no":null,"line_no":356,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉਪੈ ਜਾਨੇ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸਹਤ ਕਿਉ ਬਹਰੋ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaupai jaane raag naadh suneeat sravan kai sravan sahat kiau baharo bisekh hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we accept that we hear sweet music because of ears, then why can't a deaf person hear it with his ears intact?"}}},{"verse_id":209177,"page_no":null,"line_no":356,"gurmukhi":"ਨੈਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਬਸਾਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋ ਅਲਖ ਲੇਖ ਲੇਖਹੀ ॥੩੫੨॥","translit_en":"nain jihavaa sravan ko na kachhooaai basai sabadh surat so alakh lekh lekhahee ||352||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eyes, tongue and ears have no power of their own; only with words, can they enable us to enjoy what we see, speak or hear. Similarly, engaging with the words of the Guru and meditating on Naam, is it possible to realize and enjoy the Gurus love."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41382,"next":41384}}
files.shabads/82/41384.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41384,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209178","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209178,"last_verse_id":209181,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209178,"page_no":null,"line_no":357,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਨੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਗਵੈ ਜਠਰ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਿੰਡ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jananee jatan kar jugavai jaThar raakhai taa te pi(n)dd pooran hui sut janamat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a pregnant woman takes all possible care of herself during her pregnancy and on completion of the period gives birth to a baby boy;"}}},{"verse_id":209179,"page_no":null,"line_no":357,"gurmukhi":"ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਅਖਾਦਿ ਖਾਦਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਰਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ਤੇ ਪੈ ਪੀਅਤ ਅਰੋਗ ਪਨ ਪਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bahurio akhaadh khaadh sa(n)jam sahit rahai taahee te pai peeat arog pan pat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then she observes and controls her eating habits meticulously and rigidly that helps the young child to grow healthy by consuming his mother's milk."}}},{"verse_id":209180,"page_no":null,"line_no":357,"gurmukhi":"ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਚਿਤ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਬਾਲੁ ਤਊ ਤਨ ਗਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mal mootr dhaar ko bichaar na bichaarai chit karai pratipaal baal tuoo tan gat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mother cares not about all the filth of the child and brings him up to give him a healthy body."}}},{"verse_id":209181,"page_no":null,"line_no":357,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਅਰਭਕ ਰੂਪ ਸਿਖ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਸਨ ਗਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੩॥","translit_en":"taise arabhak roop sikh hai sa(n)saar madh sree gur dhiaal kee dhiaa kai san gat hai ||353||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is a disciple (Sikh), like a child in this world who like the mother is blessed by the Guru with Naam Simran that ultimately emancipates him. (353)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41383,"next":41385}}
files.shabads/82/41385.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41385,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209182","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209182,"last_verse_id":209185,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209182,"page_no":null,"line_no":358,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਨਨੀ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤਾਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਅਰੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau jananee khaan paan kau sa(n)jam karai taate sut rahai nirabighan arog jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a would-be mother takes care of what she eats so that the child in her womb remains healthy."}}},{"verse_id":209183,"page_no":null,"line_no":358,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚੈਤੰਨ ਰੂਪ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਿੰਤ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਬਸਤ ਲੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raajaneet reet chakravai chaita(n)n roop taa te nihachi(n)t nirabhai basat log jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a good ruler remains alert in the enforcement of law and order so as to keep his subjects safe, fearless of any harm and happy."}}},{"verse_id":209184,"page_no":null,"line_no":358,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰੀਆ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੰੁਚਤ ਪਥਿਕ ਅਸੋਗ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kareeaa samu(n)dhr bohith mai saavadhaan taa te paar paha(n)uchat pathik asog jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sailor is ever alert while sailing his boat in the ocean so that he takes all his passengers safely to other shore."}}},{"verse_id":209185,"page_no":null,"line_no":358,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਸਿਖ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਜੋਗ ਜੀ ॥੩੫੪॥","translit_en":"taise gur pooran braham giaan dhiaan liv taa(n) te niradhokh sikh nij padh jog jee ||354||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the God-like True Guru is ever alert to bless his loving and devoted servant with knowledge and ability to focus his mind in Lord's name. And thus a Sikh of the Guru keeps himself free of all vices and becomes eligible for higher spiritual state. (354)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41384,"next":41386}}
files.shabads/82/41386.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41386,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209186","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209186,"last_verse_id":209189,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209186,"page_no":null,"line_no":359,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਨੀ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਜਉ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਪਿਆਰ ਝਿਰਕਾਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jananee suteh jau dhikaar maar piaar karai piaar jhirakaar dhekh sakat na aan ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mother scolds and spanks the child but cannot tolerate anyone else scolding, spanking and loving him."}}},{"verse_id":209187,"page_no":null,"line_no":359,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਨੀ ਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਅਉ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਹੇਤ ਆਨ ਕੋ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਪਿਆਰ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jananee ko piaar aau dhikaar upakaar het aan ko dhikaar piaar hai bikaar praan ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mothers scolding and spanking of the child is for his benefit but when someone else does it, it is indeed painful."}}},{"verse_id":209188,"page_no":null,"line_no":359,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਪਰੈ ਬੂਡ ਮਰੈ ਜਰੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਪ ਆਨ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal agan mai parai boodd marai jarai taise kirapaa krop aan banitaa agiaan ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":" (Although water is cold and fire is hot) falling in water drowns while jumping into fire burns a person to death. Similarly it is foolish to believe on the kindness or anger of another woman. (It is utter foolishness to lay faith on any other god/goddess or so-called saint; leaving the True Guru)."}}},{"verse_id":209189,"page_no":null,"line_no":359,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਜੁਗਵਤ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕੋ ॥੩੫੫॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikhan ko jugavat jatan kai dhubidhaa na biaapai prem param nidhaan ko ||355||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just like mother, the True Guru makes every effort and attaches the Sikhs in the love of the Supreme Lord, the source of everything. And thus they are never infatuated or attracted by the love or anger of any god/goddess or spurious saint. (355)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41385,"next":41387}}
files.shabads/82/41387.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41387,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209190","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209190,"last_verse_id":209193,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209190,"page_no":null,"line_no":360,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰ ਗਹਤ ਸਰਪ ਸੁਤ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਫੁਸਲਾਇ ਉਰ ਮੰਡ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kar gahat sarap sut pekh maataa kahai na pukaar fusalai ur ma(n)dd hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as seeing a snake in the hands of her son, the mother does not shout but very calmly endears him to herself."}}},{"verse_id":209191,"page_no":null,"line_no":360,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਦ ਰੋਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸੰਜਮ ਕੈ ਔਖਦ ਖਵਾਇ ਰੋਗ ਡੰਡ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baidh rogee prat kahai na bisathaar birathaa sa(n)jam kai aauakhadh khavai rog dda(n)dd hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a physician does not disclose the details of ailment to the patient but serves him medicine within strict preventions and makes him well."}}},{"verse_id":209192,"page_no":null,"line_no":360,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਚਟੀਆ ਕੀ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ਪਾਧਾ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਸੀਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਖੰਡ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bhool chook chaTeeaa kee na beechaarai paadhaa keh keh seekhiaa moorakhat mat kha(n)dd hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the teacher does not take the mistake of his student to heart, and instead he removes his ignorance by imparting him with necessary lesson."}}},{"verse_id":209193,"page_no":null,"line_no":360,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਅਉਗਨ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਮਝਾਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੬॥","translit_en":"taise pekh aaugan kahai na satigur kaahoo pooran bibek samajhaavat pracha(n)dd hai ||356||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru says nothing to a vice-infested disciple. Instead, he is blessed with complete knowledge. He makes him understand and changes him into a sharp-minded wise person. (356)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41386,"next":41388}}
files.shabads/82/41388.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41388,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209194","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209194,"last_verse_id":209197,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209194,"page_no":null,"line_no":361,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਪੋਖਿ ਤੋਖਿ ਬਾਲਕਹਿ ਅਸਥਨ ਪਾਨ ਬਾਨਿ ਜਨਨੀ ਮਿਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise misaTaan paan pokh tokh baalakeh asathan paan baan jananee miTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mother weans away the child from sucking her breast by feeding him with sweet meats."}}},{"verse_id":209195,"page_no":null,"line_no":361,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਉਖਦ ਖਵਾਵੈ ਬੈਦੁ ਮੀਠੋ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਤ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗਹਿ ਘਟਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"misaree milai jaise aaukhadh khavaavai baidh meeTho kar khaat rogee rogeh ghaTaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a physician serves medicine coated with sugar to his patient who readily swallows it, the physician thus cures the patient."}}},{"verse_id":209196,"page_no":null,"line_no":361,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲੁ ਸੀਚਿ ਸੀਚਿ ਧਾਨਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾਨ ਪਾਲੈ ਪਰਪਕ ਭਏ ਕਟਿ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਲਿਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal seech seech dhaaneh kirasaan paalai parapak bhe kaT ghar mai liaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a farmer irrigates his fields and brings up crops or rice and wheat and when ripe, harvests them and brings it home."}}},{"verse_id":209197,"page_no":null,"line_no":361,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਾਮੁ ਸਿਖੈ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਈ ॥੩੫੭॥","translit_en":"taise gur kaamanaa pujai nihakaam kar nij padh naam dhaam sikhai pahuchaaviee ||357||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a True Guru free a Sikh from the worldly affairs and fulfils his desire of consecration. Thus he raises the Sikh high up spiritually through perpetual Naam Simran. (357)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41387,"next":41389}}
files.shabads/82/41389.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41389,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209198","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209198,"last_verse_id":209201,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209198,"page_no":null,"line_no":362,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਤ ਰਾਖਤ ਜਨਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਤਾ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਚੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan praan sut raakhat jananee prat avagun gun maataa chit mai na chet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a son leaves his understanding, perception and protection of his life in the care of his mother, and she too does not think of her son's merits and demerits."}}},{"verse_id":209199,"page_no":null,"line_no":362,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਭਰਤਾਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਲਨਾ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bharataar bhaar naar ur haar maanai taa(n) te laal lalanaa ko maan man let hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife filled with love of her husband, bears all the load of her husband on her mind, the husband too makes loving and respectful room for her in his heart."}}},{"verse_id":209200,"page_no":null,"line_no":362,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੀਤਿ ਸਕੁਚਤ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਚੂਕਿ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਛਾਡਤ ਨ ਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chaTeeaa sabheet sakuchat paa(n)dhaa pekh taa(n) te bhool chook paa(n)dhaa chhaaddat na het hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a student feels petrified at the sight of the teacher and as a reaction, the teacher too ignores his mistakes under the influence of this reverential fear and does not give up loving him."}}},{"verse_id":209201,"page_no":null,"line_no":362,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਿਖ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਮ ਦੂਤਹਿ ਨ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੮॥","translit_en":"man bach kram gur charan saran sikh taa te satigur jam dhooteh na dhet hai ||358||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a Sikh of the Guru who takes rage;"}}},{"verse_id":209203,"page_no":null,"line_no":363,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਲੋਭ ਲੋਭੀ ਹੁਇ ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਗਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan lobh lobhee hui laalach karai koTin koTaan moh moh avagaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If he is visited by millions and millions of allurements of greed and attachments to entangle sa(n)pai sukh bal chhal chaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions and millions of such temptations are visited upon him like enemies that would make him proud, enticing him with wealth, luxuries and physical power;"}}},{"verse_id":209205,"page_no":null,"line_no":363,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੇ ਰੋਮਹਿ ਨ ਚਾਪ ਸਕੈ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥੩੫੯॥","translit_en":"satigur sikhan ke romeh na chaap sakai jaa mai gur giaan dhiaan sasatr sanaeh jee ||359||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"These evil forces cannot even harm a hair of the body of these Sikhs of the Guru who are blessed with the weapons and armour of the knowledge and consecration of True Guru. (359)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41389,"next":41391}}
files.shabads/82/41391.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41391,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209206","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209206,"last_verse_id":209209,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209206,"page_no":null,"line_no":364,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਊਚ ਅਚਲ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਵਨ ਜਲ ਬਿਆਪ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sumer uooch achal aga(n)m at paavak pavan jal biaap na sakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As Sumer mountain is believed to be very high, immovable and inaccessible, it is least influenced by fire, air and water;"}}},{"verse_id":209207,"page_no":null,"line_no":364,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਬਾਨੀ ਚਉਗਨੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਤ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਚਮਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"paavak pragaas taas baanee chauganee chaRhat paun gaun dhoor dhoor hoi chamakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It shines and blazes in fire many times more while the air removes its dust making it glitter far more,"}}},{"verse_id":209208,"page_no":null,"line_no":364,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਮ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਜਮ ਬਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gam salil mal dhoi niramal karai harai dhukh dhekh sun sujam bakat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water pouring on it makes it clean washing away all its dross. It dispels the distresses of the world by providing them with many herbs and medicinal plants. Because of all these virtuous qualities, people sing the glory of Sumer mountain."}}},{"verse_id":209209,"page_no":null,"line_no":364,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਜੋਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਛਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikh jogee tiragun ateet cheet sree gur sabadh ras a(n)mirat chhakat hai ||360||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind of Sikhs, attached to their Guru, is free from the influences of maya and accumalates no filth. He is stable, pious, free of filth and relieves sufferings of others. They keep relishing the elixir-like Naam blessed to them by the Guru. (360)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41390,"next":41392}}
