files.shabads/82/41393.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41393,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209214","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209214,"last_verse_id":209217,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209214,"page_no":null,"line_no":366,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਮੈ ਨ ਏਕਸੈ ਆਵਤ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਬਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"teerath jaatraa samai na ekasai aavat sabai kaahoo saadhoo paachhai paap saban ke jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All pilgrims on pilgrimage are not alike. But when a rare hermit of higher spiritual state enjoins them, the sins of all of them perish."}}},{"verse_id":209215,"page_no":null,"line_no":366,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੋਤ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪਾਛੇ ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nirap sainaa samasar na sakal hot ek ek paachhe kiee koT pare khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As all soldiers in a king's army are not equally valiant, but together under a brave and courageous general they become a force to reckon with."}}},{"verse_id":209216,"page_no":null,"line_no":366,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਸੈ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau samu(n)dhr jal bimal bohith basai ek ek pai anek paar pahuchaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a ship leads the other ships to the safety of the shore through tumultuous ocean, many passengers of these ship also reach the safety of the other end."}}},{"verse_id":209217,"page_no":null,"line_no":366,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਓਟ ਗਹੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਆਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੨॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikh saakhaa anik sa(n)saar dhuaar sanamukh oT gahe koT biaasaat hai ||362||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, there are numerous teachers and disciples at the worldly level, but one who has taken the refuge of the True Guru, an embodiment of the Lord, millions sail across the worldly ocean with his support. (362)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41392,"next":41394}}
files.shabads/82/41394.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41394,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209218","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209218,"last_verse_id":209221,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209218,"page_no":null,"line_no":367,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਂਜਨ ਕੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਊ ਦੀਪਕੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਮੰਦਰ ਮੈ ਅਛਤ ਹੀ ਦੂਸਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaa(n)jan kai jaise kouoo dheepakai dhurai raakhai ma(n)dhar mai achhat hee dhoosaro na jaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a beacon is lit but kept under cover, no one can see anything in that room despite the presence of an oil lamp there."}}},{"verse_id":209219,"page_no":null,"line_no":367,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਰਖਵਈਆ ਪੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਤਮ ਤਿਮਰ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਠਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai rakhavieeaa pun pragaT pragaas karai harai tam timar udhot jot Thaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But he who has hidden the lamp removes its cover and light up the room, the darkness of room is dispelled."}}},{"verse_id":209220,"page_no":null,"line_no":367,"gurmukhi":"ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੇਖਿਐ ਪ੍ਰਤਛਿ ਰੂਪ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਪਈਆ ਤਤ ਖਿਨ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਈ ॥","translit_en":"sagal samagree gireh pekhiaai pratachh roop dheepak dhipieeaa tat khin pahichaaniee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then one is able to see everything and even he who has lit the lamp can be recognised."}}},{"verse_id":209221,"page_no":null,"line_no":367,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਅਵਘਟ ਘਟ ਗੁਪਤ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਉਨਮਾਨੀ ਉਨਮਾਨਈ ॥੩੬੩॥","translit_en":"taise avaghaT ghaT gupat jotee saroop gur upadhes unamaanee unamaaniee ||363||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, God resides latently in the tenth door of this sacred and invaluable body. By the incantation blessed by the True Guru and perpetual practicing on it, one realises Him and feels His presence there. (363)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41393,"next":41395}}
files.shabads/82/41395.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41395,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209222","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209222,"last_verse_id":209225,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209222,"page_no":null,"line_no":368,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਅਉਖਧ ਹਿਤਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਲ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birathaava(n)t ja(n)t aaukhadh hitai ridhai birathaa bal bimukh hoi sahaj nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a medicine suits a person, he-gets cured and becomes peaceful and comfortable."}}},{"verse_id":209223,"page_no":null,"line_no":368,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਧਾਤ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਹੀ ਕਲੰਕ ਡਾਰੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਕਨਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise aan dhaat mai tanak hee kala(n)k ddaare anik baran meT kanak pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as adding some chemicals in the metals give them a shinning lustre and their original colour vanishes."}}},{"verse_id":209224,"page_no":null,"line_no":368,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਭਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਸਟਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਮੈ ਰੰਚਕ ਹੀ ਆਂਚ ਦੇਤ ਭਸਮ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koT bhaar kar kaasaT ikatrataa mai ra(n)chak hee aa(n)ch dhet bhasam udhaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a small amount of fire can reduce millions of heaps of woods into ashes and destroy it."}}},{"verse_id":209225,"page_no":null,"line_no":368,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਉਰ ਅੰਤਰ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖਨ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੪॥","translit_en":"taise gur upadhes ur a(n)tar praves bhe janam maran dhukh dhokhan binaas hai ||364||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, when the teachings of the True Guru resides in the mind of a seeker, his cycle of birth and death and all his sins are destroyed. (364)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41394,"next":41396}}

it is pulled out with the help of a magnet."}}},{"verse_id":209227,"page_no":null,"line_no":369,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੋਕ ਤੋਂਬਰੀ ਲਗਾਈਅਤ ਰੋਗੀ ਤਨ ਐਂਚ ਲੇਤ ਰੁਧਿਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਖਸਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jok to(n)baree lagaieeat rogee tan aai(n)ch let rudhir birathaa sram khasat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a leech is put on the boil of a patient that sucks out all the dirty blood and pus thus relieving the patient of the pain."}}},{"verse_id":209228,"page_no":null,"line_no":369,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜੁਵਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਕਰੈ ਦਾਈ ਗਰਭ ਸਥੰਭਨ ਹੁਇ ਪੀੜਾ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise juvatin discomfort."}}},{"verse_id":209229,"page_no":null,"line_no":369,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਚੋ ਦੂਤ ਭੂਤ ਬਿਭ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਭਾਗਿ ਜਾਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੫॥","translit_en":"taise paa(n)cho dhoot bhoot bibhram hui bhaag jaat satigur ma(n)t ja(n)t rasanaa rasat hai ||365||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, he who has been blessed with the divine word by the True Guru to meditate on and he practices it ardently enjoying the elixir-like Naam with his tongue, is able to dispel the influence of the five demons i.e., lust, anger, attachment, greed and ego. files.shabads/82/41397.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41397,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209230","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209230,"last_verse_id":209233,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209230,"page_no":null,"line_no":370,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸ ਫਲ ਬਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਫਲੁ ਮੀਠੋ ਖਗ ਤਾ ਪੈ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau s fal ban bikhai birakh bibidh jaa ko fal meeTho khag taa pai chal jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a fruit orchard has many types of fruit trees, but birds fly only to the one which has sweet fruit."}}},{"verse_id":209231,"page_no":null,"line_no":370,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਬਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਤੋ ਹੀਰਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਲਲਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise parabat bikhai dhekheeaai paakhaan bahu jaa mai to heeraa khojee khoj khanavaaraa lalachaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Numerous types of stones are available in the mountains but one in search of diamond longs to see the stone that can yield one a diamond."}}},{"verse_id":209232,"page_no":null,"line_no":370,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਲਧਿ ਮਧਿ ਬਸਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਹੰਸ ਖੋਜ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau jaladh madh basat ana(n)t ja(n)t mukataa amol jaa mai ha(n)s khoj khaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lake is inhabited by many forms of marine life, but a swan visits only that lake which has pearls in its oyster."}}},{"verse_id":209233,"page_no":null,"line_no":370,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਅਸੰਖ ਸਿਖ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਲੋਕ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੬॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran hai asa(n)kh sikh jaa mai gur giaan taeh lok lapaTaat hai ||366||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly-numerous Sikhs reside in the refuge of the True Guru. But he who has the knowledge of Guru residing in his heart, people feel attracted and enamoured to him. (366)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41396,"next":41398}}
files.shabads/82/41398.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41398,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209234","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209234,"last_verse_id":209237,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209234,"page_no":null,"line_no":371,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਸਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਚਕੋਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise sas jot hot pooran pragaas taas chitavat chakrat chakor dhiaan dhaarahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a geek partridge is spellbound by the radiation of moonlight and keep on looking at it with rapt attention."}}},{"verse_id":209235,"page_no":null,"line_no":371,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੀਪ ਹੀ ਦਿਪਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁੰਜਾਰਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise a(n)dhakaar bikhai dheep hee dhipat dhekh anik pata(n)g ot pot hoi gu(n)jaarahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as countless moths and insects gather around the flame of lamp lighted in dark place."}}},{"verse_id":209236,"page_no":null,"line_no":371,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਕਾਜ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਮੈ ਰਾਖਤ ਹੀ ਚੀਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise misaTaan paan jaan kaaj bhaa(n)jan mai raakhat hee cheeTee koT lobh lubhit apaar hee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as ants gather around the pot in which some sweet meats have been kept."}}},{"verse_id":209237,"page_no":null,"line_no":371,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਾਸ ਚਰਨ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਹੀ ॥੩੬੭॥","translit_en":"taise param nidhaan gur giaan paravaan jaa mai sakal sa(n)saar taas charan namasakaarahee ||367||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the whole world bows at the feet of that Sikh of the Guru who is blessed with the supreme treasure i.e. divine word by the true guru and is well lodged in the heart of the Sikh by perpetual practice. (367)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41397,"next":41399}}
files.shabads/82/41399.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41399,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209238","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209238,"last_verse_id":209241,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209238,"page_no":null,"line_no":372,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇਤੇ ਫੂਲ ਫੂਲੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਫਲ ਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਲਾਗਤ ਜਿਤੇਕੁ ਪਰਪਕ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jete fool foole tete fal na laage dhraoom laagat jitek parapak na sakal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the flowers that blossom on a tree do not yield fruit. And whatever number of fruits appear, do not ripe to be eaten ultimately."}}},{"verse_id":209239,"page_no":null,"line_no":372,"gurmukhi":"ਜੇਤੇ ਸੁਤ ਜਨਮਤ ਜੀਅਤ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਤੇਤੇ ਜੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਕੁਲ ਨ ਕਮਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jete sut janamat jeeat rahai na tete jeeat hai jete tete kul na kamal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All sons born do not survive to live but all those who live do not bring name and fame to their family."}}},{"verse_id":209240,"page_no":null,"line_no":372,"gurmukhi":"ਦਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਤ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਭੁਟ ਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਤੇਤੇ ਜੇਤਕ ਸੁਭਟ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰਨ ਨ ਥਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhal mil jaat jete sabhuT na hoh tete jetak subhaT joojh maran na thal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All those who join the army are not valiant soldiers. And those who are brave warriors do not die fighting in the battlefield."}}},{"verse_id":209241,"page_no":null,"line_no":372,"gurmukhi":"ਆਰਸੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਏ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਅਚਲ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੮॥","translit_en":"aarasee jugat gur sikh sabh hee kahaavai paavak pragaas bhe birale achal hai ||368||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A glass embedded in a finger ring cracks when brought near fire but a genuine stone is unaffected. Similarly like a genuine stone, everyone is known as a Sikh but a few emerge genuine when put through traits. (368)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41398,"next":41400}}

॥","translit_en":"jaise eh agan kau baalak bilok dhaavai geh geh raakhai maataa sut bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of its shining characteristic, a child runs to catch hold of snake and fire, but his mother keeps stopping him from doing so resulting in the wailing of the child."}}},{"verse_id":209243,"page_no":null,"line_no":373,"gurmukhi":"ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਚਾਹਤ ਅਖਾਦਿ ਖਾਦਿ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਬੈਦ ਜੁਗਵਤ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"birathaava(n)t ja(n)t jaise chaahat akhaadh khaadh jatan kai baidh jugavat na suhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an ailing person wishes to eat food that is not good for his recovery and the physician constantly persuades him to exercise control and prevention and that helps the patient recover."}}},{"verse_id":209244,"page_no":null,"line_no":373,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪੰਥ ਅਪੰਥ ਬਿਬੇਕਹਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਅੰਧ ਕਟਿ ਗਹੇ ਅਟਪਟੀ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pa(n)th apa(n)th bibekeh na boojhai a(n)dh kaT gahe aTapaTee chaal chalio jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a blind person is unaware of the good and bad paths, and walks in a zig zag manner even by feeling the path with his walking stick."}}},{"verse_id":209245,"page_no":null,"line_no":373,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕਰਤ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਉ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੯॥","translit_en":"taise kaamanaa karat kanik aau kaamanee kee raakhai niralep gur sikh akulaat hai ||369||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a Sikh longs to enjoy the pleasure of a woman and others wealth and is ever anxious to possess them, but the True Guru wants to keep his Sikh free from these allurements. (369)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41399,"next":41401}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":41401,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209246","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209246,"last_verse_id":209249,"source_english":"Bhai Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209246,"page_no":null,"line_no":374,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਜਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਦੈ ਦੈ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਹਿ ਲਗਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maataa pitaa anek upajaat sut poo(n)jee dhai dhai banaj biauhaareh lagaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as parents give birth and raise many children and then support them with money and material to put them into trading business;"}}},{"verse_id":209247,"page_no":null,"line_no":374,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਰਤ ਬਿਰਤ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਲ ਖੋਵੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤਿ ਕੈ ਚਉਗੁਨੋ ਬਢਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"kirat birat kar kouoo mool khovai rovai kouoo laabh labhat kai chauguno baddaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And out of them, one may lose all that he has invested in business and cry while other may earn much profit to enhance his investment fourfold;"}}},{"verse_id":209248,"page_no":null,"line_no":374,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੋਈ ਕੁਲਾਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso jaiso joiee kulaadharam hai karam karai taiso taiso jas apajas pragaTaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every member of the family works and conducts himself according to the family traditions, and every son earns good or bad name according to the deeds performed by them."}}},{"verse_id":209249,"page_no":null,"line_no":374,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪੁਹਪ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੭੦॥","translit_en":"taise satigur samadharasee puhap gat sikh saakhaa bibidh birakh fal paavahee ||370||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru is like a flower that gives its fragrance to all equally, but because of their lower/higher consciousness, the Sikhs obtain different types of blessings from the Guru. Those who abide by His teachings, benefit; whose who do not, suffer or benefit less."}}}],"nav":{"prev":41400,"next":41402}}
files.shabads/82/41402.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41402,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209250","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209250,"last_verse_id":209253,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209250,"page_no":null,"line_no":375,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਕਰੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਨਮਤ ਸੁਤ ਵਾਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise narapat bahu banitaa bivaeh karai jaa kai janamat sut vaahee gireh raaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king marries many young maids, but she who produces him a son has the kingdom in her home."}}},{"verse_id":209251,"page_no":null,"line_no":375,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ੳਦਧਿ ਮਧਿ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਮੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚਲੈ ਜੋਈ ਪਾਰ ਪਹੰੁਚੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise udhadh madh chahoo(n) or mai bohith chalai joiee paar paha(n)uchai pooran sarab kaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as ships sail in the ocean from all directions, but the ship that reaches its destination safely and on time, its travellers are benefited the most."}}},{"verse_id":209252,"page_no":null,"line_no":375,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਖਾਨਿ ਖਨਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਖਨਵਾਰਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਚੜੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਜੁ ਬਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise khaan khanat ana(n)t khanavaaraa khojee heeraa haath chaRai jaa kai taa kai baaj baaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the miners dig the mines and one who is able to dig out or locate a diamond indulges in merry-making and festivities."}}},{"verse_id":209253,"page_no":null,"line_no":375,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਨਵਤਨ ਅਉ ਪੁਰਾਤਨ ਜਿਨ ਪਰਿ ਕਟਾਛਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੧॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh navatan aau puraatan jin par kaTaachh kirapaa taa kai chhab chhaaj hai ||371||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So are many old and new Sikhs of the True Guru. But those who are blessed with His clemency and look of grace, become noble, beautiful, wise and respectable through meditation of Naam. (371)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41401,"next":41403}}
files.shabads/82/41403.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41403,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209254","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":209254,"last_verse_id":209258,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209254,"page_no":null,"line_no":376,"gurmukhi":"ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਰਖ ਪਰਨਾਰੇ ਬਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਲ","translit_en":"boo(n)dh boo(n)dh barakh paranaare beh chalai jal","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every drop of rain joins the other and together they flow from the roof-tops into the streets and then in the storm water drains; And overflowing its banks, the water flows through many rivulets and join the main stream or rivers;"}}},{"verse_id":209255,"page_no":null,"line_no":376,"gurmukhi":"ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਉਮਗਿ ਬਹੈ ਬੀਥੀ ਬੀਥੀ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"bahurio umag bahai beethee beethee aai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":" "}}},{"verse_id":209256,"page_no":null,"line_no":376,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾ ਤੈ ਨੋਰਾ ਨੋਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਚਲਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"taa tai noraa noraa bhar chalat chatur ku(n)T saritaa saritaa prat milat hai jai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Water from every river flows to meet the sea, and once it falls in, it becomes one with it. It loses individuality. A person is recognized and praised according to one's traits. Similarly, a self-willed mean person and a Guru-oriented Sikh are recognized by their response and behavior."}}},{"verse_id":209257,"page_no":null,"line_no":376,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਕਲ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਹੋਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"saritaa sakal jal prabal pravaeh chal sa(n)gam samu(n)dhr hot samat samai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a diamond held in hand seems very small but when evaluated and sold, fills the coffers. Just as a cheque/draft carried on person has no weight but when cashed at the other end yields much money"}}},{"verse_id":209258,"page_no":null,"line_no":376,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਮੈ ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸਮਾਈ ਤੈਸੀਐ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਡਾਈ ਓਛੋ ਅਉ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੭੨॥","translit_en":"jaa mai jaiseeaai samaiee taiseeaai mahimaa baddaiee ochho aau ga(n)bheer dheer boojheeaai bulai kai ||372||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a banyan tree seed is small but grows into a big tree that spreads all over, the significance of the lodging the true Guru's teachings in the hearts of obedient Sikhs of the Guru leads to reaching the divine court of the Lord. (372)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41402,"next":41404}}
files.shabads/82/41404.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41404,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209259","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209259,"last_verse_id":209262,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209259,"page_no":null,"line_no":377,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਥ ਮੈ ਤਨਕ ਸੋ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਲ ਕੀਏ ਤੇ ਦਮਕਨ ਭਰਤ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise heeraa haath mai tanak so dhikhaiee dhet mol ke'ee te dhamakan bharat bha(n)ddaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a diamond held in hand seems very small but when evaluated and sold, fills the coffers."}}},{"verse_id":209260,"page_no":null,"line_no":377,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਰ ਬਾਧੇ ਹੁੰਡੀ ਲਾਗਤ ਨ ਭਾਰ ਕਛੂ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਈਅਤ ਲਛਮੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bar baadhe hu(n)ddee laagat na bhaar kachhoo aagai jai paieeat lachhamee apaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cheque/draft carried on person has no weight but when cashed at the other end yields much money "}}},{"verse_id":209261,"page_no":null,"line_no":377,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਟ ਬੀਜ ਅਤਿ ਸੂਖਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੋਤ ਬੋਏ ਸੈ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise baT beej at sookham saroop hot boe sai bibidh karai birakhaa bisathaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as seed of a banyan tree is very small but when sown grows into big tree and spreads all over. "}}},{"verse_id":209262,"page_no":null,"line_no":377,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਮੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਗਏ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀ ॥੩੭੩॥","translit_en":"taise gur bachan sachan gur sikhan mai jaaneeaai mahaatam ge hee har dhuaar jee ||373||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similar is the significance of the lodging of true Guru's teachings in the hearts of obedient Sikhs of the Guru. This is reckoned only on reaching the divine court of the Lord. (The practitioners of Naam are honoured in His court).  (373)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41403,"next":41405}}
files.shabads/82/41405.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41405,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209263","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209263,"last_verse_id":209266,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209263,"page_no":null,"line_no":378,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਦ ਪੀਅਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਮਰੰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਛੈ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ਹੋਇ ਛਕੈ ਛਕ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise madh peeat na jaaneeaai mara(n)m taa ko paachhai matavaaro hoi chhakai chhak jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a man drinking wine is unaware of its effect on him and he keeps consuming more till he falls unconscious. "}}},{"verse_id":209264,"page_no":null,"line_no":378,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨਾਰਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰਹਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਉਦਿਤ ਅਧਾਨ ਆਨ ਚਿਹਨਿ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise naar bheTat bhataareh na bhedh jaaneh udhit adhaan aan chihan dhikhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife making love with her husband is unaware of the effect at that time but it appears in the form of her pregnancy."}}},{"verse_id":209265,"page_no":null,"line_no":378,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਿ ਪਰਿ ਮਾਨਕੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਤੋਲ ਮੋਲ ਸੰਖਿਆ ਦਮਕਨ ਹੇਰਤ ਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kar par maanak na laagat hai bhaaree tol mol sa(n)khiaa dhamakan herat hiraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one feels no weight of a diamond on one's hand but when sold, amazes all with the money that it brings forth."}}},{"verse_id":209266,"page_no":null,"line_no":378,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਿਖ ਜਾਨੈ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੪॥","translit_en":"taise gur a(n)mirat bachan sun maanai sikh jaanai mahimaa jau sukh saagar samaat hai ||374||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a Sikh of the Guru listens to the elixir-like sermon of the True Guru and adopts it with mind, words and deeds. He then realises its greatness and merges in the Lord-the ocean of all comforts and peace. (374)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41404,"next":41406}}
files.shabads/82/41406.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41406,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209267","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209267,"last_verse_id":209270,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209267,"page_no":null,"line_no":379,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਛ ਕਛ ਬਗ ਹੰਸ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਪਾਖਾਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਉਦਧਿ ਸੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise machh kachh bag ha(n)s mukataa paakhaan a(n)mirat bikhai pragaas udhadh sai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the marine dependent life like fish, tortoise, heron, swan, pearls precious stones and nectar is known to be related to water (like, sea etc.) "}}},{"verse_id":209268,"page_no":null,"line_no":379,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਾਰੋ ਤਾਰੀ ਤਉ ਆਰਸੀ ਸਨਾਹ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੋਹ ਏਕ ਸੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਚਨਾ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise taaro taaree tau aarasee sanaeh sasatr loh ek se anek rachanaa bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lock, key, sword, armour jacket and other weapons are made from the same iron,"}}},{"verse_id":209269,"page_no":null,"line_no":379,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਂਜਨ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਏਕ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਸੈ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਬਿੰਜਨਾਦਿ ਅਉਖਧਿ ਸਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bhaa(n)jan bibidh jaise hot ek mritakaa sai kheer neer bi(n)janaadh aaukhadh samaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many type of earthenware are made from the clay in which milk, water, eatables and medicines are stored;"}}},{"verse_id":209270,"page_no":null,"line_no":379,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸਕਲ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਾ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੭੫॥","translit_en":"taise dharasan bahu baran aasram dharam sakal girahasat kee saakhaa unamaaneeaai ||375||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, many forms of philosophical tomes, the four caste system, the four abodes of life and religions are known as the branches of the household life. (They all are there because of the household life).  (375)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41405,"next":41407}}
files.shabads/82/41407.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41407,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209271","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209271,"last_verse_id":209274,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209271,"page_no":null,"line_no":380,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਸਰਿ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਕਲ ਮੈ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਡੋ ਮੇਰ ਮੈ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਬਡੋ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਖਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise sar saritaa sakal mai samu(n)dhr baddo mer mai sumer baddo jagat bakhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in the world, the sea is considered biggest among the lakes, rivers etc.; and Sumer mountain amongst all the mountains. "}}},{"verse_id":209272,"page_no":null,"line_no":380,"gurmukhi":"ਤਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਬਡੋ ਧਾਤੁ ਮੈ ਕਨਿਕ ਅਤਿ ਉਤਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"taravar bikhai jaise cha(n)dhan birakh baddo dhaat mai kanik at utam kai maan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sandalwood tree and gold is considered supreme amongst the trees and metals respectively. "}}},{"verse_id":209273,"page_no":null,"line_no":380,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਛੀਅਨ ਮੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਸਾਰਦੂਲ ਰਾਗਨ ਮੈ ਸਿਰੀ ਰਾਗੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਖਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)chheean mai ha(n)s miragaraajan mai saaradhool raagan mai siree raag paaras pakhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as swan is supreme amongst the birds, the lion amongst the feline family, Sri Rag amongst the mode of singing and philosopher-stone among the stones. "}}},{"verse_id":209274,"page_no":null,"line_no":380,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨਨ ਮੈ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਰੁ ਧਿਆਨਨ ਮੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਕਲ ਧਰਮ ਮੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੬॥","translit_en":"giaanan mai giaan ar dhiaanan mai dhiaan gur sakal dharam mai girahasat pradhaan hai ||376||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the knowledge imparted by the True Guru is supreme of all knowledge, and concentration of mind on True Guru is superb, so is the family life ideal and superior of all the religions (ways of life).  (376)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41406,"next":41408}}
files.shabads/82/41408.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41408,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209275","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209275,"last_verse_id":209278,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209275,"page_no":null,"line_no":381,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨ ਕਰਬੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"teerath majan karabai ko hai ihai gunaau niramal tan tirakhaa tapat nivaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The significance of bathing at places of pilgrimage is that body becomes clean and free of all desires and attractions. "}}},{"verse_id":209276,"page_no":null,"line_no":381,"gurmukhi":"ਦਰਪਨ ਦੀਪ ਕਰ ਗਹੈ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਚਿਹਨ ਮਗ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਭਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dharapan dheep kar gahai ko ihai gunaau pekhat chihan mag surat sa(n)bhaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Holding of mirror in the hand shows one the shape of features and body structure. Carrying a lamp in hand makes one aware of the path one walks on. "}}},{"verse_id":209277,"page_no":null,"line_no":381,"gurmukhi":"ਭੇਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੀਪ ਗਤਿ ਲੈ ਗਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bheTat bhataar naar ko ihai gunaau savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh seep gat lai garab pratipaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of husband and wife is like swati drop falling in an oyster that develops into a pearl. The wife becomes pregnant and she takes care of her pearl-like child in her womb."}}},{"verse_id":209278,"page_no":null,"line_no":381,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੈ ਗੁਨਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਉਰਧਾਰੀਐ ॥੩੭੭॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran ko ihai gunaau gur upadhes kar haar uradhaareeaai ||377||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a disciple taking refuge of the True Guru and getting initiation from him is that the Sikh of the Guru adopts the teachings of the True Guru in his heart and lives his life accordingly.  (377)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41407,"next":41409}}
files.shabads/82/41409.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41409,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209279","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209279,"last_verse_id":209282,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209279,"page_no":null,"line_no":382,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਤ ਪੋਖਤ ਸ-ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਹਸਤ ਬਿਹਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maataa pitaa na beechaarat bikaar sut pokhat sa-prem bihasat bihasai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the parents take no notice of the faults of their son and bring him up in happy and pleasant atmosphere. "}}},{"verse_id":209280,"page_no":null,"line_no":382,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਬੈਦਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਤਾਂਤ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਖ ਪਰੀਖਾ ਉਪਚਾਰਤ ਰਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise birathaava(n)t ja(n)t baidheh birataa(n)t kahai parakh pareekhaa upachaarat rasai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a patient suffering from pain explains his ailment to the physician, ignoring his carelessness in maintaining his health, the physician administers medicine lovingly after thorough investigation, "}}},{"verse_id":209281,"page_no":null,"line_no":382,"gurmukhi":"ਚਟੀਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਚਟਿਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਦਿਆ-ਵੰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੈ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"chaTeeaa anek jaise ek chaTisaar bikhai bidhiaa-va(n)t kare paa(n)dhaa preet sai paRhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as there are many students in a school, the teacher does not look into their childish pranks and nuisance but teaches them devotedly to make them knowledgeable, "}}},{"verse_id":209282,"page_no":null,"line_no":382,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ-ਸਿਖਨ ਕੈ ਅਉਗੁਨ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸੈ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੭੮॥","translit_en":"taise gura-sikhan kai aaugun agiaan meTai braham bibek sai sahaj samajhai kai ||378||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does the True Guru bless the Sikhs in His refuge with divine knowledge and high state of equipoise, thus obliterating their ill deeds performed in ignorance.  (378)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41408,"next":41410}}
files.shabads/82/41410.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41410,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209283","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209283,"last_verse_id":209286,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209283,"page_no":null,"line_no":383,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਰਤ ਸੁਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਇਆਨਪ ਤਊ ਨ ਜਨਨੀ ਅਉਗਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau karat sut anik iaanap tuoo na jananee aaugan ur dhaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mother ignores many of her son's amateurish deeds and brings him up with love and care. "}}},{"verse_id":209284,"page_no":null,"line_no":383,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੋ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੂਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਗਿਆ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਕੀਏ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaiso tau saran soor pooran pratagiaa raakhai anik avagiaa ke'ee maar na biddaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a warrior abides by his woe/pledge in respect of one who comes in his refuge and despite his showing disrespect does not kill him. "}}},{"verse_id":209285,"page_no":null,"line_no":383,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਜਲ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਨ ਬੋਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਜ ਅਪਨੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau saritaa jal kaasaTeh na borat karat chit laaj apano hee pratipaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a log of wood does not sink in river, since it carries a latent respect that he (river) has helped the tree grow by providing it with life-giving water. "}}},{"verse_id":209286,"page_no":null,"line_no":383,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੩੭੯॥","translit_en":"taise hee param gur paaras paras gat sikhan ko kirat karam kachh naa beechaario hai ||379||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the great benefactor True Guru who like a philosopher stone is capable of turning the Sikhs into gold-like metal. He does not dwell on their erstwhile deeds and by blessing them with Naam Simran, make them virtuous like Himself.  (379)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41409,"next":41411}}
files.shabads/82/41411.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41411,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209287","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209287,"last_verse_id":209290,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209287,"page_no":null,"line_no":384,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਈ ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਸੁਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਰਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"joiee kulaa dharam karam kai suchaar chaar soiee paravaar bikhai sresaT bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who performs all deeds according to his family traditions, behaves well and kindly is known as an ideal person in the family. "}}},{"verse_id":209288,"page_no":null,"line_no":384,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨਜੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਹ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਬਨਉਟਾ ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"banaj biauhaar saacho saeh sanamukh sadhaa soiee tau banauTaa nihakapaT kai maaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who is honest of all his dealings, alone is considered guileless and sincere before his master, the rich merchant. "}}},{"verse_id":209289,"page_no":null,"line_no":384,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਆਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਨਰੇਸ ਆਨ ਸੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਕਾਰਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"suaam kaam saavadhaan maanat nares aan soiee savaiaam kaarajee prasidh pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who acknowledges the authority of his king and performs his master's tasks with care and devotion is always recognised as the ideal servant of the master (king). "}}},{"verse_id":209290,"page_no":null,"line_no":384,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੋਈ ਸਿਖ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੮੦॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes paraves ridh a(n)tar hai sabadh surat soiee sikh jag jaaneeaai ||380||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, an obedient Sikh of the Guru who lodges the teachings of True Guru in his mind and engrosses his consciousness in the divine word is known the world over.  (380)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41410,"next":41412}}
files.shabads/82/41412.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41412,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209291","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209291,"last_verse_id":209294,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209291,"page_no":null,"line_no":385,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲ ਕੈ ਧਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨਿ ਕੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal kai dharan ar dharan kai jaise jal preet kai parasapar sa(n)gam sumaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water has love for earth and earth for water, both respond and acknowledge their love for each other. "}}},{"verse_id":209292,"page_no":null,"line_no":385,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਸੀਂਚ ਕੈ ਤਮਾਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੀਅਤ ਬੋਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਸਟਹ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal see(n)ch kai tamaal pratipaaleeat borat na kaasaTeh javaiaalaa mai naa jaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water irrigates useful trees like Tamal, brings them up, and it does not sink the tree (wood) that it has reared, nor let it burn in fire. "}}},{"verse_id":209293,"page_no":null,"line_no":385,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਸਟ ਕੈ ਜੜਿ ਗੜਿ ਬੋਹਥਿ ਬਨਾਈਅਤ ਲੋਸਟਹਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"losaT kai jaR gaR bohath banaieeat losaTeh saagar apaar paar paar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Iron is forged and moulded to fix wooden planks together to make boats and ships. Because of its association with wood, iron too is able to cross the ocean to the other side. "}}},{"verse_id":209294,"page_no":null,"line_no":385,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਜਨ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਗੁਨ ਅਉਗੁਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੧॥","translit_en":"prabh kai jaaneejai jan jan kai jaaneejai prabh taa(n) te jan ko na gun aaugun beechaar hai ||381||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devoted disciple is known from his Master God and God is recognised through His servant. That is why Master Lord does not recognise the virtues and vices of his slave (He even takes those seekers across the worldly ocean who keep the company of His slave devotees).  (381)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41411,"next":41413}}
files.shabads/82/41413.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41413,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209295","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209295,"last_verse_id":209298,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209295,"page_no":null,"line_no":386,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਆਹ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਗਾਈਅਤਿ ਗੀਤ ਏਕੈ ਹੁਇ ਲਭਤ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਨਿ ਕਾਨਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"biaaeh samai jaise dhuhoo(n) or gaieeat geet ekai hui labhat ekai haan kaan jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in celebration of marriage, songs are sung both in the bride and bridegroom's house, the bridegroom's side stands to gain through dowry and arrival of the bride whereas the bride's family loses in wealth and their daughter. "}}},{"verse_id":209296,"page_no":null,"line_no":386,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਲ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਤਾਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਜੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪਰਾਜੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhuhoo(n) dhal bikhai jaise baajat neesaan taan kaahoo kau jai kaahoo kau paraajai pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as drums are beaten by both sides before commencement of battle, one wins and the other loses ultimately. "}}},{"verse_id":209297,"page_no":null,"line_no":386,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਕੂਲਿ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਮੈ ਭਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਚਲੈ ਕੋਊ ਮਾਝਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dhuhoo(n) kool saritaa mai bhar naau chalai kouoo maajh dhaar kouoo paar paravaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a boat sets out fully loaded with passengers from both banks of a river, one sails across while the other may sink half way. "}}},{"verse_id":209298,"page_no":null,"line_no":386,"gurmukhi":"ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਪਦਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਸਿਧ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੩੮੨॥","translit_en":"dharam adharam karam kai asaadh saadh uooch neech padhavee prasidh unamaaneeaai ||382||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, by virtue of their good deeds, the obedient Sikhs of the Guru achieve high status in society while those who indulge in vices are easily recognised by their bad deeds.  (382)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41412,"next":41414}}
files.shabads/82/41414.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41414,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209299","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209299,"last_verse_id":209302,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209299,"page_no":null,"line_no":387,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਹਨ ਕੇ ਰੇਖ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਨਿਰਬਾਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਟਰੈ ਨ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਾਧ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਅਸਾਧ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"paahan ke rekh aadh a(n)t nirabaahu karai Tarai na saneh saadh bigreh asaadh ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a line drawn on a stone cannot be effaced and lasts till the stone perishes, so is the love of holy men with the Lord's feet and of vicious persons with evil. "}}},{"verse_id":209300,"page_no":null,"line_no":387,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਮੈ ਲਕੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤਿ ਤਤ ਅਧਮ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਉ ਬਿਰੁਧ ਜੁਧ ਸਾਧ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal mai lakeer dheer na dharat tat adham kee preet aau birudh judh saadh ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as line drawn on water does not last for a moment, so does the love of a wicked person and opposition or discord of a noble man vanishes in a wink. "}}},{"verse_id":209301,"page_no":null,"line_no":387,"gurmukhi":"ਥੋਹਰਿ ਉਖਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਸਾਧ ਅਧਮ ਉਪਾਧ ਕੋ॥","translit_en":"thohar ukhaaree upakaaree aau bikaaree sahaj subhaav saadh adham upaadh ko||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as cactus is painful due to its thorns and sugarcane is comforting and pleasant for its sweet juice, so is the temperament of an evil person who raises unpleasant situations while a saintly person remains peaceful and Endeavours to spread peace and happiness all around. "}}},{"verse_id":209302,"page_no":null,"line_no":387,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁੰਜਾ ਫਲ ਮਾਨਕ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਮੋਲ ਅਲਪ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੋ ॥੩੮੩॥","translit_en":"gu(n)jaa fal maanak sa(n)saar tulaadhaar bikhai tol kai samaan mol alap agaadh ko ||383||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A ruby, and seed of Abrus Precatorius, may both be colored red but the seed is a lot less valuable. A noble and an evil person may look same but an evil person has no respect anywhere; a noble person is like a ruby - respected & valued by all. (383)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41413,"next":41415}}
files.shabads/82/41415.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41415,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209303","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209303,"last_verse_id":209306,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209303,"page_no":null,"line_no":388,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਅੰਗ ਰਚਤ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਖੋੜਸ ਤੇਈ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਰਚਤ ਸਕਲ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kulaa badhoo a(n)g rachat seegaar khoRas teiee ganikaa rachat sakal seegaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lady of a noble house adorns herself with sixteen types of embellishments and even a harlot does the same; "}}},{"verse_id":209304,"page_no":null,"line_no":388,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਮੈ ਭਤਾਰ ਏਕ ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਤਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੈ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kulaa badhoo sihajaa samai ramai bhataar ek besavaiaa tau anek sai karat bibhachaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The lady of the noble house enjoys the bed of one person her husband, whereas a harlot shares her bed with many persons; "}}},{"verse_id":209305,"page_no":null,"line_no":388,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸੁਜਸ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਪਰਸਤ ਅਪਜਦਸ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kulaa badhoo sa(n)gam sujas niradhokh mokh besavaiaa parasat apajadhas hui bikaar jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"For her love of her husband, the lady of the noble house is praised, admired and is free of any calumny whereas a prostitute earns notoriety for her blemishes and offering herself to others. "}}},{"verse_id":209306,"page_no":null,"line_no":388,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੋਈ ਦੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਹੁਇ ਦਹਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੩੮੪॥","translit_en":"taise gursikhan kau param pavitr maiaa soiee dhukhadhaik hui dhahat sa(n)saar jee ||384||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly the mammon (maya) becomes good for obedient Sikhs of the Guru who use it for good of others according to the teachings of the Guru. But the same mammon becomes troublesome to the worldly people and causes them distress and sufferings.  (384)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41414,"next":41416}}
files.shabads/82/41416.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41416,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209307","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209307,"last_verse_id":209310,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209307,"page_no":null,"line_no":389,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਲੋਹਾ ਬਿਸੁ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee lohaa bis bikhai bibidh ba(n)dhan roop soiee tau ka(n)chan jot paaras prasa(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Iron is used for making handcuffs, chains and fetters while the same iron when brought in contact with the philosopher stone becomes gold and glitters. "}}},{"verse_id":209308,"page_no":null,"line_no":389,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਤਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਭਤ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੋਈ ਅਭਰਨੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਰਚਿਤ ਅੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee tau si(n)gaar at sobhat patibirataa kau soiee abharan ganikaa rachit a(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A noble lady adorns herself with various embellishments and these make her more respectable and impressive whereas the same adornments are condemned on a lady of ill repute and bad character. "}}},{"verse_id":209309,"page_no":null,"line_no":389,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਫਲ ਸੋਈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਿਖ ਭੇਟਤ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"soiee savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh mil saagar mukataa fal soiee savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh bikh bheTat bhuia(n)g hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A drop of rain during Swati constellation when falls on an oyster in the sea and becomes an expensive pearl whereas it becomes venom if it drops in the mouth of a snake. "}}},{"verse_id":209310,"page_no":null,"line_no":389,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਰਤ ਬਿਰਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜਗ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਸ੍ਰਬੰਗ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੫॥","translit_en":"taise maiaa kirat birat hai bikaar jag paraupakaar gursikhan sraba(n)g hai ||385||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, mammon is evil of character for the worldly people but for the obedient Sikhs of the True Guru, it is highly philanthropic since it does good to many in their hands.  (385)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41415,"next":41417}}
files.shabads/82/41417.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41417,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209311","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209311,"last_verse_id":209314,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209311,"page_no":null,"line_no":390,"gurmukhi":"ਕਊਆ ਜਉ ਮਰਾਲ ਸਭਾ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਦੁਚਿਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਆਸ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"kuooaa jau maraal sabhaa jai baiThe maanasar dhuchit udhaas baas aas dhuraga(n)dh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a crow joins the company of swans on the bank of lake Mansarover (a sacred lake in Himalayas) he will feel morose and in two minds since he cannot find any sullage there. "}}},{"verse_id":209312,"page_no":null,"line_no":390,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਬੈਠਾਈਐ ਸੁਭਗ ਪ੍ਰਜੰਕ ਪਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਾਕੀ ਚਾਟੈ ਹੀਨ ਮਤਿ ਅੰਧ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"savaiaan jiau baiThaieeaai subhag praja(n)k par tiaag jai chaakee chaaTai heen mat a(n)dh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a dog is made to sit on a comfortable bed, being of base wisdom and foolish he will leave it and go to lick millstone. "}}},{"verse_id":209313,"page_no":null,"line_no":390,"gurmukhi":"ਗਰਧਭ ਅੰਗ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਜਉ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਲੋਟਤ ਭਸਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਕੰਧ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"garadhabh a(n)g aragajaa jau lepan keejai loTat bhasam sa(n)g hai kuTev ka(n)dh kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a donkey is applied with paste of sandalwood, saffron and musk etc., he will still go and roll in the dust as is his character. "}}},{"verse_id":209314,"page_no":null,"line_no":390,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਉਪਾਧ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਕੀ ॥੩੮੬॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh saadh sa(n)gat na preet cheet manasaa upaadh aparaadh sanaba(n)dh kee ||386||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, those of base wisdom and turned away from the True Guru have no love or attraction for the company of saintly persons. They are ever engrossed in creating troubles and doing ill deeds.  (386)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41416,"next":41418}}
files.shabads/82/41418.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41418,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209315","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209315,"last_verse_id":209318,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209315,"page_no":null,"line_no":391,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਕੋ ਆਧਾਰ ਆਸਰੋ ਨਿਰਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ਹੈ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਦੀਨ ਕੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"niraadhaar ko aadhaar aasaro niraasan ko naath hai anaath ko dheen ko dhiaal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God is support of all those who are without any support. He is refuge of those who have no one to take care of them. He is the master of all those who are orphans. He is the haven of mercy for the destitutes. "}}},{"verse_id":209316,"page_no":null,"line_no":391,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਔ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਧਨ ਟੇਕ ਅੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਔ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"asaran saran aau niradhan ko hai dhan Tek a(n)dhan kee aau kirapan kirapaal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are unable to obtain shelter anywhere, He provides them refuge. For the poor, His name is the real treasure. For blind, He is the walking stick. He showers His kindness even on misers. "}}},{"verse_id":209317,"page_no":null,"line_no":391,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕ੍ਰਿਤਘਨ ਕੈ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੱਤਗਯਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"akirataghan kai dhaataar patit paavan prabh narak nivaaran pra'tagayaa pratipaal hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To the ungrateful, he is the provider of their needs. He makes the sinners pious. He saves the sinners from hell fire and abides by His character of kind, clement, benevolent and sustainer. "}}},{"verse_id":209318,"page_no":null,"line_no":391,"gurmukhi":"ਅਵਗੁਨ ਹਰਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਤਿੱਗਯਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਰਬੰਗਿ ਰਸ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੭॥","translit_en":"avagun haran karan krati'gayaa suaamee sa(n)gee saraba(n)g ras rasak rasaal hai ||387||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He destroys the vices and knows all the latent deeds of everyone. He is a companion who stands by in all thick and thin situations. Such a Lord is the treasure-house of elixir for those who relish His divine nectar.  (387)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41417,"next":41419}}
files.shabads/82/41419.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41419,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209319","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209319,"last_verse_id":209322,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209319,"page_no":null,"line_no":392,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਇਲਾ ਸੀਤਲ ਕਰ ਕਰਤ ਸਿਆਮ ਗਹੈ ਪਰਸਿ ਤਪਤ ਪਰਦਗਧ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"koilaa seetal kar karat siaam gahai paras tapat paradhagadh karat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A burnt out coal when held in hand blackens it but causes burns when held if burning. (Coal is problematic both when cold or burning) "}}},{"verse_id":209320,"page_no":null,"line_no":392,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂਕਰ ਕੇ ਚਾਟਤ ਕਲੇਵਰਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਛੋਤਿ ਕਾਟਤ ਸਰੀਰ ਪੀਰ ਧੀਰ ਨ ਧਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kookar ke chaaTat kalevareh laagai chhot kaaTat sareer peer dheer na dharat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as dog's lick is contagious and causes unbearable pain when it bites. (Dogs lick and bite both are troublesome). "}}},{"verse_id":209321,"page_no":null,"line_no":392,"gurmukhi":"ਫੂਟਤ ਜਿਉ ਗਾਗਰ ਪਰਤ ਹੀ ਪਖਾਨ ਫਰਿ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਰਤ ਪੁਨਿ ਗਾਗਰ ਹਰਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"fooTat jiau gaagar parat hee pakhaan far paahan parat pun gaagar harat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a pitcher breaks when dropped on a stone, and it also breaks when stone drops on it. (A stone is destroyer of a pitcher in every way). "}}},{"verse_id":209322,"page_no":null,"line_no":392,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੰੂ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਬੁਰੋ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਟਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੮੮॥","translit_en":"taise hee asaadh sa(n)g preet ha(n)oo birodh buro lok paralok dhukh dhokh na Tarat hai ||388||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is developing loving relationship with evil-minded persons. Loving him or showing dissent towards him is equally bad. Thus one cannot escape from pain and sufferings of this world and the world hereafter.  (388)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41418,"next":41420}}
files.shabads/82/41420.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41420,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209323","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209323,"last_verse_id":209326,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209323,"page_no":null,"line_no":393,"gurmukhi":"ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਛਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਛਾਹਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਬਦਲੇ ਫਟਕੁ ਕਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"chhatr ke badhale jaise baiThe chhatanaa kee chhaeh heeraa amolak badhale faTak kau paieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sitting under a small umbrella leaving the royal canopy and taking a glass crystal in place of a diamond would be a foolish act. "}}},{"verse_id":209324,"page_no":null,"line_no":393,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਬਂਦਲੇ ਕਾਚ ਗੁੰਜਾ ਫਲ ਕਾਂਬਰੀ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਕੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਓਢਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise man ka(n)chan ke ba(n)dhale kaach gu(n)jaa fal kaa(n)baree paTa(n)bar ke badhale oddaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accepting glass pieces in place of rubies, seeds of Abrus Precatorius in place of gold or wearing a tattered blanket in place of silk apparel would be an indication of base wisdom. "}}},{"verse_id":209325,"page_no":null,"line_no":393,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਿਸਟਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਕਰੀ ਫਲ ਕੇਸਰ ਕਪੂਰ ਜਿਉ ਕਚੂਰ ਲੈ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat misaTaan paan ke badhale karee fal kesar kapoor jiau kachoor lai lagaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Leaving aside dainty dishes, one eats insipid fruits of Acacia tree, and apply paste of wild turmeric in place of fragrant saffron and camphor, would be an act of total ignorance. "}}},{"verse_id":209326,"page_no":null,"line_no":393,"gurmukhi":"ਭੇਟਤ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੂਖਮ ਹੋਤ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਜੈਸੇ ਬੇਲੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੩੮੯॥","translit_en":"bheTat asaadh sukh sukirat sookham hot saagar athaeh jaise belee meh samaieeaai ||389||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, meeting with an evil and vice-ridden person, all comforts and good deeds shrink to such a size as if an ocean has been reduced to the size of a small cup.  (389)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41419,"next":41421}}
files.shabads/82/41421.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41421,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209327","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209327,"last_verse_id":209330,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209327,"page_no":null,"line_no":394,"gurmukhi":"ਕੰਚਨ ਕਲਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਕੋ ਭਏ ਸੂਧੋ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਟੀ ਕੋ ਕਲਸੁ ਫੂਟੋ ਜੁਰੈ ਨ ਜਤਨ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"ka(n)chan kalas jaise baako bhe soodho hoi maaTee ko kalas fooTo jurai na jatan sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a golden pitcher if dented can be set right whereas an earthenware pitcher can never be restored to its original shape when broken. "}}},{"verse_id":209328,"page_no":null,"line_no":394,"gurmukhi":"ਬਸਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਧੋਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਊਜਰੀ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਕਾਰੀ ਕਾਂਬਰੀ ਪਤਨ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"basan maleen dhoe niramal hot jaise uoojaree na hot kaaree kaa(n)baree patan sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a dirty cloth can be made clean by washing, whereas a black blanket can never become white till reduced to tatters. "}}},{"verse_id":209329,"page_no":null,"line_no":394,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕੁਟੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਸੇਕਤ ਹੀ ਸੂਧੀ ਹੋਇ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਪਟੰਤਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਮਨਤਨ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise lakuTee agan sekat hee soodhee hoi savaiaan poochh paTa(n)taro pragaT manatan sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wooden stick when heated on fire can be straightened, but a dog's tail can never be straightened despite numerous efforts. "}}},{"verse_id":209330,"page_no":null,"line_no":394,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਜਲ ਮੈਨ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਲਾਖ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਗਤਨ ਸੈ ॥੩੯੦॥","translit_en":"taise gur sikhan subhaau jal main gat saakat subhaav laakh paahun gatan sai ||390||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the nature of True Guru-oriented obedient Sikhs who are tender and malleable like water and wax. On the other hand, the temperament of mammon-loving person is rigid and hard like shellac and stone and thus is destructive.  (390)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41420,"next":41422}}
files.shabads/82/41422.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41422,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209331","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209331,"last_verse_id":209334,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209331,"page_no":null,"line_no":395,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੜਿ ਗੜਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਨੁਖ ਬਾਨ ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੜਿ ਗੜਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਸਨਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo bechai gaR gaR sasatr dhanukh baan kouoo bechai gaR gaR bibidh sanaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Someone manufactures bows and arrows used for killing while others fabricate armour coats and shields to defend against these weapons. "}}},{"verse_id":209332,"page_no":null,"line_no":395,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਗੋਰਸ ਦੁਗਧ ਦਧਿ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਬੇਚੈ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਮ ਚਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kouoo bechai goras dhugadh dhadh ghirat nit kouoo bechai baarunee bikham sam chaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Someone sells nourishing foods like milk, butter, curd etc. to make the body strong while others produce items like wine etc. that are harmful and destructive to the body. "}}},{"verse_id":209333,"page_no":null,"line_no":395,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਅਵਗਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"taise hee bikaaree upakaaree hai asaadh saadh bikhiaa a(n)mirat ban dhekhe avagaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is a base and low person who spreads evil whereas an obedient Guru-oriented saintly person of the True Guru desires and endeavours to dispense good for all. Treat it like bathing in a sea of poison or jumping into a reservoir of nectar. "}}},{"verse_id":209334,"page_no":null,"line_no":395,"gurmukhi":"ਆਤਮਾ ਅਚੇਤ ਪੰਛੀ ਧਾਵਤ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਜੈਸੇ ਈ ਬਿਰਖ ਬੈਠੇ ਚਾਖੇ ਫਲ ਤਾਹ ਜੀ ॥੩੯੧॥","translit_en":"aatamaa achet pa(n)chhee dhaavat chatur ku(n)T jaise iee birakh baiThe chaakhe fal taeh jee ||391||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like an innocent bird, a human mind wanders in all four directions. Whatever tree it sits on, it would get that fruit to eat. In the company of evil-doers, the mind will only pick up dross whereas one collects virtues from the company of Guru-conscious saintly persons.  (391)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41421,"next":41423}}
files.shabads/82/41423.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41423,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209335","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209335,"last_verse_id":209338,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209335,"page_no":null,"line_no":396,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਕੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਤ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸੁਤ ਗੋਦ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ek jananee kai hot hai anek sut sab hee mai adhik piaaro sut godh ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mother has many sons but one in her lap is the dearest to her; "}}},{"verse_id":209336,"page_no":null,"line_no":396,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਆਨੇ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਗੋਦ ਮੈ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨ ਸਹੋਦ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"siaane sut banaj biauhaar ke beechaar bikhai godh mai achet het sa(n)pai na sahodh ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The elder sons remain engrossed in their commercial activities but one in lap is ignorant of all allurements of wealth, commodities and love of brothers and sisters; "}}},{"verse_id":209337,"page_no":null,"line_no":396,"gurmukhi":"ਪਲਨਾ ਸੁਵਾਇ ਮਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਤ ਰੁਦਨ ਪੈ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਮਨ ਮੋਦ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"palanaa suvai mai gireh kaaj laagai jai sun sut rudhan pai peeaavai man modh ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Leaving the innocent baby in a cradle, the mother keeps attending other domestic chores but listening to the baby's cry, she comes running and feeds the child. "}}},{"verse_id":209338,"page_no":null,"line_no":396,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਾ ਖੋਇ ਜੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਨਿਰਦੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਅਨਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋ ॥੩੯੨॥","translit_en":"aapaa khoi joiee gur charan saran gahe rahe niradhokh mokh anadh binodh ko ||392||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the innocent child, he who loses his self and takes the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru, is blessed with the consecration of Naam-Simran-Mantar that saves him from the worldly vices; and relishing the bliss of Naam Simran he achieves salvation.  (392)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41422,"next":41424}}
files.shabads/82/41424.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41424,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209339","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209339,"last_verse_id":209342,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209339,"page_no":null,"line_no":397,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰਤ ਨ ਇਛਾ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰਤਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"karat na ichhaa kachh mitr satrataa na jaanai baal budh sudh naeh baalak achet kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Due to his childlike wisdom and unawareness of all sorts, a child is innocent, He desires nothing, nor does he harbour any hostility or friendship with anyone; "}}},{"verse_id":209340,"page_no":null,"line_no":397,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਨ ਬਸਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਡੋਲੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਮੁਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"asan basan le'ee maataa paachhai laagee ddolai bolai mukh a(n)mirat bachan sut het kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His mother out of love keeps wandering behind him with food and clothing and utters elixir-like loving words for her son; "}}},{"verse_id":209341,"page_no":null,"line_no":397,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕੈ ਅਸੀਸ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਰਿ ਦੈਨਹਾਰੀ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਡਾਰੀ ਸੇਤ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"baalakai asees dhainahaaree at piaaree laagai gaar dhainahaaree balihaaree ddaaree set kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mother loves her friends who keep showering blessings on her son but one who abuses him or say ill words for him destroys her peace of mind and creates duality. "}}},{"verse_id":209342,"page_no":null,"line_no":397,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਅਨੰਦਮਈ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਲੁ ਖੇਤ ਕਉ ॥੩੯੩॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh samadharasee ana(n)dhamiee jaiseo jag maanai taiseo laagai fal khet kau ||393||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like an innocent child, the obedient Sikh maintains impartiality. The Sikh treats everyone equally and by virtue of relishing on Naam (as blessed by the Guru) stays in bliss. Whatever way a person is recognized by the world, they are blessed with that reward. (393)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41423,"next":41425}}
files.shabads/82/41425.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41425,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209343","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209343,"last_verse_id":209346,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209343,"page_no":null,"line_no":398,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਸੂਰ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਖੈ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੋਤ ਕਿਰਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise dharapan dhib soor sanamukh raakhai paavak pragaas hot kiran charitr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a magnifying lens placed before the rays of the sun produces fire. "}}},{"verse_id":209344,"page_no":null,"line_no":398,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮੇਘ ਬਰਖਤ ਹੀ ਬਸੁੰਧਰਾ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਸਫਲ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise megh barakhat hee basu(n)dharaa biraajai bibidh banaasapatee safal sumitr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as earth looks good with rainfall and like a good friend produces fruits and flowers. "}}},{"verse_id":209345,"page_no":null,"line_no":398,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈਟਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਿਭਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਤ ਉਦਿਤ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"bhaiTat bhataar naar soibhat si(n)gaar chaar pooran ana(n)dh sut udhit bachitr kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the conjugal union of a well adorned and embellished woman with her husband gives birth to a son and the wife is highly pleased. "}}},{"verse_id":209346,"page_no":null,"line_no":398,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਤ ਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਪਾਵਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੯੪॥","translit_en":"satigur dharas paras bigasat sikh praapat nidhaan giaan paavan pavitr kai ||394||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly an obedient disciple of the Guru feels pleased and blossoms at the sight of the True Guru. And by acquiring the treasure-house of divine knowledge and consecration of Naam Simran from his True Guru, he becomes a pious person.  (394)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41424,"next":41426}}
files.shabads/82/41426.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41426,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209347","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209347,"last_verse_id":209350,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209347,"page_no":null,"line_no":399,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬੁਧਿਵੰਤ ਸਸੁਰਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਚੇਤਨ ਰਹੈ ਅਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kulaa badhoo budhiva(n)t sasuraar bikhai saavadhaan chetan rahai achaar chaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an intelligent daughter-in-law of a good family deals with everybody attentively, consciously and decently in her in-laws house; "}}},{"verse_id":209348,"page_no":null,"line_no":399,"gurmukhi":"ਸਸੁਰ ਦੇਵਰ ਜੇਠ ਸਕਲ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੈ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"sasur dhevar jeTh sakal kee sevaa karai khaan paan giaan jaan pat paravaar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Realizing that this is her husband's family, takes care of food and all other needs of her father-in-law, brothers-in-law and other members of the family diligently and respectfully; "}}},{"verse_id":209349,"page_no":null,"line_no":399,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੈ ਲਜਾ ਲਵੰਨਿ ਸਿਹਿਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"madhur bachan gur jan sai lajaa lava(n)n sihijaa samai ras prem pooran bhataar kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She talks with all elders of the family respectfully, politely and abashedly. Similarly a devoted disciple of the True Guru is adept in observing respect towards all human beings. "}}},{"verse_id":209350,"page_no":null,"line_no":399,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਰਬਾਤਮ ਪੂਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੩੯੫॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh sarabaatam poojaa prabeen braham dhiaan gur moorat apaar kai ||395||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But within himself, he remains focused on the divine sight of the God-like True Guru. (According to Bhai Gurdas Ji, practicing on the Guru's words and meditating on Lord's name given by the True Guru is contemplation on the vision of True Guru).  (395)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41425,"next":41427}}
files.shabads/82/41427.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41427,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209351","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209351,"last_verse_id":209354,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209351,"page_no":null,"line_no":400,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੁਰ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"teerath purab dhev jaatraa jaat hai jagat purab teerath sur koTin koTaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"People of the world visit various places of pilgrimage on various days considered auspicious by them. But such days and holy places associated with gods are numerous. "}}},{"verse_id":209352,"page_no":null,"line_no":400,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਫਲ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"mukat baiku(n)Th jog jugat bibidh fal baa(n)chhat hai saadh raj koT giaan dhiaan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of seekers of Salvation, heaven and many methods of performing Yoga, worldly knowledge and contemplations long for the holy dust of the feet of saintly True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209353,"page_no":null,"line_no":400,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਸਿਖ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਚਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"agam agaadh saadh sa(n)gat asa(n)kh sikh sree guroo bachan milai raam ras aan kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There are numerous devoted Sikhs of the True Guru in the holy assembly of the inaccessible and serene True Guru who receive the sermon of how to reach the blissful state of enjoying ambrosial name of the Lord through meditation. "}}},{"verse_id":209354,"page_no":null,"line_no":400,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥੩੯੬॥","translit_en":"sahaj samaadh apara(n)par purakh liv pooran braham satigur saavadhaan kai ||396||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such Sikhs of the Guru engross themselves in silent meditation of Lord's name that the imperceptible, inaccessible, perfect and God-like True Guru has blessed them with. Their engrossment is highly attentive and in a state of serenity. (396)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41426,"next":41428}}
files.shabads/82/41428.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41428,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209355","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209355,"last_verse_id":209358,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209355,"page_no":null,"line_no":401,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜੈਸੋ ਦੇਖੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਕਹਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhiragan kau jihabaa sravan jau mileh jaiso dhekhai taiseo keh sun gaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If eyes get tongue and ears, then whatever it sees and hears with ears, it will then describe the reality and convey it. "}}},{"verse_id":209356,"page_no":null,"line_no":401,"gurmukhi":"ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਅਉ ਲੋਚਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਆਲ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਸੁਨੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"sravan jihabaa aau lochan milai dhiaal jaiseo sunai taiseo dhekh keh samajhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If by the kindness of Almighty, the ears get tongue and eyes, then they will speak with tongue, what they see with eyes and hear. "}}},{"verse_id":209357,"page_no":null,"line_no":401,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਹਬਾ ਕਉ ਲੋਚਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਉ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਜੈਸੇੋ ਕਹੈ ਤੈਸੇੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਉ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"jihabaa kau lochan sravan jau mileh dhev jaiseo kahai taiseo sun dhekh aau dhikhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If the Almighty God bless the tongue with eyes .and ears it will say what it sees with eyes and hears with ears. "}}},{"verse_id":209358,"page_no":null,"line_no":401,"gurmukhi":"ਨੈਨ ਜੀਹ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਜੀਹ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਲਲਚਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੯੭॥","translit_en":"nain jeeh sravan sravan lochan jeeh jihabaa na sravan lochan lalachaavahee ||397||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eyes need assistance of tongue and ears, the ears need assistance of tongue and eyes. But meditating on Naam, the tongue gets dyed in the hue of the Lord. In this state, the tongue never longs for the assistance of the eyes and the ears. (397)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41427,"next":41429}}
files.shabads/82/41429.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41429,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209359","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209359,"last_verse_id":209362,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209359,"page_no":null,"line_no":402,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨੋ ਸੁਅੰਨਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਾਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਵੈਸੋ ਈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"aapano sua(n)n jaise laagat piaaro jeea jaaneeaai vaiso iee piaaro sakal sa(n)saar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one loves one's son by heart, so are their sons loved by all others in the world. "}}},{"verse_id":209360,"page_no":null,"line_no":402,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਨੋ ਦਰਬੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਵੈਸੋ ਈ ਸਮਝਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਹੰੂ ਕੇ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"aapano dharab jaise raakheeaai jatan kar vaiso iee samajh sabh kaaha(n)oo ke biauhaar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one takes full care of one's wealth and assets, so should one treat other's business and profession monetarily. "}}},{"verse_id":209361,"page_no":null,"line_no":402,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਵੈਸੀਐ ਲਗਤ ਜਗ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"asatut ni(n)dhaa sun biaapat harakh sog vaiseeaai lagat jag anik prakaar kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one feels happy listening to one's praise and disturbed on listening slander about oneself, so should one acknowledge and think that others would feel the same. "}}},{"verse_id":209362,"page_no":null,"line_no":402,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਕਾਕੋ ਉਤਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਰ ਕਉ ॥੩੯੮॥","translit_en":"jaise kul dharam karam jaiso jaiso kaako utam kai maan jaan braham birathaar kau ||398||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, whatever is the business or profession of a person according to his family tradition, it should be accepted as supreme and most appropriate for him. (No one should be hurt on this account). This is enough to understand the Omnipresence of the Lord.  (398)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41428,"next":41430}}
files.shabads/82/41430.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41430,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209363","verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":209363,"last_verse_id":209364,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209363,"page_no":null,"line_no":403,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਪੰਖ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਮੋਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਓਰ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nain bain pa(n)kh su(n)dhar saraba(n)g mor taa ke pag or dhekh dhokh na beechaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a peacock's eyes, call, feathers and all other limbs are beautiful, one should not condemn him for his ugly feet. (see the merits alone). "}}},{"verse_id":209364,"page_no":null,"line_no":403,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਦਲ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਅਤਿ ਕੋਮਲ ਕਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ॥ ਕੰਟਕਿ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਨ ਅਉਗਨ ਉਰਧਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)dhal suga(n)dh at komal kamal jaise|| ka(n)Tak bilok na aaugan uradhaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as Sandalwood is very fragrant and lotus flower very delicate, one should not bring to mind their demerit of the fact that a snake generally wraps itself around the sandalwood tree while a lotus flower has thorn on its stem. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41429,"next":41431}}
files.shabads/82/41431.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41431,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209365","verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":209365,"last_verse_id":209366,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209365,"page_no":null,"line_no":404,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਮਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਨਾਦਿ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਬੀਜ ਕਰਵਾਈ ਕੈ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਨ ਸਮਾਰੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise a(n)mirat fal misaT gunaadh savaiaadh beej karavaiee kai buraiee na samaareeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mango is sweet and delicious but its kernal's bitterness should not be thought of. "}}},{"verse_id":209366,"page_no":null,"line_no":404,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਦਾਨ ਸਬਹੰੂ ਸੈ ਮਾਂਗਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਭੂਤ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਨ ਤਕਾਰੀਐ ॥੩੯੯॥","translit_en":"taise gur giaan dhaan sabaha(n)oo sai maa(n)g leejai ba(n)dhanaa sakal bhoot ni(n)dhaa na takaareeaai ||399||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly one should take Guru's word and his sermons from everyone and everywhere. Everyone should be respected also. No one should be ever slandered and condemned for his demerit. (399)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41430,"next":41432}}
