files.shabads/82/41432.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41432,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209367","verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":209367,"last_verse_id":209371,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209367,"page_no":null,"line_no":405,"gurmukhi":"ਸਵੈਯਾ","translit_en":"savaiyaa","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Swaiya"}}},{"verse_id":209368,"page_no":null,"line_no":405,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਦਰਸ ਕਤ ਸਜਨੀ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ ॥","translit_en":"paaras paras dharas kat sajanee kat vai nain bain man mohan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O my Guru-conscious friend! like a philosopher-stone, the touch of which changes a metal into gold, where is the glimpse of the True Guru that makes a person supreme and valuable like gold? Where are those enamoring eyes and sweet invaluable words? "}}},{"verse_id":209369,"page_no":null,"line_no":405,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਵੈ ਦਸਨ ਹਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਬਨ ਸੋਹਨ ॥","translit_en":"kat vai dhasan hasan sobhaa nidh kat vai gavan bhavan ban sohan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where is that smiling face with beautiful teeth, where is the hearth and home and his majestic walk in the fields and gardens? "}}},{"verse_id":209370,"page_no":null,"line_no":405,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਵੈ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦੁਖ ਜੋਹਨ ॥","translit_en":"kat vai raag ra(n)g sukh saagar kat vai dhiaa miaa dhukh johan ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where is the treasure of peace and comfort? The treasure of singing His praises through Naam and bani (Guru's compositions). Where is that look of kindness and benevolence that is sailing myriad devotees across the worldly ocean? "}}},{"verse_id":209371,"page_no":null,"line_no":405,"gurmukhi":"ਕਤ ਵੈ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਲੀਲਾ ਕਤ ਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਛਬਿ ਗੋਹਨ ॥੪੦੦॥","translit_en":"kat vai jog bhog ras leelaa kat vai sa(n)t sabhaa chhab gohan ||400||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Where is the engrossment, strange and wondrous feeling, of enjoying the bliss of the Lord? Where is the assembly of saints in the True Guru's divine presence that sings the praises of the mighty Lord and creates a celestial image of His Court? (400)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41431,"next":41433}}
files.shabads/82/41433.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41433,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209372","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209372,"last_verse_id":209375,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209372,"page_no":null,"line_no":406,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਚਰਨਨ ਰਜ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਕਬ ਦੇਖਉ ॥","translit_en":"kab laagai masatak charanan raj dharas dhiaa dhiragan kab dhekhau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will my forehead be anointed with the holy dust of the feet of True Guru and when will I see the clement and merciful face of the True Guru with my own eyes? "}}},{"verse_id":209373,"page_no":null,"line_no":406,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਕਬ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨ ਕਬ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਬਿਸੇਖਉ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat bachan sunau kab sravanan kab rasanaa benatee bisekhau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I hear the sweet ambrosial-like and elixir-giving words of my True Guru with my own ears? When will I be able to make a humble supplication of my distress with my own tongue before him? "}}},{"verse_id":209374,"page_no":null,"line_no":406,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬ ਕਰ ਕਰਉ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਪਗਨ ਪਰਿਕ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਰੇਖਉ ॥","translit_en":"kab kar karau dda(n)ddaut ba(n)dhanaa pagan parikramaadh pun rekhau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When will I be able to lie prostrate like a staff before my True Guru and salute him with folded hands? When will I be able to employ my feet in the circumambulation of my True Guru? "}}},{"verse_id":209375,"page_no":null,"line_no":406,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਛਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ॥ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਲੇਖਉ ॥੪੦੧॥","translit_en":"prem bhagat pratachh praanapat|| giaan dhiaan jeevan padh lekhau ||401||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru who is the manifest of the Lord, provided of knowledge, contemplation, granter of salvation and sustainer of life when will I be able to realise Him clearly through my loving worship? (Bhai Gurdas Ii is expressing his pangs of separation from his True Guru)  (401)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41432,"next":41434}}
files.shabads/82/41434.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41434,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209376","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209376,"last_verse_id":209379,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209376,"page_no":null,"line_no":407,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਰਖੈੈ ਬਇਆਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰ ਰਾਤਿ ਪਾਤਿ ਪੰਛੀ ਨ ਧੀਰਜ ਕਰਿ ਠਉਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"birakhaiai biaar laagai jaise har raat paat pa(n)chhee na dheeraj kar Thaur Thahiraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the leaves and branches of a tree start trembling under the influence of fast wind and even the birds lose trust of their nests; "}}},{"verse_id":209377,"page_no":null,"line_no":407,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਵਰ ਘਾਮ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਾਰਜ ਬਿਲਖ ਮੁਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅੰਤ ਹੰਤ ਜਲ ਜੰਤ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saravar ghaam laagai baaraj bilakh mukh praan a(n)t ha(n)t jal ja(n)t akulaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as lotus flowers whither away under the sharp heat of the Sun and aquatic life of the water feels distressed as if their lives were coming to an end; "}}},{"verse_id":209378,"page_no":null,"line_no":407,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਰਦੂਲ ਦੇਖੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਮਾਲ ਦਲ ਚਿਤ ਬਨ ਵਾਸ ਮੈ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"saaradhool dhekhai miragamaal dhal chit ban vaas mai na traas kar aasram suhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the herd of deers find solace and safety in their small hiding places in the jungle when they see the lion in the vicinity; "}}},{"verse_id":209379,"page_no":null,"line_no":407,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਆਂਗ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗਿ ਭਏ ਭੈ ਚਕਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਦੁਖਤਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੨॥","translit_en":"taise gur aa(n)g savaiaa(n)g bhe bhai chakat sikh dhukhat udhaas baas at bilalaat hai ||402||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the Sikhs of the Guru are frightened, amazed, distressed and morose seeing the body/limbs of a spurious Guru marked with artificial marks of recognition. Even the Sikhs most close to the Guru feel restless.  (402)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41433,"next":41435}}
files.shabads/82/41435.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41435,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209380","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209380,"last_verse_id":209383,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209380,"page_no":null,"line_no":408,"gurmukhi":"ਓਲਾ ਬਰਖਨ ਕਰਖਨ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਬਯਾਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਬਨ ਜਰਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"olaa barakhan karakhan dhaaminee bayaar saagar lahar ban jarat agan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If hails be falling, lightening be making thunderous sounds, storm be raging. stormy waves be rising in the ocean and forests may be burning with fire; "}}},{"verse_id":209381,"page_no":null,"line_no":408,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਜੀ ਬਿਰਾਜੀ ਭੂਕੰਪਿਕਾ ਅੰਤਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਬਲ ਬੰਦਸਾਲ ਸਾਸਨਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਮੈ ਮਗਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raajee biraajee bhooka(n)pikaa a(n)tar birathaa bal ba(n)dhasaal saasanaa sa(n)kaT mai magan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The subjects be without their king, earthquakes be experienced, one may have been troubled by some deep innate pain and for some offence may have been lodged in the jail; "}}},{"verse_id":209382,"page_no":null,"line_no":408,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰ ਛਿਦ੍ਰਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਰਿਨ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਨਗਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aapadhaa adheen dheen dhookhanaa dharidhr chhidhr bhramat udhaas rin dhaasan nagan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Many tribulations may overpower him, may be distressed by false accusations, poverty may have crushed him, may be wandering for loan and caught in the slavery, may be straying aimlessly but in acute hunger; "}}},{"verse_id":209383,"page_no":null,"line_no":408,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਜਉ ਆਇ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੇ ਰੋਮ ਨ ਭਗਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੩॥","translit_en":"taise hee sirasaT ko adhirasaT jau aai laagai jag mai bhagatan ke rom na bhagan hai ||403||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And even if more of such worldly tribulations and distresses may befall upon Guru-loving, obedient and meditating persons dear to the True Guru, they are least troubled by them and live life ever in bloom and happiness.  (403)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41434,"next":41436}}
files.shabads/82/41436.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41436,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209384","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209384,"last_verse_id":209387,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209384,"page_no":null,"line_no":409,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਟੀ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਚੜੈ ਪੰਛੀ ਉਡ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਸੇ ਨਿਕਟ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise cheeTee kram kram kai birakh chaRai pa(n)chhee udd jai baise nikaT hee fal kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an ant crawls up the tree very slowly to reach the fruit, whereas a bird flies and reaches it instantly. "}}},{"verse_id":209385,"page_no":null,"line_no":409,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਡੀ ਚਲੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਲੀਕਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੀਰਜ ਸੈ ਘੋਰੋ ਦੌਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਾਂਇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਸਬਲ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise gaaddee chalee jaat leekan meh dheeraj sai ghoro dhauar jai baa(n)i dhaahane sabal kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bullock cart moving in the ruts of the path reaches its destination slowly but a horse moving on either side of the path moves fast and reaches the destination quickly. "}}},{"verse_id":209386,"page_no":null,"line_no":409,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਸ ਭਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਨ ਪਾਇਨ ਕੈ ਆਤਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਧਾਇ ਆਵੈ ਪਲ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kos bhar chal sakeeaai na pain kai aatamaa chatur ku(n)T dhai aavai pal kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as one does not cover even a mile in a few seconds but the mind reaches and wanders around in four directions in a split second. "}}},{"verse_id":209387,"page_no":null,"line_no":409,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਭੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਪਛ ਗੰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਸਥਲ ਕੈ ॥੪੦੪॥","translit_en":"taise log bedh bhedh giaan unamaan pachh ga(n)m gur charan saran asathal kai ||404||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the knowledge of Vedas and worldly affairs is based on arguments and exchange of views. This method is like the movement of an ant. But by taking the refuge of the True Guru, one reaches the infallible and stable places of the Lord in no time.  (404)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41435,"next":41437}}
files.shabads/82/41437.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41437,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209388","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209388,"last_verse_id":209391,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209388,"page_no":null,"line_no":410,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਪਰਫੁਲਤ ਫਲ ਨਮਿਤ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise banarai parafulat fal namit laagat hee fal patr puhap bilaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as trees and other vegetation grow for fruits and flowers but as soon as they bear fruits, their leaves and fruits drop. "}}},{"verse_id":209389,"page_no":null,"line_no":410,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਰਚਿਤ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਭੇਟਤ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਉਰ ਹਾਰ ਨ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise treeaa rachit si(n)gaar bharataar het bheTat bharataar ur haar na samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife adorns and embellishes herself for the love of her husband, but in his embrace, she doesn't even like the necklace she wears as it is considered an impediment in their complete union. "}}},{"verse_id":209390,"page_no":null,"line_no":410,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲਕ ਅਚੇਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਲੀਲਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਭਏ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਸਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baalak achet jaise karat leelaa anek suchit chi(n)tan bhe sabai bisaraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an innocent child plays many games in his childhood but forgets them all once he grows up. "}}},{"verse_id":209391,"page_no":null,"line_no":410,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਜ ਗਿਆਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦੈ ਉਡ ਕਰਮ ਉਡਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੫॥","translit_en":"taise khaT karam dharam sram giaan kaaj giaan bhaan udhai udd karam uddaat hai ||405||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the six forms of righteous deeds which are performed diligently for gaining knowledge, disappear like stars when the great knowledge of the Guru shines in its Sun like glory. All those deeds seem futile. (405)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41436,"next":41438}}
files.shabads/82/41438.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41438,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209392","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209392,"last_verse_id":209395,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209392,"page_no":null,"line_no":411,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹਸ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਡਾਕਨ ਹਰੈ ਕਰੇਜੌ ਬਾਲਕ ਤਾਹੀ ਲੌ ਧਾਵੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੋਦਿ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise has bolat hee ddaakan harai karejau baalak taahee lau dhaavai jaanai godh let hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a malicious woman enamors a child with her sweet and gullible talk that attracts the child to her who thinks she would bestow her love upon him. "}}},{"verse_id":209393,"page_no":null,"line_no":411,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਵਤ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਅਉਖਦ ਪਿਆਵੈ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟਿ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rovat suteh jaise aaukhadh piaavai maataa baalak jaanat moh kaalakooT dhet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a mother administer medicine to her suffering and crying son but the child feels she is serving him poison. "}}},{"verse_id":209394,"page_no":null,"line_no":411,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਬਾਲਕ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਜਗਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"haran bharan gat satigur jaaneeaai na baalak jugat mat jagat achet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The intellect of the worldly beings is also like this child. They do not know the traits of God-like True Guru who is fully capable of destroying all the vices in them. In this regard, Bhai gurdas Ji says: \"Avgun lai gun vikanai vachnai da sura\". Var. 13/21. "}}},{"verse_id":209395,"page_no":null,"line_no":411,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਤ ਆਪ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੬॥","translit_en":"akal kalaa alakh at hee agaadh bodh aap hee jaanat aap net net net hai ||406||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru is perfect in all respects. He is beyond our perception. No one can fathom his vast knowledge. He alone knows His own capabilities. All that can be said is-He is Infinite, Infinite, Infinite.   (406)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41437,"next":41439}}
files.shabads/82/41439.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41439,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209396","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209396,"last_verse_id":209399,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209396,"page_no":null,"line_no":412,"gurmukhi":"ਦੈਤ ਸੁਤ ਭਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਭਏ ਦੇਵ ਸੁਤ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਸਨੀਚਰ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhait sut bhagat pragaT prahilaadh bhe dhev sut jag mai saneechar bakhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bhagat Prehlad who made everyone in the city meditate on the name of the Lord, took birth in the house of evil-minded Harnakash. But Sanichar (Saturn) the son of Sun is believed to be an inauspicious and distressing constellation in the world. "}}},{"verse_id":209397,"page_no":null,"line_no":412,"gurmukhi":"ਮਧੁ ਪੁਰ ਬਾਸੀ ਕੰਸ ਅਧਮ ਅਸੁਰ ਭਏ ਲੰਕਾ ਬਾਸੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਭੀਖਨ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"madh pur baasee ka(n)s adham asur bhe la(n)kaa baasee sevak bhabheekhan pachhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Of the six sacred cities, one is Mathura which was ruled by a vice-ridden demon-like king called Kansa. Also, Bhabhikhan a God-loving devotee was born in Lanka, the infamous city of Ravan. "}}},{"verse_id":209398,"page_no":null,"line_no":412,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਭਈ ਅਹਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਨਿ ਉਦੈ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"saagar ga(n)bheer bikhai bikhiaa pragaas bhiee eh masatak man udhai unamaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The deep ocean yielded the death-giving poison. It is also believed that the most poisonous snake has an invaluable jewel in its head. "}}},{"verse_id":209399,"page_no":null,"line_no":412,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਨ ਸਥਾਨ ਲਘੁ ਦੀਰਘ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਬਿਸਮ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੦੭॥","translit_en":"baran sathaan lagh dheeragh jatan karai akath kathaa binodh bisam na jaaneeaai ||407||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So, considering someone high or low, good or bad because of the place of his birth or family lineage is just a misconception. This is an indescribable and wondrous play of the Lord that no one can know.   (407)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41438,"next":41440}}
files.shabads/82/41440.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41440,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209400","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209400,"last_verse_id":209403,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209400,"page_no":null,"line_no":413,"gurmukhi":"ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਚਿਤ ਤੇ ਚੁਰਾਈ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਸੰਕਟ ਕਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"chi(n)taaman chitavat chi(n)taa chit te churaiee ajonee araadhe jon sa(n)kaT kaTaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Perpetual remembrance of the Lord the fulfiller all the desires and wants, removes all worries from the mind. Worshipping the Lord who is free of birth and death cycle, one is able to achieve emancipation from entering into life of various species. "}}},{"verse_id":209401,"page_no":null,"line_no":413,"gurmukhi":"ਜਪਤ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਕੰਟਕ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸੇ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਭਜਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਦਲ ਭਜਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"japat akaal kaal ka(n)Tak kales naase nirabhai bhajan bhram bhai dhal bhajaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By contemplating on that Timeless Supreme Lord, fear of death vanishes and one becomes fearless. Singing praises of the fearless Lord, all impressions of fear and suspicions are erased from the mind. "}}},{"verse_id":209402,"page_no":null,"line_no":413,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਬੈਰ ਭਾਉ ਤਿਆਗਿਓ ਭਾਗਿਓ ਭੇਦੁ ਖੇਦੁ ਨਿਰਭੇਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"simarat naath niravair bair bhaau tiaagio bhaagio bhedh khedh nirabhedh gun gaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Remembering repeatedly the name of the Lord who is sans animosity, all feelings of hate and enmity disappear. And those who sing His paeans with devoted mind, find themselves free of all dualities. "}}},{"verse_id":209403,"page_no":null,"line_no":413,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕੁਲ ਅੰਚਲ ਗਹੇ ਕੁਲ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ ਕੋਊ ਅਟਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੮॥","translit_en":"akul a(n)chal gahe kul na bichaarai kouoo aTal saran aavaa gavan miTaae hai ||408||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He who holds the apron of the casteless and classless Lord, is never noticed for his caste and family lineage. One is able to destroy the cycles of incarnation by coming to the refuge of stable and immovable Lord.  (408)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41439,"next":41441}}
files.shabads/82/41441.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41441,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209404","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209404,"last_verse_id":209407,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209404,"page_no":null,"line_no":414,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਛੈ ਨ ਸ੍ਵਰਗ ਬਾਸ ਮਾਨੈ ਨ ਨਰਕ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਆਸਾ ਨ ਕਰਤ ਚਿਤ ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baachhai na savairag baas maanai na narak traas aasaa na karat chit honahaar hoi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An obedient disciple of the True Guru neither asks for heaven nor does he fear hell. He does not keep any longing or desire in his mind. Instead he believes that whatever God does is just right. "}}},{"verse_id":209405,"page_no":null,"line_no":414,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਪਤਿ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਪਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਬਿਹਸ ਨ ਰੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)pat na harakh bipat mai na sog taeh sukh dhukh samasar bihas na roi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Acquisition of wealth does not make him happy. In the times of distress, he is never morose. Instead he treats distresses and comforts alike and does not lament or rejoice on them. "}}},{"verse_id":209406,"page_no":null,"line_no":414,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਜਵਿਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਭੇਦ ਖੇਦ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਵਿਲੋਇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"janam javin mirat mukat na bhedh khedh ga(n)mitaa tirakaal baal budh aviloi hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is not afraid of birth and death and has no desire of salvation. He is least affected by the worldly dualities and remain in a state of equipoise. He is aware of all the three periods of life and know all the happenings of the world. Yet he always looks like an innocent child. "}}},{"verse_id":209407,"page_no":null,"line_no":414,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਨਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੯॥","translit_en":"giaan gur a(n)jan kai cheenat nira(n)janeh biralo sa(n)saar prem bhagat mai koi hai ||409||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who ever is blessed with the collyrium of knowledge of the True Guru, recognises the mammon-free Lord God. But such a person who is able to achieve that state is rare in the world.  (409)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41440,"next":41442}}
files.shabads/82/41442.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41442,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209408","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209408,"last_verse_id":209411,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209408,"page_no":null,"line_no":415,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਛੁਪਾਇ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਟੀ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau miThaiee raakheeaai chhupai jatan kai cheeTee chal jai cheen taeh lapaTaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sweetmeats are hidden carefully and yet ants reach it with impunity and cling to them, "}}},{"verse_id":209409,"page_no":null,"line_no":415,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਜਗਾਇ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਤੰਗ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak jagai jaise raakheeaai dhurai gireh pragaT pata(n)g taa mai sahaj samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lit lamp is carefully hidden in the house, yet a moth is able to find it and merges in its flame, "}}},{"verse_id":209410,"page_no":null,"line_no":415,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਬਿਮਲ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਇਕਾਂਤ ਬਸੈ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਧੁ ਅਚਵਨ ਤਹ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau bimal jal kamal ikaa(n)t basai madhukar madh achavan teh jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the lotus flower of fresh and clean water blooms in solitary place, but the black bee always reaches it to enjoy its elixir, "}}},{"verse_id":209411,"page_no":null,"line_no":415,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤਿਹਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੦॥","translit_en":"taise gurmukh jeh ghaT pragaTat prem sakal sa(n)saar teh dhuaar bilalaat hai ||410||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So does a devoted disciple of the True Guru whose heart is kindled with the Love of the Lord, the whole world beseeches and whines at his door.  (410)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41441,"next":41443}}
files.shabads/82/41443.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41443,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209412","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209412,"last_verse_id":209415,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209412,"page_no":null,"line_no":416,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਜਤ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਸੁਨੀਅਤ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਜੈਸੇ ਉਦਤ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਭਾਨ ਦੁਰੈ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"baajat neesaan suneeat chahoo(n) or jaise udhat pradhaan bhaan dhurai na dhuraae sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the beat of the drum is heard on all four sides (its sound cannot be hidden) and when the supreme celestial body-sun rises, its light cannot be concealed; "}}},{"verse_id":209413,"page_no":null,"line_no":416,"gurmukhi":"ਦੀਪਕ ਸੈ ਦਾਵਾ ਭਏ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਘਟਿਕਾ ਮੈ ਸਿੰਧ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਿਪੈ ਨ ਛਿਪਾਏ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"dheepak sai dhaavaa bhe sakal sa(n)saar jaanai ghaTikaa mai si(n)dh jaise chhipai na chhipaae sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the whole world knows that light emanates from a lamp, and the ocean cannot be contained in a small earthenware pitcher; "}}},{"verse_id":209414,"page_no":null,"line_no":416,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਨ ਛਾਨੋ ਰਹਤ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨ ਪੈ ਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਦੁਹਾਈ ਫੇਰੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਏ ਸੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise chakravai na chhaano rahat si(n)ghaasan pai dhes mai dhuhaiee fere miTe na miTaae sai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an emperor sitting on the throne of his mighty empire cannot remain hidden; he is known among the subjects of his kingdom and that glory and fame is hard to destroy; "}}},{"verse_id":209415,"page_no":null,"line_no":416,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਮੋਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਉਪਜਾਏ ਸੈ ॥੪੧੧॥","translit_en":"taise gurmukh pria prem ko pragaas jaas gupat na rahai mon birat upajaae sai ||411||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the Guru-oriented Sikh whose heart is enlightened by the love of the Lord and His meditation, cannot remain hidden. His silence gives him away.  (411)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41442,"next":41444}}
files.shabads/82/41444.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41444,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209416","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209416,"last_verse_id":209419,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209416,"page_no":null,"line_no":417,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਪਛਮ ਨੋ ਤਾਕੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਲ ਲਾਛਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai dhekh dheepak pata(n)g pachham no taakai jeevan janam kul laachhan lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a moth sees a lit lamp and turns his face away from it, he defiles his life, birth and family. "}}},{"verse_id":209417,"page_no":null,"line_no":417,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖ ਹੁਇ ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai naadh baadh sun mirag aan giaan raachai praan sukh hui sabadh bedhee na kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hearing the voice of musical instruments, if a deer ignores it and engrosses himself in some other thought, he may save his life but he can no more be known to belong to the family who love the music of Ghanda Herha, (an instrument to the sound of which deer is attracted the most). "}}},{"verse_id":209418,"page_no":null,"line_no":417,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਪੈ ਜਲ ਸੈ ਨਿਕਸ ਮੀਨ ਸਰਜੀਵ ਰਹੈ ਸਹੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੂਖਨਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਬਿਲਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jau pai jal sai nikas meen sarajeev rahai sahai dhukh dhookhan birahu bilakhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a fish stays alive after coming out of water, she will have to bear the ignominy of stigmatising its clan, whimper and suffer pangs for having separated from its beloved water. "}}},{"verse_id":209419,"page_no":null,"line_no":417,"gurmukhi":"ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਜੈ ਭਜੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਕਉ ਸੰਗਤ ਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਦਵੀ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੧੨॥","translit_en":"sevaa gur giaan dhiaan tajai bhajai dhubidhaa kau sa(n)gat mai gurmukh padhavee na paaviee ||412||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a devoted Sikh renounces True Guru's service, His teachings and contemplation of His name, is engrossed in worldly quandary, he then cannot attain the status of an obedient disciple of the True Guru in the holy congregation of Guru.  (412)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41443,"next":41445}}
files.shabads/82/41445.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41445,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209420","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209420,"last_verse_id":209423,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209420,"page_no":null,"line_no":418,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਚੀਟੀ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਚੀਟੀ ਚਲੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਇਕ ਟਕ ਪਗ ਡਗਮਗਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ek cheeTee paachhai koT cheeTee chalee jaat ik Tak pag ddagamag saavadhaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as millions of ants follow the path blazed by an ant, walk on it very attentively without faltering a step; "}}},{"verse_id":209421,"page_no":null,"line_no":418,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂੰਜ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਮੈ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸ-ਚਾਰੀ ਆਗੈ ਅਗਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koo(n)j paa(n)t bhalee bhaa(n)t saa(n)t sahaj mai uddat akaasa-chaaree aagai agavaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as cranes fly in a disciplined formation very cautiously in peace and patience and all of them are led by one crane; "}}},{"verse_id":209422,"page_no":null,"line_no":418,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ-ਮਾਲ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਤ ਟਲਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗੀ ਰਮਤ ਤਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise miraga-maal chaal chalat Talat naeh jatr tatr agrabhaagee ramat tat dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a herd of deers never stagger from their sharp march following their leader and all proceed so very attentively, "}}},{"verse_id":209423,"page_no":null,"line_no":418,"gurmukhi":"ਚੀਟੀ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਛੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੰਥ ਛਾਡ ਚਲਿਤ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੩॥","translit_en":"cheeTee khag mirag sanamukh paachhai laage jaeh praanee gur pa(n)th chhaadd chalit agiaan hai ||413||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ants, cranes and deers keep following their leader, but supreme leader of all the species who leaves the well defined path of the True Guru, is surely a fool and a highly ignorant person.  (413)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41444,"next":41446}}
files.shabads/82/41446.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41446,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209424","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209424,"last_verse_id":209427,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209424,"page_no":null,"line_no":419,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਜਨੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise pria sa(n)gam sujas naikaa bakhaanai sun sun sajanee sagal bigasaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife describes her union with her husband to her friends who feel pleased hearing the details; "}}},{"verse_id":209425,"page_no":null,"line_no":419,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੁਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"simar simar pria prem ras bisam hui sobhaa dhet mon gahe man musakaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She fantasizes her union and goes into a state of ecstasy thinking about it. She expresses the beauty of the moment in her silence; "}}},{"verse_id":209426,"page_no":null,"line_no":419,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਅਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਸੂਤ ਸਮੈ ਰੁਦਨ ਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਮੁਦਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਤਾਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran adhaan prasoot samai rudhan sai gur jan mudhit hui taahee lapaTaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On completion of her pregnancy and at the time of giving birth to the child, she cries in labour pain and her whimper pleases the elderly ladies of the house who express their love for her; "}}},{"verse_id":209427,"page_no":null,"line_no":419,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜਾਸੁ ਬੋਲਤ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਮੋਨਿ ਸਬਹੁ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੪॥","translit_en":"taise gurmukh prem bhagat pragaas jaas bolat bairaag mon sabahu suhaat hai ||414||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a devoted Guru-conscious slave, whose heart is kindled with the Lord's love by virtue of meditation and contemplation, speaks in a state of renunciation from the world. (414)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41445,"next":41447}}
files.shabads/82/41447.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41447,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209428","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209428,"last_verse_id":209431,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209428,"page_no":null,"line_no":420,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਛੀ ਫਲ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਰੋਪੈ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਰਹੈ ਬਿਰਖੈ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kaachhee fal het bibidh birakh ropai nihafal rahai birakhai na kaahoo kaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a gardener plants saplings of many trees for obtaining fruits, but one which does not bear any fruit becomes useless. "}}},{"verse_id":209429,"page_no":null,"line_no":420,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਤਤਿ ਨਮਿਤਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਛਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)tat namit nirap anik bivaeh karai sa(n)tat bihoon banitaa na gireh chhaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king marries many women for obtaining a heir of his kingdom, but the queen who does not bear him a child is not liked by anyone in the family. "}}},{"verse_id":209430,"page_no":null,"line_no":420,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਦਿਆ ਦਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਚਟਸਾਰ ਜੋਰੈ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਹੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਲ ਨਾਮ ਉਪਰਾਜ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bidhiaa dhaan jaan jaise paa(n)dhaa chaTasaar jorai bidhiaa heen dheen khal naam uparaaj hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a teacher opens a school but the child who remains illiterate is called lazy and foolish. "}}},{"verse_id":209431,"page_no":null,"line_no":420,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਸੁਗਿਆਨ ਨਿਮਿਤ ਬਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗ ਜਨਮ ਕਉ ਲਾਜਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੫॥","translit_en":"satigur sikh saakhaa sa(n)grahai sugiaan nimit bin gur giaan dhirag janam kau laaj hai ||415||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, True Guru holds a congregation of his disciples in order to impart them with supreme form of knowledge (Naam). But he who remains bereft of Guru's teachings, is worthy of condemnation and is a blotch on the human birth.  (415)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41446,"next":41448}}
files.shabads/82/41448.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41448,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209432","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209432,"last_verse_id":209435,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209432,"page_no":null,"line_no":421,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਗ ਸੇਤੁ ਕੁਰਖੇਤ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"surasaree surasatee jamunaa godhaavaree giaa praag set kurakhet maanasar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Rivers like Ganges, Saraswati, Jamuna, Godavari and places of pilgrimage like Gaya, Prayagraj, Rameshwram, Kurukshetra and Mansarover lakes are located in India. "}}},{"verse_id":209433,"page_no":null,"line_no":421,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਂਸੀ ਕਾਂਤੀ ਦੁਆਰਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਅਜੁਧਿਆ ਗੋਮਤੀ ਆਵੰਤਕਾ ਕੇਦਾਰ ਹਿਮਧਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaa(n)see kaa(n)tee dhuaaraavatee maiaa mathuraa ajudhiaa gomatee aava(n)takaa kedhaar himadhar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So are the holy cities of Kashi, Kanti, Dwarka, Mayapuri, Mathura, Ayodhya, Avantika and river Gomti. The temple of Kedarnath in the snow clad hills is a sacred place. "}}},{"verse_id":209434,"page_no":null,"line_no":421,"gurmukhi":"ਨਰਬਦਾ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨ ਦੇਵ-ਸਥਲ ਕਵਲਾਸ ਨੀਲ ਮੰਦਰਾਚਲ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਗਿਰਵਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"narabadhaa bibidh ban dheva-sathal kavalaas neel ma(n)dharaachal sumer giravar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then river like Narmada, temples of gods, tapovans, Kailash, the abode of Shiva, Neel mountains, Mandrachal and Sumer are places worth going on a pilgrimage to. "}}},{"verse_id":209435,"page_no":null,"line_no":421,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਅਰਥ ਸਤ ਧਰਮ ਦਇਆ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਤੁਲ ਨ ਸਗਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੧੬॥","translit_en":"teerath arath sat dharam dhiaa sa(n)tokh sree gur charan raj tul na sagar hai ||416||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To seek the virtues of Truth, contentment, benevolence and righteousness, the holy places are idolized and worshipped. But all these are not equal to even the dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru. (Taking refuge of Satguru is supreme of all these places of pilgrimage).  (416)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41447,"next":41449}}
files.shabads/82/41449.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41449,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209436","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209436,"last_verse_id":209439,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209436,"page_no":null,"line_no":422,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੁਆਰ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਖੇਲਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਖੀ ਸਕਲ ਕੋ ਏਕੈ ਦਿਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਬਿਵਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kuaar ka(n)niaa mil khelat anek sakhee sakal ko ekai dhin hot na bivaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many virgin maids assemble and play with each other but all of them are not married off on the same day. "}}},{"verse_id":209437,"page_no":null,"line_no":422,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਭਟ ਜੇਤੇ ਸਬੈ ਨ ਮਰਤ ਤੇਤੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਨ ਸਨਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise beer khet bikhai jaat hai subhaT jete sabai na marat tete sasatran sanaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as many warriors go to the battlefield fully armed and protected with armour coat do not die in the battlefield. "}}},{"verse_id":209438,"page_no":null,"line_no":422,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਵਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਏਕੈ ਬੇਰ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"baavan sameep jaise bibidh banaasapatee ekai ber cha(n)dhan karat hai na taeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as there are many trees and plants around a grove of sandalwood trees, but all are not blessed with the fragrance of Sandalwood at once. "}}},{"verse_id":209439,"page_no":null,"line_no":422,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਜਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦ ਚਾਹਿਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਹਿ ਜੀ ॥੪੧੭॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran jaat hai jagat jeevan mukat padh chaahit hai jaeh jee ||417||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the whole world may go to the refuge of the True Guru but he alone attains the status of living emancipated who 'is liked by Him. (That particular disciple who serves Guru with faith and devotion).  (417)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41448,"next":41450}}
files.shabads/82/41450.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41450,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209440","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209440,"last_verse_id":209443,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209440,"page_no":null,"line_no":423,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਗੁਆਰ ਗਾਇਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਜਤਨ ਬਨ ਖੇਤ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਸਬੈ ਚਰਤ ਅਘਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise guaar gain charaavat jatan ban khet na parat sabai charat aghai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as cowherd grazer grazes his cows very attentively in the jungle and does not let them wander into some fields, and they graze to their satisfaction. "}}},{"verse_id":209441,"page_no":null,"line_no":423,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਰਾਜਨੀਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੇਸ ਪਰਜਾ ਬਸਤ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raajaa dharam saroop raajaneet bikhai taa ke dhes parajaa basat sukh pai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a king who is righteous and just, his subjects live in peace and prosperity. "}}},{"verse_id":209442,"page_no":null,"line_no":423,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਹੋਤ ਖੇਵਟ ਚਿਤੰਨ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਮੈ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪਾਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise hot khevaT chita(n)n saavadhaan jaa mai laagai nirabighan bohith paar jai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a sailor is very alert and conscious of his duties, that ship touches the yonder shore without any adverse happenings. "}}},{"verse_id":209443,"page_no":null,"line_no":423,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਗਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਿਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਖ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੧੮॥","translit_en":"taise gur unaman magan braham joit jeevan mukat karai sikh samajhai kai ||418||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the True Guru who has merged with the Light divine of the Lord, like warp and weft of a cloth, alone can make a disciple living emancipated with His teachings.  (418)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41449,"next":41451}}
files.shabads/82/41451.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41451,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209444","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209444,"last_verse_id":209447,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209444,"page_no":null,"line_no":424,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਉ ਘਾਇਲ ਕੋ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਇ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghaau ghail ko jatan kai neeko hot par miT jai leek miTat na pekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the wound gets cured with medicine and the pain also vanishes, but the scar of the wound is never seen to vanish. "}}},{"verse_id":209445,"page_no":null,"line_no":424,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਫਾਟੋ ਅੰਬਰੋ ਸੀਆਇ ਪੁਨਿ ਓਢੀਅਤ ਨਾਗੋ ਤਉ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਤਊ ਥੇਗਰੀ ਪਰੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise faaTo a(n)baro seeaai pun oddeeat naago tau na hoi tuoo thegaree parekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a torn cloth stitched and worn does not bare the body but the seam of the stitch is visible and conspicuous. "}}},{"verse_id":209446,"page_no":null,"line_no":424,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਟੂਟੈ ਬਾਸਨੁ ਸਵਾਰ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਠਠੇਰੋ ਗਿਰਤ ਨ ਪਾਨੀ ਪੈ ਗਠੀਲੋ ਭੇਖ ਭੇਖੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise TooTai baasan savaar dhet hai ThaThero girat na paanee pai gaTheelo bhekh bhekheeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a broken utensil is repaired by coppersmith and even the water does not leak from it, but it is repaired form stays. "}}},{"verse_id":209447,"page_no":null,"line_no":424,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਿ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਸਰਨ ਗਹੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਪੈ ਕਲੰਕ ਲੇਖ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੪੧੯॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan bimukh dhukh dhekh pun saran gahai puneet pai kala(n)k lekh lekheeaai ||419||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a disciple who has turned away from the holy feet of the True Guru comes back to the Guru's refuge when he feels the pain of his actions. Although he is freed of his sins and becomes pious, yet the .blemish of his apostasy remains.  (419)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41450,"next":41452}}
files.shabads/82/41452.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41452,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209448","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209448,"last_verse_id":209451,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209448,"page_no":null,"line_no":425,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਨ ਦਰਸ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhekh dhekh dhiragan dharas mahimaa na jaanee sun sun sabadh mahaatam na jaanio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing many colourful festivities with eyes, an ignorant person could not appreciate the glory of the glimpse of the True Guru. He did not even learn the importance of Naam Simran, having heard praises and slanders all the times. "}}},{"verse_id":209449,"page_no":null,"line_no":425,"gurmukhi":"ਗਾਇ ਗਾਇ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਨ ਗੁਨਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੌ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gai gai ga(n)mitaa gun gan gun nidhaan has has prem kau prataap na pachhaanio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Singing praises of worldly things and people day and night, he did not reach the ocean of virtues-the True Guru. He wasted his time in idle talks and laughs but did not recognise the wondrous love of the True Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209450,"page_no":null,"line_no":425,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਇ ਰੋਇ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਓਗ ਕੋ ਨ ਸੋਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਨ ਗਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮੁਘਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"roi roi birahaa biog ko na sog jaanio man geh geh man mughadh na maanio hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wailing and crying for maya, he spent his life-time but never felt the pangs of separation of the True Guru. The mind remained engrossed in the worldly affairs but it was foolish enough not to take the refuge of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209451,"page_no":null,"line_no":425,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਸਕਿਓ ਜਨਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਬਿਹਾਨਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੦॥","translit_en":"log bedh giaan unamaan kai na jaan sakio janam jeevan dhirag bimukh bihaanio hai ||420||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in the shallow prattles and ritualistic knowledge of Vedas and Shastras, the foolish being could not know the supreme knowledge of the True Guru. The birth and lifetime of such a person is worthy of condemnation that he has spent as a renegade from the True Guru.  (420)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41451,"next":41453}}
files.shabads/82/41453.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41453,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209452","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209452,"last_verse_id":209455,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209452,"page_no":null,"line_no":426,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਨਿ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਕੋ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਵਾਰਉ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਸੂਰ ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTan koTaan man ko chamatakaar vaarau saseear soor koT koTan pragaas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shine of millions and millions of gems and pearls, light of countless Suns and Moons, are paltry and worthy of sacrifice over the obedient Sikh whose forehead is able to kiss the dust of the feet of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209453,"page_no":null,"line_no":426,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਛਬਿ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੁਜਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"koTin koTaan bhaag pooran prataap chhab jagamag jot hai sujas nivaas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The glory of millions of fortunate people and the glow of supreme honour is trivial before the beautiful sheen of the forehead that has acquired the dust of the feet of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209454,"page_no":null,"line_no":426,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੈ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਹੈ ਤਾਸ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"siv sanakaadh brahamaadhik manorath kai teerath koTaan koT baa(n)chhat hai taas jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shiv Ji, the four sons of Brahma (Sanak etc.), Brahma himself, that is the three prime gods of Hindu pantheon crave for the glorious dust of the True Guru's feet. Countless places of pilgrimage also long for this dust. "}}},{"verse_id":209455,"page_no":null,"line_no":426,"gurmukhi":"ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਾਸ ਜੀ ॥੪੨੧॥","translit_en":"masatak dharasan sobhaa ko mahaatam agaadh bodh sree guroo charan raj maatr laagai jaas jee ||421||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The forehead that acquires a small amount of dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru, the glory of his glimpse is beyond description.  (421)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41452,"next":41454}}
files.shabads/82/41454.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41454,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209456","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209456,"last_verse_id":209459,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209456,"page_no":null,"line_no":427,"gurmukhi":"ਸਵੈਯਾ: ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਚਰਾਚਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"savaiyaa: khag mirag meen pata(n)g charaachar jon anek bikhai bhram aaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Swaiye: A living being has wandered in many species of birds, animals, fish, insects, root and conscious beings. "}}},{"verse_id":209457,"page_no":null,"line_no":427,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਭੂ-ਤਲ ਦੇਵਪੁਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਲਉ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"sun sun pai rasaatal bhoo-tal dhevapuree prat lau bahu dhaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He wandered in the nether regions, earth and heaven in order to practice whatever sermons he had heard. "}}},{"verse_id":209458,"page_no":null,"line_no":427,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਹੂ ਭੋਗ ਦੁਖਾਦਿ ਸੁਖਾਦਿਕ ਧਰਮ ਅਧਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਓ ॥","translit_en":"jog hoo bhog dhukhaadh sukhaadhik dharam adharam sukaram kamaio ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He kept performing good and bad deeds bearing the comforts and sufferings of various practices of Yoga. "}}},{"verse_id":209459,"page_no":null,"line_no":427,"gurmukhi":"ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਆਇ॥ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪੨੨॥","translit_en":"haar pario saranaagat aai|| guroo mukh dhekh garoo sukh paio ||422||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He got tired going through these countless rigours of many births and then comes to the refuge of the True Guru. By adopting and accepting the teachings of the True Guru and beholding His glimpse, he is able to achieve the great spiritual comfort and peace.  (422)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41453,"next":41455}}
files.shabads/82/41455.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41455,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209460","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209460,"last_verse_id":209463,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209460,"page_no":null,"line_no":428,"gurmukhi":"ਕਬਿਤ: ਚਾਹਿ ਚਾਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਮੁਖ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਚਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਨ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"kabit: chaeh chaeh cha(n)dhr mukh chai kai chakor chakh a(n)mirat kiran achavat na aghaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Kabitt: Just as Allectoris graeca (chakor) longs for the moon because of the eyes that keep seeing it and is never satiated drinking the nectar-like rays, so does a devoted Sikh of the Guru is never satiated with the glimpse of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209461,"page_no":null,"line_no":428,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਉਦੋਤ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sun sun anahadh sabadh sravan mirag ana(n)dh udhot kar saa(n)t na samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer engrossed by hearing the melodious tune of the musical instrument called Ghanda Herha, but is never satiated hearing it. So is a devoted Sikh never satiated hearing the melody of the unstruck music of Naam Amrit. "}}},{"verse_id":209462,"page_no":null,"line_no":428,"gurmukhi":"ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਜੰਪਤ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਿਸ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਜੁਗਤ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"rasik rasaal jas ja(n)pat baasur nis chaatirak jugat jihabaa na tirapataane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the rain-bird is never tired of crying for the nectar like Swati drop day  and night, similarly the tongue of a devoted and obedient disciple of Guru is never tired of repeatedly uttering the ambrosial Naam of the Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209463,"page_no":null,"line_no":428,"gurmukhi":"ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਾਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਬਸ ਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਹਿਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੩॥","translit_en":"dhekhat sunat ar gaavat paavat sukh prem ras bas man magan hiraane hai ||423||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The indescribable celestial happiness one gets by vision of the True Guru, hearing the melodious unstruck sound and singing the praises of the Lord, he remains in a state of ecstasy under the influence of their wondrous and loving relishment. (423)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41454,"next":41456}}
files.shabads/82/41456.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41456,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209464","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209464,"last_verse_id":209467,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209464,"page_no":null,"line_no":429,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਨ ਘਟੈ ਰੁਚਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਘਟੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"salil nivaas jaise meen kee na ghaTai ruch dheepak prakaas ghaTai preet na pata(n)g kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as penchant for water for a fish never decreases and a moth's love for the flame of an oil lamp never wanes. "}}},{"verse_id":209465,"page_no":null,"line_no":429,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਜੈਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਧੁਪ ਕੌ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸ ਆਸ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"kusam subaas jaiso tirapat na madhup kau uddat akaas aas ghaTai na biha(n)g kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a black bee is never satiated enjoying the fragrance of the flowers, a bird's desire to fly in sky never decreases. "}}},{"verse_id":209466,"page_no":null,"line_no":429,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਾ ਘਨਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਲਾਸ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਰਤਿ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"ghaTaa ghanaghor mor chaatirak ridhai ulaas naadh baadh sun rat ghaTai na kura(n)g kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as hearing the thunder of the collected clouds gladens the heart of a peacock and the rain-bird, and love of a deer for hearing the sweet music of Chanda Herha does not diminish. "}}},{"verse_id":209467,"page_no":null,"line_no":429,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲ ਸੰਤ ਘਟਤ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਕੀ ॥੪੨੪॥","translit_en":"taise pria prem ras rasik rasaal sa(n)t ghaTat na tirasanaa prabal a(n)g a(n)g kee ||424||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the love of a Guru-conscious saint, the seeker of ambrosial nectar for his dear True Guru. The longing of love for his Guru that has permeated in every limb of his body and is flowing rapidly never decreases.  (424)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41455,"next":41457}}
files.shabads/82/41457.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41457,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209468","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209468,"last_verse_id":209471,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209468,"page_no":null,"line_no":430,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਦੇਖੋ ਬੋਰਤ ਨ ਕਾਸਟਹਿ ਲਾਹ ਗਹੈ ਕਹੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"salil subhaav dhekho borat na kaasaTeh laeh gahai kahai apano hee pratipaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Look at water, the nature of it never drowns wood in it. It regards the wood as his own having brought it up by irrigating it and thus keeps the shame of this relationship. "}}},{"verse_id":209469,"page_no":null,"line_no":430,"gurmukhi":"ਜੁਗਵਤ ਕਾਸਟ ਰਿਦੰਤਰਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੈ ਕਾਸਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jugavat kaasaT ridha(n)tar baisa(n)tareh baisa(n)tar a(n)tar lai kaasaT prajaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wood keeps fire in it latently but taking the wood in itself the fire burns it (wood) to ashes. "}}},{"verse_id":209470,"page_no":null,"line_no":430,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਰਹਿ ਜਲ ਬੋਰਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਢੈ ਮੋਲ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਦਗਧ ਕੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਅਉਟਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"agareh jal bor kaaddai baaddai mol taa ko paavak pradhagadh kai adhik aauTaario hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wood of Gularia Agalocha (Agar) resurfaces in water after sinking for sometime. This sinking increases the value of the wood. For burning it well in fire, it is boiled in water. "}}},{"verse_id":209471,"page_no":null,"line_no":430,"gurmukhi":"ਤਊ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰੁਿਧਰੁ ਚੁਇ ਚੋਆ ਹੋਇ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲ ਅਉਗਨਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੫॥","translit_en":"tuoo taa ko ruidhar chui choaa hoi salil mil aauganeh gun maanai biradh beechaario hai ||425||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then its essence mixes well in water to smell sweet. To extract the essence of wood, the water has to bear the hot fire. But its calm and tolerant nature changes its demerits into merits and thus fulfils its duties abiding by its creed. (425)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41456,"next":41458}}
files.shabads/82/41458.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41458,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209472","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209472,"last_verse_id":209475,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209472,"page_no":null,"line_no":431,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਸੀਚੀਅਤ ਉਪਬਨ ਬਿਰਵਾ ਲਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"salil subhaav jaise nivan gavan gun seecheeat upaban biravaa lagai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the nature of water is to flow downward, and that enables it to irrigate the plants and saplings planted in the garden, "}}},{"verse_id":209473,"page_no":null,"line_no":431,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਰਖਹਿ ਕਰਤ ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਸਾਖਾ ਨਏ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਝੁਕ ਰਹੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jal mil birakheh karat uradh tap saakhaa ne safal hui jhuk rahai aai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On meeting with water, even the tree goes through the rigours of penance by standing erect and with new branches sprouting and fruit appearing, it bows downward, (its union with water makes it humble). "}}},{"verse_id":209474,"page_no":null,"line_no":431,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਹਨ ਹਨਤ ਫਲਦਾਈ ਕਾਟੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਉਕਾ ਲੋਸਟ ਕੈ ਛੇਦੈ ਭੇਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"paahan hanat faladhaiee kaaTe hoi naukaa losaT kai chhedhai bhedhe ba(n)dhan ba(n)dhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having acquired humility from associating with water, it yields fruit even to those who throw stones at it. A boat is made of wood to take people across. The wood is cut, nailed and clipped together. Thus with so many bonds it is able to stay afloat."}}},{"verse_id":209475,"page_no":null,"line_no":431,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸੁਤ ਸਤੁ੍ਰ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਦੋਖੀ ਤਾਰੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੨੬॥","translit_en":"prabal pravaeh sut satur geh paar parai satigur sikh dhokhee taarai samajhai kai ||426||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The rapid flow of water brings the wood and its enemy (iron) alike. Similarly, the humble and philanthropic True Guru does not deliberate on the vices of the slanderers and teaches them the righteousness to takes them across the worldly ocean. (426)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41457,"next":41459}}
files.shabads/82/41459.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41459,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209476","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209476,"last_verse_id":209479,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209476,"page_no":null,"line_no":432,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਭੈ ਭਵਨ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਚਈਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes paraves kar bhai bhavan bhaavanee bhagat bhai chai kai chieele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru-conscious persons imbibe the teachings of the Guru in their hearts. They maintain utmost devotion and love for the Lord in this fearsome world. They remain in a state of bliss by their faith in loving worship and live life enthusiastically. "}}},{"verse_id":209477,"page_no":null,"line_no":432,"gurmukhi":"ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sa(n)gam sa(n)jog bhog sahaj samaadh saadh prem ras a(n)mirat kai rasik raseele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Enjoying the bliss of the union with God-like Guru and absorbed in a state of inactivity spiritually, they acquire the loving elixir of Naam from the True Guru and are ever engrossed in its practice. "}}},{"verse_id":209478,"page_no":null,"line_no":432,"gurmukhi":"ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਲਿਵ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਫਬਿ ਛਬਿ ਕੈ ਛਬੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"braham bibek Tek ek aau anek liv bimal bairaag fab chhab kai chhabeele hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of refuge, knowledge received from God-like True Guru, their consciousness remains absorbed in the Omni permeated Lord. Due to supreme adornment of unblemished feelings of separation, they look glorious and graceful. "}}},{"verse_id":209479,"page_no":null,"line_no":432,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ-ਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮੀਲੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੭॥","translit_en":"paramadhabhut gat at asacharaja-mai bisam bidheh unaman unameele hai ||427||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Their state is unique and astonishing. In this amazing condition, they are beyond the attractions of body relishments and remain in a blooming state of bliss.  (427)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41458,"next":41460}}
files.shabads/82/41460.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41460,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209480","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209480,"last_verse_id":209483,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209480,"page_no":null,"line_no":433,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਕਾਮਾਰਥੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau kar kaamanaa kaamaarathee karam keene pooran manorath bhio na kaahoo kaam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So long as a human being performed deeds to fulfill his desires or with some aim in mind, neither his performed actions achieved anything nor any of his resolutions bore fruit. "}}},{"verse_id":209481,"page_no":null,"line_no":433,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਕਰਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਸਵੰਤ ਹੁਇ ਆਸਰੋ ਗਹਿਓ ਬਹਿਓ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਠੌਰ ਠੌਰ ਪਾਇਓ ਨ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau kar aasaa aasava(n)t hui aasaro gahio bahio firio Thauar Thauar paio na bisraam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So long a human being remained dependent on others for fulfillment of his desires, he wandered from pillar to post without respite from anywhere. "}}},{"verse_id":209482,"page_no":null,"line_no":433,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਲਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਮਤ ਮੂੰਡ ਬੋਝ ਲੀਨੋ ਦੀਨੋ ਡੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਖੇਦ ਠਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jau lau kar mamataa mamat moo(n)dd bojh leeno dheeno dda(n)dd kha(n)dd kha(n)dd khedh Thaam Thaam ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So long a human being carried the load of I, my, me and yours under the influence of attachment with worldly goods and relations, he kept roving in distress from one place to the other. "}}},{"verse_id":209483,"page_no":null,"line_no":433,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਅਉ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ॥੪੨੮॥","translit_en":"gur upadhes nihakaam aau niraas bhe nimrataa sahaj sukh nij padh naam ko ||428||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One can become unattached and free from all worldly allurements only by taking the refuge of the True Guru and practicing His sermon of Naam Simran that helps one achieve spiritual high, comfort of equipoise and humility.  (428)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41459,"next":41461}}
files.shabads/82/41461.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41461,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209484","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209484,"last_verse_id":209487,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209484,"page_no":null,"line_no":434,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਜ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਲਪਟਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"satigur charan kamal makara(n)dh raj lubhat haivai man madhukar lapaTaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind of a devoted Sikh is ever entangled in the sweet smelling dust of the lotus feet of the Lord like a bumble bee. (He is ever engrossed in practicing meditation on Lord's name). "}}},{"verse_id":209485,"page_no":null,"line_no":434,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਅਤਿ ਉਨਮਤਿ ਆਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)mirat nidhaan paan ahinis rasik haivai at unamat aan gayaan bisaraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is ever longing to relish the Naam-elixir day and night. In its bliss and ecstasy, he ignores all other worldly awarenesses, allurements and knowledge. "}}},{"verse_id":209486,"page_no":null,"line_no":434,"gurmukhi":"ਸਹਜ ਸਨੇਹ ਗਹ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਰੂਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਗਤਿ ਸੀਪ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sahaj saneh geh bisam bidheh roop savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh gat seep sa(n)paT samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a devoted Sikh's mind then lovingly resides in the holy feet of the Lord. He is free of all body desires. Like the Swati drop of rain falling on an oyster, he also is enclosed in the box of Lord's holy feet. "}}},{"verse_id":209487,"page_no":null,"line_no":434,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਟਾਛ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਹੈ੍ਵ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੨੯॥","translit_en":"charan saran sukh saagar kaTaachh kar mukataa mahaa(n)t haivai anoop roop Thaane hai ||429||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in the refuge of ocean of peace-The True Guru, and by His grace, he too becomes an invaluable and an unique pearl like the pearl of the oyster.  (429)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41460,"next":41462}}
files.shabads/82/41462.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41462,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209488","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209488,"last_verse_id":209491,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209488,"page_no":null,"line_no":435,"gurmukhi":"ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਨੰਤਰ ਲਉ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"rom rom koT mukh mukh rasanaa ana(n)t anik mana(n)tar lau kahat na aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If every hair of the body is blessed with millions of mouths and each mouth has numerous tongues, even then the glorious state of the person who relishes Lord's name with them cannot be described over the eons. "}}},{"verse_id":209489,"page_no":null,"line_no":435,"gurmukhi":"ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਭਾਰ ਡਾਰ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਜਉ ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਤੋਲ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"koT brahama(n)dd bhaar ddaar tulaadhaar bikhai toleeaai jau baar baar tol na samaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If we weigh the load of millions of universes with the spiritual bliss time and again, the great comfort and peace cannot be measured. "}}},{"verse_id":209490,"page_no":null,"line_no":435,"gurmukhi":"ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਉ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੋਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"chatur padhaarath aau saagar samooh sukh bibidh baiku(n)Th mol mahimaa na paaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the worldly treasures, seas full of pearls and numerous pleasures of heaven are virtually nothing compared to the glory and grandeur of reciting His name. "}}},{"verse_id":209491,"page_no":null,"line_no":435,"gurmukhi":"ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਗਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਭਉਨ ਮਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ॥੪੩੦॥","translit_en":"samajh na parai karai gaun kaun bhaun man pooran braham gur sabadh na sunaaviee ||430||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fortunate devout who is blessed with the consecration of Naam by the True Guru, how high a spiritual state can his mind get absorbed in? No one is capable of expressing and describing this condition.  (430)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41461,"next":41463}}
files.shabads/82/41463.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41463,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209492","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209492,"last_verse_id":209495,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209492,"page_no":null,"line_no":436,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਚਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਦੀਪ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖਨ ਗਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਨ ਊਤਰ ਨ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lochan pata(n)g dheep dharas dhekhan ge jotee jot mil pun uootar na aane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The eyes of a moth who go for a glimpse of the flame of the lamp are never able to come back having engrossed themselves in its light. (So are the devoted disciples of the True Guru who are never able to return after a vision of Him). "}}},{"verse_id":209493,"page_no":null,"line_no":436,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਨ ਗਏ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਥਕਤ ਭਏ ਨ ਬਹੁਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naadh baadh sunabe kau sravan haran ge sun dhun thakat bhe na bahuraane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ears of a deer gone to hear the melody of Ghanda Herha (a music instrument) gets so engrossed that he is never able to return. (So are the ears of a Sikh gone to hear ambrosial utterances of his True Guru never want to leave Him) "}}},{"verse_id":209494,"page_no":null,"line_no":436,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ-ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"charan kamal makara(n)dh ras rasik hui mana-madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Embellished with the sweet smelling dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru, the mind of an obedient disciple gets engrossed like the black bee entranced by the sweet smell of the flower. "}}},{"verse_id":209495,"page_no":null,"line_no":436,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੧॥","translit_en":"roop gun prem ras pooran param padh aan giaan dhiaan ras bharam bhulaane hai ||431||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By virtue of the loving merits of the Naam blessed by the radiant True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru attains supreme spiritual state and rejects all other worldly contemplations and awarenesses that put one in wandering of doubts.  (431)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41462,"next":41464}}
files.shabads/82/41464.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41464,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209496","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209496,"last_verse_id":209499,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209496,"page_no":null,"line_no":437,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਹਾਨਿ ਕੈ ਪਤੰਗ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pratham hee aan dhiaan haan kai pata(n)g bidh paachhai kai anoop roop dheepak dhikhaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a moth, an obedient human being of the Guru regards all other concentrations of mind as loss incurring proposition and then, like seeing the light of the lamp (by the moth), he sees the beautiful sight of the True Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209497,"page_no":null,"line_no":437,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਜਿ ਕੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pratham hee aan giaan surat bisaraj kai anahadh naadh mirag jugat sunaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a deer discards all other sounds in favour of the melody of Chanda Herha, a disciple of the Guru listens to the sound of unstruck music after obtaining and practicing on Guru's teachings and words. "}}},{"verse_id":209498,"page_no":null,"line_no":437,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਹੀ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁੰਗ ਸਾਜਿ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pratham hee bachan rachan har gu(n)g saaj paachhai kai a(n)mirat ras apio peeaae hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a black bee, giving up its noisy stance and engulfing itself in the fragrance of the lotus-like feet of the Guru, he drinks deep the wondrous elixir of the Naam. "}}},{"verse_id":209499,"page_no":null,"line_no":437,"gurmukhi":"ਪੇਖ ਸੁਨ ਅਚਵਤ ਹੀ ਭਏ ਬਿਸਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੨॥","translit_en":"pekh sun achavat hee bhe bisam at paramadhabhut asacharaj samaae hai ||432||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"And thus a devoted Sikh of the Guru, seeing the vision of his Guru, hearing the sweet sound of Guru's words and relishing the Naam Amrit (elixir-like name of the Lord) reaches a high state of bliss and merges in the astonishing and supremely strange God.  (432)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41463,"next":41465}}
files.shabads/82/41465.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41465,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209500","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209500,"last_verse_id":209503,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209500,"page_no":null,"line_no":438,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਹਿਜਾਸਨ ਜਉ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਜਾਮਨੀ ਸਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੁਜਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaat sihijaasan jau kaamanee jaamanee samai gur jan sujan kee baat na suhaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a wife proceeds to enjoy the union of her husband in his bed at night, no talk of any noble, elderly or holy person appeals to her. "}}},{"verse_id":209501,"page_no":null,"line_no":438,"gurmukhi":"ਹਿਮਕਰ ਉਦਿਤ ਮੁਦਤਿ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਟਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ਸਮਾਰਤ ਨ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"himakar udhit mudhat hai chakor chit ik Tak dhiaan kai samaarat na gaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the moon rises, the ruddy sheldrake is immensely pleased and gazing at it with concentration of mind, is unaware of his own body even. "}}},{"verse_id":209502,"page_no":null,"line_no":438,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਕਮਲ ਦਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise madhukar makara(n)dh ras lubhit hai bisam kamal dhal sa(n)paT samaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a bumble bee is so engrossed in the sweet smelling nectar of the flower, that it gets trapped in the box-like lotus flower when the Sun sets. "}}},{"verse_id":209503,"page_no":null,"line_no":438,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਦਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਮੁਸਕਾਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੩॥","translit_en":"taise gur charan saran chal jaat sikh dharas paras prem ras musakaat hai ||433||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly a devoted slave disciple goes to the refuge of the holy feet of the True Guru; enjoying His sight and entranced in His love, he keeps smiling within while relishing the divine spectacle.  (433)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41464,"next":41466}}
files.shabads/82/41466.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41466,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209504","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209504,"last_verse_id":209507,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209504,"page_no":null,"line_no":439,"gurmukhi":"ਆਵਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭੀਖ ਮਾਗਨਿ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਅਧੀਨਹਿ ਨਿਰਾਸੋ ਨ ਬਿਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aavat hai jaa kai bheekh maagan bhikhaaree dheen dhekhat adheeneh niraaso na biddaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whosoever is visited by a beggar for alms, impressed by his humility, the donor never turns him away disappointed. "}}},{"verse_id":209505,"page_no":null,"line_no":439,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਠਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਆਰ ਆਸਾ ਕੈ ਬਿਡਾਰ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਅੰਤ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਕੈ ਤੋਰਿ ਟੂਕਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baiThat hai jaa kai dhuaar aasaa kai biddaar savaiaan a(n)t karunaa kai tor Took taeh ddaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whosoever has a dog coming to his door after discarding all other alternatives, the master of the house out of clemency serves him with a morsel of food. "}}},{"verse_id":209506,"page_no":null,"line_no":439,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਇਨ ਕੀ ਪਨਹੀ ਰਹਤ ਪਰਹਰੀ ਪਰੀ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਾਜਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਤ ਸਮਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pain kee panahee rahat paraharee paree taahoo kaahoo kaaj uTh chalat samaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A shoe keeps lying unattended and uncared, but when its owner has to go out on some work, he too takes care of it then and uses it. "}}},{"verse_id":209507,"page_no":null,"line_no":439,"gurmukhi":"ਛਾਡਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਛਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਕੈ ਦਇਆ ਕੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਪਗਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੪॥","translit_en":"chhaadd aha(n)kaar chhaar hoi gur maarag mai kabahoo kai dhiaa kai dhiaal pag dhaar hai ||434||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, he who ever discards his ego and pride and lives in the refuge of the True Guru in utter humility like the dust of His feet, the clement True Guru will definitely shower His benevolence one day and attach him with His feet (He blesses him with His sermon).  (434)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41465,"next":41467}}
files.shabads/82/41467.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41467,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209508","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209508,"last_verse_id":209511,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209508,"page_no":null,"line_no":440,"gurmukhi":"ਦ੍ਰੋਪਤੀ ਕੁਪੀਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਦਈ ਜਉ ਮੁਨੀਸਰਹਿ ਤਂਾ ਤੇ ਸਭਾ ਮਧਿ ਬਹਿਓ ਬਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhropatee kupeen maatr dhiee jau muneesareh ta(n)aa te sabhaa madh bahio basan pravaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Daropadi gave away a piece of cloth from her head-covering scarf to a sage Durbasha whose loin cloth had been washed away in the river. As a result, when efforts were made to strip her off in the court of Duryodhan, the cloth length coming off her body would just not end. "}}},{"verse_id":209509,"page_no":null,"line_no":440,"gurmukhi":"ਤਨਕ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਜਗਦੀਸਹਿ ਦਏ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਥਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"tanak ta(n)dhul jagadheeseh dhe sudhaamaa taa te paae chatur padhaarath athaeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sudama offered a handful of rice to Krishna Ji, with utmost love and in return, he attained the four aims of life as well as many other treasure-houses of His blessings. "}}},{"verse_id":209510,"page_no":null,"line_no":440,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਖਤ ਗਜਿੰਦ ਅਰਬਿੰਦ ਗਹਿ ਭੇਟ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਜੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਪਾਨ ਅਨਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਾਹ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"dhukhat gaji(n)dh arabi(n)dh geh bheT raakhai taa kai kaajai chakrapaan an grase graeh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A distressed elephant caught by an octopus, plucked a lotus flower in desperation and offered it to the Lord in humble supplication. He (elephant) was freed from the clutches of the octopus. "}}},{"verse_id":209511,"page_no":null,"line_no":440,"gurmukhi":"ਕਹਾ ਕਊ ਕਰੈ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਜਾਂ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਨ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਤਾਹ ਜੀ ॥੪੩੫॥","translit_en":"kahaa kuoo karai kachh hot na kaahoo ke ke'ee jaa(n) kee prabh maan laih sabhe sukh taeh jee ||435||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What can one do with his own efforts ? Nothing tangible can be achieved by one's own efforts. All this is His blessing. One whose hard work and devotion is accepted by the Lord, gets all peace and comforts from Him.  (435)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41466,"next":41468}}
files.shabads/82/41468.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41468,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209512","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209512,"last_verse_id":209515,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209512,"page_no":null,"line_no":441,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਗਾਈਅਤ ਜਸੁ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"saravan sevaa keenee maat pitaa kee bisekh taa(n) te gaieeat jas jagat mai taahoo ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sarwan, the devoted son served his blind parents with love and dedication that has earned him fame and praise in the world. "}}},{"verse_id":209513,"page_no":null,"line_no":441,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤ ਲਉ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਾਤ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਨੁ ਵਾਹੂ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"jan prahilaadh aadh a(n)t lau avagiaa keenee taat ghaat kar prabh raakhio pran vaahoo ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What a strange play it is of the Lord that instead of serving his father, Bhagat Prahlad disobeyed his father's order that demanded of him not to meditate on the name of God (Ram). The Lord destroyed Harnakash (Prahlad's father) and protected Prahlad thus upholding His creed.
