"}}},{"verse_id":209514,"page_no":null,"line_no":441,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਆਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਨੀ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਕਰੀ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਤਤਖਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਾਹੂ ਕੋ ॥","translit_en":"dhuaadhas barakh suk jananee dhukhit karee sidh bhe tatakhan janam hai jaahoo ko ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is said that sage Sukdev kept on causing pain to his mother by remaining in her womb for 12 years, but when born he was found to be an established and perfect sage, and all those born at that time turned out to be hermit with divine powers. "}}},{"verse_id":209515,"page_no":null,"line_no":441,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬਿਸਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੁ ਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ॥੪੩੬॥","translit_en":"akath kathaa bisam jaaneeaai na jai kachh pahuchai na giaan unamaan aan kaahoo ko ||436||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His mysterious play is beyond explanation and is astonishing. No one can know on whom will He be kind when and where and who will receive His blessings.  (436)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41467,"next":41469}}
files.shabads/82/41469.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41469,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209516","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209516,"last_verse_id":209519,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209516,"page_no":null,"line_no":442,"gurmukhi":"ਖਾਂਡ ਖਾਂਡ ਕਹੈ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮੀਠੋ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਸੀਤ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khaa(n)dd khaa(n)dd kahai jihabaa na savaiaadh meeTho aavai agan agan kahai seet na binaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No action but repeated utterances are futile. Repeatedly saying sugar, the tongue is unable to experience sweet taste, nor shivering with cold can stop by saying fire! fire! "}}},{"verse_id":209517,"page_no":null,"line_no":442,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਦ ਬੈਦ ਕਹੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੰੂ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਦ੍ਰਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baidh baidh kahai rog miTat na kaaha(n)oo ko dhrab dhrab kahai kouoo dhrabeh na bilaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"No ailment can be cured by repeated utterance of doctor! doctor! nor can anyone enjoy the luxuries that money buys just by saying money! money! "}}},{"verse_id":209518,"page_no":null,"line_no":442,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਹਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਚੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਕਹੈ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan cha(n)dhan kahat pragaTai na subaas baas cha(n)dh cha(n)dh kahai ujiaaro na pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as saying sandalwood! sandalwood, the fragrance of sandalwood cannot spread, nor can the radiance of the moon-light be experienced by repeatedly saying moon! moon! unless the moon rises. "}}},{"verse_id":209519,"page_no":null,"line_no":442,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗਯਾਨ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦਤਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੭॥","translit_en":"taise gayaan gosaT karat na rahat paavai karanee pradhaan bhaan udhat akaas hai ||437||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, just listening to holy sermons and discourses, one cannot acquire the divine life-style and code of conduct. The fundamental need is to practice them in actual life. Then the light radiance of the effulgent Lord is experienced. (437)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41468,"next":41470}}
files.shabads/82/41470.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41470,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209520","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209520,"last_verse_id":209523,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209520,"page_no":null,"line_no":443,"gurmukhi":"ਹਸਤ ਹਸਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਹਸਿ ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਹਸਾਇ ਰੋਵਤ ਰੋਵਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਰੋਇ ਅਉ ਰੁਵਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"hasat hasat poochhai has has kai hasai rovat rovat poochhai roi aau ruvai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A laughing person merrily asks a happy and laughing person various things that can make them laugh. Similarly a crying person asks another crying person matters that causes crying. "}}},{"verse_id":209521,"page_no":null,"line_no":443,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਠੇ ਬੈਠੇ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੈਠਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟ ਜਾਇ ਚਾਲਤ ਚਲਤ ਪੂਛੈ ਦਹਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"baiThe baiThe poochhai baiTh baiTh kai nikaT jai chaalat chalat poochhai dhahadhis dhai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A settled person will share with another settled person means of settling down. A person treading a path will ask another on the right path, things that would lead one to the right path. "}}},{"verse_id":209522,"page_no":null,"line_no":443,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਗ ਪੂਛੇ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਛੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਾਇ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"log poochhe logaachaar bedh poochhai bedh bidh jogee bhogee jog bhog jugat jugai kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A worldly person asks the other worldly persons various aspects of worldly affairs. One who studies Vedas would ask about Vedas from another who has the knowledge of Vedas. "}}},{"verse_id":209523,"page_no":null,"line_no":443,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਸਾਕਿਓ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੪੩੮॥","translit_en":"janam maran bhram kaahoo na miTai saakio nihachal bhe gur charan samai kai ||438||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the above do satiate the addiction of a person, but such prattles cannot end the birth-death cycle. Those who unite their attention in the holy feet of the Lord, only those obedient disciples of the Guru are able to end their cycle. (438)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41469,"next":41471}}
files.shabads/82/41471.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41471,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209524","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209524,"last_verse_id":209527,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209524,"page_no":null,"line_no":444,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਛਤ ਪਥਕਿ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨ ਧਾਰੈ ਪਗੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੈ ਦੇਸ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਾਤਨ ਸੇ ਜਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"poochhat pathak teh maarag na dhaarai pag preetam kai dhes kaise baatan se jaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One asks a wayfarer of the beloved Lord's abode, the path to Him but does not tread even a step on it. Without launching oneself on that path, how can one reach the abode of the beloved Lord by mere prattles? "}}},{"verse_id":209525,"page_no":null,"line_no":444,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਛਤ ਹੈ ਬੈਦ ਖਾਤ ਔਖਧਿ ਨ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"poochhat hai baidh khaat aauakhadh na sa(n)jam sai kaise miTai rog sukh sahaj samaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One asks the physician the True Guru, the medicine of curing the malady of ego, but does not consume the medicine with dedicated discipline and precautions. Then how can the ailment of ego be cured and spiritual peace acquired. "}}},{"verse_id":209526,"page_no":null,"line_no":444,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਛਤ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਭਚਾਰ ਕਤ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥","translit_en":"poochhat suhaagan hai karam dhuhaagan kai ridhai bibhachaar kat sihajaa bulaieeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One asks from the dear and beloveds of the Lord husband the way of meeting Him, but all her actions and deeds are like of wretched and discarded women. Then how can such a seeker wife with deceitful heart ever be called to the nuptial bed of the husband Lord for union? "}}},{"verse_id":209527,"page_no":null,"line_no":444,"gurmukhi":"ਗਾਇ ਸੁਨੈ ਆਂਖੇ ਮੀਚੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗਹਿ ਜੌ ਲੌ ਨ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥੪੩੯॥","translit_en":"gai sunai aa(n)khe meechai paieeaai na param padh gur upadhes geh jau lau na kamaieeaai ||439||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, without singing, listening, and closing eyes for the beloved Lord, one cannot reach to the higher spiritual state. Reaffirming of Guru's sermons in the heart and practicing them perpetually is the only way of meeting with Him. (439)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41470,"next":41472}}
files.shabads/82/41472.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41472,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209528","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209528,"last_verse_id":209531,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209528,"page_no":null,"line_no":445,"gurmukhi":"ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਠਿਕਾਨੇ ਆਲਸ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਕੀਏ ਖੋਜ ਮਿਟ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"khojee khoj dhekh chalio jai pahuche Thikaane aalas bila(n)b ke'ee khoj miT jaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tracker proceeds along the footprints and reaches the desired place, but had he been lazy or complacent, these footprints trail would have been obliterated. "}}},{"verse_id":209529,"page_no":null,"line_no":445,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਮੈ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sihajaa samai ramai bharataar bar naar soiee karai jau agiaan maan pragaTat praat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a woman who moving to the bed of her husband at night is fortunate to enjoy the union with her husband is the prime wife of that man. But one who shows arrogance due to ignorance loses the opportunity of this union because of her laziness and complacency. "}}},{"verse_id":209530,"page_no":null,"line_no":445,"gurmukhi":"ਬਰਖਤ ਮੇਘ ਜਲ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪੀਏ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਤੀਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"barakhat megh jal chaatirak tirapat pe'ee mon gahe barakhaa bateete bilalaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a rain-bird may be able to quench his thirst when it is raining, but if he does not open his mouth and the rain stops, then he wails and cry. "}}},{"verse_id":209531,"page_no":null,"line_no":445,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਖ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੀਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੦॥","translit_en":"sikh soiee sun gur sabadh rahat rahai kapaT saneh ke'ee paachhe pachhutaat hai ||440||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, he alone is an obedient Sikh of the True Guru, who listens to His sermon and adopts it in his life immediately. Otherwise, one would lose the opportune moment and repent thereafter. (440)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41471,"next":41473}}
files.shabads/82/41473.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41473,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209532","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209532,"last_verse_id":209535,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209532,"page_no":null,"line_no":446,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਬਿਛੁਰ ਪਰੈ ਆਨ ਗਾਇ ਥਨ ਦੁਗਧ ਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਲਾਤ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bachhuraa bichhur parai aan gai than dhugadh na paan karai maarat hai laat kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a calf separated from his mother rushes to suck milk from another cow's teats, and he is denied sucking milk by the cow who kicks him away. "}}},{"verse_id":209533,"page_no":null,"line_no":446,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੰਸ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਜਾਤ ਖਾਤ ਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਫਲ ਭੁਗਤ ਜੁ ਗਾਤ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise maanasar tiaag ha(n)s aan sar jaat khaat na mukataa fal bhugat ju gaat kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a swan leaving Mansarover lake goes to some other lake cannot get his food of pearls to eat from there. "}}},{"verse_id":209534,"page_no":null,"line_no":446,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰ ਤਜਿ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਤ ਜਨ ਹੋਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਭੰਗੁ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬਾਤ ਕੀ ॥","translit_en":"jaise raaj dhuaar taj aan dhuaar jaat jan hot maan bha(n)g mahimaa na kaahoo baat kee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a guard on the door of the king leaves and serves on another's door, it hurts his pride and does not help his glory and grandeur anyway. "}}},{"verse_id":209535,"page_no":null,"line_no":446,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਕੀ ਸਰਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਨ ਪਰਤ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਪਾਤਕੀ ॥੪੪੧॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh aan dhev kee saran jaeh rahio na parat raakh sakat na paatakee ||441||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a devoted disciple of Guru leaves the refuge of his Guru and goes into the protection of other gods and goddesses, he cannot find his stay there worthwhile nor anyone would show any respect and regard towards him being a blemished sinner.  (441)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41472,"next":41474}}
files.shabads/82/41474.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41474,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209536","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209536,"last_verse_id":209539,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209536,"page_no":null,"line_no":447,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਘਨਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਕ ਸਨੇਹ ਗਤਿ ਬਰਖਤ ਮੇਂਹ ਅਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise ghanaghor mor chaatrak saneh gat barakhat me(n)h asaneh kai dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a peacock's and rain-bird's love is confined to the thunder of the clouds and this love is visible only till the rain lasts. (Their love is not lasting.) "}}},{"verse_id":209537,"page_no":null,"line_no":447,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਕਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੁਇ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਹੇਤ ਉਪਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau kamal jal a(n)tar dhisa(n)tar hui madhukar dhinakar het upajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a lotus flower closes at sunset but remains in water and the bumble bee keeps hovering over other flowers. But at sunrise when lotus flower opens up, its love for the lotus flower resurfaces. His love is not of permanent nature. "}}},{"verse_id":209538,"page_no":null,"line_no":447,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਦਰ ਨਿਰਾਦਰ ਹੁਇ ਜੀਅਤ ਪਵਨ ਭਖਿ ਜਲ ਤਜਿ ਮਰਤ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਹਿ ਲਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"dhaadhar niraadhar hui jeeat pavan bhakh jal taj marat na premeh lajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A frog's love with water is very disrespecting. He comes out of water to breathe air. Out of water, it does not die. He thus shames his love for water. "}}},{"verse_id":209539,"page_no":null,"line_no":447,"gurmukhi":"ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੇਤ ਠਹਰਾਵਹੀ ॥੪੪੨॥","translit_en":"kapaT sanehee taise aan dhev sevak hai gursikh meen jal het Thaharaavahee ||442||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a deceitful Sikh with demonstrative love is the follower of other gods and goddesses, whereas the love of a true and obedient Sikh for his True Guru is like fish and water. (He holds no love for anyone else other than the True Guru).  (442)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41473,"next":41475}}
files.shabads/82/41475.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41475,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209540","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209540,"last_verse_id":209543,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209540,"page_no":null,"line_no":448,"gurmukhi":"ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਪੁੰਸਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਬਾਂਝ ਕਹਾਂ ਜਾਨੈ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਸਨੇਹ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"purakh nipu(n)sak na jaanai banitaa bilaas baa(n)jh kahaa(n) jaanai sukh sa(n)tat saneh kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an impotent person does not know what pleasure it is to share a union with a woman, and a barren woman cannot know the love and attachment of children. "}}},{"verse_id":209541,"page_no":null,"line_no":448,"gurmukhi":"ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਬਖਾਨ ਕਹਾ ਗੋਤਚਾਰ ਨਾਹਿ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਕਛੁ ਕੁਸਟੀ ਕੀ ਦੇਹ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"ganikaa sa(n)taan ko bakhaan kahaa gotachaar naeh upachaar kachh kusaTee kee dheh kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the lineage of the children of a prostitute cannot be defined, and a leper cannot be cured anyway. "}}},{"verse_id":209542,"page_no":null,"line_no":448,"gurmukhi":"ਆਂਧਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਨ ਦਸਨ ਛਬਿ ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਬਹਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਅਸਪ੍ਰੇਹ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"aa(n)dharo na jaanai roop ra(n)g na dhasan chhab jaanat na baharo prasa(n)n asapreh kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a blind person cannot know the beauty of the face and teeth of a woman and a deaf person cannot feel anyone's anger or happiness since he cannot hear. "}}},{"verse_id":209543,"page_no":null,"line_no":448,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਜਵਾਸੋ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹਤ ਹੈ ਮੇਹ ਕਉ ॥੪੪੩॥","translit_en":"aan dhev sevak na jaanai gurdhev sev jaise tau javaaso nahee chaahat hai meh kau ||443||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, a devotee and follower of other gods and goddesses, cannot know the celestial bliss of service of true and perfect Guru. Just as camel-thorn (Alhagi maurorum) resents rain.  (443)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41474,"next":41476}}
files.shabads/82/41476.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41476,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209544","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209544,"last_verse_id":209547,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209544,"page_no":null,"line_no":449,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਛੁਰਾ ਪਰਤ ਆਨ ਗਾਇ ਥਨ ਬਹੁਰਿਓ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਾਤ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਸਮਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise bhool bachhuraa parat aan gai than bahurio milat maat baat na samaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a calf goes to another cow for milk by mistake, and on coming back to his mother, she does not recall his mistake and feeds him. "}}},{"verse_id":209545,"page_no":null,"line_no":449,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਾਨਸਰ ਹੰਸ ਦੇਤ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਦੋਖ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise aan sar bhram aavai maanasar ha(n)s dhet mukataa amol dhokh na beechaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a swan reaches Mansarover lake after wandering to various other lakes, Mansarover lake does not remind him his mistake and serves him with pearls. "}}},{"verse_id":209546,"page_no":null,"line_no":449,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਹਾਰ ਆਵੈ ਚਉਗਨੋ ਬਢਾਵੈ ਨ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਉਰਿਧਾਰ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise nirap sevak kau aan dhuaar haar aavai chaugano baddaavai na avagiaa uridhaar hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a royal attendant, after wandering all over comes back to his master who does not recall him his departure and instead raises his status many time more. "}}},{"verse_id":209547,"page_no":null,"line_no":449,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਖਨ ਕੋ ਭੂਲਿਬੋ ਨ ਰਿਦ ਮੈ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੪॥","translit_en":"satigur asaran saran dhiaal dhev sikhan ko bhoolibo na ridh mai nihaar hai ||444||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the radiant and benevolent True Guru is the support of the destitute. He does not keep in mind the mistakes of those Sikhs who have separated themselves from the door of their Guru and are wandering on the door of gods and goddesses.  (444)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41475,"next":41477}}
files.shabads/82/41477.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41477,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209548","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209548,"last_verse_id":209551,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209548,"page_no":null,"line_no":450,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਂਝ ਬਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਪੰੁਸਕ ਨ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਲਲ ਬਿਲੋਏ ਕਤ ਮਾਖਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"baa(n)jh badhoo purakh nipa(n)usak na sa(n)tat hui salal biloe kat maakhan pragaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a barren woman and an impotent man cannot produce children, and churning of water cannot yield butter. "}}},{"verse_id":209549,"page_no":null,"line_no":450,"gurmukhi":"ਫਨ ਗਹਿ ਦੁਗਧ ਪੀਆਏ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੂਰੀ ਖਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਸੈ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"fan geh dhugadh peeaae na miTat bikh mooree khaae mukh sai na pragaTe subaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a poison of a cobra cannot be destroyed by feeding him milk and one cannot get good smell from mouth after eating radish. "}}},{"verse_id":209550,"page_no":null,"line_no":450,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸਰ ਪਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਬਾਇਸੁ ਉਦਾਸ ਬਾਸ ਅਰਗਜਾ ਲੇਪੁ ਖਰ ਭਸਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"maanasar par baiThe bais udhaas baas aragajaa lep khar bhasam nivaas hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a filth-eating crow on reaching lake Mansarover, becomes sad since he cannot get filth which he is so used to eating; and a donkey will roll in dust even if it is given a bath with sweet smelling scents. "}}},{"verse_id":209551,"page_no":null,"line_no":450,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕਠਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਟਤ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੫॥","translit_en":"aan dhev sevak na jaane gurdhev sev kaThan kuTev na miTat dhev dhaas hai ||445||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, the servant of other gods cannot realise the ecstasy of serving the True Guru, because the chronic and bad habits of the followers of god cannot perish.  (445)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41476,"next":41478}}
files.shabads/82/41478.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41478,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209552","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209552,"last_verse_id":209555,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209552,"page_no":null,"line_no":451,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਅਤਿ ਗਰਜਿ ਗਰਜਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਿਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd bilokeeat garaj garaj bin barakhaa bilaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as black clouds are often seen in the sky who make thundering sound but disperse without releasing a drop of rain. "}}},{"verse_id":209553,"page_no":null,"line_no":451,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਹਿਮਾਚਲਿ ਕਠੋਰ ਅਉ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਤਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਖਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau himaachal kaThor aau seetal at sakeeaai na khai khaae tirakhaa na miTaat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a snow clad mountain is very hard and cold; it yields no eatable nor can the thirst be quenched by eating the snow. "}}},{"verse_id":209554,"page_no":null,"line_no":451,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਓਸ ਪਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਸਜਲ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਨ ਠਉਰ ਠਹਿਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise os parat karat hai sajal dhehee raakheeaai chira(n)kaal na Thaur Thahiraat hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as dew wets the body but it cannot be kept at a place for long. It cannot be stored. "}}},{"verse_id":209555,"page_no":null,"line_no":451,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧੀ ਚਪਲ ਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਨਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੬॥","translit_en":"taise aan dhev sev tirabidhee chapal fal satigur a(n)mirat pravaeh nis praat hai ||446||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is the fruit of the service of gods who live life in the three traits of maya. Their reward is also influenced by the three traits of mammon. Only the service of the True Guru maintains the flow of the Naam-Bani elixir for ever.  (446)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41477,"next":41479}}
files.shabads/82/41479.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41479,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209556","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209556,"last_verse_id":209559,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209556,"page_no":null,"line_no":452,"gurmukhi":"ਬੈਸਨੋ ਅਨੰਨਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਨਿ ਸਾਲਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੀਤਾ ਭਾਗਵਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਏਕਾਕੀ ਕਹਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"baisano ana(n)n brahama(n)n saalagraam sevaa geetaa bhaagavat srotaa ekaakee kahaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If someone is a worshipper of Vishnu, is brahmin by caste, worships (stone) and listens to the recitation of Geeta and Bhagwat in a secluded place; "}}},{"verse_id":209557,"page_no":null,"line_no":452,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਦੇਵ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਤ ਗਵਨ ਸੋ ਮਹੂਰਤ ਸੋਧਾਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"teerath dharam dhev jaatraa kau pa(n)ddit poochh karat gavan so mahoorat sodhaavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Have the auspicious time and date worked out by learned brahmins before proceeding on religious places or visiting the temples of gods and goddesses located on banks of rivers; "}}},{"verse_id":209558,"page_no":null,"line_no":452,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਗਰਧਬ ਸੁ੍ਵਾਨ ਸਗਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਕਾ ਉਪਰਾਜਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੀ ॥","translit_en":"baahar nikas garadhab suvaiaan sagan kai sa(n)kaa uparaaj bahur ghar aavahee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But when he sets out of the house and faces a dog or a donkey, he regards it inauspicious and a doubt arises in his mind forcing him to return home. "}}},{"verse_id":209559,"page_no":null,"line_no":452,"gurmukhi":"ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਗਹਿ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਤ ਨ ਏਕਾ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅਛਿਤ ਨ ਪਰੰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੪੪੭॥","translit_en":"patibrat geh reh sakat na ekaa Tek dhubidhaa achhit na para(n)m padh paavahee ||447||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Despite belonging to a Guru like a faithful wife, if a person does not acknowledge the support of his Guru firmly and wanders at the door of one god or the other, he cannot reach the supreme state of Oneness with God having been caught in duality.  (447)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41478,"next":41480}}
files.shabads/82/41480.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41480,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209560","verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":209560,"last_verse_id":209561,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209560,"page_no":null,"line_no":453,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਐਸੋ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aaiso patibrat ek Tek dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The union of a Sikh with his Guru and becoming one with him is like a faithful wife who discards the desire of others and lives in the refuge of one husband. "}}},{"verse_id":209561,"page_no":null,"line_no":453,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਛਤ ਨ ਜੋਤਕ ਅਉ ਬੇਦ ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਕਛੁ॥ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਉ ਨਖਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਉਰਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"poochhat na jotak aau bedh thit vaar kachhu|| gireh aau nakhatr kee na sa(n)kaa uradhaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikh who places his faith in the refuge of one True Guru, does not depend upon astrology or the command of Vedas, nor does he bring any doubt about the auspiciousness of a day/date or constellation of stars/planets to his mind. "}}}],"nav":{"prev":41479,"next":41481}}
files.shabads/82/41481.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41481,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209562","verse_count":2,"first_verse_id":209562,"last_verse_id":209563,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209562,"page_no":null,"line_no":454,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾਨਤ ਨ ਸਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaanat na sagan lagan aan dhev sev sabadh surat liv neh nira(n)kaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in the Guru's holy feet, the Sikh is unaware of the omens or service of gods and goddesses. He remains aborbed in such inaccessible love with the True Guru by lodging the divine word of the True Guru in his consciousness."}}},{"verse_id":209563,"page_no":null,"line_no":454,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਬਾਲਕ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹੁਇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੮॥","translit_en":"sikh sa(n)t baalak sree gur pratipaalak hui jeevan mukat gat braham beechaaree hai ||448||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The father Guru protects and brings up the specially virtuous children. Such Sikhs are freed of all rites and rituals by the Guru during their life-time, and instills the ideology and thoughts of one Lord in their mind.  (448)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41480,"next":41482}}
files.shabads/82/41482.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41482,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209564","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209564,"last_verse_id":209567,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209564,"page_no":null,"line_no":455,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਤਾਰ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"naar kai bhataar kai saneh patibrataa hui gursikh ek Tek patibrat leen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wife is considered faithful who lives life in the love of her husband. So does an obedient Sikh of the Guru take refuge of one Guru-God Lord. "}}},{"verse_id":209565,"page_no":null,"line_no":455,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਅਉ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਕਾਨ ਸਿਖ ਦੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"raag naadh baadh aau sa(n)baadh patibrataa hui bin gur sabadh na kaan sikh dheen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a husband enjoys the subject of mode of singing musical instruments and other conversation, so does a Sikh in the service of the Guru talks and listens nothing other than the sound of the divine words of the Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209566,"page_no":null,"line_no":455,"gurmukhi":"ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਹੇਰੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"roop ra(n)g a(n)g saraba(n)g here patibrataa aan dhev sevak na dharasan keen hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a faithful wife admires the good looks, colour and beauty of all limbs of her husband, so does a devoted Sikh neither is the follower of any god nor proceeds to see any. Other than one True Guru, the form of True Master, he looks at no one else. "}}},{"verse_id":209567,"page_no":null,"line_no":455,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਜਨ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਗਉਨ ਕਰੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੯॥","translit_en":"sujan kuTa(n)b gireh gaun karai patibrataa aan dhev sathaan jaise jal bin meen hai ||449||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a faithful wife lives amongst close relatives and goes nowhere else; so does the Sikh of the Guru live in the court of the True Guru and assembly of His devotees. Leaving to him is like a fish dying after leaving water. (449)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41481,"next":41483}}
files.shabads/82/41483.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41483,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209568","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209568,"last_verse_id":209571,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209568,"page_no":null,"line_no":456,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮੈ ਕੁਆਰ ਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਹੀ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਭਲੀ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਹ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaisee naikaa mai kuaar paatr hee supaatr bhalee aas piaasee maataa pitaa ekai kaeh dhet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A virgin maid who is ever hopeful of achieving a place of superior authority in the house of a husband that her father will find for her one day is far better than a deceitful woman. "}}},{"verse_id":209569,"page_no":null,"line_no":456,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੀਨਤਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਭਲੀ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਇ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaisee naikaa mai dheenataa kai dhuhaagan bhalee patit paavan pria pai lai let hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A woman who has been disassociated with her husband by him and who regrets her actions by her humility, consequence of which her husband forgives her sins is far better than a deceitful woman. "}}},{"verse_id":209570,"page_no":null,"line_no":456,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਸੈ ਭਲੋ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਲਗਨ ਸਗਨ ਸੋਧੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਸਹੇਤ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"aaisee naikaa sai bhalo birahaa biog sog lagan sagan sodhe saradhaa sahet hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That woman separated from her husband who bearing the pangs of separation is devotedly involved in finding out auspicious time and good omens for the reunion is better than a treacherous and deceitful woman. "}}},{"verse_id":209571,"page_no":null,"line_no":456,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਭਲੀ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਹੁ ਕੇਤੁ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੦॥","translit_en":"aaisee naikaa maat garabh hee galee bhalee kapaT saneh dhubidhaa jiau raahu ket hai ||450||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a woman of deceitful love should have perished in her mother's womb. Deceit filled love is full of such duality as the two demons Rahu and Ketu are who cause solar and lunar eclipse.  (450)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41482,"next":41484}}
files.shabads/82/41484.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41484,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209572","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209572,"last_verse_id":209575,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209572,"page_no":null,"line_no":457,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਕੂਪ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਜਤਨ ਕੀਏ ਸੀਚੀਅਤ ਖੇਤ ਏਕੈ ਪਹੁਚਤ ਨ ਆਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise jal koop nikasat jatan ke'ee seecheeat khet ekai pahuchat na aan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as water from a well can be drawn by different methods, such as bucket and rope, Persian wheel etc. and then it is directed to irrigate a field and it goes nowhere else. "}}},{"verse_id":209573,"page_no":null,"line_no":457,"gurmukhi":"ਪਥਿਕ ਪਪੀਹਾ ਪਿਆਸੇ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਢਿਗ ਬੈਠਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਭਾਂਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"pathik papeehaa piaase aas lag ddig baiTh bin gun bhaa(n)jan tirapat kat praan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A traveller and a rain-bird may keep on sitting thirsty near a well but cannot quench their thirst without means to draw water from the well and therefore cannot assuage their thirst. "}}},{"verse_id":209574,"page_no":null,"line_no":457,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਤ ਫਲ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਸਮਾਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"taise hee sakal dhev Tev sai Tarat naeh sevaa ke'ee dhet fal kaamanaa samaan kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Likewise, all gods and goddesses can do something within their power. They can reward a devotee for his services only to that extent and that too of worldly desires. "}}},{"verse_id":209575,"page_no":null,"line_no":457,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਿਤਿ ਬਰਖ ਹਰਖਿ ਦੇਤ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਉ ॥੪੫੧॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gur barakhaa a(n)mirat hit barakh harakh dhet sarab nidhaan kau ||451||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The service of gods and goddesses is trivial in benefits whereas that of True Guru blesses one with Naam which is the treasure-house of all the virtues and spiritual happiness. (451)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41483,"next":41485}}
files.shabads/82/41485.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41485,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209576","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209576,"last_verse_id":209579,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209576,"page_no":null,"line_no":458,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਉਲੂ ਦਿਨ ਸਮੈ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise uloo dhin samai kaahooaai na dhekhio bhaavai taise saadh sa(n)gat mai aan dhev sevakai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as sight of an owl during the day is not appreciated by any body, so is a follower of a god not liked by the disciple of the True Guru in their holy congregation. "}}},{"verse_id":209577,"page_no":null,"line_no":458,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕਊਆ ਬਿਦਿਆਮਾਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਉ ਬੋਲੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise kuooaa bidhiaamaan bolat na kaahoo bhaavai aan dhev sevak jau bolai aha(n)mev kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a crow cawing is not appreciated by anyone, just as a devotee of a god is not appreciated in the holy assembly of god-like True Guru. (because he may be saying haughty traits of his deity) "}}},{"verse_id":209578,"page_no":null,"line_no":458,"gurmukhi":"ਕਟਤ ਚਟਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਹਾਇ ਨ ਕੁਟੇਵ ਕੈ ॥","translit_en":"kaTat chaTat savaiaan preet bipreet jaise aan dhev sevak suhai na kuTev kai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a dog licks when he is patted and bites when shouted and scolded at. (both acts are not good), "}}},{"verse_id":209579,"page_no":null,"line_no":458,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਸੋਭਤ ਨ ਬਗੁ ਠਗੁ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਪਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ॥੪੫੨॥","translit_en":"jaise maraal maal sobhat na bag Thag kaaddeeaai pakar kar aan dhev sevakai ||452||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a heron does not fit in the group of swans and is turned out from there, so does a devotee of some god or goddess not fit into the holy assembly of God-worshipping saints. Such fake devotees should be turned out from these assemblies.  (452)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41484,"next":41486}}
files.shabads/82/41486.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41486,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209580","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209580,"last_verse_id":209583,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209580,"page_no":null,"line_no":459,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਉਲੂ ਆਦਿਤ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੈ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise uloo aadhit udhot jot kau na jaane aan dhev sevakai na sujhai saadh sa(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an owl cannot know the greatness of sunlight, similarly a worshipper of other deities cannot have perception of True Guru's advice and company of the holy men. "}}},{"verse_id":209581,"page_no":null,"line_no":459,"gurmukhi":"ਮਰਕਟ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਿਕ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਜਾਨੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਨ ਸਬਦ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"marakaT man maanik mahimaa na jaane aan dhev sevak na sabadh prasa(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a monkey does not know the value of pearls and diamonds, so can a follower of other deities not assess the importance of Guru's sermon. "}}},{"verse_id":209582,"page_no":null,"line_no":459,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਫਨਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੈ ਪਾਨ ਮਹਾਤਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau fani(n)dhr pai paan mahaatamai na jaanai aan dhev sevak mahaa prasaadh a(n)g mai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a cobra cannot appreciate nectar-like milk, similarly a follower of other gods cannot understand significance of the blessings of the Guru's word and his consecrated gift of Karhah Parsad. "}}},{"verse_id":209583,"page_no":null,"line_no":459,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸ ਬਗ ਠਗ ਨ ਸਕਤ ਟਿਕ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੰਗ ਮੈ ॥੪੫੩॥","translit_en":"bin ha(n)s ba(n)s bag Thag na sakat Tik agam agaadh sukh saagar tara(n)g mai ||453||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an egret cannot fit in a flock of swans, a worshipper of other gods cannot stay in the society of devout Sikhs blessed by the True Guru, nor can he understand the deep nuances of the waves of knowledge and teachings of the Guru. (453)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41485,"next":41487}}
files.shabads/82/41487.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41487,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209584","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209584,"last_verse_id":209587,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209584,"page_no":null,"line_no":460,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਨਗਰ ਏਕ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਾਟੈ ਗਾਹਕ ਅਸੰਖ ਆਵੈ ਬੇਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਲੈਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau nagar ek hot hai anek haaTai gaahak asa(n)kh aavai bechan ar lain kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a town has many shops which are visited by many customers who go there to buy or sell their merchandise. "}}},{"verse_id":209585,"page_no":null,"line_no":460,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਪੈ ਕਛੁ ਬੇਚੈ ਅਰੁ ਬਨਜੁ ਨ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਨ ਪੈ ਬਿਸਾਹੈ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਖ ਨੈਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaa pai kachh bechai ar banaj na maa(n)gai paavai aan pai bisaahai jai dhekhai sukh nain kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a customer who has sold something at a shop is unable to buy something from there since it is not available, he visits other shops. Finding his requirements there, he feels happy and relaxed. "}}},{"verse_id":209586,"page_no":null,"line_no":460,"gurmukhi":"ਜਾ ਕੀ ਹਾਟ ਸਕਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਅਉ ਬਿਕਾਵੈ ਬੇਚਤ ਬਿਸਾਹਤ ਚਾਹਤ ਚਿਤ ਚੈਨ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"jaa kee haaT sakal samagree paavai aau bikaavai bechat bisaahat chaahat chit chain kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A shopkeeper who keeps all types of commodities in his shop and which are sold frequently, a customer generally likes to sell or purchase from there. He feels happy and satisfied. "}}},{"verse_id":209587,"page_no":null,"line_no":460,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਜਾਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਦੈਨ ਕਉ ॥੪੫੪॥","translit_en":"aan dhev sev jaeh satigur poore saeh sarab nidhaan jaa kai lain ar dhain kau ||454||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a follower of other god comes to the refuge of the perfect True Guru, he will find that his store-house is filled with all types of trading commodities (of loving worship).  (454)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41486,"next":41488}}
files.shabads/82/41488.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41488,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209588","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209588,"last_verse_id":209591,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209588,"page_no":null,"line_no":461,"gurmukhi":"ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖ ਹੋਇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"banaj biauhaar bikhai ratan paarakh hoi ratan janam kee pareekhiaa nahee paiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the profession of trading, a man can assess and evaluate pearls and diamonds but has not been able to evaluate this precious human birth and his aim of coming to this world. "}}},{"verse_id":209589,"page_no":null,"line_no":461,"gurmukhi":"ਲੇਖੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਸੇ ਲੇਖਕ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਅਸੰਕਾ ਨ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"lekhai chitr gupat se lekhak likhaaree bhe janam maran kee asa(n)kaa na miTaiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One can be a good accountant and expert in keeping accounts but has not been able to erase the repeated cycle of his birth and death. "}}},{"verse_id":209590,"page_no":null,"line_no":461,"gurmukhi":"ਬੀਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਬਲੀ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਧਨੁਖ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"beer bidhiaa mahaa balee bhe hai dhanukh dhaaree haumai maar na sahaj liv laiee hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the profession of fighting in the battlefields, a man may become very brave, strong and powerful, acquire sound knowledge of archery, but has failed to overpower his internal enemies of ego and pride so as to acquire spiritual stability through the teachings of the Guru. "}}},{"verse_id":209591,"page_no":null,"line_no":461,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਨ ਜਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੫॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gurdhev sev kaleekaal maiaa mai udhaasee gursikhan jataiee hai ||455||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Living in the world of maya (mammon), the disciples of the Guru who have remained unsoiled of it have learnt that in this dark eons, the meditation on the name of God-like True Guru is supreme.  (455)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41487,"next":41489}}
files.shabads/82/41489.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41489,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209592","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209592,"last_verse_id":209595,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209592,"page_no":null,"line_no":462,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਫਲ ਹੋਤ ਸਮੈ ਪਾਇ ਸਰਬਦਾ ਫਲੰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਫਲ ਸੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise aan birakh safal hot samai pai sarabadhaa fala(n)te sadhaa fal su savaiaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a tree bears fruit at a certain time of the year, but there are some trees which bear fruit all the time (like Kalap Variksh) and their fruit is very tasty too. "}}},{"verse_id":209593,"page_no":null,"line_no":462,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਪ ਜਲ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਹੈ ਜਤਨ ਕੀਏ ਗੰਗਾ ਜਲ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise koop jal nikasat hai jatan ke'ee ga(n)gaa jal mukat pravaeh prasaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as drawing water from the well demands some effort, but the flow of water in river Ganges is continuous and in plenty. "}}},{"verse_id":209594,"page_no":null,"line_no":462,"gurmukhi":"ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੂਲ ਤੇਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪੈ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਸੀਅਰ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"mritakaa agan tool tel mil dheep dhipai jagamag jot saseear bisamaadh hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the combination of an earthen lamp, oil, cotton and fire results in a light-giving lamp that spreads its radiance in a limited place, but the radiance of the moon shines in the whole world and spreads strange happiness all around. "}}},{"verse_id":209595,"page_no":null,"line_no":462,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਕੀਏ ਫਲੁ ਦੇਤ ਜੇਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸ ਨ ਸਾਸਨ ਜਮਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੬॥","translit_en":"taise aan dhev sev ke'ee fal dhet jet satigur dharas na saasan jamaadh hai ||456||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, whatever quantum of devoted service one performs for a god, one receives reward accordingly. But a vision of the True teacher dispels the fear of angels of death beside blessing I one with many other goods. (456)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41488,"next":41490}}
files.shabads/82/41490.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41490,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209596","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209596,"last_verse_id":209599,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209596,"page_no":null,"line_no":463,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਚ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕੈ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਰਥ ਸੇ ਪੰਚ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਾਹੂਐ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pa(n)ch parapa(n)ch kai bhe hai mahaa bhaarath se pa(n)ch maar kaahooaai na dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"During the times of Mahabharat, there had many warriors like the five Pandavas in the past but none ever endeavoured to end his duality by destroying the five vices residing within. "}}},{"verse_id":209597,"page_no":null,"line_no":463,"gurmukhi":"ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਨਵਿ ਨਾਥ ਸਿਧਿ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਮੈ ਤਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"gireh taj nav naath sidh jogeesur hui na tiragun ateet nij aasan mai taaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Renouncing home and family, many became the Masters, Sidhs and sages, but none had engrossed his mind in the higher spiritual state by keeping oneself free of the effect of the three traits of maya. "}}},{"verse_id":209598,"page_no":null,"line_no":463,"gurmukhi":"ਬੇਦ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਸਮੋਧ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨ ਹਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"bedh paaTh paR paR pa(n)ddit prabodhai jag sakai na samodh man tirasanaa na haaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A learned person imparts knowledge to the world by studying the Vedas and other scriptures, but he could not bring around his own mind nor end his worldly desires. "}}},{"verse_id":209599,"page_no":null,"line_no":463,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੭॥","translit_en":"pooran braham gurdhev sev saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat liv braham beechaaree hai ||457||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devoted Sikh of the Guru who in the company of saintly persons, and serving the Lord-like True Guru has engrossed his mind in the divine word, is in reality the real scholar of the Lord.  (457)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41489,"next":41491}}
files.shabads/82/41491.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41491,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209600","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209600,"last_verse_id":209603,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209600,"page_no":null,"line_no":464,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham sam dhekh samadharasee hui akath kathaa beechaar haar mon dhaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A pursuant disciple of the True Guru feels the presence of Lord Almighty in every living being and at all places, becomes impartial and instead of indulging in discussions of Lord's visible plays and performances, remains engrossed in Him. "}}},{"verse_id":209601,"page_no":null,"line_no":464,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"honahaar hoi taa(n) te aasaa te niraas bhe kaaran karan prabh jaan haumai maaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever is happening, is happening in His will. Thus such a disciple remains unsullied of all his desire. Knowing the traits of the Almighty who is the cause and effect of everything, he loses his pride and ego in accordance with immortal saying of Gurbani ''Main nahi Prabh sabh(u) kichh(u) tera\" "}}},{"verse_id":209602,"page_no":null,"line_no":464,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੁਇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sookham sathool oa(n)kaar kai akaar hui braham bibek budh bhe brahamachaaree hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He accepts that all big or small forms have come out of One Lord. Adopting the divine wisdom, he becomes Godly in character. "}}},{"verse_id":209603,"page_no":null,"line_no":464,"gurmukhi":"ਬਟ ਬੀਜ ਕੋ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੮॥","translit_en":"baT beej ko bithaar braham kai maiaa chhaiaa gurmukh ek Tek dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||458||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a well-spread banyan tree is born out of a seed, his form also spreads around in the form of maya. An obedient Sikh of the Guru removes his duality by leaning heavily on this support without being enamored by any other gods/godesses. (458)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41490,"next":41492}}
files.shabads/82/41492.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41492,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209604","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209604,"last_verse_id":209607,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209604,"page_no":null,"line_no":465,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਆਪਨੀ ਆਪਨੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਤਮਾਲ ਕਉ॥","translit_en":"jaise tau sakal dhrum aapanee aapanee bhaa(n)t cha(n)dhan cha(n)dhan karai sarab tamaal kau||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as all trees grow and spread according to the nature of their species and they cannot impose their influence on others but a sandalwood tree can make all other trees smell like itself. "}}},{"verse_id":209605,"page_no":null,"line_no":465,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਂਬਾ ਹੀ ਸੈ ਹੋਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਲੰਕੁ ਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਕਲ ਉਜਾਲ ਕਉ ॥","translit_en":"taa(n)baa hee sai hot jaise ka(n)chan kala(n)k ddaarai paaras paras dhaat sakal ujaal kau ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as addition of some special chemical in copper. can convert it into gold, but all metals can become gold by the touch of a philosopher-stone. "}}},{"verse_id":209606,"page_no":null,"line_no":465,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੰਗਮ ਸਮ ਜਲ ਸੁਢਾਲ ਕਉ॥","translit_en":"saritaa anek jaise bibidh pravaeh gat surasaree sa(n)gam sam jal suddaal kau||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as the flow of many rivers is different in many ways, but their water becomes pure and sacred once they mingle with water of river Ganges. "}}},{"verse_id":209607,"page_no":null,"line_no":465,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਟੇਵ ਸੈ ਟਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਲ ਕਉ ॥੪੫੯॥","translit_en":"taise hee sakal dhev Tev sai Tarat naeh satigur asaran saran akaal kau ||459||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, none of the gods and goddesses change their basic character. (They can reward someone according to their nature). But like sandalwood, philosopher-stone and river Ganges, the True Guru takes all under his refuge and blessing them with Naam Amrit, he unites them all with the Lord.  (459)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41491,"next":41493}}
files.shabads/82/41493.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41493,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209608","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209608,"last_verse_id":209611,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209608,"page_no":null,"line_no":466,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਰਗਟ ਕੈ ਰੰਗ ਕਮਲ ਸਮੇਹ ਬਹੁ ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਊਆ ਕਹਾਂ ਧਉ ਸਵਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"giragaT kai ra(n)g kamal sameh bahu ban ban ddolai kuooaa kahaa(n) dhau savaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A chameleon who changes the colour of its body so very often looks very much like the form of a lotus flower. But this insect-eating chameleon cannot be holding the merits of a lotus flower. A dead flesh-eating crow that flies here and there cannot reach a swan who eat pearls. "}}},{"verse_id":209609,"page_no":null,"line_no":466,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰ ਘਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਮੰਜਾਰ ਅਹਾਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਬੇਸ੍ਵਾ ਬਿਸਨੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਸਤੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"ghar ghar firat ma(n)jaar ahaar paavai besavaiaa bisanee anek satee na samaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a male cat roams about various burrows and houses searching for food, and likewise a whore living life of several vices cannot reach out to a woman of truth, sincerity and virtues. "}}},{"verse_id":209610,"page_no":null,"line_no":466,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰ ਸਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਜੀਵ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਮੋਨੀ ਬਗੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sar sar bhramat na milat maraal maal jeev ghaat karat na monee bag dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as wandering from pond to pond, one cannot find a flock of swans who live in lake Mansarover and an egret who kills living beings for food cannot be contemplating. "}}},{"verse_id":209611,"page_no":null,"line_no":466,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਦੁਰੰਗਧਿ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੦॥","translit_en":"bin gurdhev sev aan dhev sevak hui maakhee tiaag cha(n)dhan dhura(n)gadh asathaan hai ||460||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, without the service of perfect Guru, if someone becomes a follower of any other god/goddess, it is like a fly who giving up the fragrance of sandalwood goes and sits on foul smelling filth.  (460)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41492,"next":41494}}
files.shabads/82/41494.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41494,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209612","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209612,"last_verse_id":209615,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209612,"page_no":null,"line_no":467,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਹਾਟ ਕੇ ਹਟੂਆ ਲੇਤ ਹੈ ਘਟਾਇ ਮੋਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇ ਡਹਕਤ ਜੋਈ ਆਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"aan haaT ke haTooaa let hai ghaTai mol dhet hai chaRhai ddahakat joiee aavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a shopkeeper or a trader approaches another but a clever shopkeeper, the later sells his merchandise at a profit and manipulates to buy other's goods at a lesser price. "}}},{"verse_id":209613,"page_no":null,"line_no":467,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਨ ਸੈ ਬਨਜ ਕੀਏ ਬਿੜਤਾ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਊ ਟੋਟਾ ਕੋ ਬਨਜ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"tin sai banaj ke'ee biRataa na paavai kouoo ToTaa ko banaj pekh pekh pachhutaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dealing with such deceitful shopkeepers cannot be profitable. Every trader repents at conducting a deal at a loss. "}}},{"verse_id":209614,"page_no":null,"line_no":467,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਹਾਂਡੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਚਢੈ ਏਕੈ ਬਾਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਕਪਟ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਕੀਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਖਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"kaaTh kee haa(n)ddee jaise chaddai ekai baar kouoo kapaT biauhaar ke'ee aapeh lakhaavai jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a wooden pot can be used for cooking only once, similarly he who indulges in cheating in business exposes his self through his deceitful dealings. "}}},{"verse_id":209615,"page_no":null,"line_no":467,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹ ਗੁਨ ਬੇਚ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਲੇਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਜਸ ਜਗਤ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ਜੀ ॥੪੬੧॥","translit_en":"satigur saeh gun bech avagun let sun sun sujas jagat uTh dhaavai jee ||461||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The True Guru is a truthful trader who sells the commodity of virtues and in return takes away vices from Sikhs who come to trade with him. Listening to the glory of the True Guru, the world rushes to Him to obtain this invaluable commodity. (461)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41493,"next":41495}}
files.shabads/82/41495.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41495,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209616","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209616,"last_verse_id":209619,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209616,"page_no":null,"line_no":468,"gurmukhi":"ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"pooran braham samasar dhuteeaa naasat pratimaa anek hoi kaise ban aaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the perfect Lord manifests Himself totally in all and there is none like Him, then how can his myriad forms be made and installed in the temples? "}}},{"verse_id":209617,"page_no":null,"line_no":468,"gurmukhi":"ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾ ਮੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿੁ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"ghaT ghaT pooran braham dhekhai sunai bolai pratimaa mai kaahe na pragaT hui dhikhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When He Himself pervades in all, He Himself listens, speaks and sees, then why is He not seen speaking, listening and seeing in the idols of the temples? "}}},{"verse_id":209618,"page_no":null,"line_no":468,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰ ਘਾਰ ਘਰਨਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਹੁਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾ ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ-ਸਥਲ ਹੁਇ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"ghar ghaar gharan anek ek roop hute pratimaa sakal dheva-sathal hui na suhaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Every house has utensils of many form but made from the same material. Like that material, the light effulgent of the Lord exists in all. But why is that radiance not seen in its full grandeur in the idols installed in various temples? "}}},{"verse_id":209619,"page_no":null,"line_no":468,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸੋਈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜੁਗਲ ਹੁਇ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੪੬੨॥","translit_en":"satigur pooran braham saavadhaan soiee ek jot moorat jugal hui pujaaviee ||462||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru is the embodiment of the complete and perfect Lord, the light is one that exists both in Absolute and Transcendental form. The same Effulgent Lord is getting Himself worshipped in the form of True Guru.  (462)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41494,"next":41496}}
files.shabads/82/41496.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41496,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209620","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209620,"last_verse_id":209623,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209620,"page_no":null,"line_no":469,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਨਸਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਸਰ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਠੇ ਹੰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਜਲ-ਜੰਤ ਹੰਸ ਬੰਸਹਿ ਲਜਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"maanasar tiaag aan sar jai baiThe ha(n)s khai jala-ja(n)t ha(n)s ba(n)seh lajaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a swan leaves lake Mansarover and resides in a pond, starts eating living beings from the pond like a heron, he will shame the species of swans. "}}},{"verse_id":209621,"page_no":null,"line_no":469,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਅਤ ਜਉ ਰਹੈ ਮੀਨ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੈ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"salil bichhoh bhe jeeat jau rahai meen kapaT saneh kai sanehee na kahaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a fish survives outside water, then its love for water will be considered false and it would not be called as beloved of water. "}}},{"verse_id":209622,"page_no":null,"line_no":469,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਘਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਉ ਅਨਤ ਜਲ ਪਾਨ ਕਰੈ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਲਾਛਨ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥","translit_en":"bin ghan boo(n)dh jau anat jal paan karai chaatirak sa(n)taan bikhai laachhan lagaaviee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a rain-bird satiates its thirst with a drop of water other than the swati drop, he would stigmatise his family. "}}},{"verse_id":209623,"page_no":null,"line_no":469,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਲਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੋਖ ਹੁਇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕ ਹੁਇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੪੬੩॥","translit_en":"charan kamal al gursikh mokh hui aan dhev sevak hui mukat na paaviee ||463||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A devoted disciple of the True Guru preaches the teachings of the True Guru and achieves emancipation. But a disciple who gives up his love for the True Guru serves and worships other gods and self-made saints can never be liberated. (463)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41495,"next":41497}}
files.shabads/82/41497.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41497,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209624","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209624,"last_verse_id":209627,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209624,"page_no":null,"line_no":470,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਮਵਾਸ ਸਾਧਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਆਨਿ ਤਾ ਪਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਰਖ ਨਰਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jau kouoo mavaas saadh bhoomeeaa milaavai aan taa par prasa(n)n hot nirakh nari(n)dh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If a brave warrior defeats a rebel landlord and brings him into the protection of the king, the king rewards him out of happiness and glory is bestowed upon him. "}}},{"verse_id":209625,"page_no":null,"line_no":470,"gurmukhi":"ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਪੈ ਜਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਮਾਰੇ ਭੂਮੀਆ ਸਹਿਤ ਹੀ ਰਜਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"jau kouoo nirapat bhirat bhaag bhoomeeaa pai jai dhai maare bhoomeeaa sahit hee raji(n)dh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"But if an employee of the king absconds the king and joins the rebel landlord, the king launches a campaign against him and kills both the rebel landlord as well as the disloyal servant. "}}},{"verse_id":209626,"page_no":null,"line_no":470,"gurmukhi":"ਆਨ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਰੇਸ਼ ਆਨ ਦੁਆਰ ਜਾਤ ਨਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥","translit_en":"aan ko sevak raaj dhuaar jai sobhaa paavai sevak naresh aan dhuaar jaat ni(n)dh jee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If someone's employee takes refuge of the king, he earns praise there. But if a servant of the king goes to someone, he earns slander from all around. "}}},{"verse_id":209627,"page_no":null,"line_no":470,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਅਨਤ ਸਰਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਨ ਨ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ॥੪੬੪॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh aan anat saran gur aan na samarath gursikh prat bi(n)dh jee ||464||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly, if a devotee of some god/goddess comes to the True Guru as a devoted disciple, the True Guru bless him with His refuge, initiates him in the meditation of His name. But no god or goddess is capable of granting refuge to any devoted Sikh of the True Guru.  (464)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41496,"next":41498}}
files.shabads/82/41498.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41498,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209628","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209628,"last_verse_id":209631,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209628,"page_no":null,"line_no":471,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਉਪਬਨ ਆਂਬ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਹੈ ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jaise upaban aa(n)b se(n)bal hai uooch neech nihafal safal pragaT pahichaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as there are mango and silk cotton trees in the same garden, but a mango tree is more respected because of the fruits that it yields, whereas the Silk cotton tree being without fruits is considered inferior. "}}},{"verse_id":209629,"page_no":null,"line_no":471,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਸਮੀਪ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਂਸ ਅਉ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਗੰਧ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤਿ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sameep jaise baa(n)s aau banaasapatee ga(n)dh niraga(n)dh siv sakat kai jaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as in a jungle, there are sandalwood and bamboo trees. Since bamboo remains devoid of fragrance is known as egoistic and proud, whereas others absorb sandalwood's fragrance and are considered peace and comfort-giving trees. "}}},{"verse_id":209630,"page_no":null,"line_no":471,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਪ ਸੰਖ ਦੋਊ ਜੈਸੇ ਰਹਿਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੰਤਤਿ ਨ ਸਮਤ ਬਿਧਾਨੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"seep sa(n)kh dhouoo jaise rahit samu(n)dhr bikhai savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh sa(n)tat na samat bidhaaneeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as an oyster and conch shell are found in the same sea but oyster accepting ambrosial drop of rain water yields a pearl whereas a conch shell remains useless. Thus both cannot be graded equal. "}}},{"verse_id":209631,"page_no":null,"line_no":471,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵਕਨ ਭੇਦ ਅਹੰ ਬੁਧਿ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਅਮਾਨ ਜਗ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੬੫॥","translit_en":"taise gurdhev aan dhev sevakan bhedh aha(n) budh nimrataa amaan jag maaneeaai ||465||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Similarly there is a difference between the devotees of the True Guru-the blesser of truth, and gods and goddesses. files.shabads/82/41499.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":41499,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":47,"page_no":null,"shabad_name":"209632","verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":209632,"last_verse_id":209635,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Vaaran","raag_unicode":"ਵਾਰ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":209632,"page_no":null,"line_no":472,"gurmukhi":"ਜੈਸੇ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੀ ਕੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"jaise patibrataa par purakhai na dhekhio chaahai pooran patibrataa kai pat hee kai dhiaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a faithful wife does not like to look at another man and being sincere and faithful always supports her husband in her mind. "}}},{"verse_id":209633,"page_no":null,"line_no":472,"gurmukhi":"ਸਰ ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਆਸ ਘਨ-ਬੂੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਗੁਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"sar saritaa samu(n)dhr chaatirak na chaahai kaahoo aas ghana-boo(n)dh pria pria gun giaan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a rain-bird does not want water from a lake river or sea, but keeps on wailing for Swati drop from the clouds. "}}},{"verse_id":209634,"page_no":null,"line_no":472,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਨਕਰ ਓਰ ਭੋਰ ਚਾਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਚਕੋਰ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਿਮਕਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹੈ ॥","translit_en":"dhinakar or bhor chaahat nahee chakor man bach kram himakar pria praan hai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Just as a Ruddy sheldrake does not like to look at the Sun even when the Sun is rising because the moon is his beloved in all respects. "}}},{"verse_id":209635,"page_no":null,"line_no":472,"gurmukhi":"ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਰਹਤਿ ਪੈ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਨ ਅਵਗਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੬॥","translit_en":"taise gursikh aan dhev sev rahat pai sahaj subhaav na avagiaa abhimaan hai ||466||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So is a devoted disciple of the True Guru who does not worship any other god or goddess except the dearer than his life-True Guru. But, by remaining in a state of tranquility, he neither disrespects anyone nor shows the arrogance of his supremacy.  (466)"}}}],"nav":{"prev":41498,"next":41500}}
